khrinori ridhe+o glusde+ogrewīhūṃ 4ne+e dzerbe— — /5rdotrīgyi/〉tsho ritshe byulā — dosdu — ji 4 ——rngudwo— rna staḍho
r+sā྾ṭhaṣ+ṭha༈auṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhazloḍālkoshāmeloblabod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig lo rgyus/chab 'gag rta mgrin gyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagale'u dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi sbyi tshogs rgyab ljongs/ (1)le'u gnyis pa/ krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes pa'i dus mgo'i bod kyi rtsom pa po grags can 'ga'i brtsams chos bshad pa/ (7)dang po/ rtsom rig gi skabs bab bshad pa/ (7)gnyis pa/ brtsams chos dngos bshad pa/ (12)gcig rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/ (12)gnyis/ tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang gi rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/ (34)gsum/ bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/ (45)bzhi/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/ (57)gsum pa/ mjug sdud pa'i gtam/ (79)le'u gsum pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig bshad pa/ (83)

dang po/ dus skabs gsar pa'i dus mgo'i bod kyi rtsom rig bstan bcos 'ga' bshad pa/ (83)gcig dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi(snyan ngag la 'jug tshul tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed〉 bshad pa/ (87)gnyis/ tshe tan zhabs drung gi(snyan ngag spyi don〉 bshad pa (97)gsum/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan gyi〈tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs〉 bshad pa/ (103)bzhi/ dor zhi snyems pa'i blo gros kyi〈snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus kyi don 'grel shes bya'i gnad gsal〉 bshad pa/ (108)gnyis pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag bshad pa/ (121)gcig bzang por bstod pa'i skor/ (122)gnyis/ ngan pa ther 'don gyi skor/ (142)gsum/ rang mos snyan ngag gi skor/ (148)bzhi/ byung brjod snyan ngag gi skor/ (156)lnga/ snyan ngag 'gyur ma'i skor/ (159)gsum pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi sgrung gtam bshad pa/ (164)gcig dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam gyi byung ba bshad pa/ (165)2

gnyis/ dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam gyi snang tshul gtso bo bshad pa/ (176)gsum/ dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos bshad pa/ (200)bzhi/ dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam 'gyur ma bshad pa/ (203)bzhi pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi lhug rtsom bshad pa/ (211)gcig dus skabs gsar pa'i lhug rtsom gyi byung ba bshad pa/ (211)gnyis/ gnas rnying dang yul srol ngo sprod pa'i lhug rtsom/ (216)gsum/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom/ (224)bzhi/ skye khams srung skyob mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom/ (237)lnga pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig dpyad rtsom bshad pa/ (243)gcig deng rabs rtsom rig skor gyi dpyad rtsom/ (244)gnyis/ gna' rabs rtsom rig skor gyi dpyad rtsom/ (255)gsum/ rtsom rig shes bya'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom/ (257)drug pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig bshad pa/ (263)gcig dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi 'chad nyan spel ba/ (264)3
bya‘papa

le'u dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi spyi tshogs rgyab ljongs/krung go gung khran tang gis dbu khrid mdzad 'og 1949lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes gcig nyin/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes shing / lo rgyus kyi dus rabs gsar pa de lta bu'i 'gros kyi rgyun mthud nas/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum nas bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi dang smad mdo khams sgang drug gi sa yi khyon chen por gnas shing 'tsho ba'i smug po bod kyi gdung rgyud rnams kyang char rjes sha mo brdol ba'i dpal ltar 'phro rim 'phror spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs rnying ba'i 'ching rgya las rnam par grol te/krung hwa nor 'dzin chen po'i mi rigs khag dang lhan du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bzhud lam yangs pa'i steng du gom kha'i kha lo mngon par bsgyur pas/ bsam blo'i 'du shes dang srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi/dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen/ rig gnas kyi chu tshad sogs la snga na med pa'i 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba yin no/ /bsam blo'i 'du shes la 'pho 'gyur byung ba/ rgyal yongs rigs so so'i mi dmangs la dbu khrid mdzad pa'i krung go gung khran tang ni mar le ring lugs la rjes su yi rang zhu zhing de rang gi bsam blo'i slob ston du byed pa'i srid 'dzin tang zhig yin pas/ dus dang rnam

pa kun tu mar le ring lugs la sbyang brtson byas nas rang gi chab srid kyi go rtogs je mthor gtong ba dang 'jig rten gyi lta ba legs por gyur par ma zad/ chab srid dang dril bsgrags/ slob gso/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/ rigs gzhung sogs las rigs so sor brten nas mar le ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pas/ bod kyi srid 'dzin mi sna nas mi ser dkyus ma'i bar du'ang lta ba de rim gyis sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur cing / bod mi mang po'i rang gi bsam sbyor la khrid ston byed pa'i phyogs ston 'khor lor 'gyur 'go brtsams shing / spyi tshogs kyi gnad don gang yin rung tshan rig dang mthun pa'i lta ba dang thabs shes spyad nas rtog zhib dang thag gcod byed kyin yod/ bod mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes la 'pho 'gyur gsar pa byung ba des bod kyi spyi tshogs hril bor 'phel 'gyur byed par sman pa'i nus pa bskyed do/ /srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi la 'pho 'gyur byung ba/ lo ngo brgya phrag du ma'i bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'ching rgya yongs su dkrol rjes/ lo rgyus kyi rmang gzhi dang sa bab kyi cha rkyen/skabs bab kyi gnas tshul/ do dam gyi dgos mkho/ mi rigs kyi 'brel ba sogs la dmigs nas/ bod 'di rje dpon so sos dum bur bcad nas dbang bsgyur pa'i sgrig srol rnying pa rtsa ba nas dor zhing / srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi gsar pa ste/ bod rang skyong ljongs dang / yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul/ dkar mdzes bod rigs 2

rang skyong khul/ mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul/ mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul/ mtsho byang bod rigs rang skyong khul/ mtsho nub sog bod rang skyong khul/ rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul/ kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul/ rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul/ bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul/ dpa' ris bod rigs rang skyong khul/ smi li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong bcas rang skyong ljongs gcig dang rang skyong khul bcu/ rang skyong rdzong gnyis bcas su dbye ba dang chabs cig rang skyong las khungs dang rang skyong khrims srol/ rang skyong dbang cha/ rang skyong las 'gan sogs kyang btsugs shing gtan 'beb mdzad nas mi rigs rang skyong byas pas/ bod mi rigs kyi rang khyim rang bdag gi brtson sems skul spel byed pa dang / mi rigs rang skyong sa khul dang rgyal yongs kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun las don 'phel rgyas su gtong ba bcas la nus pa ha cang chen po bskyed pa red/dpal 'byor la 'phel 'gyur byung ba/ rgyal khab kyi mtha' mtshams srung skyob dang bod kyi sa gnas 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i ched du/ mtsho bod gzhung lam dang khron bod gzhung lam/ yun bod gzhung lam/ zhin bod gzhung lam/ bal bod gzhung lam sogs kyis gtsos bod kyi sa khul dang rdzong so sor bgrod pa'i yan lag gzhung lam rim bzhin las nas rlangs 'khor shar gtong byas shing / pe cin nas lha sa dang / lha sa nas ne pa la/ pe cin nas zi ling bcas 3

bar du mkha' lam btod de/ dmangs spyod gnam gru mngag gtong byas la/ mtsho bod lcags lam las nas me 'khor shar gtong thub pa byung yod/ bod kyi sa khul so so dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi sa cha khag bar du rlangs 'khor dang me 'khor/ gnam gru bcas mngag gtong byas pa des rgyal khab dang sa gnas de dag bar dngos zog brje res dang bsam blo brje res/ rig gnas brje res sogs byed pa'i mthun rkyen chen po zhig tu gyur/ 'grim 'grul gyi dra ba cha tshang zhig grub par brten nas mi rigs dang rgyal khab gzhan gyi dngos zog gsar pa dang sngon thon rig gnas nang 'dren byas pa des bod kyi dngos po'i cha rkyen je legs dang thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas/tshan rig lag rtsal je mtho bcas su 'gro bar bsnyon du med pa'i nus pa bskyed pa dang / de sngon bod kyi 'tsho ba dang zhing phyugs thon skyed las dbang ngam gnam 'ba' zhig la re ba'i goms srol rnying ba de rim gyis nyams par gyur cing / tshan rig dang mthun pa'i sgo nas zhing phyugs thon skyed gnyer pas/ sngon chad 'byung ma myong ba'i grub 'bras gsar pa thon/ bzo las dang glog 'don las rigs/gter 'don las rigs/ 'khel 'thag las rigs/ las snon las rigs sogs kyang rim bzhin rnam grangs je mang dang yo byad 'phrul chas can/ thon tshad je mtho bcas su phyin nas bod kyi dngos po'i 'tsho ba je legs su 'gro bar ma zad/ rgyal khab spyi'i dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang mtha' mtshams srung skyob byed par yang 4

phan pa chen po byung yod/rig gnas slob gso dang tshan rig 'phrod bsten sogs la 'phel 'gyur byung pa/ de yang bod 'dir sngon chad srol rgyun gyi slob gso'i sgrig gzhi ste dgon pa las deng rabs khyad chos can gyi slob grwa shin tu nyung rung / bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshun la/ bod kyi sa gnas so sor rim bzhin slob chung nas slob grwa chen mo bar gyi slob gso'i ma lag cha tshang zhig chags pa dang / des bod kyi las rigs khag la shes ldan mi sna 'bor chen zhig skyed sring byas pas/ bod khul gyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun las don gong du spel bar nus shugs chen po bskyed/ der ma zad tang gi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus lag bstar dngos 'beb byas te/ bod kyi dgon sde khag sor bzhag mdzad pa de bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed par ched gnyer sgrig gzhi dang mi sna nges can zhig yod par gyur/ de bod kyi slob gso dang rig gzhung zhib 'jug ma lag gi grub cha gal chen zhig byas nas/ bod kyi slob gso dang rig gzhung zhib 'jug bya bzhag gong du spel bar phyag rjes brjod gyis mi lang pa bskrun/ dus mtshungs su zlos gar sna tshogs 'khrab ston dang glog brnyan sgyur skrun 'grem ston byas shing /pe cin dang bod ljongs/ bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi zhing chen du mi rigs dpe skrun khang btsugs te bod kyi rig gnas rtsom rig gi dpe cha mang po dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pas/ bod kyi rig gnas 5

'tsho ba yang sngar las phun sum tshogs por gyur/ gso ba rig pa'ang bod kyi nad gso sman bcos kyi goms phyogs dang mkho ba ltar sa khul mang por srol rgyun gyi sman rtsis khang btsugs shing sgrig chas dang sman rdzas deng rabs can du bsgyur ba dang chabs cig phyi lugs sman khang yang mi nyung ba zhig btsugs nas/ bod mi rigs kyi na ba'i sdug bsngal je chung du gtong gang thub byas/ 'di ni bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig 'byung ba'i spyi tshogs kyi rgyab ljongs yin/

le'u gnyis pa/ krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes pa'i dus mgo'i bod kyi rtsom pa po grags can 'ga'i brtsams chos bshad pa/dang po/ rtsom rig gi skabs bab bshad pa/rgyal yongs bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshun la bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs dang / bsam blo'i 'du shes/ dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen/rig gnas kyi chu tshad sogs la snga na med pa'i 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba dang chabs cig ‘‘rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa dang / bzo zhing dmag gsum la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’pa'i byed phyogs gtan la phab pas/ krung hwa nor 'dzin chen po'i khyon yongs su rtsom rig 'du shes 'di 'dra zhig grub pa ste/ chab srid lam phyogs la bstun zhing chab srid kyi dgos mkho bskong ba'i rtsom rig ngo bo'i 'du shes dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs dang dngos yod ring lugs zung du 'brel ba dang /gsar brje'i dngos yod ring lugs dang gsar brje'i 'char yan ring lugs zung du 'brel ba'i rtsom rig rtsom thabs kyi 'du shes/dpe mtshon khor yug khrod kyi dpe mtshon mi sna btod pa'i rtsa don ltar/ dpa' bo'i snang brnyan gsar pa btod pa gtso bo yin pa'i mi 7

sna'i 'du shes/ gzhung sger gnyis kyi 'gal ba mtshon par byed pa gzhi rtsa'i nang don yin pa'i brjod bya'i bstan don gyi 'du shes shig grub/ der brten rtsom pa po rgan pa khag cig gis sngar gyi 'tsho ba dang sngar gyi bsam phyogs bskyur nas/ 'tsho ba gsar pa dang mang tshogs gsar pa/ dpa' bo gsar pa bcas dang mnyam du 'tsho ba las gsar rtsom 'gyur ldog gi 'byung rtsa 'tshol dgos par gyur/ de yang brtsams sgrung rtsom tshe yongs khyab kyis spyi tshogs kyi brjod bya gal chen dang / deng rabs lo rgyus thog gi don rkyen gal chen btsal nas brtsams pas/ spyi tshogs kyi chab srid las 'gul dang srid jus/ las 'gan gtso bo bcas dang 'brel ba'i brtsams chos rtsom gang thub byas/ dpe de bzhin du bod kyi rtsom pa po mang che ba de snga dgon pa'i slob gso cha tshang myong mkhan yin zhing / khong tshos ston pa shākya thub pa'i gsung la blo sems rtse gcig gis dad cing rang gi bsam sbyor la slob ston byed pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs su bsten pa dang / brtsams chos kyi brjod bya'i nang don dang mtshon bya'i dgongs pa'ang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad tshul dang thar ba'i lam la skul ba de yin pas/ glo bur du rtsom rig gi 'du shes dang chab srid kyi 'du shes/ 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bcas bsgyur nas/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa de re zhig mi goms pa ltar snang yang /rim gyis srid dang dus kyi blang bya gsar pa ltar hur brtson gyis rtsom pa mdzad pas/ dus rabs kyi khyad chos mtshon pa'i snyan rtsom

dang bslab bya/ glu tshig 'gyur yig sogs mi nyung ba zhig thon/ de yang skabs der srid phyogs nas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi byed phyogs gtan la phab pa dang de lag bstar bya dgos pa'i blang bya bton pa dang gcig khong tsho'i 'khrungs yul dang nye 'brel/ sbyin bdag tshang ma grong pa yin pas/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i ser skya mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul gsal bor mkhyen par ma zad/ bcings 'grol byas pa'i rjes su'ang‘‘dge mtshan ldan pa'i stobs shugs yod tshad la mthun sgril byed pa'i’’'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus lag bstar byas nas khong tsho'i yon tan mu mthud du spyod du bcug cing /rgyal gces mi sna khag cig la da dung srid phyogs kyi go gnas sprad pa dang chabs cig nang logs kyi dar rgyas che ba'i sa khul dang grong khyer/ bzo grwa/ dmag dpung / 'brel yod kyi rgyal khab bcas la gzigs skor du khrid pas/ tang gi srid jus kyi yang dag rang bzhin dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dge mtshan rang bzhin mngon par mkhyen zhing / dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi zil shugs gsar bor rtogs pa dang gnyis/ tang dang rgyal khab kyi gtso 'jin rnam par mjal 'phrad zhu ba'i go skabs mang bas khong rnam pa'i thugs gshis dang dgongs pa/ mthu nus bcas la rgyus mnga' ba dang gsum/ khong tsho mang che bas de snga dgon par〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa zhig mdzad par ma zad/ de'i lugs ltar bstod tshogs dang snyan 9

ngag mang du brtsams shing / lugs kyi bstan bcos dang bslab bya sogs la gzigs rgya yangs shing / rtsom lus de dag rtsom par shin tu goms pa dang bzhi/ skabs de'i bod phyogs kyi las rigs so so'i thad byung ba'i mi gsar don gsar dang grub 'bras gsar pa sogs sku dngos kyis mthong myong ba dang lnga bcas rkyen gyis/ skabs de'i brtsams chos mang che ba bstod pa yin zhing ched dmigs kyi bsam don de brjod par 'phrod pa'i rtsom lus ni snyan ngag yin la/rtsom pa po goms par gyur pa'ang de yin pas snyan ngag gi rnam pa spyad pa mang /rtsom pa por 'gyur ldog cher ma byung rung brjod bya'i nang don ni dngos yod spyi tshogs steng byung ba'i bya dngos gsar pa dang 'tsho ba gsar pa/ mi sna ngo ma/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying zhib sdur byed pa sogs yin pas/ de dag las mngon par mtshon pa'i don gtso che shos kyang tang gi srid jus dang rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs/ bod kyi 'tsho ba gsar pa/ las rigs so so'i grub 'bras bcas la bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor pa dang /tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bsam sbyor la zur za'i mda' mo 'phen pa/rjes lus kyi rnam par 'tshang 'byin gyi mtshon cha snun zhing sngon thon gyi lam la gsal ston gyi sgron me sbar ba/ mi rigs kyi brtson sems skul spel dang mthun sgril gyi dgos gal gnad du ston pa sogs yin/ skabs de'i klog pa po mang che ba bzo shing dmag gsum yin 10

pas/ de dag gis go bar bya ba'i phyir/ mngon brjod dang brda rnying /chos lugs kyi tha snyad mang pos ma bcings la/ go dka' ba'i 'khyog brjod kyi rgyan mang pos kyang ma spros par/ tshig sbyor mdzes shing mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi skad cha dang mthun che la/ tshad ldan gyi brda sprod rig pa dang yang mi 'gal ba'i sgo nas brjod don rnams gzugs brnyan ji bzhin mtshon par byed pa'i rtsom rig skad cha spyad pa red/ rtsom srol thad〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉gi lugs ltar brtsams pas/ tshig gi sdeb sbyor tshags zhib cing gzab nan yin la nyams 'gyur ldan pa/ dngos bstan gyi don gsal zhing shugs mtshon gyi don zab cing rgya che ba red/ yin na'ang skabs der chab srid kyi dgos pa nan du bzung drags pas/ chab srid las 'gul dang lte ba'i bya bar bstun thabs byed pa'i brtsams chos mi nyung rung brjod bya'i nang don dang rnam pa mi mang / rtsom pa po rnams 'tsho ba gsar par bstod pa'i spro sems che yang / de 'dra'i gting zab la 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal dang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i 'gal ba ngos 'dzin byas pa mi 'dang pa red/ rtsom pa po'i do snang byed sa de phyi ngos kyi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa zhib 'bri byed par 'khor ba las mi'i rang snang gi 'jig rten dang brtse dung gi 'tsho ba mtshon par byas pa mngon gsal gyis mi 'dang pa red/11

gnyis pa/ brtsams chos dngos bshad pa/gcig rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho ni/mdo smad rdo sbis gser smug ljongs kyi khongs gtogs hor gro ba zhes pa'i grong sde der yab lha lung skyabs dang / yum lha lung skyid gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo1884lor 'khrungs shing / dgung lo lnga ba'i tshe sgo mang dge bshes lha rams pa nor bu rin po che'i drung nas rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par bzhes te/ rdo sbis grwa tshang gi chos sgor zhugs nas yi ge sbyor klog la sbyang ba legs par mdzad/dgung lo bcu drug gi ston khar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te/ a khu gong thang blo gros dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug sogs sde snod 'dzin pa'i bla ma du ma bsten nas slob gnyer mdzad pa dang / khyad par du a khu gong thang blo gros tshang gi mdun nas dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par mnos pa yin/dgung lo nyer gcig gi tshe/ khong lha sar phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos sgor zhugs shing mdo sngags rig gnas yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo mchog grub dkar po 12

dang / bla ma 'bul sdud rin po che blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag gsum lhag spyi bo'i cod pan du bsten te rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam mthar phyin par mdzad nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan la mnga' brnyes shing sgo thams cad nas 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/dgung lo so gsum gyi steng dmigs bsal gyis lha rams pa 'phar ma'i ming btags byung ba dang / nor bu gling ga'i rtsod rgyugs tshe ang dang po byung ba/ rtse gzim chung du tshogs langs dmigs bsal can gnang ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i mdzad bzang mang po grub/ de lo'i smon lam nyi shu bzhi'i nyin nor bu gling gar gzhung gi sku drag ser skya tshang 'dzoms kyi dbus su rtse drung yig chen po chos dar lags nas lha rams pa'i dam bca' ang grangs kyi rim pa sgrig skabs/ tā la'i bla ma'i bka' lung ltar rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i ang dang po ni 'bras spungs sgo mang klu 'bum dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho'o zhes mtshan snyan me tog gi phreng ba dgung la 'thor pas der bzhugs tshogs pa kun gyi ngo mtshar dang rjes su yi rang tshad med byas/dgung lo so bzhi par tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub 13

bstan rgya mtsho'i bka' lung ltar bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub kyi gsung 'bum dpar gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi zhu dag mdzad/ lo drug tsam gyis gsung 'bum po ti nyer dgu'i zhu dag legs par grub/ da dung rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dpar gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi zhu dag mdzad de lo brgyad tsam gyis dpar gzhi gsar bzhengs legs grub byung /dgung lo nga lnga la phebs tshe/ skabs de'i rgyal khab kyi srid dbang 'dzin mkhan go min tang gis gdan drangs pa ltar nang sar phebs nas chos srid zung gi bya ba mang po mdzad pa dang / khyad par krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes rjes mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bka' ltar bstan 'gro spyi la phan pa'i thugs smon rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas chos srid gnyis ka'i thad nas rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad bzang gi gru char bsnyil bar mdzad/dgung lo don gsum gyi tshe/ rgya gar dang bal bo rgyal khab gnyis kyis gdan zhus ltar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya'i rjes dran tshogs chen la zhugs/ gzhan yang de'i sngon gzhug tu 'bar ma dang / can pu'u kre/sing ga la/ ros tan sogs chos ldan rgyal khab dag la phebs nas de ga'i chos pa rnams la bka' chos mang du gsungs shing bstan pa spyi dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i mdzad 'phrin rgya chen po mdzad do/ /khong gis de ltar chos srid zung gi 'phrin las rgya chen po spel 14

mthar spyi lo1968lor grong khyer zi ling du dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan to/ /①khong gis dgung lo bco lnga'i steng nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba spyi'i don la dmigs nas ljags rtsom ha cang mang po brtsams mod/ bstan pa 'phel 'grib dang dus kyi 'gyur ba'i dbang gis gsung rtsom gyi ma phyi po ti bcu phrag lhag med du gyur la/da lta dngos su par du bskrun pa la po ti gsum bzhugs pa las mang che shos bcings 'grol sngon du brtsams pa'i gzhung 'grel dang grub mtha'/ dgag yig dpyad rtsom/ rtogs brjod/ bslab bya/'phrin yig gnas bstod/ gsol 'debs/ bsang mchod/ bca' yig sogs yin pas/ brtsams chos de dag la khyad du 'phags pa'i dgos pa dang / gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos/ mngon par 'phags pa'i nus pa brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig mchis mod/ 'dir brjod par 'os pa'am 'dod pa ni gtso bor bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshun du brjod bya gsar pa las brtsams pa'i brtsams chos yin/ de yang1949lo nas rgyal yongs mi rigs khag rnams krung go gung khran tang gi dbu khrid 'og lam lugs rnying pa'i 'ching rgya las rnam par grol zhing / spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba sogs 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba dang bstun nas/ dge bshes rin po che yang rgyal yongs kyi mkhas pa gzhan dag dang 'dra bar/ bya dngos gsar pa brjod pa dang bya dngos gsar pa de dag la 'dzin 15

pa'i lta ba mtshon pa'i snyan ngag gam bslab bya sogs mang po brtsams nas skabs de'i rtsom rig dang spyi tshogs la yar skul chen po mdzad/ brtsams chos de dag brjod bya'i nang don cha nas dbye na/gung khran tang dang de'i srid jus la bsngags pa brjod pa dang gcig ma'o tse tung dang khong gi dgongs par bstod bsngags 'bul ba dang gnyis/ bcings 'grol dmag gi drag pa'i rtsal dang zhi ba'i spyod par bsngags pa dang gsum/ tshul min gyi bsam sbyor dgag cing 'jug ldog gi gnas ston pa dang bzhi bcas 'dus pa 'di ltar/ (bslab bya rang byung lha'i rnga bo〉zhes pa las/rgyal yongs mi dmangs sdug bsngal khri khrag gis/ /mnar pa'i nyams la snying rje ma bzod par/ /'jigs bral dpa' bo'i go cha lhur bzhes te/ /dang por dgra las rgyal ba gung khran tang / /rang la chos lugs med cing khas mi len/ /gzhan la mi 'gog dad mos rang dbang ste/ /chab srid tang gi srol ltar brtsi dgos pa/ /gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' yin/ /blo mthun ma'o tse tung dang mkhas mang gis/ /lan brgyar brtags pa las byung rtsa ba'i khrims/ /dar cha gsum dang tang gi rnam 'dren la/ /spyi 'bangs kun gyis yid ches bya dgos pa/ /

gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' yin/ /rtsad nas dgag dgos dgra yi 'gal ba dang / /bcos pas tshogs pa nang gi 'gal ba gnyis/ /so sor phye nas nyams su bstar dgos pa/ /gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' yin/ /btsan rgyal lugs la sdang mig dmar po dang / /spyi tshogs lugs la dga' mgu'i mdzum dkar gnyis/ /gsal bar ston pa'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dzol ba/ /gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' yin/ /a ris shog gu'i stag dang wu ba'i gsob/ /che drag rdzig nyams cho 'phrul ci bstan kyang / /bden don brtag bzod til tsam ma dmigs pa/ /gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' yin/ /chung nga'i rgyal khab yi dwags 'dra ba 'ga'/ /nor gyis bslus pas rang gi phyogs su 'khrid/ /gzhan la'ang srin mo 'dzum 'drar shes dgos pa/ /gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' yin/ /deng sang srid na krung go 'phrul gyis che/ /btsan lugs mis gos spyi bor 'phur ba dang / /de yi snying rtsa 'dar bar shes dgos pa/ /'di ni tang gi da lta'i grub mtha' yin/ /17

zhes 'khod yod/ brtsams chos 'di lta bur mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos kun gyis go sla ba'i bslab bya'i tshul gyis krung go gung khran tang ni btsan po gnya' nas gnon zhing gnyom chung mtha' nas skyong pa'i skyabs mgon yin tshul brjod pa nas dbu brtsams te/ tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus dang rtsa ba'i blang bya/ dgra dang rang phyogs bar gyi 'gal ba sdum thabs med pa dang mi dmangs nang khul gyi 'gal ba sdum thabs yod pa'i rtsa don/ btsan rgyal ring lugs la 'dzin pa'i lta ba dang tang gi phyi 'brel srid jus sogs skabs der gung khran tang la rgyus gsal bo med pa'i bod mi rigs la ngo sprod gsal bo mdzad pa'i shugs las/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis krung go gung khran tang gi ngo bo dang dmigs 'ben/ rtsa ba'i las 'gan dang blang bya/ srid jus sogs kyi dpal dang yon tan ma lus lhang nger mkhyen pa dang der rjes su yi rang zhu la/ bsngags brjod kyi 'dun mos snying ga gang ba mngon par mtshon yod/ der ma zad skabs der gung khran tang la rgyus med pa dang yang na log lta'am som nyi 'dzin pa'i bod rigs mang tshogs la gung khran tang ni tshul mthun chos lugs srung ba'i grogs po dang / nyam thag 'gro ba skyong pa'i mgon skyabs yin la/ mkhas shing mdzangs pa'i dpal 'bar bar gsungs shing / der log lta'am som nyi mi 'dzin par yid rton dgos pa yang yang du nan gyis gsungs pa 'di ltar/thub bstan 'o ma'i mtsho chen 'phyur ba las/ /18

gung khran zla ba'i 'dzum dkar gnyen du che/ /byams brtse'i ba gam mthon por dkrigs pa'i sprin/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gebs pa'i grib bsil can/ /②zhes pa dang /gung srid gsar mthun 'grogs zab mo bsus/ /'di'i rig par khra glag spyang gsum 'dzoms /kha zhe 'gal g.yo zol gtan ma byed/ /khos 'bangs mir 'tshe ba spu tsam med/ /zhes gsungs yod/ brtsams chos 'di las dge bshes rin po che gung khran tang la thugs dkar zhing yid ches ldog med mnga' ba gsal bor bstan la/ khyad par du/ rang gi chos lugs rtsa ltar 'dor pa'i blo/ /rang gshed gzugs med mi dge'i mgo dgu pa/ /rang skyong zhib mo'i rig pas gzir pa'i mur/ /rang dang gung khran rdo rje'i spun du sdebs/ /②zhes gung khran tang dang khong gnyis rdo rje'i spun grogs su gyur par 'khod pa las khong rang gung khran tang la rjes su yi rang zhu bar ma zad/ der mdza' bshes kyi brtse dung zab mo yod pa mngon par bstan la/ (lung bstan rdzun ma sun 'byin rmongs pa'i mun sel shes rab nyi ma'i 'od zer〉las/ ‘‘rin min krin h+phus( mi dmangs srid gzhung) chos la dad pa'i rang dbang / yul srol goms 'dris kyi rang dbang / dgon pa dang grwa pa'i mthun rkyen srung 19

skyob sogs gang ci'i bka' drin nam mkha' dang mnyam par mdzad pa ni/ chu tshod gcig la'ang brjed mi chog pa'i don rtsa gal chen yin/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang rang gi bde skyid rang gis ma bshig na gung khran tang nas mi bshig par thag gis chod/ mi rigs grangs nyung la lhag par brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur 'di 'dra sngon gyi rgyal rabs stong phrag khri phrag gi mthong thos ma myong ba ci nas kyang snying gi ze'u 'brur bsrel bar gyis/’’ zhes pas kyang gsal bor rtogs thub/de bzhin du ma'o tse tung dang khong gi dgongs par bsngags pa'i brtsams chos kyang 'di 'dra yod de/ ma'o tse tung gi dgongs dbyings nam mkha'i mthongs/ /spyi tshogs gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ /zas gtsang sras kyi lung rtogs nyi zla'i 'od/ /'dzin ma'i khyon na dge bar kho bos 'khums/ /②zhes ma'o tse tung gi thugs dgongs rgya che ba dang gzhan phan thugs kyis rgyud phyug pa/ zas gtsang sras te sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan dang ldan par brjod pa'am bsngags pa'i don du so sor gzhal mtha' bral ba'i nam mkha'i mthongs dang srid 'dir ches rgya che la gting zab pa'i rgya mtsho/ 'gran zla bral ba'i nyi zla zung gi 'od snang bcas kyi gzugs su bkod nas mngon par bstod pa dang / yang /ma'o tse tung zhes bya ba'i dam pa 'dir/ /20

shākya seng ge'i dgongs pa rma med pa'i/ /ngo mtshar bsngags par 'os pa mang po zhig /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros bdag gis mthong / /⑤zhes par mtshon na'ang rang bzhin brjod pa'i lam nas ma'o tse tung la sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i dgongs pa dri ma med pa mang po zhig ldan pa mngon par bstod kyin yod/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa de tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi rnam 'dren nyid du bsten zhing sku tshe gang bo rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i don du phul ba'i lha rams pa dge bshes shig la mtshon na/ rang gi ston pa dang gnyis su med ces pa las lhag pa'i bstod tshig 'bul rgyu med na/khong gis ma'o tse tung kru'u zhi la rjes su yi rang dang gong bkur ji 'dra zhu bzhin yod pa smra mi dgos la/ khyad par du‘‘'dzin ma'i khyon na dge bar kho bos 'khums’’zhes pa dang / ‘‘'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros bdag gis mthong ’zhes mngon par tshig thag bcad nas gsungs pa 'dis khong gis ma'o tse tung kru'u zhir yi rang pa'i mchod sprin phul bar g.yo zol gyi dri ma bral ba mngon par gsal la/bod mi rigs ma'o tse tung kru'u zhir blo dkar zhing yid rton par yang nus pa dpe zla bral ba zhig thon/ma'o tse tung dgongs pa ni rgyal yongs rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyi las don la slob ston byed pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yin pas/ de'i dgongs don ma lus gsal bor rtogs rgyu ni 21

bya ba mtha' dag gi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen du gzigs nas/ go sla ba'i bslab bya'i rnam pa spyad nas kun la nan gyis gnad bstan pa 'di ltar/chos kyi tshul la rang gi ston pa'i sras/ /srid kyi phyogs la tang gi 'dren pa'i 'og /ya nga bag tsha med par bya dgos pa/ /'di ni ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /chos la chos nas gsungs pa ji bzhin du/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i dge sbyor byed pa las/ /srid kyis the gtogs btsan gnon mi rigs pa/ /'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /dkar nag shan 'byed tshangs pa'i thig btab nas/ /ya rabs dam pa'i dbu 'phang bstod byed cing / /ma rabs 'gong po'i mgo bo 'gems byed pa/ /'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /lan brgyar bshad kyang rna ba mi gtod pa/ /ci yis bcos kyang bzang por mi 'gyur ba'i / /skye bo ngan pa sol ba lta bu'i rigs/ /btsan gnon me rlung 'khrugs pas sun 'byin pa/ /'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /yar la 'khor na mdzes sdug lha yi bzhin/ /22

mar la 'khor na 'jigs rung gdon gyi gdong / /mi min mi ru brdzus nas 'ongs pa dag /'chor med nags pas yan por mi gtong pa/ /'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /drang por mi spyod 'khyog po'i wa rnga 'phyang / /gyen du mi 'gro las ngan lud pa'i chu/ /de 'dra la yang legs pa'i lam ston pa/ /'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /rang re'i mi rigs chos lugs gang yang rung / / spyi lam bgrod pa gcig po'i thig skud ltar/ /chig dril zhi bde'i dbyings la 'jug dgos pa/ /'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /de lta na yang chos lugs so so'i srol/ /rang gis brtags nas rang nyid ma 'gyur ba/ /de srid srid kyis btsan bsgyur mi byed pa/ /'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin/ /re ba'i 'bangs rnams brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis bsu/ /sdang ba'i dgra rnams rdo rje'i thog gis 'joms /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag pa'i 'jigs zil can/ /ma'o tse tung la dwangs pa'i mig gis ltos/ /chos pas chos lugs 'dzin la de bzhin mdzod/ /23

srid pas srid jus skyong na'ang de bzhin gyis/ /'bangs mis spyi 'bungs byed na'ang de bzhin 'bungs/ /gtsang ma'i me long mnga' ba'i spun zla'i tshogs/ /de ltar yid la zungs shig a ma'i bu/ /zhes( bslab bya rang byung lha'i rnga bo〉 bya bar 'khod yod/bslab bya 'dir skabs der ma'o tse tung kru'u zhir rgyus chung ba'i bod rigs mang tshogs la kha gsal zhing tshig bsdus pa'i sgo nas ma'o tse tung gi srid khrims dang mthun pa'i chos lugs bya 'gul thad kyi spyod tshul 'dzin stangs dang / skye bo mchog dman dang ngan pa mkhregs 'dzin mkhan/ ngo gnyis ma bcas so sor ya lan sprod stangs/ mi rigs so so'i chos lugs kyi las 'gan sogs dgongs pa'i gnad dang thugs gshis gsal bor spros la/ sho lo ka so so'i tshig rkang rjes mar‘‘'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yin’’zhes do mnyam par 'khod pa des sgyu rtsal gyi sgo nas brjod don nan bcag mdzad pa dang / brtsams chos kyi mjug tu chos skyong mkhan dang srid 'dzin mkhan/ 'bangs phal pa kun gyis ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa ltar 'bad brtson bya dgos par bstan par ma zad/ da dung gal bo che la nan tan gyi tshul du‘‘de ltar yid la zungs shig a ma'i bu’’zhes yang bskyar nan du bstan pa las skabs der ma'o tse tung dgongs pa gsal bor rtogs pa dang rtogs nas kyang de'i rjes su 'brangs dgos pa'i gal chen rang bzhin dang / khong gis 24

ma'o tse tung kru'u zhir dad gus tshad med mdzad pa gsal bor mtshon pa yin/bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshun la/ dge bshes rin po ches chos srid gnyis kyi 'go khrid pa'i 'gan bzhes shing de dag gi 'phrin las rgya cher mdzad par ma zad/ nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi u yon gyi 'gan yang bzhes nas/ rtag tu mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang 'brel 'dris mdzad pas/ de'i drag pa'i zil shugs dang zhi ba'i spyod par gsal cha shin tu che ba red/ khong gi gsung rtsom pod gnyis pa'i shog ngos509las/e ma da ni ril mo'i 'dzam gling nas/ /je h+phang(bcings 'grol)mchog gi 'od dmar 'phyur ba'i zil//mi mthun nyin long mig gis bzod dka' ba/ /skye rgu yongs kyi mgrin pa'i rol mo khrol/ /zhes mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi drag po'i zil shugs kyis go min tang gi dmag dpung khri phrag brgyad brgya thal bar brlags pa dang / rgyal yongs rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyis bcings 'grol dmag dang de'i dpa' zhing mdzangs pa'i mdzad rjes la bsngags pa brjod pa'i gnas tshul dngos 'god pa la brten nas/ bcings 'grol dmag dang mi dmangs mang tshogs bar gyi chu dang nya mo lta bu'i mdza' bshes zab mo gsal ler bstan zhing / khong nyid kyis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dgra 25

'thab la dpa' zhing 'bangs mi la zhen pa'i mdzad spyod la rjes su yi rang zhu ba'i thugs dgongs dri ma med pa de'ang ngang ngam shugs kyis mtshon yod/ dgung lo lnga ba nas rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i chos sgor zhugs shing / sku tshe gang bor thugs dgongs rtse gcig gis rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi 'phrin las rgya cher mdzad pa'i lha rams pa'i dge bshes shig gis chos lugs gang rung la dad pa byed mi rung ba'i gung khran tang dang de'i gtso 'dzin ma'o tse tung /mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bcas la de 'dra'i gong bkur dang rjes su yi rang zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ khong gi mdzad rnam dang dgongs pa/ brtsams chos sogs la phyogs bsdus kyis dpyad na/ rgyu mtshan 'di 'dra 'ga' mchis par snyam/ krung go gung khran tang gis chos lugs la dad pa mi byed rung / ‘‘rang don spu tsam yang mi bsgrub par blo gcig sems gcig gis rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi don du mtha' na rang gi srog blos gtong bar yang mi 'dzem par/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' nyid yin pas/ ngas lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas gong bkur dang rjes su yi rang zhu gi yin’ri⑥zhes dge bshes rang gi zhal nas gsungs pa bzhin/ gung khran tang gi blo sems rtse gcig gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i rtsa ba'i blang bya dang / btsan dbang la ngo rgol dang 'dzam gling gi zhi bde srung skyob byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don 26

sogs ni 'dzam gling na ches drang bden yin pa/ ma'o tse tung kru'u zhi sogs gsar brje'i rgan rabs pa rnams kyis mi tshe gang bor rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur dang mi dmangs kyi bde skyid don du phul ba'i gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa ni ha cang rlabs che ba/ chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus lag len du bstar ba'i thugs dgongs rgya che ba/ lugs mthun gyi chos lugs bya 'gul la srung skyob byas pa dang der mthun rkyen bsgrub pa bka' drin du gzigs pa/krung go gung khran tang dang de'i 'go 'dren rnam pas 'go 'dzin nam 'go khrid mdzad 'og gtan la phab pa'i rtsa khrims kyi nang don khag ya rabs dge ba'i lugs dang yongs su mthun pa/ krung go gung khran tang gi mkhas shing mdzangs pa'i rang bzhin dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dpa' zhing rtul phod pa'i yon tan rnam par mkhyen pa bcas kyi rkyen yin par snyam/dge bshes rin po che ni mdo sngags zung gi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa'i lha rams pa'i dge bshes shig yin par ma zad/ nyid kyi zhal nas/sngon chad go min tang gis bkur/ /da lta gung khran tang gis kyang / /ston pas bden pa rgyal lo zhes/ /gsung la dad pas snying ga gang / /②zhes gsungs pa bzhin spyi tshogs gsar rnying gnyis la tang 27

khag mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi srid gzhung gis gtsigs su bzung nas bod phyogs kyi srid don mang po spel ba'i grogs su bsten pas/ srid phyogs la'ang mkhyen pa ha cang yangs shing / bod mi rigs kyi bde sdug dang las skal/ mdun lam sogs la dus dang rnam pa kun tu thugs khur chen po mdzad pa red/ 〈gzur gnas mkhas pa'i gzigs mo 'dod 'jo nor bu'i 'khri shing〉las/gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog gi ser ba la/ /byis pa'i khu tshur gsor ba 'thad dam ci/ /bstan 'gro'i srog la 'dzem pa blos btang nas/ /gzims chung rkyal gyis rtsen rnams yi re mug /zhes pa dang /dad 'dun bag yod bdud rtsis snying gang pa'i/ /bod 'bangs rtsub 'gyur tshal du ma song yang / /srog gi mchod sbyin 'gyed la mngon phyogs pa/ /de dag bskyabs pa'i bsod nams bsam mi khyab/ /zhes 'khod pa las mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du skyod skabs dang / 1959lo'i dus zing gi skabs su col chung gi dbang du gyur pa'i tsho dpon la las bcings 'grol dmag la dogs slong dang 'gran 'dzugs par rtsom pa'i snang tshul de mi 'jig rdo rje thog gi ser ba la byis pa'i khu tshur gyis 'gran pa'i dpe ru gzigs shing srog gi mchod sbyin gtong ba tsam yin par 28

mkhyen nas/ de'i don du thugs khral chen po mdzad cing mi rigs spyi'i tshe srog gi chag sgo la'ang snang dogs mi byed par bag med longs spyod la blo g.yeng mkhan la‘‘yi re mugamimices tshig gi mtshon bsnun pa dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi 'gran zla bral ba'i zil shugs dang 'bangs la zhen pa'i spyod pa sogs dril bsgrags nas/ mi dmangs kyi dogs slong sel te dgos med kyi srog sbyin 'gyed pa las rnam par bskyabs pa la‘‘bsod nams bsam mi khyab’’par bsngags pa red/gzhan yang /rtsa ba dam tshig gal ba'i sgros tsam yang med par/ /'dod yon lam 'khyer zab mdog myur mdog gi 'ur gyis/ /dad ldan rmongs pa cal 'drogs su bslu ba'i/ /chom rkun nam yang mi bgyid zhe nas rang smon no/ /②zhes pa dang /bstan pa rang gis gting nas bshig ste/ /bstan dgra rwa can gzhan du 'tshol ba /bstan la khyim pa sun 'byin de rigs/ /bstan pa'i phyogs na yod med the tshom/ /⑨zhes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rnam par dag pa tshig zur tsam yang mi gleng bar rdzun bshad g.yo gtam 'ba' zhig la brten nas/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi mgo bskor nas rgyu nor zas gos sogs bslu 29

bar byed pa'i chos lugs par‘‘chom rkun’’zhes sun 'byin mdzad pa dang chabs cig de lta bu'i chos pa mi byed pa'i thugs smon 'debs pa dang / rang nyid kyis rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'gal nas g.yo gsob dang / kha 'jam khog rtsub/ chags sdang ris gcod sogs kyi las 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pa bskyur nas/ da dung gzhan la bstan pa'i dgra bo zhes snyon mkhan la‘‘khyim pa sun 'byin de rigs’’zhes mngon du dgag cing / ‘‘bstan pa'i phyogs na yod med the tshom’’zhes sun 'byin mdzad la/ (lung bstan rdzun ma sun 'byin rmongs pa'i mun sel shes rab nyi ma'i 'od zer〉las kyang‘‘chos phyogs nas yi dam gyi lha la rdzun khag bkal te g.yo khram gsog gsob me dong thal bas g.yogs pa lta bus rnam pa kun tu skye 'gro bslu bar rtsom pa 'di las lhag pa'i bstan dgra sdig can ma rungs pa ci zhig yod/’’ ces gsungs yod/ brtsams chos 'di dag las dge bshes rin po ches sa paṇa khu dbon ji bzhin bod mi rigs kyi bde sdug dang bstan pa'i las don la thugs khur chen po mdzad pa dang / dga' zhen tshad med bcangs pa mtshon yod/ mdor na khong gi bcings 'grol tshun gyi brtsams chos gsar pa de dag las brtag gzhig byas na dge bshes rin po che ni tang dang ma'o kru'u zhir thugs dkar zhing yid ches brtan po yod cing / ma'o tse tung sogs gsar brje'i rgan rabs rnams kyi gzhan phan gyi spyod pa rlabs chen la gong bkur dang rjes su yi rang zhu ba/ rang gi mi 30

rigs la dga' zhen chen po dang brtse dung zab mo yod pa/ nang pa'i bstan pa la dad 'dun zab mo dang thugs skyong chen po mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po zhig lags/brtsams chos kyi khyad chos brjod pa/ dge bshes rin po ches bcings 'grol tshun la'ang gsung rtsom mang du brtsams yod pa las/brjod don gsar pa mtshon pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos mang che ba ni snyan ngag dang bslab bya yin la/ de yang dge bshes rin po che ni rang bzhin gyis thugs spobs che zhing lhan skyes kyi mkhyen rab yangs pa/ khyad par du mdo sngags rig gnas thad/ dus skabs der gangs ri'i ljongs ma zad/ krung go spyi dang ye sha ya'i shar lho yongs su'ang don gyi snyan pa 'brug ltar grags pa'i lha rams pa'i dge bshes chen mo yin pa dang / bstod pa'i yul la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i dpal dang yon tan mnga' zhing de ji bzhin du rnam par mkhyen pa'i dbang gis/ snyan ngag gi sbyor ba cung zad dam zhing tshig gi gzengs mtho la don gyi rlabs che ba/ tshig bsdus shing don 'dus pa'i khyad chos gsal ler mngon la/ bslab bya ni spel yul gyi yon tan dang dril sgrog gi dgos mkho dang bstun pas/ mngon brjod dang brda rnying mang po ma bkol la/ 'khyog brjod kyi tshig rgyan mang pas kyang ma spras par kha gsal zhing drang pa'i tshig gi lam nas lhug par brjod pas/ bklags ma thag bstan don gsal bor rtogs la/bklags na lcer bde zhing nyan na rnar snyan pas rang bzhin lhun 31

grub kyi nyams dang dpal 'bar ba dang / 〈bslab bya rang byung lha'i rnga bo〉bya bar mtshon na rtsom pa pos sngon gyi bslab bya dang gsol 'debs sogs kyi rtsom srol spyad pa ste/ tshigs bcad sho lo ka re re'i rjes su‘‘gung khran tang gi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' yin’’zhes pa dang / yang na‘‘'di yang ma'o tse tung gi ring lugs yinaririzhes do mnyam par 'khod pa des bslab bya hril bo 'gros rim dang mtshams tshigs ldan par gyur la/ brjod don brnan pa'i nus pa khyad par ba zhig thon pa red/brtsams chos kyi nus pa brjod pa/ dge bshes rin po che'i snyan ngag dang bslab bya gang zhig yin rung rnam pa'i cha nas sngar yod kyi rtsom srol dang rtsom lus spyad pas/ dus skabs de dang phyis kyi rtsom rig 'phel 'gyur la shugs rkyen nam nus pa 'di 'dra bskyed ces pa zhig brjod rgyu cher med mod/ rtsom lus rnying par brten nas nang don gsar pa brjod pa'i srol sngon na cher med pas/ khong gis srol rgyun gyi snyan ngag dang bslab bya'i rnam pa spyad nas tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs/ srid jus/ ma'o tse tung sogs gsar brje'i rgan rabs pa'i dgongs pa bcas dril bsgrags dang der bstod bsngags mdzad cing / mi rigs kyi tshe srog dang mdun lam la gnod pa dang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba'i bgegs su gyur ba'i snang tshul la dgag rgyag dang slob gso yang na de 'tshang 'byin mdzad pa ni/bod kyi rtsom rig gi brjod bya'i nang don cha nas snga na med pa'i 32

'gyur mtshams gsar pa zhig tu snang pas/ dus skabs de dang de'i rjes kyi rtsom pa po rgan gras rnams la spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos spyad nas rtsom pa mdzad par ma dpe'i nus pa bskyed cing / bod kyi rtsom rig gis dngos yod kyi spyi tshogs dang mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu bar sne khrid rang bzhin gyi nus pa rgya chen po thon pa red/ 'di ni rtsom rig la thon pa'i nus pa red/dge bshes rin po che ni mdo sngags gzhung lugs kyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa'i lha rams pa'i dge bshes dang / gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i ser skya mang tshogs kun gyis gtsug gi tog ltar bkur ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po zhig yin pas/ khong gis brtsams chos de dag brtsams shing spel ba des dus der gung khran tang la rgyus chung ba'i mang tshogs khag cig gi sems kyi dogs 'jigs bsal nas tang dang ma'o kru'u zhir dga' zhing blo dkar ba dang / skabs de'i tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs/ srid jus sogs dga' spro'i ngang brtsi srung dang lag bstar byed pa/ mi rigs mthun sgril dang spyi tshogs zhi 'jags yong ba/ mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur srung skyob byed pa/ tshul min gyi bya spyod bkag nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyob pa/ mdor na krung go'i gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og skabs de'i bod phyogs kyi bya gzhag ma lus bde legs ngang spel bar nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyed pa red/ 33

gnyis/ tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang gi rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/bod kyi snyan du grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang ni/ 1880lor gzhis rtse bde legs rab brtan gyi khyim na sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo lnga'i steng se ra dgon pa'i tsha pa khams tshan gyi dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang dge legs sprul sku'i yang srid du ngos bzung / dgung lo drug pa'i tshe se ra dgon par bsus nas chos sgor zhugs zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po spyi bo'i cod pan du bsten nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya chen por thos bsam dpyis phyin par mdzad/ dgung lo nyer lnga par rtsod rgyugs sprad nas lha rams pa dge bshes kyi mtshan thob/ de'i rjes su'ang bod ljongs kyi yul gru so sor phebs nas mkhas dbang du ma bsten te mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs dang bod kyi lo rgyus/ rtsom rig sgra snyan ngag gso rig skar rtsis sogs la sbyang brtson mtha' 'khyol bar mdzad/ khong gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i drung yig gi 'gan bzhes shing /dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho dang mnyam du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cig gi dpar gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi zhu dag mdzad pas/ snyan pa'i grags pa mdo dbus khams gsum yongs la khyab cing / ser skya mang pos khong rang gtsug gi cod pan du bsten nas brda sprod dang 34

snyan ngag sogs rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa mdzad/bod ljongs zhi bas bcings 'grol byas rjes/ dgung lo bdun cu brgal ba'i tsha sprul rin po che lhag bsam rnam dag gis gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs shing / dang thog bod ljongs dmag khul las byed slob grwar bod yig gi slob deb rtsom sgrig mdzad par ma zad/sku dngos kyis dpe khrid mdzad pa/ phyis su bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par khang gi spyi khyab rtsom sgrig pa gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes shing / zhor du bod ljongs dmag khul khang rtsom zhus u yon lhan khang gi rgyun u dang bod ljongs rgyal gces gzhon nu mdza' 'brel tshogs pa'i u yon/ lha sa'i slob chung gi tung hri sogs kyi 'gan bzhes/ tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang ni sku drag gi sras su 'khrungs shing se ra dgon chen gyi sprul sku dang lha rams dge bshes yin yang / bod ljongs zhi bas bcings 'grol byas rjes/ gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs nas slob gso dang rtsom sgrig dril bsgrags sogs kyi bya gzhag bsgrubs pas gung khran tang gi lam phyogs dang / bod ljongs su 'dzin pa'i byed phyogs dang srid jus kyi yang dag rang bzhin gsal bor rtogs pa dang / khyad par du bya ba'i byed phyogs dang dmigs bsal srid jus de dag lag len du bstar nas lo 'ga'i ring grub 'bras mi dman pa thob par brten nas/ gung khran tang la thugs dkar zhing de'i byed phyogs dang srid jus la rjes su yi rang zhu ba dang / rgyal gces ring lugs kyi thugs dgongs drag tu brnyes 35

pa/ skabs de'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi byed phyogs mngon par mkhyen zhing dril bsgrags kyi dgongs gzhi yongs su gsal pas/ skabs bab kyi rjes su mthun zhing de la smon pa'i ljags rtsom〈rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyi gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhir bstod glu 'bul〉zhes pa dang / krung go gung khran tang gi mkhas shing mdzangs pa'i 'go khrid la bsngags pa'i(dmag 'dzugs dus chen la phul ba〉zhes pa/lha sa'i bar snang du gnam gru slebs pa bsu ba'i〈lcags kyi phug ron dngul skya mdog〉zhes pa/ (gung khran tang gi 'khrungs skar dus chen la bsngags pa brjod pa〉zhes pa/ 〈gser zam g.yu yi lam bu〉zhes pa sogs mang du brtsams nas 'grem spel byas pa las1956lo'i zla7pa'i tshes1nyin gyi〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉 du 'khod pa'i〈gung khran tang gi 'khrungs skar dus chen la bsngags pa brjod pa〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom la sho lo ka bzhi ma gtogs med kyang kha gsal zhing brtse dung zab pa/ yid 'gyur gyi shugs drag cing brjod don gsar pas/ dril bsgrags dang 'bod skul gyi nus pa rgya chen po zhig ldan pa 'di ltar/bde skyid dga' tshal skyed tshal yangs po'i gzhir/ /rab dkar lding g.yab phubs pa'i grib bsil 'og /ser skya mi dmangs gos bzang lhab lhub g.yo/ /pho mo khyad med gshis goms rgyan chas spras/ /tshang ma spun zla lta bu'i mdza' brtse'i ngang /36

dga' ba'i gzhas dang snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /dwangs gsal bcud ldan ja dang zhal tog zhim/ /gung khran tang gi srol der sems 'gul thebs/ /krung gung tang dang srid gzhung bzang por bcas/ /rlabs chen ma'o kru'u zhi yi bslab ston 'og /rang skyong gra sgrig lhan khang gsar du tshugs/ /bde skyid 'tsho ba bzang po'i lam bzang rnyed/ /sger dbang rgyud 'dzin phyed las lhag med grol/ /srid don chu tshad rig mtho'i gru gzings nang / /gsar pa'i lugs bzang gom tshugs brtan por spos/ /rlabs chen spyi tshogs yang rtser son gyur cig /snyan ngag 'di ni rtsom pa pos1956lo'i zla7pa'i tshes1nyin bod ljongs rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyis tang gi 'khrungs skar bsu ba'i dga' ston dpal gyi ngo mtshar gzigs nas/ thugs kyi mtsho mo kun nas 'phyo zhing dga' ba'i 'gyur ba drag tu brnyes pa'i shugs las 'khrungs pa lags/ de yang thog mar dga' ston rol pa'i yul gyi nyams spro ba'i bkod pa dang / ser skya mang tshogs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i gzab spros/ mi rigs so so mdza' brtse mthun sgril dang sos dal bag g.yeng gis dga' mgu'i rol rtsed dang / zas rigs longs spyod la rol pa'i ngang tshul gzigs nas/ gung khran tang la sngar las lhag pa'i dad 'dun chen po brnyes pa ste/ khyad du 'phags 37

pa'i skal ba de lta bu ni bod ljongs zhi bas bcings 'grol byas pa'i lo lnga'i ring la krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og lhag bsam rnam dag gis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun lag bstar byas pa'i thog ma'i grub 'bras su dgongs pa dang chabs cig krung go gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' slob ltar lo der srid dbang gi ngo bo ldan pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang tshugs pa de yang bod du mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar byed rgyur gal 'gangs che ba'i gom pa gang spos pa dang /bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs lhag med du btang bas/ ‘‘bde skyid 'tsho ba bzang po'i lam bzang rnyed’ripar dgongs zhing / bde skyid 'tsho ba bzang po'i lam la 'khrid mdzad mkhan te/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi sne khrid 'og bod 'di mthun sgril dang shes rig 'byor phyug ldan pa bcas kyi bod ljongs gsar pa zhig tu slebs pa'i bkra shis smon 'dun yang zhu ba red/snyan rtsom 'di las rtsom pa pos tang gi 'khrungs skar bsu ba'i dga' ston dpal gyi ngo mtshar la bsngags brjod mdzad par brten nas/ lo lnga'i ring bod ljongs su lag bstar byas pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gyi mthun pa'i rang bzhin dril bsgrags dang /ma 'ongs par krung go gung khran tang dang bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid 'og bod ljongs 'di mu mthud du 38

yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar yid ches chen po yod pa gsal bar bstan pas/ dngos yod kyi don snying chen po ldan la/ mjug mthar‘‘rlabs chen spyi tshogs yang rtser son gyur cig’’ces bkra shis smon 'dun zhu ba las rtsom pa pos rang gi pha yul dang mi rigs la dga' zhen tshad med bcangs pa dang / rang gi pha yul dang mi rigs kyi dar rgyas kyi don du thugs snang chen po mdzad pa yang mtshon yod/de bzhin du1956lo'i zla4pa'i tshes12nyin(bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉steng 'khod pa'i(lcags kyi phug ron dngul skya mdog〉ces pa yang snyan rtsom ring mo zhig min rung / rtsom pa pos gnam gru lha sa'i mkha' dbyings su slebs nas phyir log pa'i ngang tshul brjod pa la brten nas/ bod rigs mang tshogs kyis tang dang srid gzhung la re ltos chen po dang / ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam la yid ches chen po yod pa/ rgya bod mi rigs bar la gcen gcung lta bu'i mdza' mthun zab mo yod par bstan pas/ skabs de'i chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang rtsom rig gi rin thang gang gi cha nas dpyad kyang snyan ngag legs po zhig tu bgrang dgos par snyam/ de yang nang don gyi cha nas tshan pa gsum du snang ste/ tshan pa dang por/gnam gshis bzang zhing nyi 'od gsal ba'i mur/ /byang shar mtshams nas snyan pa'i sgra zhig thos/ /des rkyen bdag cag steng du bltas pa'i skabs/ /39

yid 'ong mdzes pa gnam gru yong ba mthong / /zhes dbus gtsang gi mkha' dbyings su sprin gyi 'dab ma'i stod g.yogs ma mnab tshe/ mkha' dbugs dwangs shing gtsang la nyi ma'i 'od snang gsal ba'i mtho sgang gi gnam gshis khyad chos sam gnam gru gsal bor mthong thub pa'i cha rkyen sngon du gleng rjes/ lha sa'i bar snang du gnam gru tshul ji ltar slebs par brjod pa dang /tshan pa gnyis par/de ni phug ron mdog can 'dab gshog can/ /khang mig mdzes ldan skar rtags rnam par bkra /grong khyer 'di'i steng dal bus lding zhing 'khor/ /byams brtse'i spyan gyis ring nas gzigs zhes dran/ /lhang lhang rna bar 'bab pa'i sgra de'i nang / /bod rigs mi dmangs rnams la 'tshams 'dri dang / /chabs cig myur du 'dzugs skrun thub yong zhes/ /zhal bzhes bslab ston gnang bar yid ches rnyed/ /rlangs 'khor bgrod pa'i shugs las ches myur ba'i/ /rin chen gnam gru'i lam nas spel ba yi/ /dngos zog sna tshogs 'dod rgur 'grems nus des/ /bod mi'i bde skyid 'tsho ba'i sgo 'phar dbye/ /mes rgyal mtha' mtshams brtan srung thub pa la/ /shugs snon yang yang thebs rgyu'i snying stobs des/ /40

'byor ldan gzhan gyi g.yo sgyu'i dra ba'i nang / /tshud yang bsam pa'i dogs gzhi'i rtsa ba chod/ /zhes gnam gru'i kha dog dang dbyibs/ khyad chos byed nus sogs zhib 'bri mdzad cing / de dag gi blos bslangs la brten nas/bod ljongs su skyod pa'i mkha' lam btsal nas gnam gru shar gtong byas pa ni tang dang srid gzhung gis bod ljongs la byams brtse'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i 'bras rtags su nges shing / gnam gru de'i lhang lhang rna bar 'bab pa'i sgra'i zil shugs las bod ljongs 'di myur ba myur du 'dzugs skrun byed thub pa'i yid ches rnyed la/de'i rdzu 'phrul shugs kyi myur rtsal dang do zla bral ba'i 'dren rtsal gyis bod ljongs mi dmangs la ma 'gyangs par rgyal khab phyi nang kun gyi dngos zog sna tshogs gang la gang 'dod du sprod thub pa dang / mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams brtan srung byed par 'gan len yod pa'i nges shes dang spobs pa bskyed cing / thams cad blo bde bag yangs byas chog pa'i dgongs pa bstan yod/tshan pa gsum par bod rigs mang tshogs kyis gnam gru phyir log pa'i rjes su skyo gdung mig gis cer nas blta zhing skyel ba'i ngang tshul mngon par brjod pa dang / bod kyi srol ltar rgya rigs spun zla rnams sku khams bzang zhing ma 'gyangs par slar mjal ba'i bkra shis smon 'dun zhus nas rtsom gyi mjug bsdus pa red/gnam sngon dbyings nas dgyes gzigs gcen po tsho/ /41

sku khams bzang ldan re zhig rang gnas phebs/ /khyed rjes lta bzhin myur mjal smon tshig dang / /bkra shis bde legs ngang nas dga' skyel zhu/ /gang du phebs pa'i grogs bzang rnam pa la/ /dga' gces 'phrin bzang legs skyes 'di bsnams nas/ /rgya bod mi rigs mthun sgril chen po 'di/ /rtag brtan khri lor gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /mjug bsdus pa'i gtam 'dis skabs der rgya bod mi rigs bar gcen gcung lta bu'i brtse dung zab mo dang 'bral thabs med pa'i mthun sgril dam po byung bar ma zad/ mdza' zhing brtse ba'i 'brel ba de bskal pa'i bar du rtag cing brtan pa'i re smon bcangs pa yang bstan yod/khong gi snyan ngag gi khyad chos dang de'i nus pa bshad pa/ tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang mchog dgung lo drug nas se ra dgon chen du phebs te/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs kyis gtsos pa'i rig gnas thams cad la dpyad sbyang dpyis phyin pa mdzad pa'i dge bshes lha rams pa yin pas/ srol rgyun rtsom rig gi bag chags zab cing de'i rtsom srol la shin tu goms yod pa ni smra mi dgos kyang /bod ljongs zhi bas bcings 'grol byas rjes/ khong nyid thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i ngang gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs te tang gi slob gso sna tshogs myangs pas/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi zhabs 42

'degs zhu yul de rig gnas chu tshad mtho ba'i mkhas pa nyung shas tsam min par/ gtso bor rgya che'i mi dmangs yin pa rtogs shing /khyad par〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉 khang du phyag las gnang skabs gsar 'gyur dang rtsom rig gi skad cha de mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi skad cha dang nye bar byed thub min ni gsar 'gyur dang rtsom rig gi khyab rgya dang byed nus la thad kar rag las pa'i gnad dam pa zhig yin pa gsal ler mkhyen pa'i rkyen gyis/bcings 'grol tshun gyi snyan ngag gsar pa 'di dag rtsom pa'i tshe na'ang gtso bor spel yul gyi yon tan dang dril bsgrags kyi dgos mkhor gzhigs nas/ (snyan ngag me long ma〉las bstan pa'i bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang rab rtog gi rgyan/ phul byung gi rgyan/ sgra rgyan/gab chig gi rgyan sogs 'khyog brjod kyi rgyan gyis ma spras la/ tha na dpe rgyan gyis kyang mang po spras med par/ phal cher rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gcig pu'i lam nas brjod pa dang / mngon brjod dang brda rnying / chos lugs kyi gzhung dang 'brel ba'i ming brda gang yang 'dres med la/ mang che ba tsheg khyim dgu can yin pas/ tshig sbyor lhod cing brjod bya gsar pa/ brjod don gsal la snyan pa'i nyams ldan pa/ brtse dung zab la yid 'gyur shugs drag pa'i khyad chos ldan pa red/ de ni bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng gi gsar btod cig red/ tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang ni skabs der mdo dbus khams gsum du snyan pa'i grags pa khyab pa'i lha rams dge 43

bshes dang dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang dge legs kyi yang srid yin pas/ khong gi gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi snyan ngag de dag tshags par steng du dngos su 'khod nas 'grem spel byas pa des lo rgyus kyi 'gyur mtshams chen po'i spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i bod rigs mang tshogs 'jigs dogs dang go log gya tshom sogs rmongs pa las rnam par sad nas gung khran tang la blo 'khor zhing yid rton pa dang / gsar du tshugs pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi sne khrid 'og gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bde blag ngang lag bstar dngos 'bebs byed pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod ljongs gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed thub pa'i spobs pa dang yid ches bskyed pa/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes rnying pa legs por 'gyur ba dang rgyal gces bsam blo je brtan du 'gro ba/ mi rigs kyi mthun sgril je dam dang dmag dmangs kyi mdza' brtse je zab tu gtong ba bcas la sub thabs med pa'i nus pa thon par ma zad/ rtsom rig gi 'phel 'gyur la'ang nus pa mi dman pa thon te/ bod kyi rtsom rig gi brtsam bya'i nang don gtso bo sngon byung gi gtam dang 'das pa'i lo rgyus sam rgya gar sogs mi rigs gzhan gyi yig thog gi rgyu cha yin pa nas/ dngos yod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang gsar byung bya dngos gtso bor 'dzin pa dang /tshig nyams btod pa dang shugs don zab pa hur len pa'i rtsom srol nas tshig gi don gtso bo yin zhing go sla la/ yid 'gyur zab 44

pa'i rtsom srol gsar pa zhig tu 'phel par sne khrid dang ma dpe'i nus pa bskyed yod/ der brten tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang ni snyan grags che ba'i lha rams pa dge bshes dang sprul ba'i sku yin par ma zad/ dus skabs kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chab srid pa dang rtsom rig pa zhig kyang red/gsum/ bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/bstan pa rgya mtsho ni sku na gzhon pa'i dus nas bla brang dgon par phebs nas/ bod kyi tha snyad rig gnas dang gzhung bka' pod lnga la sbyangs pa legs po byas te mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob cing snyan pa'i grags pa rgyas/ bcings 'grol byas rjes srid gzhung gis gdan drangs pa ltar nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor phebs nas dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang / khong nyid la ljags rtsom mang po yod srid kyang da lta nga tsho'i mthong lam du gyur pa ni(snyan ngag gi spyi don tshig rgyan rig pa'i lde mig〉dang / (mi dmangs shes rab rtsal gyis dge mtshan gsar du skrun pa〉/ 〈sum rtags las la don gyi gnad don kha shas〉zhes pa sogs yin pa las/ skabs 'dir brjod par bya ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni thog ma gnyis yin pas/rim bzhin ngo sprod byas na/ (snyan ngag gi spyi don tshig rgyan rig pa'i lde mig〉ces pa ni rtsom pa pos1960lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i skad yig sde tshan du dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang 45

skabs slob ma'i slob deb tu brtsams shing / 1980lo'i zla7par kan su'u mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa yin/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i dus bab dang dgos pa/ spel yul bcas mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis/ de'i sngon gyi tshig rgyan rig pa'i bstan bcos rnams dang bsdur na khyad chos mi mthun pa bzhi yod par 'dod do/ /1 gzhung tshad 'os shing 'tsham la spyod che ba/ bod kyi bstan bcos sngon ma rnams ni(snyan ngag me long ma〉rgyas par 'grel ba gzhi byas rang gi dper brjod brtsams pa zhig yin pas/ gzhung tshad ring zhing bod skad la rgyugs chung ba dang yang na mkho mi che ba'i tshig rgyan yang shin tu mang pa red/ de lta bu'i bstan bcos su dus skabs gsar pa'i slob mar mkho mi che pa'ang yod pas rtsom pa pos(me long ma〉la zhib 'jug legs po mdzad pa dang / skabs de'i slob ma'i chu tshad dang slob sbyong gi mos pa/ bkol spyod kyi rin thang bcas la dmigs nas/ (snyan ngag me long ma〉las bod kyi skad la rgyugs che zhing nye bar mkho ba'i rgyun spyod kyi rgyan ma gtogs/bod skad la ji bzhin du mi 'byor ba dang yang na rgyugs mi che ba'i le'u dang po'i rgyan bcu dang ba glang gcin/ dus bzang 'khor lo sogs bya dka' ba'i sgra rgyan rnams dmigs su bkar nas ma spros la/ de min le'u gnyis pa don rgyan so gnyis dang le'u gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan las kyang tshig nyams 'don tshul phal cher cha 'dra 46

ba'am skyar bzlas su gyur pa'i skor gcig shes kun grol yong bar dmigs nas gcig gis 'thus par mdzad cing / rgyun bkol ma yin pa'am nye bar mi mkho ba'i rgyan rnams kyang rgyas par ma spros pas/ nang don nyung zhing lag len mang ba'i khyad chos 'bur du thon la/ skabs de'i gsar slob mkhan rnams kyi rig gnas chu tshad dang 'tsham zhing spyod go chod pa'i slob deb legs po zhig red/2 da yod kyi brjod bya dang sbyar pas/ rmad du byung ba'i chos mnga' ba/ de yang(snyan ngag me long ma〉las/ ‘‘sngon byung gtam las gyur pa'am/ /cig shos legs pa la brten pa/ /sde bzhi'i 'bras bu'i dbang gyur dang / /mkhas shing rgya che'i 'dren pa can/ /g.yul dang 'dren pa dar bas kyang / /brgyan par gyur cing mdor bsdus min/ /’’ zhes gsungs yod pas/ bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis brtsams pa'i tshig rgyan rig pa'i bstan bcos kyi dper brjod rnams kyang rgya gar gyi rig byed gtam rgyud dang thub pa'i skyes rabs/ rtogs brjod sogs sngon byung gi gtam sna tshogs dang / (me long ma'i〉dngos bstan grong khyer dang / rgya mtsho/ ri/ dus bzhi/ nyi zla 'char nub/ skyed tshal/ chu la rol rtsed/ chang 'thung ba/ gnyis sbyor gyi dga' ston/ grogs por dus 'debs pa/ gnyen bsu ba/gzhon nu skyes pa/ de nyid skyed 'phel/ gros byed pa/ pho nya'i 'gro 'ong / g.yul 'thab/ mnga' thang dar ba sogs rtsa ba'i dngos bstan bcu bdun yod pa las rtsom zhing gzhung chen po dang sbyar nas rtsom 47

pa las/ da yod kyi brjod bya dang sbyar nas brtsams pa shin tu nyung /spyir rang gzhan gyi gtam rgyud ngo mtshar ba dang sbyar nas brtsams na snyan ngag khyad du 'phags pa thon la/ gzhung chen po dang sbyar nas brtsams na snyan ngag gi rin thang dang khyab rgya/ gnas yun gang gi cha nas kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan pa ni smra mi dgos mod/ sngar gyi byung bar thos rgya chung zhing gzhung chen po dag la sbyangs pa dman pa'i gsar slob mkhan rnams la mtshon na de tshig rgyan gyi gzhung don thad kar nges par byed pa la mi phan pa'i rkyen du'ang 'gyur ba red/ rgyu mtshan ni/ gsar slob mkhan rnams kyis tshig rgyan rig pa sbyong ba'i dus mnyam du rgya gar gyi byung ba sna tshogs dang bod rang gi lo rgyus ngag rgyun/ gzhung chen po dag kyang shes dgos pas so/ /der brten rtsom pa pos don de dang skabs bab kyi chab srid blang byar dmigs nas/ rtsa ba'i dngos bstan gyi rmang gzhi'i steng‘‘da lta rang re'i spyi tshogs 'dir/ tang gi yang dag gi 'go 'dren dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun/ bcings 'grol dmag gi dpa' rtsal/ mi dmangs dung phyur mang po'i nus stobs brtson sems sogs dang / mar le'i ring lugs de krung go'i dngos don dang sbyar ba'i srid jus las skabs bab gzi brjid can gyi nang don sna tshogs dang sbyar nas rtsom na ches rmad du byung bar 'gyur ro’’⑪zhes rgyan phal che ba'i dper brjod nang don gsar pa dang sbyar nas go sla bar brtsams 48

yod de/ dper na/rigs rang bzhin brjod pa ni/bla na med pa'i gsar brje'i rang bzhin dang / /dmangs gtso gcig sdud 'dzom pa'i rtsa 'dzugs can/ /chig sgril stobs shugs sus kyang gzhom med pa/ /mang tshogs 'di ni 'jig rten byed por bsngags/ /zhes rigs spyi ste‘‘mang tshogs 'di’rigasar brje dang / rtsa 'dzugs/ mthun sgril rang bzhin can du sgro skur med par drang bor dngos su brjod pa dang /go bzlog pa'i dpe ni/rlabs chen rnam dag tang gi 'go 'dren bzhin/ /nyin mor byed 'di 'jig rten yongs la gsal/ /gang gi rnam par dag pa'i srid jus ltar/ /'od zer snang bas skye rgu bde la sbyor/ /zhes gung khran tang gi 'go khrid dang srid jus la sbyar nas spros yod/ldog pa can gyi gzugs can ni/nam mkhar rang byung rgyu skar dang / /sa gzhir 'dzugs skrun rgyu skar mthong / /gcig shos mtshan mo kho na dang / /'di ni nyin mtshan kun tu mthong / /49

zhes skabs de'i 'dzugs skrun gyi grub 'bras la sbyar nas spros yod/'jigs rung gi nyams ni/nam mkha' stong bar rgyu nus shing / /bgrod pa glog gi shugs las myur/ /gang 'phrad brlag pa'i drag shul can/ /me shugs 'phur mdar su yang 'jigs/ /zhes me shugs 'phur mda'i nus pa dang sbyar nas bstan pa/thog bar mtha' gsum chod min gyi rgyan ni/lham lham nyin mor byed pa'i 'od lham lham/ /lham lham kun las lham lham nyi ma ltar/ /lham lham gtso bo'i gzi mdangs brjid lham lham/ /lham lham kru'u zhi lham lham dpal gyis brjid/ /ces ma'o kru'u zhi'i gzi brjid dpal la sbyar ba/kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig gi rgyan ni/gzi ldan spyi tshogs 'grul bskyod so so'i nang / /rnam kun thon skyed ngal rtsol ma byas pas/ /ci dgar bag yangs sdod pa'i ngang tshul rnams / /lhag ma lus pa de yang rab tu spro/ /zhes gab bya ngal rtsol ma byas pa dang / gab byed le lo can la sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /50

dper brjod 'di dag gi nang don ni skabs de'i gsar slob mkhan rnams la cha rgyus yod pa rkyang rkyang yin pas/ rig byed gtam rgyud dang thub pa'i skyes rabs/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ sngon byung gi lo rgyus sna tshogs la thos rgya che mi dgos la/ gzhung chen po dag la sbyang pa med kyang / sum rtags dag gsum la blo goms pa tsam zhig yin phyin/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung don rtogs sla zhing spyod shes par 'gyur nges red/3 go bde tshig gi lam nas bstan pas/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung don nges sla ba/ gong du brjod pa ltar dper brjod rnams nang don gsar pa dang sbyar nas spros pas/ rang shugs kyis chos skad je nyung du song thog rtsom pa pos skabs de'i slob ma'i chu tshad dang bstun nas/ mngon brjod dang brda rnying cung zad dor zhing /tshig sdud mang po yang med pa'i stabs kyis/ bklags ma thag tshig mnyen zhing don go la spyod bde ba zhig tu snang / dper na/ grol rigs mdzod 'dus las mdzod kyi dper brjod de/spyi tshogs ring lugs rtogs ldan pa'i/ /dmar mkhas las byed gso skyong bya/ /slob gso de yis 'byor med pa'i/ /chab srid la ni zhabs 'degs sgrub/ /de yang thon skyed ngal rtsol dang / /sbyor ba'i byed phyogs legs par bzung / /

de yi mthu las rigs gzhung dang / /slob gso'i 'dab brgya cir yang 'dzum/ /zhes 'khod pa la mtshon na chos kyi skad dang brda rnying / mngon brjod gcig kyang ma bkol par go sla ba'i tshig gi lam nas mdzod ces pa'i sbyor lugs gsal bor bstan pas/ gsar slob mkhan rnams kyis tshegs chen po med par nges thub pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i tshig rgyan rig pa'i bstan bcos de1980lo'i sngon du dngos su par du btab nas gzhi khyon chen por spel ba'i skal ba ma smin pas/ skabs der bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel 'gyur la nus pa 'di dang de bskyed ces smra mi phod mod/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig sde khag sogs kyis dus der snum par du btab nas slob deb byas pa'i yun la gsar slob pa rnams kyis tshig rgyan rig pa sbyang ba'i mthun rkyen legs por gyur pa dang / khyad par dngos su dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus 'gor snyan ngag gsar slob mkhan rnams kyi ngag gi 'dod 'jor gyur par ma zad/ go bde'i ngag gi tshig sbyor spel nas dus skabs gsar pa'i bya dngos brjod cing / yar thon bsam blo mtshon par byed pa gtso bor 'gyur ba'i deng rabs rtsom rig 'di 'grub par rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhi chen po bting pa ni bdag gis mang po smra mi dgos te/dus skabs de nyid brgyud pa'i skye bo kun kyis gsal ler mkhyen pa 52

ltar lags/dpe de bzhin du khong gis1958lor brtsams pa'i(mi dmangs shes rab rtsal gyis dge mtshan gsar du bskrun〉zhes pa'ang krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go 'dren 'og kan su'u mi dmangs kyis ri chu bcos bsgyur byas nas lo yag blangs tshul brjod pa la brten nas/ bod rigs mi dmangs‘‘mgo nag skyid sdug gnam gyi lag’’ces pa dang / rang byung gi ri klung kun la lha klu gnyan gsum sogs gnas pas de bslog mi rung ba dang / bslogs na gnod 'tshe sna tshogs 'byung ba'i gdod ma'i 'du shes kyi 'ching rgya las rnam par grol nas/ dpa' ngar zhum med kyis rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod dang de bcos bsgyur byas te/ mi'i rigs la bde skyid bskrun par blo sgo phyes shing spobs pa bskyed pas/ dus rabs kyi don snying dang dngos yod kyi don snying ldan pa'i don brjod lhug rtsom zhig red/ de yang thog mar‘‘yul de'i rang byung gi bkod pa ni/ kho ra khor yug brag gi ri bo tshar du dngar ba las khyad par nub phyogs kyi sa'i char/ sngon rgya bza' gong jo bod bskyod thog ma'i skabs su bzhengs par grags pa'i snang brnyan 'bum gyis mkhyud pa'i brag ri zlum po da lta 'bum gling brag ces grags pa de dang gzhan yang grwa sde'i brag dang dus gsum brag sogs kun kyang rtse mo nam mkha'i mthongs la bsnyegs pas/ rtsa ba chu bo'i gzhung la thug pa/ bya rgod po 'phur na gshog rtsal 'dar ba/ stag dmar yag 53

mchong na snying rtsa 'dar ba de 'dra'i gcong rong 'jigs su rung ba'i 'gag 'phrang na 'dzam gling 'dir grags pa rab tu gsal ba'i chu bo chen po/ rma klung gaṅga'i sring mo de nyid rol sgeg brgya phrag gi nyams dang / chu lag stong phrag gi rgyun/ sa sna 'bum phrag gi bcud dang ldan zhing rang gar rang byung gi brtul zhugs ngom ste/ lhung lhung gi sgra dang / chal chil gyi rlabs dang / drag 'bab kyi shugs dang bcas mdor na/ rgya mtsho 'khrug pa'i klung 'khor la 'gran pa bzhin du 'bab bo/ /’’zhes tshig lhug gi sgo nas de'i brag ri mtho zhing gcong rong zab la rma klung drag tu 'bab pa'i sa bab rtsub cing chu'i thon khungs 'dzoms tshul zhib 'bri gson nyams ldan pa zhig byas pa dang / de nas‘‘de 'dra'i rang byung gi khor yug dang ldan pa'i rdzong de'i mi dmangs yongs kyi 'tsho ba'i gzhi rtsa ri thang 'gram gsum gyi sa zhing rgya chen po rnams rlan bsher dang bral zhing than pas gdungs te mi yi skyid sdug rang byung la bcol nas blta dgos pa 'di ni gnas ma yin’’zhes sa der chu'i thon khungs ha cang phyug kyang bcings 'grol sngon du‘‘mi yi skyid sdug gnam la bcol’’ba'i 'du shes dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs dang sa bdag nyung shas kyi btsan gnon gyi 'og nas chu bab bzang po bed spyod ma thub par‘‘rgya mtsho rtsib nas bskyur te/ ko gyong mchil mas sbangs pa'i’’dpe'i rjes su song ba brjod cing / bcings 'grol byas rjes dang lhag par lnga brgyad lor tang krung dbyang gi spyi tshogs 54

ring lugs kyi spyi'i lam phyogs dang / kan su'u zhing chen gyi skabs gnyis pa'i thengs gnyis pa'i tshogs chen nas bton pa'i‘‘dka' spyad lo gsum’’gyis kan su'u mi dmangs kyis dpa' stobs gcig bsdus dang thabs brgya jus stong gis ri bo gtor ba'i ldir sgra ni/thog brgya gcig car 'phangs pa 'dra/ /rdo hrag yal ba'i gzegs ma ni/ /mda' yi 'tshub ma 'tshubs pa 'dra/ /rdo dang shing sogs gshags gtubs sgra/ /rtsed 'jo 'du ba'i rol cha 'dra/ /brag gzar ldebs la dmu thag dang / /chu bo'i gzhung la lag rkyal dang / /phan tshur bgrod la thag shud sogs/ / thabs mkhas brgya phrag dag gis bsgrubs/ /zhes grwa sde'i brag dang dpa' bo'i rka zam sogs brag ri rtsub po rnams gtor zhing bslogs la/ yur ba dang chu zam las nas khor yug gi zhing sa mu'u khri phrag mang por rma chu drangs pas/ than skam las rnam par rgyal te lo legs g.yur du za ba smin tshul brjod yod/mjug mthar/sems med blun pa'i rang byung dang / /sems ldan rig pa'i sgyu 'phrul gnyis/ /rgyal pham lag len steng nas mngon/ /

de'i phyir 'jig rten byed por bsngags/ /zhes yun cing rdzong gi ri chu bcos bsgyur byas nas than pa'i gnod 'tshe bsal ba la brten nas rang byung gi khor yug dang cha rkyen bcos bsgyur byed nus pa'i gnas lugs brjod pa dang / rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs ni 'jig rten byed po ste 'jig rten gsar skrun byed mkhan yin pa bden dpang dang der bsngags brjod mdzad par ma zad/lo stong phrag mang por than skam zhing / /'bangs snying stobs can gyis chu mar bsgyur/ /rang byung las rgyal ba'i dpa' ngar thob/ /don de phyir tang la bka' drin zhu/ /zhes pa'i dmangs glu drangs te yun cing rdzong gi ri chu bcos bsgyur byed pa'i bzo bkod bde blag ngang legs grub byung ba ni gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og rgya che'i mi dmangs kyis dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas pa'i grub 'bras yin par brjod pa dang chabs cig bzo bkod de legs grub byung ba des rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi rang byung gi gnod 'tshe las rnam par rgyal thub pa'i dpa' ngar dang spobs pa'ang je cher btang ba bstan nas/ gung khran tang la bka' drin zhu ba'i lha rdzas 'bul ba dang rtsom yig hril po'i mjug bsdus pa red/rtsom yig 'di'i nang don la dus skabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa 56

dang bsam blo'i thad sngon thon gyi nying bcud 'dus par ma zad/'di'i rtsom stangs dang skad cha deng rabs kyi don brjod lhug rtsom gyi sgo dang bstun zhing / lus kyi rnam pa ni〈snyan ngag me long ma'i〉lugs ltar tshigs bcad lhug spel ma'i sgo nas brtsams yod pas/srol rgyun dang deng rabs zung gi khyad chos dang ldan pa'i don brjod lhug rtsom zhig tu snang ba yin na 'dis kyang bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi 'phel 'gyur la rmang gzhi cung zad legs po bting ba red/bzhi/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos bshad pa/dge bshes gsung rab rgya mtsho ni mtsho sngon zhing chen dpa' lung rdzong gi mnga' khongs ri bo dan tig gi nye 'khor ba yan stag tshang sde bar yab skal rdo'am pad ma bkra shis kyi sras su spyi lo1896lor 'khrungs shing / dgung lo bdun gyi tshe ba yan g.yu tsha dgon par phebs nas slob gnyer mdzad/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su ldi tsha bkra shis chos sdings kyi grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la sbyang pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad cing / dgung lo zhe gnyis steng dge bshes kyi mtshan rtags bzhes/ de'i phyi lor ma pu h+phang gis gdan drangs pa ltar/ mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung gi drung yig dang ma pu h+phang gi bu'i bod yig dge rgan mdzad/ de nas1949lor krung go gsar pa tshugs pa dang gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs shing / snga gzhug tu mtsho 57

sngon zhing chen dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang rtsom sgyur khang gi kha'o krang gzhon pa'am nub byang rig slob u yon lhan khang gi u yon/ zhing chen slob gso thing gi thing krang / zhing chen rtsom sgyur u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa/ krung go glog brnyan las don gros tshogs li hri tshogs pa'i li hri/ mtsho sngon zhing chen skabs dang po dang skabs gnyis pa'i mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi/ zhing chen mi dmangs u yon lhan khang gi u yon/ rgyal yongs srid gros skabs gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa/ lnga pa'i u yon/zhing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi rgyun las li hri/ zhing chen srid gros skabs gsum pa'i u yon dang skabs bzhi pa'i kru'u zhi gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan bzhes/⑪ spyi lo1982lor zi ling mkhar du sku gshegs/lo ngo bcu phrag 'ga'i ring la tang gi skyed sring dang sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi thugs skyed la brten nas khong gi gzigs rgya je che dang mkhyen rgya je yangs/ dmigs rgya je ring du gyur thog mi rigs gzhan la dpe ltos nas sku dngos kyis rtsa 'dzugs dang las sne khrid de/ bod mi rigs la nye bar mkho ba'i mtsho sngon bod yig tshags par dang mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin gsar 'don mdzad cing / bod skad kyi glog brnyan sgyur skrun dang bod yig gi slob deb sgyur rtsom mdzad par ma zad/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gsar spel byed par yang phyag rjes mi dman pa bskrun yod/ khong rang sku 58

na phra ba'i dus nas dgon pa 'grims te nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung bka' pod lnga dang bod kyi rig gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pa dpyid phyin par mdzad pas/ bod kyi rig gnas la dga' zhen dang thugs 'dang rab tu che thog 1949lor gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs pa'i tshun la/ tang gi byed phyogs dang srid jus sna tshogs thugs su chud cing / nang logs kyi bzo grwa dang slob grwa sogs sngon thon sde khag la lta gzigs su phebs pa las bod mi rigs kyi rjes lus kyi rnam pa mngon par mkhyen zhing / rjes lus kyi rnam pa de rtsa ba nas bsgyur te sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi rjes su chod dgos na nges par rig gnas slob gso dang tshan rig lag rtsal la brten dgos pa'i shes rtogs sngar las chen po brnyes pas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i las don gtsigs su dgongs shing skal ldan gzhon nu rnams skyed bsring par thugs khur chen po mdzad de/ sbra gur slob chung dang gtan sdod slob chung sogs slob grwa sna tshogs 'dzugs pa dang / sku dngos kyis sne khrid nas(sum rtags mdor bsdus〉dang(rgya bod hor gsum gyi lo rgyus mdor bshad〉/ (dag yig nyi ma'i 'od zer〉sogs slob deb sna tshogs gang la gang 'tsham gyis rtsom sgyur mdzad pa dang dpe khrid gnang ba/gang sa gang du bod kyi gsar skyes gzhon nu rnams la/brtse ldan gzhon nu'i grogs rnams tshur gson dang / /mdzes sdug me tog bzhad 'dra'i grong khyer du/ /59

rin chen lang tsho don med chud gzon du/ /ma gtong bde skyid 'tsho ba bskrun pa'i slad/ /rang 'khri'i don la brtson pa ma lhod cig /⑥ces zhen skul mdzad la/ (nga yi sha tsha'i snying gtam 'di/ /sems la zhog cig mos mthun tsho/ /〉 zhes pa'i bslab bya brtsams pa las kyang 'di ltar gsungs yod/nga dang khyod ces phyogs ris med na yang / /nga tsho bod kyi gzhug ma yin pa'i phyir/ /nga yis bltas na rang gi rig gzhung la/ /nga rgyal med par slob pa gal che snyam/ /bod la rig gzhung mang po yod na yang / /bod yig rtsa ba brda sprod 'di nyid la/ /bod kyi mi rigs don du legs sbyangs na/ /bod la phan thogs che'o grogs po tsho/ /rang gis rang la nges par sha tsha na/ /rang bsdad med par khom pa yod pa'i tshe/ /rang gis tshod kyis slob sbyong byas gyur na/ /rang la phan thogs che'o spun zla tsho/ /legs bshad bzang po 'di yi gzhung don kun/ /legs po zhig ni myur bar ma shes kyang / /legs par nyan nas rang gis 'dang brgyab na/ /60

legs lam shin tu che'o blo ldan tsho/ /zhes na chung gzhon nu rnams la bod kyi sum rtags dag gsum dang / sgra snyan ngag tshad ma sogs rig gzhung mang po dang khyad par du rig gnas kun gyi rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa'i brda sprod rig pa ni na gzhon so so dang mi rigs spyi'i shes rtogs je mthor 'phel ba'i thabs lam nyag gcig yin pa'i gnas lugs zab mo rnams thog ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan gyis spras nas gsal bor bstan zhing / de lta bu'i gzhung lugs gal chen rnams nges par byed pa la'ang spang blang gi bslab bya 'di ltar gnang yod/ bslabs ma thag nas yon tan thob na 'dod/ /nyin zhig song tshe sun nas rnam g.yeng byed/ /de 'dra byas na ci yang mi yong bas/ /rgyun du hur thag gyis shig gzhon nu tsho/ / shes rab bzang po'i mtshon cha rno na yang / /brtson 'grus lag pa'i shed dang ma 'brel na/ /gti mug dgra yi mgo gcod mi nus pas/ /shes brtson zung 'brel byed dgos slob grogs tsho/ /de phyir 'dir tshogs mthun grogs rnam pa la/ /de ring nga yis tshig gsum zhu ba 'di/ /de la bsam blo yag po gtong shes na/ /de kun khyod tshor phan pa'i bslab bya yin/ /61

da skabs nga tsho lhan cig bsdad kyang rung / /rjes sor rang rang las— kar song yang rung / /mi rgan nga yi sha tsha'i snying gtam 'di/ /rgyun du sems la zhog cig mos mthun tsho/ /⑪zhes sun snang dang rnam g.yeng / gti mug sogs kyi dbang du ma gyur par dus dang rnam pa kun tu hur thag dang shes brtson zung 'brel gyis gzhung lugs gal chen rnams sbyang dgos par bstan yod/bslab bya 'di la mtshon na rtsom pa pos thog ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan dang rang bzhin tshig gi sbyor ba la brten zhing / gson nyams ldan pa'i dpe'i sgo nas slob sbyong gi nang don dang dmigs yul/phan yon/ byed phyogs/ de min slob sbyong gi bgegs rkyen sogs mdzub mos ris ston mdzad yod pa red/ 'dir tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs pas spras med kyang rang byung lhun grub kyi ngag gi phreng ba las rtsom pa po bod kyi rig gnas la thugs 'dang che zhing mi rabs rjes mar zhen chags zab pa/ bod mi rigs kyi ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam la thugs khur chen po mdzad pa'i thugs dgongs dri ma med pa de rang shugs kyis mngon 'dug(grong khyer khrang khron gyi gnas tshul zhu pa'i 'phrin yig〉bya bar mtshon na'ang khong gis nub byang rig slob u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang / zhing chen rtsom sgyur u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon 62

pa sogs kyi 'gan bzhes pa'i tshe na bod rigs mi dmangs la mgyogs myur du rang skad kyi glog brnyan bstan nas/ rig gnas 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs por gtong zhing / mthong rgya je yangs dang thos rgya je cher gtong ched/ sku dngos kyis glog brnyan sgyur skrun dang de'i skor gyi shes bya sbyang du phebs skabs/ khrang khron grong khyer gyi 'dzugs skrun dang dar rgyas la ngo mtshar zhing / grong khyer de'i glog brnyan bzo grwa'i sdod khang gi cha rkyen dang longs spyod kyis yid tshim pa/ rgyu rkyen de dag la brten nas tang gi bka' drin dran zhing glog brnyan sgyur skrun gyi las la 'bad dgos pa'i thugs brnyes pa bcas yid 'gyur sna tshogs kyi stobs las thon pa ste gnas tshul zhu rtsom du brtsams pa lags/ de yang nang don cha nas dbye na don tshan bzhir 'dus te / dang por/gzi ldan mes po'i rgyal khab ces/ /grags snyan 'bar ba'i byang shar gyi/ /khrang khron mchog gi snod bcud la/ /bsngags pa'i me tog sil ma 'thor/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin thig le 'dir/ / ngam grogs g.yang sa ma mchis par/ /ljongs chen nam mkha' lta bu la/ /khang khyim skar tshogs bzhin du bkra/ /brgyad 'bum lhag pa'i mi grangs kyis/ /63

bde skyid 'tsho ba gsar pa'i dpal/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal ba mchog /ring nas thob pa'i rtags su che/ /mtsho dang mtshe'u khron pa sogs/ /gtsang ma'i chab rgyun shin tu mang / /khyad par rang byung 'bab chu ni/ /grong khyim kun la 'khor mor khyab/ /mtshan gyi mun stug mthar byed kyi/ /dkar gsal glog gi sgron me'i tshogs/ /phan tshun 'od kyis 'khyud pa yis/ /rmad byung nyi zla'i snang ba 'dzin/ /g.ya' rdo sho bsgrigs lta bu dang / /sa mkhregs lcags dang ar 'dam gyis/ /shing rta glog 'khor rlangs 'khor gsum/ /bgrod pa'i lam chen so sor bzos/ /gnam gru 'phur ba'i gshog rlabs dang / /bzo grwa 'phrul 'khor shugs kyi sgra/ /dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir ba bzhin/ /'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dar snyam byed/ /nye 'dab kun la me 'khor tshogs/ /ri phran mang po phan tshun du/ /64
