'gro bar snang ba'i 'khrul ba skyed/ /dpal stug mdzes ldan nor 'dzin 'dir/ /bzo bos mgo 'dren gsar bcos kyis/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal brgya'i bcud/ /de min gzhan pa su yis sgrub/ /yul 'di'i bzo zhing phal mo cher/ /mar le'i lam srol dpangs mtho bas/ /spyi tshogs ring lugs phun tshogs kun/ /mgron du 'gugs pa'i mthun rkyen zab/ /bzo rig 'phrul gyi na tshod dar/ /tshong las rgya chen bgrang bar yas/ /zhing las g.yur du dud pa'i 'bras/ /kun kyang mthun sgril khang gis brjid/ /gom 'gros myur ba'i rta po dang / /bongs tshod che pa'i ba lang khyu/ /ske nu can gyi ra skyes sogs/ /phyugs rigs dag kyang bgrang las 'das/ /zhim mngar ldan pa'i shing tog dang / /'bru rigs mang po'i dga' ston gyis/ /ngal rtsol 'bangs mi'i bzhin ras la/ /rab dga'i thig le ci yang ster/ / 65

srid 'byor 'bum phrag rgyas byed pa'i/ /rig gzhung mtha' dang gting mi ngoms/ /khyad par glog brnyan rig pa'i khungs/ /'jig rten gzhan las brjid bag chags/ /tā zho drug gi dga' tshal du/ /rnam mang slob grogs bung ba'i khyus/ /rig gzhung zil mngar la spyad pas/ /sngon 'gro'i 'phur lding shin tu mgyogs/ /sngo ljang rtswa yi tshang tshing khrod/ /rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i dga' tshal du/ /gzhon nu pho mo mang po'i tshogs/ /rtag par brtse dga'i dpal la rol/ /bzo tshong las khungs slob grwa sogs/ /ya mtshan bzo dbyibs bkod pa de/ /lha yul gzhal med pho brang kun/ /cig car sa la 'phos 'dra snyam/ /mdor na gsar brje'i 'jig rten du/ /gung khran ring lugs nyin byed 'og /'dren pa'i spyi tshogs skya rengs gsar/ /myur du shar pa'i dge mtshan rdzogs/ /zhes grong khyer khrang khron gyi gzhi khyon mtha' yas shing chu dang 66

glog gi mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa/ 'grim 'grul bde la bzo tshong las rigs dang zhing phyugs thon skyed 'phel rgyas che ba/ rig gnas slob gso dang ar las bya 'phur ba bzhin yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba/ mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba bzang zhing snang ba skyid pa sogs dge mtshan sna tshogs zhib tu brjod cing / de spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin du gzigs pa red/don tshan gnyis par khrang khron glog brnyan bzo grwa'i mthong thos so so dang myangs pa sna tshogs lu gu rgyud ltar brjod pa 'di ltar/nged cag ljongs de'i nang rol gyi/ /krung go glog brnyan bzo grwa yis/ /rtse mor gyur pa tun yin zhes/ /grags pa'i ba dan g.yo ba der/ /ka ba gdung lcam mi mngon zhing / /rdul nyag tsam yang mi dmigs pa'i/ /rab gtsang mdzes sdug khang bzang mchog /chu shel dwangs mas spras pa der/ /dra mig 'phrul gyis legs sbrel ba'i/ /lcags kyi nyal khri mthon po'i steng / /mnyen zhing 'bol ba'i mal stan la/ /gnyid dang ngal gso ci dgar byed/ /67

khang bzang mdzes pa'i khor yug tu/ /spang ljongs rtse shing 'thug po dang / /rab mdzes mig gi mdangs 'phrog pa'i/ /me tog sna tshogs tshar du dngar/ /rmad byung ro brgya'i bcud ldan pa'i/ /bza' bca'i bye brag sna tshogs shig /nyin re bzhin du dus ston bzhin/ /ci 'dod rol bas lus sems tshim/ /gtsang zhing mdzes pa'i khrus rdzing du/ /bsil drod snyoms pa'i chab rgyun la/ /phung bo 'khru ba'i 'phrod sbyor de/ /lus zung skyed pa'i gsos su gyur/ /dkar yol rgyu las legs grub pa'i/ /rta mgo can gyi gsang spyod kyang / /nyin re bzhin du byi dor byed/ /des kyang yid la dga' bde skyed/ /g.yas g.yon nye ba'i khang bzang du/ /lang tsho gsar pa'i gzhon nu tshos/ /rtag tu glu dbyangs sna tshogs dang / /rol cha snyan mos nyin mtshan 'da'/ /zhes khrang khron glog brnyan bzo grwa'i 'chi med khang bzang lta 68

bu'i khang brtsegs kyi phyi'i bkod pa dang nang gi sgrig sbyor/ rab mdzes mig dbang 'phrog pa'i khor yug gi rnam pa/ dga' spro'i dus ston lta bu'i bza' btung gi mthun rkyen/ lus zungs rnam par skyed pa'i 'phrod sbyor gyi cha rkyen/ yid la dga' ba ster ba'i gsang spyod kyi bkol chas/ lus kyi ngal ba gso ba'i khor yug gi rol rtsed/ yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog pa'i glu gar gyi longs spyod sogs dga' zhing tshim pa'i yid 'gyur drag po'i stobs las re re bzhin gzugs brnyan can du thon pa red/don tshan gsum par 'di ltar brjod de/de lta'i mdzes pa'i yul ljongs su/ /lha yi bde skyid lta bu zhig /rmi lam bzhin du myangs pa de/ /srid jus gsar pa'i drin du 'khums/ /zhes ngo mtshar rmad du byung pa'i grong khyer chen po dang / mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i yul ljongs su de snga mig gi spyod yul du'ang smin ma myong ba'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs por rol ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa ni krung go gung khran tang gi mi rigs mthun sgril dang grangs nyung mi rigs la rogs skyor byed pa'i srid jus gsar pa'i bka' drin du rtogs pa red/don tshan bzhi bar rtsom pa pos tang gi bka' drin dran pa dang chabs cig mdzad spyod dngos kyi steng nas drin lan 'jal ba ste 69

tang gis bsgos pa'i bod skad kyi glog brnyan sgyur skrun gyi bya gzhag la 'bad pa'i thugs mnyes pa ste/srid gzhung bka' drin nam mkha'i nor/ /yid kyi mkha' la rtag rol pas/ /spro dga'i pad+ma dkar po'i 'dzum/ /cir yang bzhad pa'i mthun grogs tshogs/ /sus kyang yid kyi chu gter la/ /ngal pa'i rnyogs ma ma mchis par/ /'od stong 'bar ba'i bya ba 'dir/ /dga' ba'i me lce gyen du skyod/ /snga na med pa'i las kyi mchog /khyad nor lta bu rnyed pa 'di/ /rjes su sgrub pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /nam yang rang la skul lcag gis/ /gzi brjid che ba'i bya ba 'di/ /myur du 'grub pa'i re 'dun zab/ / dzeces skul ma dang smon pa cig car du mdzad pa'i dus mtshungs su sku dngos kyis glog brnyan sgyur skrun bya gzhag la rtsa 'dzugs dang mdzub ston mdzad pas/ dus yun thung thung lo 'ga'i ring la byung brjod glog brnyan dang dngos bshus glog brnyan/ tshan rig slob gso'i glog brnyan bcas bcu phrag 'ga' sgyur skrun byas te/ rgya che'i 70

bod rigs sa khul la mig gi longs spyod mi nyung ba zhig 'don sprod byed pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal las don khyab gdal du spel zhing mthor 'degs byed par skul 'ded kyi nus pa rgya chen po bton pa red/ de bas na khong gis glog brnyan bsgyur bskrun gyi las la skul ma mdzad pa'am de legs por grub pa'i smon 'dun zhus pa gang yin rung / thugs la gang shar dang zhal la ci thon smras pa min par/ tang gi skyed sring 'og glog brnyan gyi rang bzhin dang nus pa de sgyur skrun byed pa'i dgos pa sogs mngon par rtogs pa las thon pa'i thugs kyi bdud rtsi dngos yin pa red/dge bshes gsung rab rgya mtsho mchog la snyan rtsom ha cang mang po med kyang / (mtsho sngon po la bstod pa〉bya ba ni rjod byed kyi tshig dang sgyu rtsal gyi nyams/ brjod bya'i nang don/ mtshon bya'i bsam blo gang gi thad nas kyang dus rabs kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba'i brtsams chos shig red/ rang re'i sngon gyi gnas bstod mang che shos ni rtsom pa po rang rang yun ring bzhugs pa'i sgom gnas sam 'khrungs yul gyi ri chu bye brag pa'i bstod pa tsam du zad kyang / dge bshes gsung rab rgya mtsho mchog gyis mtsho sngon zhing gi mtshon byed du lham mer 'khyil ba'i rang rgyal gyi skam sa'i mtsho'u che shos/ snyan pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling khyon du khyab pa'i mtsho khri phyogs rgyal mo de brjod bya'i nang don du 'khod pa dang / rigs lam gsal zhing go rim ldan pa'i sgo nas der bsngags brjod cha tshang zhing gson 71

nyams ldan pa zhig mdzad yod/ de yang thog mar 'di ltar 'khod yod/gnam sngon bzhus pa lta bu'i chab kyi rgyun/ /be+eṭu sngon mo'i klung du 'khyil ba las/ /a mdo mtsho sngon khri phyogs rgyal mo zhes/ /grags pa'i rba rlabs chen po phyogs bcur g.yo/ /mtsho chen de yi rgya dang khyon gyi tshad/ /khor yug ring por yongs su bgrod pa'i tshe/ /rta pho bzang pos nyin lam bco brgyad tsam/ /dgos zhes rtswa thang mi dmangs ngag las thos/ /mtsho yi phyi rol khor yug tu/ /g.yu yi spang ljongs yangs pa la/ /rtsi shing me tog sna tshogs kyis/ /phra tshom btab pa bzhin du mdzes/ /zhes mtsho khri phyogs rgyal mo'i khyad chos dang gnas yul/ rgya khyon/de'i khor yug gi bkod pa sogs yid sprul phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas gzugs snang ldan pa zhig mdor bstan rjes/nang du gser nya mang pos gtsos/ /sram dang chu srin rus sbal dang / /dung dang nya phyis la sogs pa'i/ /srog chags mang zhes yongs su grags/ /72

ngang ngur dang ni chu bya'i rigs/ /bzhad dang mthing ril la sogs pa'i/ /bya tshogs mang po rang rang gi/ /gshog zung gru yis phan tshun skyod/ /mtsho yi lte bar lhun chags pa'i/ /rang byung sa 'dzin chen po la/ /mtsho snying zhes pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /ri bo de yi ngos yongs su/ /me tog 'khrigs pa'i dga' tshal gyi/ / yid 'ong nyams dga'i khang bzang de/ /ngal gso'i gnas la shin tu bzang / /de dang nye 'dabs 'brel ba'i sar /bya sgong ri ltar spung bar thos/ /zhes mtsho mo de'i nang gi thon khungs dang gnas kyi bkod pa dang khyad chos sogs drang bden tshig gi lam nas ngo sprod gsal bo mdzad par ma zad/gnam ngo dag pa'i mtshan mo ru/ /mtsho la zla gzugs shar ba dang / /rgyu skar mang po bkra ba'i tshe/ /nam mkha' yin nam 'khrul ba bskyed/ /ces ngo mtshar zhing 'ud chen po'i sgo nas khri phyogs rgyal mo'i 73

khyad chos phul du byung bar brjod pas 'dzam gling gi ljongs rgyu ba rnams kyi yid kyi dwangs ma 'dren pa'i lcags kyur gyur yod/ mtsho sngon po'i mtha' 'khor gyi mdzes shing byin chags pa'i rang byung yul ljongs dang / der gnas pa'i ri skye srog chags dang phyugs rigs sna tshogs kyi 'du 'god de ni de bas kyang yid kyi spro ba 'dren pa'i dga' ston du mngon pas/ rtsom pa pos mtsho mo'i nang rol gyi dpal dang ngo mtshar zhib 'bri mdzad rjes/ smyu gu'i gom kha rim gyis mtsho mo'i khor yug tu bsgyur pa ste/mtsho chen de yi mtha' skor du/ /dgung la bsnyegs pa'i ri bo dang / /gtsang zhing dwangs pa'i chu phran sogs/ /yul ljongs mdzes pas yid dbang 'phrog /khod snyoms 'jam pa'i rtswa thang du/ /sus kyang bdag tu ma bzung ba'i/ /rkyang dang gla ba shwa yu mo/ /rna g.yag rko ba kha shwa dang / /wa dang 'brong rgod la sogs pa'i/ /ri dwags mang po bag phebs su/ /khyu khyu byas nas rgyu ba las/ /ya mtshan ltad mo mang du mchis/ /rta mang ri dwags bzhin du bang rtsal 'gran/ / 74

nor rnams phan tshun rgyugs nas rwa rtse byed/ /ra lug gnam du mchong nas bro gar rtse/ /lu gus 'ba' dir byas nas glu dbyangs len/ /zhes mtsho mo'i phyi rol gyi rang byung bkod pa dang 'dzoms pa rnams drang bden dang sgro btags zung 'brel gyi sgo nas zhib tu bstan yod/〈mtsho sngon khri phyogs rgyal mor bstod pa〉zhes pa ni mtsho sngon po'i phyi nang gi rang byung bkod pa dang thon khungs tsam ngo sprod pa'am de 'ba' zhig la bstod pa'i ched du brtsams pa ma yin te/rtsom pa pos mtsho khri phyogs rgyal mo'i phyi nang gi dpal dang ngo mtshar brjod nas klog pa po'i spro ba kun nas 'dren pa dang chabs cigarim bzhin mtsho mo de'i khor mo yug tu gnas pa'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba gsar pa brjod pa'i phyogs su 'khor ba 'di ltar/mtsho sngon mtsho yi phyogs bzhi ru/ /gnam la rgyu skar shar ba bzhin/ /'dzad med rtswa thang chen po'i thog /'brog khyim mang pos yongs su gang / /'brog la spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi/ /gsar brje chen po byas pa'i rjes/ /gnam sa lta bu'i g.yo 'gul gyis/ /glo bur 'gyur ldog byung ba'i tshul/ /75

ri lung so sor 'khyams pa yi /'brog 'bangs mtha' dag mthun sgril gyis/ /rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i bde thang du/ /gtan chags byas nas bde bar 'tsho /de yis rgan byis mang po zhig /'gro 'dug dka' ngal bsal ba dang / /phyugs zog sngar las 'phel che bas/ /phyugs thon rdzas kyang sngon las mang / /sha mar gnyis kyi ri brtsigs shing / /zho dang 'o ma'i mtsho bskyil te/ /zhim mngar 'dzoms pa'i bza' btung la/ /ci dgar longs su spyod byas nas/ /zhes mdzes sdug 'byor phyug ldan pa'i mtsho sngon khri phyogs rgyal mo'i khor mo yug tu 'brog sde rnams mthun sgril gcig gyur gyis gtan chags kyi khang pa dang phun sum tshogs pa'i bza' btung la ci dgar rol par bstan cing / der brten nas skabs der mtsho sngon zhing gi 'brog phyogs su phyugs zog thun mong la dbang ba'i lam lugs btsugs pa dang / phyugs las gtan chags kyi sa khul btsugs pa'i yang dag rang bzhin la bsngags brjod byas pa red/mjug mthar/rmad byung tang gi 'go 'dren dang / /76

mi rigs srid jus 'od zer 'og /rgyal khab mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis/ /mchong skyod chen po'i rba rlabs kyis/ /zhing phyugs 'brel ba'i thon skyed sogs/ /spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la/ /'bad pas brel ba chen po des/ /gung khran ring lugs myur du bsu/ /zhes skabs de'i tang gi byed phyogs dang srid jus bzang por brten nas phyugs las thon skyed la phyogs yongs nas thon legs byung zhing 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba sngar las je bzang du song bas/ rgya che'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi thon skyed brtson sems rab tu che ba bstan pa dang rtsom hril po'i mjug bsdus pa red/mdor na snyan rtsom 'di'i brjod bya'i nang don la mtshon byed rang bzhin ldan zhing / rtsom pa po'i rigs lam gsal zhing go rim zhib mo'i sgo nas brjod bya'i nang don cha tshang zhing gzugs snang ldan pa zhig bkod pa dang / rang gi pha yul la thugs mnyes shing de gces su dgongs pa dang / skabs de'i tang gi byed phyogs dang srid jus la mngon par bstod pa'i mdo don 'bur du thon zhing mngon par gsal ba/ mtsho khri phyogs rgyal mo'i khyad chos dang yul bkod ngo mtshar can la thugs phyogs shing / de'i thon khungs 'dzoms po dang gnas de'i 'brog pa rnams kyi snga na med pa'i 'tsho ba'i longs spyod 77

la ngo mtshar zhing thugs tshim pa'i 'gyur ba drag po dang ldan pas/snyan rtsom 'di bklags ma thag mtsho khri phyogs rgyal mo'i 'gram ngogs su dngos su 'byor ba lta bu'i snang ba ster ba dang / khyad par du snyan rtsom de lo rabs brgyad cu bar mi rigs slob grwa chen po drug gi deng rabs rtsom rig slob deb tu bkol nas khrid sbyong byas pas/ skabs de'i gsar slob pa rnams la shan shugs zab mo thebs/snyan rtsom de dang de lta bu'i blo bskyed la brten nas/ mtsho sngon zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lhan tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gcod pa don grub lags kyis(mtsho sngon por bstod pa'i glu dbyangs〉⑫bya ba brtsams shing / mtsho sngon mi rigs dge thon ched sbyong slob grwa'i dge rgan chen mo bkra shis phun tshogs lags kyis〈mtsho khri phyogs rgyal mor phul ba'i glu dbyangs〉⑪bya ba brtsams/ snyan rtsom de dag gi rtsom pa po so so yin pas rtsom gyi nyams 'gyur dang skad cha'i sgyu rtsal la khyad par cung zad yod rung / rtsa ba'i sgrig phyogs ha lam rgan gsung rab kyi snyan rtsom dang gcig 'dra yin la/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs(sprin gyi sgra dbyangs〉su drangs pa'i bdag gi snyan rtsom(khri gshog rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉zhes pa de'ang brjod bya'i nang don dang de'i sgrig rim sogs dge bshes gsung rab rgya mtsho'i(mtsho sngon por bstod pa〉la dpe bltas nas brtsams pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du khong gi rtsom rig brtsams chos gzhan pa rnams kyang dus skabs de'i bod kyi 'thus tshab brtsams chos yin 78

te/ de dag gis bod kyi rtsom rig gi skad cha dang brjod bya'i nang don mang tshogs can dang spyi chos can du 'gyur bar sne khrid kyi nus pa bskyed par ma zad/ skabs de'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyis tang gi srid jus sna tshogs nges par byed cing nang logs 'dzugs skrun byas pa'i grub 'bras dang nyams myong rgyus lon byed pa/ 'du shes rnying ba'i 'ching rgya dkrol te gsar byung bya dngos dang len byed pa/bod kyi na gzhon rnams blun rmongs dang le lo'i dbang du ma song par rig gnas spyi dang khyad par du deng gi sngon thon tshan rig la sbyangs brtson byas nas/ bod kyi spyi tshogs phyogs yongs nas dar rgyas su 'gro bar skul 'ded kyi nus pa rgya chen po bskyed pa red/gsum pa/ mjug sdud pa'i gtam/bcings 'grol sngon du bod kyi dbang sgyur mi sna nas ser skya mang tshogs tshang mas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad pa dang /khyad par du btsun pa rab byung ba rnams kyis blo sems rtse gcig gis der dad mos byed par ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi chos spel ba dang rnam thar skyong ba'i las la 'bad kyin yod pas/ khong tsho'i brtsams chos mang che ba'i brjod bya'i nang don yang ston pa shākya thub pas bka' chos gnang skabs chos nyan pa rnams kyis go zhing rtogs par bya ba'i phyir btags par byung ba gzhan las drangs te dpe rgyas par bstan pa'i rtogs brjod dang / bcom ldan 'das 79

kyis sngon bskal ba grangs med gsum la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad par grags pa'i skyes rabs gtam rgyud/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i rnam thar/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ram rtogs brjod sogs yin la/ brtsams chos de dag gi dgos pa gtso bo'ang ston pa'i che ba brjod nas der dad mos med pa rnams la dad mos bskyed pa dang / dad mos ldan pa rnams kyi yid la dga' ba bskyed pa/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la snying po med par brjod cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par bsngags nas mi rnams rnam dkar dge ba'i las la skul ba de red/ brjod bya'i nang don sngon byung gi gtam yin pa dang mtshon don bsam blo chos lugs kyi lta ba yin pas/ sngon byung gi gtam la thos pa med pa dang chos lugs kyi gzhung la sbyang pa med pa zhig yin tshe/ mtshon don bde blag gis dpyis phyin pa zhig go mi thub pa yin/ yin na'ang / krung go gsar pa tshugs pa dang bstun nas spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs dang khrid ston gyi bsam blo/ chab srid kyi dgos pa/ rtsom rig gi byed phyogs/ klog pa po'i rim pa sogs la 'pho 'gyur snga na med pa byung bas/ bod kyi rtsom rig la'ang ngo bo rang bzhin gyi 'phel 'gyur byung ba ste/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i chos pa rnams 'jig rten gyi 'tsho ba dang chab srid kyi dgos pa brjod pa'i rtsom pa por gyur pa dang / brjod bya'i nang don de sngon byung gi gtam gtso bo yin pa nas da lta'i spyi tshogs steng byung ba'i 80

bya dngos gsar par 'gyur pa/ rtsom rig gi mtshon don bsam blo ni tshe phyi ma'i bde ba snyeg pa nas tshe 'di'i bde ba 'tshol bar gyur la/rtsom rig gi skad cha'ang rtogs dka' ba'i yig skad nas go sla ba'i mang tshogs kyi skad cha dang nye bar 'phel 'go brtsams pas/ bod kyi rtsom rig spyi tshogs can dang mang tshogs can du 'phel bar sne khrid kyi nus pa rgya chen po thon la/ bod kyi rtsom byung lo rgyus kyi ngos nas bltas na rtsom rig sngon thon can du 'phel ba'i bskyogs mtshams chen po zhig kyang red/gsal bshad/durje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom pod dang por 'khod pa las mdor gshu byas/②bu②rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom pod gnyis par 'khod pa'i(bslab bya 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i mdzum zer〉bya ba las gsal/durje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom pod gnyis pa'i shog ngosakhya98las gsal/⑥ 〈 dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho〉 bya ba'i shog ngos365par drangs yod/tsorje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom pod gnyis pa'i shog ngosakhya40las gsal/durje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom pod gnyis pa'i shog ngosakhya38las gsal/81

stirje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom pod gsum pa'i shog ngos530las gsal/(yi(snyan ngag gi spyi don tshig rgyan rig pa'i lde mig〉gi shog ngos13las gsal/(yi(gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod〉las gsal/⑪(mi1982lo'i(sbrang char〉deb4par drangs yod/3khong gi gsung rtsom(brtse dung gi mig chu〉bya bar drangs yod/⑤bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs(sprin gyi sgra dbyangs〉su drangs yod/

le'u gsum pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig bshad pa/dang po/ dus skabs gsar pa'i dus mgo'i bod kyi rtsom rig bstan bcos 'ga' bshad pa/de yang‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’zang zing gi lo zla'i nang du g.yon thal che ba'i bsam blo'i shugs rkyen 'og bod kyi rtsom rig sogs rig gnas spyi la glang dar dus skabs lta bu'i gnod pa tshabs chen thebs nas ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur rung / 1978lor tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs nas g.yon thal che ba'i nor 'khrul bsam blo yo bsrang byas pa dang tang gi las don gyi lte gnad de dpal 'byor 'dzugs bskrun bya bar bsgyur zhing / lag len ni bden don tshod bgam byed pa'i tshad gzhi nyag cig yin pa'i kha phyogs dang dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi bsam blo'i lam phyogs skyar du gtan la phab pa'i dus mtshungs su bod kyi las don thams cad bod kyi don dngos dang bstun dgos pa'i byed phyogs srid jus rab dang rim pa gtan la phab/ de dang chabs cig tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus 83

skyar gso'am dngos 'beb byas pa dang / bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang de'i phyogs kyi mkhas pa rnams la lta stangs yang dag bcangs nas‘‘lha 'dre gdon bgegs’’dang‘‘rjes lus’’‘‘rmongs dad’’kyi btsan 'gel 'og nas thar par gyur pas/ slar yang rtsom rig gsar rtsom la 'jug pa'i rang dbang thob cing rtsom pa'i thugs 'dun drag tu brdol ba/ khyad par du slob gso lam lugs legs bcos byas nas rgyal yongs kyi mi rigs slob grwa chen mo so so'i bod skad sde khag tu ched las nyams pa slar gso dang med pa gsar 'dzugs byas pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas la mkhyen pa yangs pa'i bla sprul dang dge bshes rgan pa dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las dang tshe tan zhabs drung / dmu dge bsam gtan/ shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/ dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan sogs so sor bod ljongs mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ kan su'u zhing chen gtsod mi rigs ched sbyong slob grwa chen mo sogs su gdan drangs shing / khong rnam pas bod kyi rig gnas sna tshogs 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa dang sgos su mi rabs rjes ma'i shes bya'i kho lag rgyas pa'i ched du/ thugs ngal brgya phrag mang po khyad bsal gyis skabs bab slob ma'i yon tan dang dgos mkho ltar rtsom rig bstan bcos dang gna' rabs rtsom rig sum rtags dag gsum 84

bcas kyi slob deb rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang la gang 'os su brtsams par ma zad/ zhib 'jug slob ma dang slob grwa chen mo ba/mtho rim ched sbyong slob ma/ slob grwa chung 'bring gi dge rgan bcas la mdzub khrid mdzad pas/ bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig nyams pa slar gso'i sman du gyur la/ de'i mtshungs su slob grwa chen mo so so'i bod skad sde khag tu rtsom 'jug dang rtsom rig rnam bshad sogs deng rabs rtsom rig shes bya'i khrid rgyun yang spel bas/ gna' deng gnyis kyi rtsom pa'i lugs la goms pa'i rtsom pa po'i dpung sde gsar pa zhig 'tshar longs byung / de'i steng du1980lor bod kyi rtsom rig dus deb dang po〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉gsar gtod byas pa'i tshun la(sbrang char〉 (mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉 (zla zer〉 〈spang rgyan me tog〉 (gangs ljongs rig gnas〉 〈gangs dkar ri bo〉 〈lho kha'i rtsom rig〉 (bod ljongs sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug〉sogs rim bzhin gsar spel byas thog (bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉dang〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉steng du'ang rtsom rig gi par ngos btod pas/ bod kyi brtsams chos sna tshogs rtsa ba zug cing yal 'dab rgyas la me tog rnam par bzhad pa'i sa zhing gshin por gyur la/ bod rang skyong ljongs dang zhing chen/ khul so sor rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs btsugs nas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal las don ched du gnyer zhing der do dam dang khrid ston byas/ de ltar tang gi byed phyogs srid jus dang rtsom pa po brtsams chos 85

'god yul/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal las don gnyer ba'i las khungs/ phul byung rtsom rig la bya dga' ster pa bcas phyogs lnga'i mthun rkyen mngon par 'dzoms pa la brten nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig de chab srid kyi tshod 'dzin dang 'ching rgya las grol te/ chab srid can nas spyi tshogs can dang bod can du 'gyur zhing bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas chen po byung / de yang rtsom pa po'i dz+was nas bltas na rgan dar gzhon gsum zung du 'brel ba'i rtsom pa po'i dpung sde zhig chags pa dang / brjod bya'i bstan don gyi ngos nas bltas na rma brjod rtsom rig dang phyi 'dang rtsom rigabacos sgyur sgo 'byed dang na gzhon pho mo'i brtse dung / 'jig rten mi chos sogs gtsor ston pa shas che ba/ rtsom gyi rnam pa'i ngos nas bltas na snyan ngag dang sgrung gtam/ lhug rtsom/ zlos gar/ dpyad brjod bcas mnyam du 'phel ba/ rtsom gyi rigs kyi ngos nas bltas na dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig mnyam du 'phel pa/ sgyu rtsal rtsom stangs kyi ngos nas bltas na rang gi dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi rtsom stangs dang gna' bo'i rgya gar mkhas pa'i rtsom stangs/ deng gi 'dzam gling spyi la khyab pa'i rtsom stangs bcas zung du 'brel ba'i khyad chos yod pa yin/ des na gsham du bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gal chen te rtsom rig bstan bcos 'ga'i yon tan dang phan nus brjod par 'dod do/ /86

gcig dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi(snyan ngag la 'jug tshul tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed〉bshad pa/(gcig)rtsom pa po dang rtsom pa'i dgos pa bshad pa/de yang tshig rgyan rig pa'i bstan bcos de'i rtsom pa po ni dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchog yin zhing / khong ni1927lor bod ljongs kong po nying khri'i khongs gtogs jo mo shang du sku 'khrungs pa dang / 1934lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas dung dkar sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / khong sku na phra ba'i dus nas se ra dgon pa grims nas mdo sngags gzhung la thos bsam rgya cher mdzad de dge bshes lha rams pa dang sngags rams pa'i mtshan ming thob/ 1956lor rgyal khab gzhung gi las byed pa'i gras su zhugs shing nying khri kron chus kyi u yon dang nang bstan chos tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon par bsko bzhag gnang / de nas mi ring bar pe cing du krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang / ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i’’skabs su lha sa grong khyer grong mi u yon lhan khang gnyis pa'i khongs su ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod la zhugs su bcug 1975lo nas bzung snga rjes su bod rang skyong ljongs rig dngos do dam u yon lhan khang dang / bod ljongs yig tshags bdag gnyer khang / bod ljongs gsar brje 'grem ston khang / bod rang skyong ljongs chab srid gros tshogs bcas su dkar chag dang lo rgyus rtsom sgrig gi phyag las gnang zhing / 1978lo nas 87

bzung slar yang krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor bod yig dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang / dge rgan chen mo'i go ming dang krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i phul byung dge rgan gyi gzengs bstod lag 'khyer/ bod rang skyong ljongs slob gso tshan rtsal u yon lhan khang nas bod ljongs slob gso'i phul byung byas rjes can gyi gzengs bstod lag 'khyer thob/ 1993lo nas rgyal yongs chab srid gros tshogs skabs bdun pa dang skabs brgyad pa'i u yon du 'dem bsko byung ba dang / gzhan yang krung go rgyal yongs lo rgyus zhib 'jug tshogs pa dang krung go 'dzam gling chos lugs zhib 'jug tshogs pa/ krung go grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom rig zhib 'jug tshogs pa/ krung go rgyal yongs nang bstan chos tshogs bcas kyi u yon dang 'thab jus 'dri yul/ krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi spyi khyab dbu 'dzin gzhon pa dang / rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i zhib dpyad lhan tshogs kyi las 'dzin bcas kyi 'gan bzhes gnang la/ snga rjes su 'jar man dang nor wi/ dbyi ta li/ o ti li/ h+pha ran si/ dbyin ji bcas su rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gros tshogs su phebs myong ba bcas mdor na khong nyid ni rgyal khab phyi nang du mkhas pa'i grags pa rab tu 'bar bar mngon/①gsung rtsom la(dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉deb las(snyan ngag la 'jug tshul tshig rgyan rig 88

pa'i sgo 'byed〉ni khong gis lo rabs drug cu bar krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i zhib 'jug slob mar slob khrid kyi zin bris gzhir bzung nas brtsams shing / de1962lor snum par du btab nas nang khul dpyad gzhi'i yig char phul ba las/ rgya che'i klog pa pos bod kyi rig gzhung la slob gnyer byed pa'i las dang po ba rnams la gzhung cha tshang ba'i slob deb cig yod na skabs bab dgos mkho dang bstun te rgyas bsdus brkyang bskum byas chog pa zhig yong rgyur phan thogs 'dug pas slob deb der gzhung cha tshang ba zhig kha snon byed dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ rang rigs kyi mi rabs rjes ma rnams rab gsal blo gros kyi mig gi mthong rgya che ru gtong ched/ bskyar du legs bcos dang kha snon byas te gzhung cha tshang ba'i slob deb de brtsams pa red/(gnyis)rtsom rig bstan bcos dekhri khyad chos bshad pa/bstan bcos de ni lo bcu'i zang zing sngon dang khyad par du lo bcu'i god chag byung ba'i rjes su bod kyi rig gnas la skya zad sngo stong byung ba'i dus kyi zhib 'jug slob ma dang slob grwa chen mo pa/mtho rim ched sbyong slob ma bcas kyi rig gnas chu tshad dang slob khrid kyi dgos mkhor dmigs nas brtsams pas/ dus rabs kyi khyad chos mngon par thon yod/ de yang nyid kyi zhal nas/ snyan ngag gi 'grel bshad snga ma rnams su rtsa ba'i tshig 'grel dang dper brjod kyi 'grel bshad mdzad de/ de'i steng du gzhung gzhan gyi 89

dper brjod drangs nas/ da dung dper brjod gsar pa re bkod 'dug pa ltar/ 'dir yang rtsa ba'i sdom tshig dang / rgyan so so'i ngos 'dzin/ dper brjod rnying ba re dang / da lta'i dus skabs dang sbyar ba'i dper brjod gsar pa re bcas sbrags nas rang gi blo ngor 'char ba bde bar bya ba'i phyir de tsam gyis 'thus par bya rgyu yin no/ /zhes pa ltar/ snyan 'grel sngon ma rnams kyi rtsom srol gyi rgyun bskyangs pa ltar snang yang / zhib tu dpyad na snyan 'grel sngon ma rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos 'di 'dra yod par snyam/1 brjod bya'i nang don dang go rim〈snyan ngag me long ma'i〉sgo dang bstun yod kyang snyan 'grel sngon ma ltar de'i rtsa ba'i tshig ji bzhin du drangs nas 'grel ba mi mdzad par rtsom pa pos rang gi mkhyen rab la brten nas gzhung de'i go don re re phyogs bsdus dang go sla ba'i ngag gis thad kar gsal bor bstan pa ste/ tshigs bcad rtsom yig gi tshig rkang mang nyung skor bshad skabs/tshigs bcad rkang bzhi pa de yang / /bṛ t+ta dzā zhes rnam gnyis/ /de yi spros pa mtha' dag ni/ /sdeb sbyor gzhung du nges par bstan/ /zhes pa de drangs nas 'grel ba mi byed par/rgya skad tshigs bcad rtsom yig gi /'bri tshul sdeb sbyor gzhung du gsal/ /90

bod skad tshigs bcad rkang pa bzhir/ /tsheg bar grangs ni cha mnyam zhing / /tshig rkang re re'i tsheg bar grangs/ /snga nas so gsum bar du bshad/ /zhes pa dang / le'u gsum pa sgra rgyan spyi'i mtshan nyid yang /rjod byed tshig gang yig gzugs dang / /sgra dang mtshungs par sbyar ba las/ /tshig sbyor mdzes shing brjod don kyang / /legs par ston nus sgra yi rgyan/ /zhes rtsa ba las don 'dus shing kha gsal ba zhig 'khod cing de'i steng nas rgyas par spros pas/ skabs su bab pa'i slob gnyer pa rnams kyis tshig rgyan so so'i mtshan nyid sogs gzhung don ma lus nges sla bar ma zad/ blo ngor 'dzin bde pa'i yon tan mnga' ba ltar red/2 tshig rgyan so so'i dper brjod du thog mar〈snyan ngag me long ma'i〉 rtsa ba bkod nas go sla ba'i tshig gis zhib 'grel byas pas khongs dang ldan la/ de nas bod mkhas sngon ma rnams kyi dper brjod las rgyan gyi mtshan nyid tshang zhing go bde la/ sdeb sbyor legs shing nyams che pa gang la gang 'os bkod pas/ bod mkhas sngon ma rnams kyi rtsom pa'i nying bcud 'dus pa/ mtha' mar skabs de'i slob ma'i shes rgya dang chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang bstun ched/91

skabs de'i slob ma rnams la cha rgyus yod pa'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ rig gnas sogs 'thab phyogs so so'i gsar byung bya dngos dang 'tsho ba dngos las brtsams pa'i dper brjod gsar pa re bkod pa ste/ dper na/ don rgyan so gnyis las zla bo dngos po'i dper brjod la/srid 'dir rigs pa'i gzhung lugs sna mang yang / /bden don dngos ston mar le ring lugs te/ /rno ngar mtshon cha'i bye brag mtha' yas kyang / /gnad du mi 'chor me shugs 'phur mda' tsam/ /zhes dang / gzugs can gyi rgyan las khyad par gzugs can gyi dper brjod la/ri 'dzegs dpung sde'i rkang sen nor bu'i rdul/ /'dzam gling sa mtho'i ral ba'i cod pan du/ /bkod tshe mthon mthing gangs kyi rgyal mo yang / /skar lnga'i dar dmar spyi bo'i rgyan du blangs/ /zhes pa/ sgra rgyan las rkang pa bzhi ka'i gnas gsum du chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi dper brjod la/gsal gsal nyi ma'i 'od kyis gsal gsal nor 'dzin ma lus ches gsal gsal/ /gsal gsal dwangs pa'i yid ngos gsal gsal ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku gsal gsal/ /92

gsal gsal rig gzhung nang nas gsal gsal slob dpon khyod kyi gsung gsal gsal/ /gsal gsal blo gros mig zung gsal gsal ma 'ongs mdun lam kun gsal gsal/ /zhes bkod pas/ rgya gar gyi gna' bo'i rig gnas dang chos lugs/ bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus dang brda rnying sogs kyi rmang gzhi zhan pa'i slob ma yin yang sum rtags dag gsum la byang cha cung zad yod pa zhig yin phyin/ snyan ngag gi gzhung don ma lus nges thub pa yin/ mdor na slob deb de ni mi rigs kyi dbang du byas na rgya bod mi rigs gnyis dang / dus kyi dbang du byas na gna' nye deng gsum gyi tshig rgyan rig pa'i dper brjod 'dzoms pa'i bstan bcos shig red/3 gsar byung bya dngos sogs spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos las brtsams pa'i dper brjod gsar pa'i sgo nas tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung don gsal bor bstan par ma zad/ snyan ngag gi srog bshad skabs/ da lta'i dus rabs dang sbyar na/ gong gi brjod don rnams kyi nang nas re gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi steng du/ krung go gung khran tang dang / rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi mchog gi dpa' mdzangs thabs mkhas kyi dbu 'khrid yang dag pa dang / krung go'i mi rigs yongs rdzogs 'ching 'grol thob pa dang / rig gnas dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun sogs yar rgyas mdun mchongs 93

chen po byung ba dang / mang tshogs kyi rig rtsal las 'gul gyi ngo mtshar ba'i khyad chos gang yod dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang / gsar brje'i don du gshegs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyi dpa' ngar zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs dang / mar khe si le nyin ring lugs dang / deng rabs chab srid kyi nang don sogs skabs su bab pa'i brjod don rnams 'os shing 'tsham pa'i snyan ngag gi rgyan dang sbyar na ches phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhes(snyan ngag me long〉 las dngos su bstan pa'i snyan ngag rtsom gzhi bco brgyad kyi tshod 'dzin thebs mi nyan pa bstan par ma zad/ de dag mang che ba las kyang gsar byung bya dngos dang spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon par byed cing / snyan ngag gi rtsom gzhir skabs su bab pa'i spyi tshogs kyi bya dngos gsar pa bkod nas brtsams na snyan ngag phun sum tshogs por 'gyur ba gsal bor bstan/ 'di ni snyan 'grel sngon ma rnams las ma thon pa'am yang na gsal bor brjod med pa'i cha'o /4 le'u gsum gyi brjod don yongs su rdzogs rjes go bde ba'i tshigs bcad kyi sdom tshig bkod cing / de ni rtsom pa pos a kyā yongs 'dzin dang / dngul chu dharma bha dra'i〈snyan ngag me long〉 gi sdom tshig gnyis gtso bor bzung / der ma tshang ba(me long ma〉 rang gi rtsa tshig gal che ba rnams dang / sa paṇa gyi〈mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo〉 gnyis nas legs pa'i cha rnams blangs/ de'i steng du skabs 94

skabs su go bde ba'i tshigs bcad gsar rtsom 'ga' zhig kyang bsnan nas grub pa yin pas/ gzhung don tshang zhing rgyas bsdus ran pa/ brten sa'i khongs btsun zhing nyer mkho'i gzhung dag pa/ blo la nges sla zhing yid la 'dzin bde ba bcas kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon la〈snyan ngag me long〉 bod can du gyur pa'i mtshon rtags shig kyang red/5 slob gnyer pa rnams kyi rig gzhung gi chu tshad mtho dman dang bstun zhing sbyangs bya'i bed spyod rin thang gi che chung la dmigs nas snyan ngag gi slob khrid rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ji ltar bya ba'i dpe mtshon dpyad gzhir 'khod pas/ snyan ngag 'khrid mkhan rnams la stabs bde bzos pa dang / khyad par du sbyang bya'i bed spyod kyi rin thang la dmigs nas sa bcad dang tshan pa'am rgyan gang dag deng skabs bed spyod kyi rin thang cher med pas 'khrid mi dgos par gsungs pa dang / sa bcad dang tshan pa'am rgyan gang dag bod kyi skad la rgyugs che zhing bkol spyod kyi rin thang dang ldan pas dmigs su bzung nas 'khrid dgos par bstan pa des slob ma rnams la sbyang bya'i gnad gang yin pa gsal bor bstan par ma zad/ don la(snyan ngag me long〉 gi dngos bstan gyi nang don la dpyad brjod thengs shig kyang mdzad pa lags/6 snyan ngag gi gzhung dngos ma brjod pa'i sngon du tshig sbyor kha gsal zhing don 'dus pa'i sgo nas gzhung de'i rtsom pa bam̐ dang 95

nang don/ grangs tshad bcas mdor bstan pa dang / snyan ngag gi gzhung de bod la ji ltar 'gyur pa dang de gzhung gang la brten nas sbyong dgos pa sogs ngo sprod mdzad cing / gzhung de bod la ma 'gyur pa'i sngon la bod du snyan ngag gi gzhung med kyang snyan ngag yod pa lung rigs rnam dag gi sgo nas bstan pas/ snyan ngag gi gzhung gzhan na med pa'i khyad chos ldan cing snyan ngag la 'jug pa'i las dang po pa rnams kyis〈snyan ngag me long〉 gi rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus dang de rtsom pa'i skabs bab dang dgos pa/ (snyan ngag me long〉 dang 'brel ba'i snyan ngag gi gzhung gtso bo gang dag yod pa bcas rgyus lon byed par khrid ston gyi nus pa chen po thon pa dang /bod kyi snyan ngag dang de'i skor gyi gzhung lugs byung 'phel la zhib 'jug byed par lung tshad ma dang lta ba rnam dag 'don sprod mdzad pa yin/(gsum)rtsom rig bstan bcos de'i phan nus brjod pa/lo bcu'i zang zing gi khrod du bod kyi rig gnas la glang dar dus skabs lta bu'i god chag tshabs chen byung nas snyan ngag gi gzhung rnying pa rnams med brlag tu gyur pa dang gsar pa da dung ma thon pa'i dus skabs der khyad chos drug dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung de brtsams pa dang khyad par du1982lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dngos su par skrun 'grem spel byas rjes rim bzhin kruja dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang / mtsho sngon mi 96

rigs slob grwa chen mo/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo sogs kyi bod skad sde khag gi snyan ngag slob deb tu gyur pas/ skabs der snyan ngag slob deb med pa'i stong cha bskangs shing / gzhung de'i blang bya ltar zhib 'jug slob ma dang slob grwa chen mo pa/ ched sbyong slob grwa chen mo pa sogs la gang la gang 'tsham du slob khrid byas pa las blo gsal slob gnyer pa rnams kyis dus yun thung ngu'i nang du snyan ngag gi gzhung don phal cher khong du chud cing / gzhung de'i khrid ston 'og spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang gsar byung bya dngos rnams tshig rgyan sna tshogs dang sbyar nas snyan ngag rtsom pa'i blo sgo che ru phye shing spobs pa che ru bskyed pas/ skabs bab dang mthun pa'i snyan ngag mang po phan tshun 'gran pa ji bzhin gsar rtsom 'grem spel byas nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig nyams pa skyar gso dang / dus rabs dang mthun pa'i rtsom pa po khag cig skyed sring byed par bsnyon du med pa'i nus pa thon pa yin/gnyis/ tshe tan zhabs drung gi〈snyan ngag spyi don〉bshad pa/(snyan ngag spyi don〉 ni bod kyi rig gnas kun la nang byan chud cing mkhas pa'i snyan pa 'dzin ma'i rgyan du khyab pa'i tshe tan zhabs drung 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyis lo rabs lnga bcu ba'i 'gor brtsams pa yin/ de yang spyi lo1959tsam la srid gzhung gis gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i 97

bod skad sde khag tu dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang zhing / skabs de'i slob ma mang che ba ni krung go gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i dgos mkho ltar spyi tshogs steng bsdus pa yin pas/ rgya bod gnyis ka yod cing rgya yig la byang cha yod pa'i slob ma'ang mi nyung ba dang / bod yig gi rmang gzhi zhan pa/ slob yun thung ba/ blang bya mtho bas/ sngar yod tshig rgyan rig pa'i bstan bcos rnams slob ma'i chu tshad dang mi ran la/ rgyal khab kyi shes ldan mi sna skyed sring byed pa'i blang bya dang yang mi 'tsham par gyur/ gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og tu rtsom pa pos slob ma'i rig gnas chu tshad dang spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho/ skyed sring gi blang bya sogs la dmigs nas brtsams shing snum par du btab nas khrid gzhir byas pa dang / lo ngo nyi shu 'ga' la bkol spyod dang zhib 'jug phyogs sdom bcas byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo sogs kyi slob chen pa dang zhib 'jug slob ma sogs don gnyer can skor zhig la khrid gzhi mkho ba rkyen du byas nas sngar brtsams kyi spyi don de la snon 'phri ci rigs kyis cung zad je rgyas su btang ste khrid pa dang chabs cig spyi lo1981lor kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dngos su par skrun 'grem spel byas pa lags/ (snyan ngag spyi don〉 de rtsom pa'i dus dang dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ khyad chos kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod pa 'di ltar/98

1 brjod bya'i nang don bsdus shing spyod go che ba/bstan bcos de'i brjod bya'i nang don rgya gar gyi(snyan ngag me long〉 gi brjod don dang de'i go rim ji bzhin brtsams pa ma yin te/ bod kyi skad la rgyugs chung zhing spyod go mi che ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bcu lta bur mtshon na/ go sla ba'i tshig gis de'i mtshan nyid tsam 'grel pa las re re bzhin dper brjod bkol nas rgyas par spros med pa dang / rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang dpe rgyan so gnyis dpyis phyin pa zhig nges na don rgyan so lnga las mang po zhig gcig shes kun grol du 'gyur pa dang / yang na rgyan so so'i spyi'i 'gro phyogs tsam shes na'ang gzhan rnams gcig shes kun grol tu 'gyur srid pas/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang dpe rgyan so gnyis go sla ba'i tshig gi sbyor pa dang kun la rgyus che pa'i nang don can gyi dper brjod la brten nas gsal bor bstan pa las/don rgyan gzhan pa dang sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan mang che ba spyi'i 'gro phyogs tsam bstan pas 'thus par mdzad cing skyon bsal yang rgyas par ma bstan pas/ brjod bya'i don bsdus shing spyod go che la skabs de'i slob yun dang slob ma'i dgos mkho dang mthun pa yin/2 dper brjod kyi nang don phal che ba kun la cha rgyus yod pa'i gsar byung gi bya dngos yin pa/skabs de'i slob ma'i bod yig gi chu tshad cung zhan pa dang rgya gar rig gnas la rgyus chung par dmigs nas/ slob dpon darnyi'i(99

snyan ngag me long〉 gi dper brjod mi 'dren par skabs de'i slob gnyer pa rnams la cha rgyus gsal bo yod pa'i rang byung yul ljongs dang byung ba gsar pa/ dngos rdzas gsar pa/ dus tshigs kyi khyad chos/ srog chags kyi rang bzhin sogs la sbyar ba'i dper brjod kyi sgo nas tshig rgyan so so gsal bar bstan pas/ dus rabs kyi blang bya dang mthun par ma zad/ slob gnyer pa rnams kyis dus yun thung thung nang du tshegs chen po ma byas par snyan ngag gi spyi khog lon pa'i khyad chos ldan pa yin/3 dper brjod kyi nang don gzhan rigs slob mar 'tsham pa/skabs de'i slob ma'i khrod na rgya sogs mi rigs gzhan pa'ang mi nyung pa zhig yod cing / kho tshor bod yig gi chu tshad mthon po med kyang rgya yig gi rmang gzhi cung bzang po zhig yod pas/ rtsom pa pos snyan ngag gi spyi don bde blag gis rtogs par bya ched/ nyid kyi zhal nas/rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs dri ma med/ /rgya chen rig pa'i bang mdzod ltar gang mod/ /rgya mtsho las 'ongs chu yi thigs pa bzhin/ /rgya bod gzhon nu dgyes pa'i skyes su spel/ /②zhes pa ltar/ dper brjod kyi nang don rgya mi rigs kyi gna' gtam grags can dang rgya yul gyi rang byung yul ljongs/ grong khyer gyi khyad chos sogs la sbyar bas/ rgya dang rgya'i rig gnas la cha rgyus 100

yod pa'i slob gnyer pa rnams kyis snyan ngag gi spyi khog lon pa'i sman du gyur pa yin/4 tshig sbyor snyan zhing go sla ba/gzhung de'i dper brjod kyi nang don skabs de'i slob gnyer pa rnams la rgyus yod pa'i bya dngos 'god pa dang chabs cig brda rnying pa dang mngon brjod/ chos lugs kyi tha snyad sogs mang po ma bkol pa dang / tshig gi sbyor ba cung zad lhod pas bklags ma thag snyan zhing go sla ba'i snyam pa bskyed nges red/5 bod kyi tshig rgyan rig pa 'thus tshang du btang ba/bod la rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi ring nas tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi nang du ka mad sum cu 'du par byed pa'i ka rtsom dang /'gro mgon 'phags pa'i sku ring nas ka mad sum cu'i go rim dang yang na gsal byed sde ba so so'i nang gses kyi go rim ltar rtsom pa mdzad pa'i srol yod pa mgrin pa gzengs su bstod nas brjod phod cing / bod mkhas rim byon rnams kyis rtsom srol de dag 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas ka rtsom sna tshogs grangs las 'das pa brtsams yod pa kun gyi mthong snang du gyur/ yin yang bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom srol de dag gzhung lugs su gtan la phab cing bod kyi tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung du 'god mkhan cher ma byung bas/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi ka rtsom gyi lugs dang〈snyan ngag me long〉gi dngos bstan gyi rgyan bya dka' ba'i sgra rgyan gnyis zung du sbrel 101

nas tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung du 'khod pa ni/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng snga na med pa'i gsar gtod cig yin la bod kyi tshig rgyan rig pa 'thus tshang du gtong ba'i lhan thabs gal chen zhig kyang yin par nges/6 thun min gyi dper brjod drangs nas gab tshig gi rig pa bstan pa/gab tshig ni tshig rgyan gyi ngos nas bltas na bod kyi dmangs khrod brtsams chos khed dang kun nas mtshungs mod/ sngon gyi tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung rnams su〈snyan ngag me long〉 las bstan pa'i dper brjod 'gyur ma 'dren pa dang yang na de dpe byas nas brtsams pa'i gab tshig snyan ngag gi sgo nas ngo sprod pa yin yang /rtsom pa pos skabs de'i slob ma'i bab dang bstun ched/ bod kyi dmangs khrod brtsams chos khed dang de las brtsams pa'i gab tshig gi dper brjod thun mong ma yin pa drangs nas bstan pas/ gab tshig gi rgyan rnams rtsed mtshar dang las sla ba'i sgo nas nges thub pa yin/ des na bod dmangs khrod du sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur pa'i khed dang de brjod bya byas pa'i gab tshig snyan ngag la brten nas gab tshig gi rgyan ngo sprod pa ni bod mkhas sngon ma rnams kyi thugs la ma shar pa dang / thugs su shar rung zhal nas ma gsungs pa/ zhal nas gsungs kyang snyan ngag gi gzhung du 'god ma myong ba'i thabs dam pa zhig yin no/ /102

khyad chos drug dang ldan pa'i〈snyan ngag spyi don〉de snub par du btab nas khrid sbyong byas pa dang / khyad par du spyi lo1981lo'i zla8par kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dngos su par skrun 'grem spel byas shing / lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i mgor mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis rtsom pa po sku dngos kyis slob khrid mdzad pa sgra blangs nas bod kyi skad yig khrid pa'i las tshan nang du btang par ma zad/ mtsho sngon zhing chen khu nu sgra brnyan par skrun khang gis slob khrid kyi sgra phab spyin shog dngos su 'grem spel byas pa bcas la brten nas/ (snyan ngag spyi don〉 de slob grwa chen mor khrid sbyong byed pa nas spyi tshogs dang dgon sde so so'i khrid gzhir gyur nas/ bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa nyams pa slar gso byed pa dang deng rabs rtsom rig 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar sman pa'i nus pa rgya chen poske thon pa yin/gsum/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan gyi〈tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs〉 bshad pa/snyan ngag la 'jug pa'i tshul rgya cher bshad pa'i bstan bcos de'i rtsom pa po ni/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i thugs sras bse khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje yin zhing / khong nyid sku na phra ba'i dus nas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam pa'i drung du mdo sngags rig gnas 103

dang bcas pa'i gsan sbyong mi nyung ba mdzad pa dang / khyad par du mkhas pa'i dbang bo kun dga' rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas snyan ngag rtsa 'grel gyi mdzub khrid dang dper brjod rgyugs 'bul bcas zhib mor sbyangs par brten snyan ngag phyogs la skyes sbyangs kyi mkhyen dpyod rab tu yangs pa zhig yin thog② 1980lor kan lho mi rigs slob grwa'i dge rgan rnams la snyan ngag gi slob khrid byed skabs/ dbyangs can dgyes glu dang / bod mkhas pa'i dper brjod rtsa ba dang sbrags pa'i 'grel bshad go bde can gyi bslab deb cig dgos par dge slob kun gyis re ba yang yang zhus pas/mi rigs rang gi rig gnas 'phel rgyas dang / blo gsal gzhon nu don gnyer can rnams la phan pa'i ched du/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i〈snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs〉 kyi dgongs don khrid rgyun dang dus yun ring bo'i slob khrid kyi nyams myong gzhir bzung pa dang / mkhas pa'i dbang bo dag gi gsung rgyun dri ma med pas rab brgyan te/ 1982lor mjug rdzogs par brtsams shing / 1984lor kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas kun gyi spyan lam du dngos su 'grem spel byas pa lags/ snyan ngag gi gzhung de kan lho mi rigs slob grwa'i dge rgan gtso byas pa'i blo gsal gzhon nu rnams kyi re ba yid bzhin du bskong pa'i ched du brtsams pa yin pas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bzhi thon pa 'di ltar/104

1 bstan bcos kyi khungs btsun zhing brjod don nges sla ba/bstan bcos de'i zhu pa po ni bod yig gi rmang gzhi bzang pa dang yang na snyan ngag la'ang go ba nges can yod pa'i kan lho'i mi rigs slob grwa'i dge rgan dag yin pas/ de dag la snyan ngag ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul rgyas par ston ched/ thog mar〈snyan ngag me long〉 gi rtsa ba ji bzhin bkod nas rang stobs kyis tshig sbyor bde mo'i sgo nas zhib 'grel mdzad pas/ bstan bcos khungs dang ldan zhing tshig rgyan so so'i gnad kyi dam pa nges sla ba yin/2 grags can mkhas pa'i tshad ldan dper brjod bdams nas bkral pas snyan ngag gi gzhung 'grel mang po gcig chog tu gyur pa/gzhung der〈dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu'i〉 dper brjod cha tshang pa dang / bod mkhas dang rje zhwa dmar parnyi ta'i dper brjod gnyis las gang 'os cha tshang bar bkod de zhib 'grel byas pa'i mthar rang nyid kyi dper brjod cha tshang ba re bkod pas na/ dpe mang klog mi dgos pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung 'grel gcig chog tu gyur pa ma zad/ slob gnyer pa rnams kyis snyan ngag gi gzhung cha tshang zhing yang dag pa zhig nges par byed pa dang / tshad dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag rtsom pa la gzhal mtha' bral ba'i nus pa rgya chen po thon la/ mkhas pa gsar rnying gi dper brjod zung du sbrel nas bkod pa des tshig rgyan so so'i gnad kyi dam pa rtogs par byed pa 105

dang / mkhas pa so so'i rtsom rtsal 'don stangs dang brjod bya 'dem tshul/ thugs kyi 'char so sogs nges par yang sman gyi nus pa bskyed pa red/3 rgyan gyi ngo bo'i khyad par phye bas de'i gnad kyi dam pa ngos 'dzin byed bde ba/rgyan gong 'og gi khyad par 'dres la khad yod pa'i rigs te/dper na/ le'u dang po'i lho ba'i lugs kyi sbyar ba dang gzhon pa'i khyad par/ don rgyan so lnga las rmad byung gi dpe dang gtan 'bebs kyi dpe'i khyad par/ smad pa'i dpe dang dgag pa'i dpe gnyis kyi khyad par/ dpe rgyan dang gzugs rgyan gyi khyad par/ rigs rang bzhin brjod pa dang rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed kyi khyad par/ le'u dang po'i rgya che'i yon tan dang don rgyan so lnga'i nyer gnyis pa 'byor ba rgya che'i rgyan gyi khyad par/ mnyam nyid kyi dpe dang tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar rgyan gyi khyad par/ le'u dang po'i rjes khrid kyi rgyan dang le'u gsum pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan gyi khyad par sogs 'dres la khad yod pa dang yang na cha 'dra ba'i rgyan rnams dmigs su bkar nas/ de dag gi khyad par gsal bo phye pas/ slob gnyer pa rnams kyis rgyan so so'i ngo bo ma 'dres par ngos 'dzin byed bde ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa ni snyan gzhung sngon ma rnams la med pa'i legs bshad du 'khums so/ / 4 rigs pa yang dag gis gzhan lugs dgag cing rang 106

lugs 'thad ldan bkod pas slob mkhan la dogs gzhi med pa/snyan ngag skabs kyi yi ge lci yang ji ltar 'jog pa'i thad sde ba rin spungs sogs kyis rgya gar gyi yi ge lci yang gi rigs pas bod yig la 'gebs pa mdzad nas/ bod yig la'ang brtsegs pa dang /'greng bu can dang / na ro can/ mtha' rten can rnams lci ba dang /de las ldog pa rnams yang ba'i yi ge la 'jog par bzhed pa dang /bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rnams dang 'brug khams sprul sogs kyis rgya gar pa'i srol ltar/ bod yig la yi ge lci yang gi brda chad btsan gyis sbyar du med cing / bod skad la sum rtags kyi gzhung dang bstun nas tshig sdud dang / yi ge pho mo ma ning sogs kyi dbye bas sgra gdangs drag zhan dang / byed rtsol che chung gi khyad par la khungs bcol nas/ lci yang mtho dman sogs ma 'khrugs pa byas na mi rung ba med par gsungs pa las phyi ma legs par bzhed pa dang / don rgyan so lnga las sum cu ba nges bstan gyi rgyan la sa skya'i mkhas pa ngag chos kyis/ rgyan 'di ni dpe rang dang chos mtshungs pa'i don nges par bstan pa'i rgyan yin pas na dpe rgyan so gnyis kyi nang tshan ma yin yang dpe rgyan du song zhes bshad pa mi 'thad par bkag nas rang lugs 'thad ldan pa bzhag pa lta bus mtshon mkhas pa so so'i bzhad dgongs mi 'dra ba dang phan tshun 'gal bar gyur pa/ yang na rang nyid kyi lta ba dang mi mthun pa'i rigs la rang stobs kyis brtag cing dpyad pa zhib mo mdzad nas rang 107

lugs 'thad ldan bzhag pa de slob gnyer pa rnams kyi shes bya rgya bskyed pa dang dogs gzhi med pa'i sgo nas shes bya tshad ma ngos 'dzin par phan pa chen po yod pa red/khyad chos sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung chen po de dpe skrun 'grem spel byas rjes/ snyan ngag la spro ba rgyas pa'i slob gnyer pa dang khyad par du slob grwa che 'bring gi dge rgan dang zhib 'jug slob ma/ de min bod kyi snyan ngag gi gzhung rgyas par shes 'dod mkhan rab byung btsun pa rnams kyi sbyang gzhi gal chen du gyur cing / kho tshos gzhung de nyid la brten nas bod kyi snyan ngag gi gzhung zhib mo shes shing rtsom rtsal je mthor 'gro ba dang / brtsams chos gsar pa mang du brtsams te bod kyi rtsom rig nyams pa slar gso dang 'phel rgyas su btang dang gtong bzhin pa yin/bzhi/ dor zhi snyems pa'i blo gros kyi(snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus kyi don 'grel shes bya'i gnad gsal〉bshad pa/(snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus〉 ni rgan dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo mchog gis spyi lo1985lo'i dbyar kha mtsho sngon zhing chen mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang gis zi ling grong khyer du zhing chen gyi bod yig las khungs dang / rong 'brog khul gyi rtsom sgyur pa dang bod yig dge rgan brgya phrag longs pa bsdus nas bod yig zab sbyong 'dzin grwa tshugs skabs/ rtsom rig shes bya'i slob 108

deb du sgyu rtsom rigs spyi la khyab pa'i shes bya'i gal gnad mang po zhig rtsa tshig gi tshul du brtsams shing / dpe khrid byed pa brgyud nas(rtsom rig shes bya gnad bsdus kyi don 'grel shes bya'i gnad bsdus〉brtsams nas/ spyi lo1986lo'i(mtsho sngon slob gso〉 deb dang po nas bzhi ba'i steng du mu 'god byas pa dang / spyi lo1990lo'i zla8par mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉su dpe skrun 'grem spel byas rjes/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang rtsom rig dpyad brjod la blo phyogs mkhan rnams kyi khrid ston gzhung lugs su gyur/(gcig) bstan bcos de'i brjod bya'i nang don bshad pa/rtsom rig bstan bcos de'i brjod bya'i nang don bye brag tu shin tu mang yang gtso bor gsham gsal gyi phyogs bzhir 'dus pa 'di ltar/1 bstan bcos de'i brjod bya'i nang don gtso shos ni sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi shes bya yin pas/ thog mar sgyu rtsal rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal rtsom rig ma yin pa'i dbye ba rnam par phye ba ste/ brjod bya don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa dang / bden don brjod pa dang / drang bor brjod pa gtso bor byed pa'i rtsom ni sgyu rtsom ma yin pa'am dngos po'i gnas lugs brjod pa'i rtsom du bcad cing / brjod bya mngon sum gyi tshul du rtogs pa dang / rtog btags brjod pa dang / 'khyog brjod gtso bor brjod pa'i rtsom ni sgyu rtsom du bshad pa yin/ spyir 109

rtsom gyi rigs la‘‘dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa dang / skyon yon bsngags pa rnam gnyis yodari’ces sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis〈sdom gsum rab dbye〉sogs su bstan rung / rtsom gyi rigs dbye ba'i tshad gzhi cha tshang zhing mngon par gsal ba zhig thon med la/ bstan bcos de dngos su dpe skrun 'grem spel byas med pas/ don gnyer pa rnams kyis bklag par de 'dra'i stabs bde po'ang ma red/ des na rgan dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo mchog gis rgya gar gyi snyan gzhung dang bod mkhas sngon ma rnams kyi gsung sgros la gzhi byas/ deng gi rtsom rig gzhung lugs la zur lta mdzad nas rtogs rigs dang brjod don/ tshig sbyor bcas gsum gyi ngos nas sgyu rtsom dang sgyu rtsom ma yin pa'i dbye ba gsal bor phye ba des rtsom rig gsar rtsom pa dang / rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa/ rtsom rig zhib 'jug pa sogs la rtsom gyi rigs 'jal pa'i yo byad tshad ma zhig gnang pa su zhig gis bsnyon par nus/2 〈snyan ngag me long〉 la gdengs 'jog byed pa/de yang rtsom pa pos(snyan ngag me long〉 gi rnam bshad sogs la/ rgyan gyi bstan bcos dang tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos su 'bod pa la brten nas/ de tshig rgyan kho na yin par bsam pa dang / tshig rgyan sbyor tshul tsam shes na snyan ngag shes par rlom nas tshig 'don tshul la do snang cher byed pa las/ rtsom gyi lus dang srog dang nang don/rtsom stangs/ rtsom gshis/ rtsom gyi rgyu dang dgos pa sogs rtsom gyi 110

gnad don gzhan dag la do snang mi byed pa la sogs pa'i snang tshul la dmigs nas/ 〈snyan ngag me long〉 gi bstan don dang deng gi rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi nang don gnyis zhib bsdur gyis〈snyan ngag me long〉 de tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos tsam min par/ rtsom lus kyi rnam pa dang / brjod bya'i nang don/ brjod don bsam blo/ rtsom stangs/ rtsom gshis/ rtsom gyi rgyu cha/ rtsom skyon spong tshul sogs rtsom rigs kyi gzhung lugs cha tshang zhig yin zhes gdengs 'jog byed pa'i zhor du snyan ngag sogs sgyu rtsom legs po zhig rtsom dgos na tshig rgyan sbyor tshul tsam shes pas mi chog par/ rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi gnad don gal chen rnams kyang nges par shes dgos pa nan gyis bstan yod/3 〈snyan ngag me long〉 du ma 'dus pa'i rtsom rig shes bya bstan pa/de yang rtsom pa pos thog mar(snyan ngag me long〉 gis zin pa'i rtsom rig shes bya rnams gshib sdur dang dpyad brjod yod pa'i sgo nas gsal bor bstan rjes/ der ma 'dus pa'i deng rabs sgyu rtsom gzhung lugs kyi shes bya ste/ sgyu rtsom gyi mtshan nyid dang rang bzhin/ snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid dang khyad chos/ sgrung gtam gyi mtshan nyid dang khyad chos/ zlos gar gyi mtshan nyid dang khyad chos/ lhug rtsom gyi mtshan nyid dang khyad chos/ sgyu rtsom gyi brjod bya dang dgongs pa'i 'brel ba/ rtsom pa po'i langs phyogs dang lta phyogs/ bsam pa'i 111

dmigs yul sogs kyi khyad par/ rtsom gyi rang bzhin mchog dman gyi khyad par/ mdzes sdug rig pa'i lta ba/ rtsom gyi brjod bya'i nang don dang / rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor/ rtsom gyi bzo bkod sogs phyi tshul bar gyi 'brel ba/ snyan rtsom gyi byed las dang dgos pa'i sgrub phyogs/rtsom mkhan gyis shes rgya bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rtsom gyi brjod bya bsal 'don byed tshul/ sgyu rtsom gyi rang bzhin/ brjod bya gzugs dbyibs kyi snang brnyan dang / mngon sum gyi yul du gtad pa'i rtsom stangs/ mngon 'gyur du yod pa'i 'tsho ba'i bden pa dang / sgyu rtsom gyis mtshon pa'i bden pa'i khyad par/ sgyu rtsom gyi don ston stangs/sgyu rtsal la mi rigs kyi khyad chos dgos tshul/ snyan rtsom tshig sbyor gyi blang bya/ rtsom mkhan bzang po zhig la 'dzom dgos pa'i yon tan/rtsom gshis/ tshig dang don gyi 'brel ba/ rtsom gyi bzang ngan 'byed pa'i tshad gzhi sogs gang la gang mkho rnams kha gsab mdzad pas brjod bya'i khyab rgya che ba yin/4 bod kyi skad la rgyugs dang mkho che ba'i tshig rgyan bshad pa/〈snyan ngag me long〉 du dngos su bstan zhing bod kyi skad la'ang rgyugs dang mkho che ba'i tshig rgyan te/ dpe rgyan dang gzugs rgyan/ don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ ldog pa can gyi rgyan/ phul byung gi rgyan/ bsnyon dor gyi rgyan/ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan/ phra mo'i rgyan/ cha'i rgyan/ rab rtog gi rgyan/ nyams ldan gyi rgyan/ srid pa can gyi rgyan/rim pa can gyi rgyan/ dga' ba'i rgyan/ rgya che ba'i rgyan/ sbyar rgyan/112

khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/ mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan/ skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan/ zol bstod kyi rgyan/ nges bstan gyi rgyan sogs dmigs su bkar nas mtshan nyid gsal bor bstan par ma zad/ phul byung gi rgyan dang bsnyon dor gyi rgyan gnyis kyi rang bzhin dang byed las/bsdus rgyan gyi khyad chos/ cha rgyan gyi ngo bo dang khyad chos/ sgra rgyan gyi rang bzhin dang nyams 'don tshul sogs kyang 'bur du brjod yod/de yang rgyan de dag rtsom pa pos rtsom rig spyi'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal du nges pas/ de dag gsal bar bshad par yang mkhas pa'i snyan tshig 'ba' zhig steng nas mi brjod par kha skad dang / dmangs khrod gtam rgyud/ glu dang gzhas shags/ yang na 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan gyi brtsams chos sam ri mo 'bri stangs sogs kyang gang la gang 'tsham bdams thog rang gi shes rab stobs las thon pa'i kha gsal don 'dus kyi tshig sbyor khyad par can gyis spros pas/bklags ma thag tshig nyams kyi gnad 'don tshul nges sla ba yin/de'i zhor du da dung snyan tshig la dpe dang nyams gsar pa dgos tshul dang don la mi 'byor ba dang gnad la mi khel ba'i tshig skyon spel dgos tshul/ tshig gis don ston tshul dang don ston tshul gyi thabs/ rang phyogs dang ldog phyogs nas yon tan ston thabs/ snyan rtsom gyis brjod bya'i dngos po'i rang bzhin mtshon tshul/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad je mthor gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs rtsom rig gsar rtsom la mkho che ba'am rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad mnyam 113

'jog dgos pa'i shes bya'i gal gnad kyang mang du bstan yod/(gnyis) bstan bcos de'i sku rtsal gyi khyad chos bshad pa/de yang gong gsal gyi phyogs bzhi'i ngos nas brtag cing dpyad na/ rtsom rig bstan bcos de la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang yon tan shin tu mang yang / phyogs gcig tu bsdus na gsham gsal gyi phyogs bzhir 'dus par snyam/1 brjod bya'i don gyis phyug pas/ sbyangs pa'i phan nus che ba/rtsom pa po'i zhal nas/gna' nas dar ba'i mi rigs rang gi rtsom srol gzugs mdzes gzhon nu dang / /deng dus grags pa'i 'jig rten spyi lugs rtsom rig mtshar sdug bu mo gnyis/ /rnam dpyod khyim du mdza' bor bsdebs la legs 'khrungs rtsom gzhung bu chung 'di/ /chung yang gsar skyes khyad chos ldan pas rgas 'khogs dag gis 'gran nus min/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin bstan bcos de ni bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom gzhung dang deng rabs sgyu rtsal spyi la khyab pa'i shes bya'i gal gnad zung du sbrel ba'i rtsom rig gzhung lugs shig dang / bod kyi skad la rgyugs dang mkho che ba'i tshig rgyan rig pa dang rtsom rig gzhung lugs lhan du 'dres pa'i phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi bstan 114

bcos rtsa chen zhig red/ snga na med pa'i bstan bcos gal chen des rtsom pa'i las kyi bzhi mdor rmongs pa'i gzhon nu gsar rtsom pa rnams kyis tshig nyams 'don tshul kho nar 'bad nas rtsom rig shes bya gzhan la do snang mi byed pa'i snang tshul bsgyur nas/ 〈snyan ngag me long〉 dang deng rabs sgyu rtsom skor gyi shes bya'i gal gnad mang por phyogs yongs nas sbyangs pa legs po byas te/ rtsom rig gzhung lugs dang ro myong gi chu tshad mthor 'degs su gtong pa dang / rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi las la tshul ji ltar 'jug par sa paṇa〈mkhas 'jug〉 lta bu'i phan nus bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyed cing / 〈snyan ngag me long〉 gis bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas thad bskyed pa'i phan nus dang bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng zin pa'i go gnas la zhib 'jug byed par gzhung lugs kyi khongs bcol sa legs po zhig kyang 'don sprod mdzad pa red/2 bod skad rnal ma'i tshig sbyor spel bas/ brjod don thams cad bde blag tu go ba/rtsom pa po bod kyi tshig rgyan rig pa dang 'dzam gling spyi khyab kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la mkhyen pa rab tu rgyas shing tshig sbyor tshul la khyad du 'phags pa'i rtsal dang ldan pas/ rjod byed tshig la bod skad rnal ma'i tshig sbyor tshul dang shod stangs/ don ston tshul sogs kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal zhing brjod don go bde ba yin/ dper na/115

'o ma'i kha las 'o zhag bcad pa bzhin/ /zhag de bsrubs nas nying bcud len pa bzhin/ /brjod byar blangs pa'i don gyi 'o mtsho las /don gnad nying bcud mar gsar len par bya/ /zhes brjod bya bsal 'don byed tshul bod rang gi 'tsho ba dngos dang sbyar nas bstan pa dang / snyan rtsom gyi byed las dang dgos pa'i sgrub phyogs de/rmongs pa'i gnyid las sad byed 'brug gi sgra/ /gshis ngan dug sbrul tshang gtor gnam lcags thog /ya rabs snang ba'i lam ston nam mkha'i nor/ /dgongs gzhir byas pa snyan rtsom mechog tu bsngags/ /zhes bod la shin tu goms shing rgyus che pa'i gzugs rgyan la sbyar nas bstan pas/ 'gyur ma dang bshus ma'i slad cung zad kyang ma 'dres shing / brjod don gzugs snang ldan pa'i sgo nas nges thub pa'i khyad chos 'bur du thon pa ltar ro/ /der ma zad phyis su(rtsom 'jug〉 dang〈rtsom rig rnam bshad〉sogs rtsom rig bstan bcos rtsom zhing bsgyur bar tha snyad gsar ba'i rmang gzhi brtan po bting zhing tshig sbyor spel stangs dang don ston tshul gyi ma dpe bzang por gyur pa red/3 sna tshogs lung gis bstan pas/ brjod bya rnam par rtoṭa pa/rtsom pa pos bod yig dang rgya yig dbyin yig sogs skad 116

rigs mang po mkhyen zhing gzigs rgya shin tu yangs pas/ brjod bya'i lta ba gang zhig sgrub pa'i lung dang bstan bya'i shes bya gang zhig mtshon pa'i dper 'dzam gling mi rigs so so'i mkhas pa'i gsung sgros khyad par can gang la gang 'tsham drangs nas brjod par ma zad/ nyid kyi zhal nas/ dpe sbyor tshul snyan tshig rig pa'i gzhung gi dper brjod sogs dang / mkhas pa'i gsung rtsom sogs las shes dgos par ma zad/ kha skad dang / dmangs khrod kyi sgrung gtam/ glu dang gzhas shags dpe 'then gyi nang na don zab cing / nyams mtshar ba'i dpe mang du yod pas slob sbyong byas nas bed spyad na rtsom nyams legs po thon/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ tshig rgyan mtshon byed kyi dper da dung dmangs khrod kyi skad cha dang glu gzhas nyams mtshar ba'ang drangs pas shes bya'i gal gnad rtogs sla zhing klog mkhan gyi shes rgya bskyed par phan nus chen po ldan pa red/4 deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig la/ 'phel phyogs gsal ba'i sgron me sbar/sngon chad gzhan gyis gsung ma myong ba ston pa dang / gzhan gyis gsung myong ba je gsal du gtong pa ni bstan bcos de'i khyad chos gtso shos shig red/ rtsom pa pos sgyu rtsom gyi gzhung lugs dang tshig rgyan ston pa dang / de'i zhor du bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi 'phel phyogs dang 'bad phyogs ston pa'i legs bshad kyang mang du gsungs pas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom pa rnams kyi blo mig ches 117

cher phye pa red/ de yang sgyu rtsal gyi ngo bo la/ sgyu rtsom gyis dus gsum gyi bem shes dngos po'i snang tshul gang rung zhig mtshon phyir/ rtsom pa pos rang gi dga' sdug chags sdang gi yid 'gyur nyams snang dang /dran pa'i mkha' dbyings su rang dgar rgyu ba'i 'char snang sna tshogs las bris pa'i rtog btags kyi snang brnyan rjod byed tshig gi lam nas ston/ zhes bod mkhas sngon ma rnams kyis gsung ma myong ba gsar du bstan pa dang / snyan rtsom gyi dgongs gzhi brjod skabs/rmongs pa'i gnyid las sad byed 'brug gi sgra /gshis ngan dug sbrul tshang gtor gnam lcags thog /ya rabs snang pa'i lam ston nam mkha'i nor/ /dgongs gzhir byas pa snyan rtsom mchog tu bsngags/ /zhes snyan rtsom gyi dgongs gzhir mi rnams rmongs pa las slong pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi gshis ngan yo bsrang byed pa/ bsam pa rgya che zhing kun spyod mdzes pa/ shes rig ldan zhing spyod pa yag pa'i mi skyed sring byed pa/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas kyi mdun lam gsal bar byed pa brjod don byed dgos par gdams pa dang / snyan rtsom gyi dgos pa'i dgag phyogs ston pa la/ ‘‘bzang ngan go bzlog dang / ma rabs gzengs bstod byed pa dang / spyod ngan rgyun 'byams dang yar skyed stobs shugs nyams pa'i rgyur 'gro ba'i rtsom rigs ni dug tu blta zhing mi gtsang phyag lud bzhin du spang dgos’migasungs pa/ rtsom gshis ston skabs/118

la la'i tshig sbyor chu dwangs nya mo bzhin/ /la la'i tshig sbyor chu rnyog rdo mi mthong / /gab tshig lta bu'i dgos pa gzhan med na/ /snga ma yon tan phyi ma skyon du blta/ /zhes rgyun spyod min pa'i brda rnying mngon brjod dang / bsdus che zhing 'khyog rgyan gyis spras pa'i tshig sogs nan gyis sbyar nas don bsgribs pa'i rtsom gshis 'gog cing tshig don gsal zhing go bde ba'i rtsom gshis la bsngags pa brjod nas 'bad par skul pa/rtsom mkhan gyis shes rgya bskyed dgos tshul ston skabs/ spyir phyogs gang thad nas kyang shes rgya lta rgya che bar gtong ba dang / 'jig rten gyi rig gnas gsar pa len pa gal che zhing / lhag par rtsom rig phyogs nas gzhan gyi legs cha blangs nas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad je mthor gtong ba gal che zhing / de ltar ma byas na rang re'i gna' lugs kyi khang brtsegs nyis thog sum thog cig las/brtsegs thog brgya lhag yod pa'i deng rabs kyi mkha' bsnyegs khang brtsegs mthon po nam yang bzo bar mi nus so/ /zhes rtsom pa po rnams shes rgya je cher gtong ba dang / 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas legs cha blangs nas rang gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad je mthor gtong bar gdams pa sogs kyis bod kyi deng ra bas rtsom rig gi brjod bya spyi tshogs can/ sgyu rtsal tshad mtho can/dgongs gzhi yar skyed can/ khyad chos mi rigs can/ skad cha spyi 119

mthun can/ rtsom gshis go sla can du 'phel bar khrid ston gyi nus pa thon nges red/gzhan yang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dmu dge bsam gtan gyis brtsams pa'i〈snyan 'grel yang gsal snang ba'i mdzod〉dang / rgan rdo rje rgyal pos brtsams pa'i〈snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron〉 sogs la'ang tshig nyung zhing don gsal la/ 'grel ba gnad du khel la slob pa po rnams kyi blo kha dang mthun zhing slob khrid byed bde ba'i yon tan dang khyad chos mang po ldan pas/ snyan ngag la blo phyogs pa'i gsar skyes gzhon nu rnams snyan ngag la 'jug par phan nus rgya chen po thon par smras ma 'tshal/mjug sdud pa'i gtam/‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’zang zing dus kyi mtha' la bod kyi rtsom pa po rgan rabs rgyun chad la nye ba dang / gzhon pa 'tshar longs ma byung ba'i skya zad sngon stong gi dus bab de 'dra zhig la bstan bcos de dag dngos su dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pa des rtsom rig gsar rtsom pa rnams la rtsom par tshul ji ltar 'jug pa'i slob rten yod pa dang / rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa rnams la dpyad brjod kyi tshad gzhi yod pa/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig phyogs gang la 'phel ba'i lam ston sgron me yod par gyur/ bstan bcos de dag khrid sbyong byas pa la brten nas gzhon pa gsar skye rnams kyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs dang ro myong gi chu tshad je mthor 'gro ba dang rtsom 120

pa la 'jug pa'i blo mig ches cher phye zhing rtsom rtsal je mthor phyin pas/ sngon na med pa'i snyan ngag dang sgrung gtam/ lhug rtsom/ 'khrab gzhung sogs rtsom rig rnam grangs gsar pa char rjes sha mo rdol bzhin thon nas bod kyi rtsom rig de lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar pa zhig la slebs pa red/gsal bshad/rjokrung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis par skrun byas pa'i〈dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉 kyi dpe skrun gsal bshad du 'khod yod/②kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun byas pa'i(snyan ngag spyi don〉 gyi shog ngos123na gsal/rjokan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun byas pa'i〈tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs〉 kyi thog ma'i gleng bslang ba las gsal/gnyis pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag bshad pa/1978lo nas bod kyi snyan ngag gsar rtsom de dus skabs gsar pa zhig tu zhugs 'go brtsams shing / srol rgyun snyan ngag la bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshun la 'byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba dang / dus rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i tshig rgyan 121

rig pa'i bstan bcos gang la gang 'os su brtsams pa/ snga na med pa'i rang mos snyan ngag gsar du thon la snyan ngag 'gyur ma'ang 'bor chen po thon/ skabs de'i snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi stobs shugs gtso bo ni phyogs gsum yod de/ gcig ni lo rabs lnga bcu ba'i mjug nas lo bcu'i nang zing gi khrod du chab srid dang chos lugs rig gnas thad nyes pa btsan 'gel thebs pa dang yang na der dogs nas rtsom pa'i thugs mos khong du bsdus pa'i mkhas pa rgan gras yin pa dang / gnyis ni lo rabs bdun cu'i dus dkyil tshun la mkhyen rabs yangs shing lhag bsam dkar pa'i mkhas pa rgan pa rnams kyi skyed sring 'og 'tshar longs byung ba'i gzhon dar rtsom pa po yin/ gsum ni rgya'i skad yig la mkhyen pa yangs shing de spyad nas bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba 'bri pa'i bod rigs rtsom pa po yin/ kho tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi myangs pa mi 'dra ba dang rig gnas gso sbyong mi mtshungs pa/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so mi gcig pa/ ma 'ongs re 'dun sna tshogs yin pa bcas rkyen gyis/ kho tshos brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi brjod don dang rnam pa/ rtsom srol/ mtshon thabs sogs la'ang mi 'dra ba byung zhing / de phyogs sdud byas na gtso bor gsham gsal gyi phyogs 'gar 'dus pa yin no/ /gcig bzang por bstod pa'i skor/dus skabs gsar ba'i dus 'go'i bod kyi snyan ngag las mang che shas ni bstod pa'i skor yin/ de yang bstod pa'i snyan ngag de 122

dag rtsom mkhan mang che ba ni de snga chab srid dang chos lugs rig gnas thad nyes pa btsan 'gel thebs pa dang / yang na der dogs nas rtsom pa'i thugs mos khong du bsdus pa'i mkhas pa rgan gras dang srol rgyun rtsom rig la byang cha cung zad yod pa'i dar ma rtsom pa po yin pas/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khagari’rtsa slog byed pa dang g.yon thal che ba'i lam phyogs yo bsrang byas nas/ bod kyi mkhas pa dang rig gnas rtsom rig‘‘lha 'dre gdon 'gegs’’kyi gras nas dkar 'don byas par dga' spro'i pad 'dab lhug par grol zhing / tang gi yang dag pa'i lam phyogs srid jus gtan la phab cing lag len du bstar pa'i tang gi 'go khrid la dga' zhen dang gong bkur zhu pa dang / 〈〈mdo sde skal bzang〉phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal pa ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan tshe bde gshegs rtswa mchog la/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni thugs bskyed do/ /zhes pa sogs la rjes su yi rang byas nas dar pa'i rtsom srol gyi rgyun bskyangs pa'am yang na de'i shan thebs pa'i bod mkhas sngon ma rnams la lad mo byed cing / skabs de'i chab srid dril sgrog gi dgos mkho skong ba bcas rkyen du gyur pas/ tang gi 'go khrid dang lam phyogs/ srid jus/ bla ma'am slob dpon/ pha yul/ slob grwa/ yul ljongs/ bod kyi rig gnas sogs la bsngags pa brjod pa'i snyan ngag〈〈gnas bstod dbyangs can sgeg mo'i glu dbyangs〉〉①dang / 〈〈mtsho sngon 'brog thang la bstod pa rgyud mangs 123

stong gi dbyangs snyan〉〉②〈〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs〉〉② 〈〈bod kyi yi ge la bsngags pa lhag bsam sprin gyi sgra dbyangs〉〉④ 〈〈dpa' ris dkar po'i snod bcud kyi bkod pa dpe rgyan gyi lam nas brjod pa tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rol mo〉〉⑤ 〈〈'tsho ba gsar par phul ba'i bstod dbyangs〉〉⑥ 〈〈rlabs chen tang la bstod glu 'bul〉〉②〈〈rlabs che'i 'pho 'gyur la dga' spros lta ba〉〉② 〈〈bsngags brjod me tog phreng mdzes〉〉⑥ 〈〈bstod tshig pad dkar chun po〉〉⑪〈〈bstod tshig me tog phreng ba〉〉⑪ 〈〈bkra shis rtags brgyad dang sbyar pa'i bsngags tshig〉〉⑪ 〈〈gsar bzhad rig gnas dpyid dpal la bstod pa〉〉⑪ 〈〈hwa kru'u zhi yi gzi brjid rab tu rgyas〉〉⑪ 〈〈mtsho sngon po la bstod pa'i glu dbyangs〉〉⑫ 〈〈bstod tshig lhag bsam khol ma'i gzegs ma〉〉⑪ 〈〈dus bzhir bstod pa〉〉⑪ 〈〈mtsho sngon zhing la bstod pa'i dpe rgyan gyi phreng ba〉〉⑪sogs bstod pa'i snyan rtsom bgrang gis mi lang ba brtsams shing / 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dang〈〈sbrang char〉〉 〈〈zla zer〉〉sogs dus deb brgyud nas rgya che'i klog pa po'i mig gi spyod yul du gyur/ bsngags pa brjod pa'i snyan rtsom de dag rtsom mkhan mang che ba ni bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig la dga' zhing de'i rtsom srol la ha cang goms pas/ khong tsho'i snyan rtsom la yang srol rgyun snyan ngag gi khyad chos mngon par gsal pa red/ de yang〈〈gsar bzhad rig gnas kyi dpyid dpal la bstod 124

pa〉〉pa mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos bod la gna' nas rig gnas cha tshang zhig yod cing bcings 'grol sngon la gong gras mi sna nyung shas kyis sger sdom byas pas/ bod 'bangs mang che bar longs su spyod pa'i skal ba med pa dang / bcings 'grol rjes su skal ba cung zad smin yang‘‘mi bzhi shog khag gis bod kyi rig gnas lha 'dre gdon bgegs kyi gras su bgrangs nas bkag bya byas/ tang gi dpon rabs gnyis pas mi bzhi shog khag rtsa gtor byas shing / g.yon thal che ba'i nor 'khrul yo bsrang byas nas/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus lag bstar dngos 'beb byas pa dang chabs cig bod kyi rig gnas la'ang bcings 'grol thob pas blo gsal gzhon nu rnams kyis der gang la gang dgar sbyangs brtson lhod med byed pa'am ngom pa med par longs su spyod pa'i nyams dga' pa'i rnam pa de dag yid la sems shing bsam bya de sdud byed kyi dpe'i dngos po ste pad+ma'i tshal ni sprin nag long long du 'khrugs shing mun pa stug po 'thibs pa'i dus su lhug par grol ba'i pad ma'i 'dab ma rnams zum par byed cing rnying bar 'gyur la dud du dpyang pas/ pad+ma'i tshal la chags pa'i bung ba'i tshogs la sbrang rtsi'i bcud du rol pa'i skal ba med pa dang / drag po'i thog dang ser bu rlung gi shugs kyis sprin dang mun pa nag po rtsa 'thor du btang ba dang lhan du/ nyin ma'i 'od kyi drod khol kun la khyab nas pad+ma'i rtsa ba nas smyu gu gsar du 'bus shing / g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i sgra dang khu byug bu mo'i 125

glu yis mdun bsus te dpyid kyi dpal yon kun nas rgyas pas/sred ldan bung ba rnams sbrang rtsi'i bcud las gang dgar rol ba'i skal bzang thob pa sogs skyed ma'i tshal gyi 'gyur ldog dang khyad par du dpyid kyi dpal mo'i chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas tshur bsdus pa ste/ rtsom yig hril bo bsdus brjod kyi thabs la brten nas/bod kyi rig gnas sger sdom byed pa'i gong gras mi sna dang‘‘lha 'dre gdon bgegasari’su brtsi pa'i‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’sogs kyi nyes pa ther 'don dang der dgag rgyag byed pa dang / tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun la bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i rnam pa gsar pa zhig grub par dga' ba'i glu dbyangs len zhing bstod pa'i me tog gtor bzhin yod/ snyan rtsom hril bo'i cha nas gtso bor bsdus brjod kyi lam nas brtsams yod kyang / bye brag tu tshig rgyan gzhan gyis spras pa'ang yod de/ldir ldir 'byung ba 'khrugs shing gnam lcags dang / /zur zur rlung dmar 'tshub pas rwa ba'i gyang / /lhag lhag shul med song zhing sprin nag 'thor/ /dro dro skyid pa'i nyin byed dgung du 'char/ /zhes pas〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉gi dngos bstan gyi rgyan thog ma'i zung ldan bar ma chod pa dang bsdus brjod spel ma'i thabs la brten nas/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi 'gran zla bral 126

pa'i dpung gi stobs kyis bod ljongs bcings 'grol dang lam lugs rnying ba rtsa rdzogs byas nas bde skyid kyi snang ba kun la khyab par bstan yod/yang / 1981lor rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' thob pa'i snyan ngag〈〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs〉po mtshon na/ rtsom pa po chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs lags kyis ka rtsom gyi rtsom stangs dang / dpe rgyan/ rab rtog gi rgyan sogs spel ma'i thabs kyis dgun kha'i bod ljongs kyi rnam pa bkod pa ste/ka shi'i ras kyi mdzes pa rab 'phrog dgun dus bod kyi yul ljongs ni/ /kha ba'i zeg mas yongs su klub pa'i ke la sha ris kun nas bskor/ /ga bur rdul gyis dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo'i bzhin gyi ra ri ma lus bkrus/ /nga cag mes rgyal mtha' mtshams 'di ni rab dkar ba so'i gzhong ba 'dra/ /ca gas rab bskyangs gsar du btsugs pa'i 'bras ldan shing dang skyed mos tshal/ /cha nas yul gyi gdod ma'i nags dang 'dzam gling yang rtser sngar med kyi/ /127

ja shing la sogs rkang 'thung kun kyang srin bal las byas 'khri shing la/ /nya rgyas zla ba'i 'od kyis spud bzhin 'dren byed zim bus blta la 'god/ /ta ma las g.yogs chu shel can bzhin dgun brgal skyes dngos sna tshogs kyang / /tha lam grang ba'i reg bya 'gog ched gangs dkar phying pa'i mal cha gyon/ /da dung dang bsil yan lag brgyad ldan chu dang chu phran thams cad kyang / / na chung gser mig can dang lhan cig 'khyags rom g.yang ṭi'i khang par nyal/ /pa tra'i ris ltar mdzes shing bkra ba'i grong dang grong gseb gsar skrun rnams/ /pha lam ltar 'tsher gangs kyi khrod na ma snyigs gangs lha me tog bzhin/ /ba gam can gyi khang bzang star phreng dang shel sgo dang sge'u khung can/ /ma lus nam mkha'i nor bu la phyogs mdzes pa'i nyi ma me tog bzhin/ /zhes dgun dus su gangs kyi ri bos mtha' phyogs kun nas 128

bskor zhing kha ba dkar pos yul khams ma lus g.yogs pa'i bod ljongs kyi yul bkod spyi ni‘‘rab dkar ba so'i gzhong ba’’zhig dang 'dra zhing / bye brag tu rtswa dang rtsi shing rnams kha bas g.yogs pa'i rnam pa de skye dngos rnams kyis‘‘grang reg 'gog pa'i don du phying ba'i mal cha gyon par’’sgro btags pa dang / nya dang gtsang bo rnams la yongs su 'khyags rom chags nas nya dang chu ci yang mi mthong bar gyur pa de‘‘gser mig can dang lhan cig 'khyags rom g.yang ṭi'i khang bar nyal’rizhes 'khyags rom de g.yang ṭi'i khang ba'i gzugs su bkod cing / chu dang gtsang bo ci yang mi mthong bar gyur pa de'ang‘‘g.yang ṭi'i khang par nyal’’par sgro btags nas brjod pa/ gangs kyi ri bos mtha' nas bskor zhing kha ba dkar pos yongs su g.yogs pa'i gangs ljongs sa yi dkyil 'khor kun tu grong dang grong gseb gsar pa khri gdugs nyi mar kha phyogs shing lham mer chags pa'i rnam pa de so sor nyin dga' me tog nyi mar 'khor zhing gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan char rdo rje pha lam gyi phra tshom btab pa dang / gangs ri'i khrod kyi gsar bzhad gangs lha me tog bcas su 'dra bar brjod pa ste/ phun sum tshogs pa'i yid sprul dang gzugs snang gsal ba'i dpe 'jog snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i tshig sbyor bcas la brten nas dgun dus kyi gangs ljongs spyi dang bye brag gi bkod pa sna tshogs mig lam du dngos su shar ba zhig bkod rjes/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba spyad 129

nas gnam gshis cha rkyen shin tu zhan pa'i yul ljongs der gnas pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis 'tsho ba bzang zhing snang ba spro pa'i ngang zhing phyugs las rigs dang chu bed 'dzugs skrun sogs deng rabs can bzhi mngon du 'gyur pa'i bya bzhag bsgrub par brel pa'i ngang tshul dang grub 'bras bstan yod/ mdor na/ rtsom pa pos sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs sna tshogs la brten nas gangs ris bskor zhing kha bas g.yogs pa'i gangs ljongs spyi dang bye brag gi bkod pa sna tshogs sngon du bris par don snying gnyis yod de/ gcig ni rtsom pa po rang nyid 'khrungs shing 'tsho gzhes gnang sa'i bod ljongs la thugs dgyes shing zhen chags che pa'i dgongs pa mtshon par byed pa dang / gnyis ni bod rigs mi dmangs ni kha bas g.yogs shing grang ngar che ba'i gnam gshis de lta bus kyang dpa' ma zhum par ma zad snang ba spro ba'i sgo nas can bzhi 'phrin las rgyas pa'i las la brtson par brjod cing / de dang der brten nas bod mi rigs kyi las la brtson pa'i rang gshis dang tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun gyi tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs srid jus kyi yang dag rang bzhin mtshon par byas yod/yang / slob dpon dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo mchog gis brtsams pa'i〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa〉〉⑫lta bur mtshon na/‘‘nor 'dzin bu mos za 'og gos gyon 'bru bcud me tog rgyan 130

spras shing / /'bab chu'i pi wang snyan 'jebs sgra 'byin bya bye'u na chung gar rtsen pa'i/ /ston gyi longs spyod ci dgar rol pa sad dang lhags pa'i gdug rtsub mtshon/ /'jin pa'i dgun gyi chom rkun tshogs rnams mi bzod sems kyis dpung 'jug byas/ /gos rgyan longs spyod stongs pa'i mdzes mas mya ngan khur gyis rab non zhing / /gcer bur 'khums shing lus kyi mdangs nyams shugs ring bsil bu'i sgra 'byin par/ /'jig rten mes pos spyan chab bsil zhing nam mkha'i mdzod las blangs pa yi/ /dar dkar yor ba phying ba'i gos stan de la dbugs dbyung slad du byin/ /gzhan phan snying rjes yid ni rab g.yos skyed byed dbang 'jin sgeg mo de/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis glog zhags ltar bcibs gser rnga khur nas lha las babs/ /lam du bskyod pa'i ngal bar ma 'dzem phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i mthas gtugs par/ /131
