ri lung shar shur thang dang chu 'gram nags tshal kun tu zhabs rjes kyi/ /bkra shis ri mo khyab par bkod cing 'jam mnyen drod 'bar phyag zung gis/ /sa gzhi g.yogs pa'i gangs dang dar 'khyag sra mthug yol ba bsal bar byas/ /sgra brgya pa yis grang ngar gcan gzan phyogs mthar bskrad cing nor 'dzin ma/ /gnyid las slong zhing nyal 'gro'i bu mos rngul dang dri ma 'khrud phyir rgyug /tsha zer can yang ram 'degs bya phyir gser gyi me long byi dor byas/ /dri yi bzhon pas skra ni shad phyir so mang thogs te shar nas 'ongs/ /rtswa ljang myu gus gos gsar btegs shing sa rdo'i gseb nas 'dzul te lhags/ /dkar ser dmar pa'i me tog sna tshogs rgyan ni bya phyir phan tshun rtsod/ /gsar skyes shing gi lcug phran dag gis lan bu dang ni sna tshar byas/ /'jol mo la sogs bye'u rnams kyang glu gar rtsed mo'i dga' 132

ston bgyid/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i mig gi rdzing bur rab dga'i mchi ma g.yo ba las/ /'thor ba'i sil ma mu tig dog pa mkhur tshos pad+ma'i lto bar 'dril/ /mnyen lcug yal ga'i lag pa brkyangs nas dpyid kyi bdag mo'i mgul bar 'khyud/ /da nas khyod nyid gtong bar mi bya bdag gi gtan grogs mdzod ces smra/ /’rizhes‘‘rig gnas gsar brje’’sngon du krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag 'go khrid 'og krung go spyi'i las rigs so sor grub 'bras g.yur du za ba smin pa'i skabs su ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’sogs kyis‘‘rig gnas gsar brje’’chen po'i las 'gul bslangs shing g.yon thal che pa'i nor 'khrul lam phyogs lag len du bstar pas/ krung go'i spyi tshogs hril por ya nga pa'i god chag byung ba dang / ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rtsa brlag byas shing sgos su tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs pa'i rjes su g.yon thal che ba'i nor 'khrul bsam blo yo bsrang byas pa dang / tang gi las don gyi lte gnad de dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu'i phyogs su 'khor pas/ krung go'i spyi tshogs phyogs yongs nas dbyar mtsho rgyas pa bzhin gong nas gong 133

du 'phel ba'i rnam pa gsar pa zhig byung nas mi rnams dga' ba 'bum gyis myos shing bstod pa'i glu dbyangs 'bul pa'i snang tshul brjod pa ste/ dus skabs mi 'dra ba gsum la byung ba'i krung go'i spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur de thad kar mi brjod par yid la sems shing de dang 'dra ba'i dpe ston ka dang dgun kha/ dpyid ka bcas dus tshigs gsum du rang byung khams chen por 'gyur ldog sna tshogs byung ba'i snang tshul gyi steng du bsdus de brjod la/ dus tshigs gsum dang rang byung khams chen po'ang ston ka'i dus kyi sa gzhi chen po gzhon nu mdzes ma zhig gi gzugs su bkod cing / dgun kha'i dus kyi sad dang lhags pa chom rkun tshogs kyi gzugs su bkod pa/dpyid kyi dpal yon dpyid kyi bdag mo'i gzugs su bkod pa bcas la brten nas/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’dang de dag gi g.yon thal che pa'i nor 'khrul bsam blor dgag pa mdzad cing / de dag gi nag nyes ther 'don mdzad pa dang / khyad par du/'o zo'i kha dang thong gshol rtse mo rtsom pa mkhan gyi snyug gu'i rtser/ /ri mo pa yi tshon snod nang dang glu ma rnams kyi mgrin pa'i dkyil/ /tshan rig rtog zhib byed mkhan dag gi rnam dpyod ral gri rnon po'i sor/ /rgan po rnams kyi thod gnyer bar dang byis pa rgod pa'i rtsun 134

rkong du/ /'dod ldan na gzhon pho mo'i mig dang bung ba'i mgrin sgra snyan mo la/ /dpyid kyi bdag mo sdug gu ma de'i gzugs kyi rnam pa mngon par gsal/ /zhes dpyid kyi bdag mo'i dpal dang yon tan las rigs so so dang skye pho mo rgan gzhon kun gyi steng nas mngon par gsal pa brjod pa des tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i lam phyogs dang byed phyogs srid jus la thugs dgyes shing bstod pa'i glu dbyangs 'bul gyin yod/ rtsom pa pos lo rgyus phyir dran dang spyi tshogs hril bor thugs gzhigs zab mo gnang pa'i sgo nas brjod 'dod kyi dgongs pa mtshon par byas pas/ brjod bya'i nang don dang sgyu rtsal rtsom thabs gang gi thad nas kyang skabs de'i dpe mtshon snyan ngag cig tu gyur/yang / 1981lo nas1983lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉phros bya dga' ang dang po thob pa'i〈〈bod kyi yi ge la bsngags pa lhag bsam sprin gyi sgra dbyangs〉〉kyi rtsom pa po rdo rje tshe brtan nam 'jigs med theg mchog lags kyang snyan rtsom de rtsom dus dgung lo cung zad gzhon yang bod kyi rig gnas sna tshogs la sbyangs pa zab cing / bod kyi yi ge byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus dang de'i phan nus la 'dris che pa dang /bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal rtsom stangs la byang cha ldan 135

pas/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlag rjes/ rnyog zing yo bsrang byas nas bod kyi rig gnas sna tshogs‘‘lha 'dre gdon bgegs’’kyi gras nas dkar 'don byung ba dang / rgyal yongs kyi las ka'i lte gnad de deng rabs can bzhi mngon 'gyur byed par sgyur skabs rtsom pa pos lo rgyus thog bod yig gis bod kyi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun thad thon pa'i byed nus la phyi dran mdzad nas/ deng rabs can bzhi mngon du bsgyur pa'i bya rim khrod du yang bod kyi na gzhon rnams kyis phyi mo yi ge der brten na grub 'bras chen po lon par dgongs nas brtsams pa red/ de yang gna' bo'i mgur gyi tshig lus dang〈〈jo bo rje bstod pa sum cu ba〉〉sogs bod mkhas sngon ma rnams kyi snyan ngag rtsom stangs/ 〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉gi dngos bstan gyi tshig rgyan sna tshogs bcas zung du sbrel ba'i sgo nas bod kyi yi ger bsngags pa brjod pa ste/ thog mar rang bzhin gyi ngos nas/sems med lags kyang mkhas pa'i spyan zung gi bdud rtsi/ /smra ba med kyang snyan 'gyur sgra 'dzin gyi bcud len/ /nyi zla ma yin lugs gnyis kun gsal gyi sgron me/ /bod kyi phyi mo'i yi ge so bzhi rang lags so/ /zhes bod kyi phyi mo'i yi ge ni/ ‘‘mkhas pa'i spyan zung gi bdud rtsimi’‘‘snyan 'gyur sgra 'dzin gyi bcud len’’‘‘lugs gnyis kun gsal gyi sgron me’’bcas su bsngags pa brjod rjes/ bod kyi phyi mo'i yi ge ma byung sngon du bod la‘‘mun glingari’du 'bod kyang / phyi mo yi ge 136

'di byung ba dang 'di'i stobs la brten nas sgra tshad bzo gso dang nang rig skar rtsis/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar ste rig gnas bcu dar par byas nas gangs ri'i ljongs la rig pa'i nyi 'od khyab par gyur zhing rmongs pa'i mun pa mtha' nas sangs pa'i lo rgyus dang dz+rel te/ de'i byed nus la bstod bsngags brjod pa dang chabs cigakrung hwa mi rigs hril bo'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhi na/ /mi rigs sna tshogs can bzhi'i lha yul du bskyod pa/ /e ma gzigs sam bod yig rig 'phrul gyi mes po/ /bod kyi na gzhon khyod kyi 'phrul 'degs la re'o/ /zhes deng gi dus la deng rabs can bzhi mngon 'gyur byed na'ang bod kyi na gzhon rnams kyis der brten pa'am re dgos par bstan yod/snyan rtsom 'di bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas kyi gting zab tu zhugs nas phyi mo'i yi ge byed nus la don gyi bstod bsngags mdzad pas/ don dngos dang mthun la bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal rtsom stangs spyad pa dang sgos su sho lo ka re re'i tshig rkang rjes mar〈〈jo bstod sum cu ba〉〉dang bzhin tshig don cha 'dra ba do mnyam par 'khod pa ste/ ‘‘nang don rig pa de yang 'di nyid las byung ngo’’ ‘‘ngag gi sbyor ba 'di yang bod yig tu mdzes so’’ ‘‘rtsis kyi rig rtsal 'di yang yi ge las byung ngo’’ ‘‘zlos gar rig pa'i ltad 137

mo yi ge las byung ngo’’zhes sgyu rtsal gyi sgo nas bsngags don nan gyis brjod cing / rtsom pa po'i bod kyi yi ger bsngags 'dod kyi yid 'gyur drag po'am der thugs zhen tshad med mdzad pa gsal ler mtshon yod/ mthar/da nas gung zhes bya ba'i rlabs chen gyi tang gi /gzhal dka'i sku drin yid la brjed med du bcangs nas/ /myur mgyogs shugs ldan cang shes rta mchog gi kha lo/ /can bzhi'i lam du sgyur bar thugs stobs ni skyod cig /ces bod kyi srol rgyun rig lam ltar smon skul zung phrel tshig gis mjug bsdus pa las rtsom pa pos bod kyi yi ge'i ma 'ongs par bcangs pa'i re smon dang yid ches mtshon yod/yang / 1986lo'i〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉8ba4par 'khod pa'i〈〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs mtshon pa'i tshig phreng ngag gi rol dbyangs〉sngar mtshon na'ang rtsom pa po mkhas grub kyis dus tshigs bzhi le tshan bzhir phye nas/ gnam gshis dang zhing las kyi snga gzhug rim pa ltar brjod bya bkod sgrig byed pa ste/ thog mar dpyid dus yul ljongs kyi khyad par dang / rmo 'debs sogs kyi bya ba bstan pa/ de nas rim bzhin dbyar dus kyi yul ljongs dang zhing skye tshul/ lo nad sad ser 'gog tshul/ sngo lud bsnyal ba'i bya ba sogs dang / ston gyi yul ljongs dang brnga sdud byed pa/ g.yul gcog pa/ nyar tshags bsdu gsog byed pa/ ston slog byed tshul/138

dgun gyi yul ljongs dang zhing khar do dam byed tshul/ dgun chu gtong tshul/ gnam gshis brtags pa sogs bod ljongs zhing pa'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mngon par bstan par ma zad/mu mtha' mi mngon zhing thang nam mkha'i spun/ /mdzo pho'i rkang pa'i grangs kyis gzhal ba la/ /ngang sgug ma gzod 'phrul chas sna mang rigs/ /rmo 'debs dus bzang 'dzin pa'i grogs su phebs/ /zhes pa dang /bong bu ngal ba'i 'khun sgra der/ /'phrul 'khor snying rje rab skyes nas/ /dbor 'dren rogs su phebs dang lhan/ /ma lus phyi nas nang du bsdus/ /zhes pa sogs kyis bod ljongs kyi zhing las de rjes lus kyi gnas stangs nas deng rabs can du 'gyur pa'i dus rabs gsar ba'i khyad chos mngon gsal du bstan la/gza' skar tshes grangs yongs su bzang po'i nyin/ /nyin der khyung dkar mdzo pho'i rwa rtse steng / /steng phyogs lha la ngom pa'i dar dmar rgyan/ /zhes pa dang /tsha gdung ma theg ngal gso'i bar mtshams su/ /pho gzhon mo gzhon sbe ga 'gran pa dang / /139

phan tshun chu rtsed rtse dang tshig rgyag pa/ /brtse dung bdud rtsi'i ro mchog mtshon par byed/ /ces pa dang /mtha' ma'i nyin der 'debs mjug rten 'brel thog /mi mdzo dbyer med bdud rtsi chang gis myos/ /zhes dang /don zab gdangs snyan btsas glu dag /g.yas gtong g.yon len byas pa na/ /zhes pa sogs kyi rmo 'debs kyi mgo 'dzugs skabs gza' skar tshes grangs 'dem pa dang / rmo mdzo'i rwa la dar tshon 'degs pa dang ske la dril chung 'dogs pa/ ngal gso'i mtshams su na gzhon pho mo rtsed mo rtse ba/ rmo 'debs tshar rjes chang ston byed pa/ brnga sdud byed skabs btsas glu len pa sogs bod mi'i sems khams dang goms gshis/ 'tsho ba'i khyad chos sogs brjod pa'i shugs las dus bde gnas 'jags dang mi rnams lus bde sems skyid/dga' dga' spro spros las la brtson zhing bde skyid rang dbang gi 'tsho bar rol ba mtshon yod/ lhag par snyan ngag der phul byung dang rab rtog sgra rgyan/ ting nge 'jin gyi rgyan sogs gang la gang 'tsham du sbyar pas/ klog pa po'i yid ngor brjod bya'i dngos po'i dbyibs dngo kha dog rnam 'gyur sogs glog brnyan ji bzhin gsal ler 'char zhing yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang mi sna'i snang brnyan/ sems 140

med dngos pos gson po'i 'gul skyod byed pa'i ngo mtshar mdzes sdug gi snang brnyan sogs mngon du gsal zhing 'bur du thon pa'i nyams chen po ldan pa yin/glo bur phyi yi zhing thang gshin po nas/ /nas zhing skra lo gcod pa'i glu dbyangs sgra/ /sgra 'dzin lam du lhang lhang thos pa'i dus/ /dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs yid la dran/ /zhes pa sogs mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan byas nas tshig snga phyi dbugs kyi mtshams bcad kyang / sgra'i rgyun mi 'chad cing snga phyi gcig tu 'brel bas don snga phyi 'brel dam pa mtshon par ma zad/mtshungs sgra bsdebs pa'i dbyangs kyi snyan ro thon pa ste/ dus bzhi'i go rim ltar le tshan phyes pas rtsom gyi sgrig rim gsal pa/ brjod bya so nam byed lugs la sbyar pas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa/'das pa'i dus kyi rjes lus kyi gnas stangs dang / da lta'i dus kyi sngon thon gyi cha zung du sbrel nas bstan pas dus rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa/ bod kyi sems khams dang lta spyod goms gshis mngon par gsal pas mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa/ sna tshogs rgyan gyis phyug pas snang brnyan gsal zhing 'bur du thon pa sogs lta bu red/gong du brjod pa ltar1978lo nas rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis/ bstod pa'i snyan ngag rtsom pa'i rlabs rgyun zhig byung zhing / spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa dang snang brnyan gsal 141

pa/ dus rabs dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i bstod pa'i snyan ngag gang legs byung mod/ skabs de'i bstod pa'i snyan ngag rtsom pa po mang po zhig snyan ngag gsar slob pa yin pas/ kho tshos rgan dar mkhas pa rnams la lad mo'am dpe lta pa dang yang na rang rang gi dga' phyogs/ dung phyogs sogs kyi dbang du song nas yul ljongs dang bla dpon/ dge rgan/ slob grwa sogs la bstod pa byas pas/ bstod pa don la mi gnas pa dang bstod rin med pa'am bstod mi 'os pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad mi mtho ba/ dngos yod kyi don snying chen po med pa'i snyan ngag kyang mi nyung ba zhig thon la/1984lor slebs tshe/ ‘‘bstod pa bris na los chog kyang / /ha can bstod pa thal ches na/ /gang gā'i chu bo rgya mtshor bzhin/ /smad pa'i ba tshwar nges par 'gyur/ /long ba dag la spyan stong can/ /'theng bo la ni mgyogs 'gro zhes/ /bstod tshig me tog rab bstor kyang / /zhib tu dpyad na snying bos dben/ /deng rabs rtsom gyi lha lam ngor/ /sgyu rtsal 'phur mda' bgrod pa'i tshe/ /‘ bstod pa'i’ bong bu la zhon nas/ /mkha' la 'phur 'dod ngal ba'i rgyu/ /mi’⑪zhes dgag dgos pa'i gnas su gyur ro/ /gnyis/ ngan pa 'ther 'don gyi skor/lo bcu'i zang zing gi nang du mi rnams kyi sems la skyo shas kyi snang ba'am khong khro tshad med skyes pas/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlag cing rnyog zing yo bsrang byas nas/ dus rabs gsar pa'i 142

rtsom rig gi mgo tshugs skabs su bzang por bstod pa dang / ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’gi nag nyes la dgag pa rgyag pa'i snyan ngag sna tshogs spel pa dang chabs cig bod kyi spyi tshogs dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro par gnod pa'i spyod ngan gshis ngan sogs skyon gyi sne mang po zhig la smyu gu'i mdung rtse gtad de mtshang 'byin ther 'don byas nas/ dran skul gyi cong brda gtong ba dang bod mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i shes rtogs je mthor gtong ched/ skabs de'i bod spyi tshogs khrod kyi bla sprul rdzun ma dang de dag gis mi rnams mgo skor pa'i spyod pa ngan pa dang / chos lugs pa la la'i tshul min gyi bya spyod/yul chos rnying pa dang 'brel pa'i rmongs zhen gyi bsam blo/ srol rgyun rnying pa'i ngan shugs kyis pho mo'i rang dbang 'dod brtse la bgegs dang bar chad bzo ba/ phu nu nang dme'i rtswa sa rtsod gleng / a rag 'du 'dzir rol nas nyi ma chod thabs byed pa sogs mtshang brtol ther 'don byed pa'i snyan ngag kyang mi nyung ba zhig byung ba las 'ju skal bzang gis brtsams pa'i〈〈ka rtsom gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug pa'i 'phrul 'khor〉〉⑪dang / lha rgyal tshe ring gis brtsams pa'i〈〈phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med bzhur〉〉yi/ nor sdes brtsams pa'i〈〈lhod kyis 'phangs pa'i nyag phran〉〉spyi a smyon gyis brtsams pa'i〈〈mtshang brtol drang srong ngag gi phur bu〉〉⑫ blo bzang chos grags kyis brtsams pa'i〈〈mtshang la rgol ba'i gtam〉〉yisogs ni brjod don bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs gang gi cha nas kyang 143

skabs de'i phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag yin la/ snyan ngag de dag ni mi ga ge mo zhig la phrag dog dang 'khon sems bcangs nas 'phya dmod dang zur za byed pa'i ched du brtsams pa ma yin par/ bod kyi spyi tshogs spyir gnas pa'i gshis ngan srol ngan dang de dag gi gnod pa rtogs nas ma gzod par dran skul gyi cong brdar brtsams pa red/ dper na/ 〈〈ka rtsom gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug pa'i 'phrul 'khor〉phros/ka kha ga nga slob pa'i byis pa tshos dbyangs gsal mi klog sgor mo klog /kha rog ma ṇi 'don ran rgas 'khogs dag phreng ba mi bgrang sgor mo bgrang / /ga byed 'di byed med pa'i las byed rnams bya ba mi gnyer sgor mo gnyer/ /nga cag mi rabs gsar pa'i na gzhon yang mdun lam mi sems sgor mo sems/ /zhes par mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos ka kha slob pa'i lo drug bdun can gyi byis pa rnams kyis rang gi skabs su bab pa'i las 'gan te dbyangs gsal mi 'don par sgor mo klog pa dang / dgung lo bdun cu brgyad cur son pa'i rgan rgon rnams blo rig nyams shing lus zungs zad pas ngal bsos nas ma ṇi re bton na spyi lugs dang mthun yang / de las ldog ste sgor mo kho na bsam zhing rtsis pa dang /144

tang dang srid gzhung gi las byed pa'i 'os 'gan ni rgyal khab dang mi dmangs la phan pa'i bya ba gnyer rgyu de yin yang de ltar mi byed par rang la mkho ba'i sgor mo 'ba' zhig gnyer pa/ mi rabs gsar pa'i na gzhon zhig yin phyin rang gi mi tshe'i mdun lam yid la bcangs nas shes bya sna tshogs la sbyangs brtson byed pa dang yar skyed kyi las la phyogs na rigs kyang de las ldog ste mig lam gyi sgor mo kho na bsam pa bcas kyi snang tshul brjod pa la brten nas/spyi tshogs steng sgor mo gcig pu ma gtogs kun spyod dang las 'bras/ ngo tsha sogs mi bsam pa dang tha na pha ma gnyen nye yang mi brtsi ba'i dar srol ngan pa zhig chags par yid skyo zhing sun 'byin byed gyin yod/〈〈lhod kyis phangs pa'i nyag phran〉phros/ra min lug min rkub ser de tsho gter ston min la/ /la lung nyul ba'i heb rgan de tsho chos pa min pas/ /sha la dga' zhing khrag la rngam pa'i spyang ki'i rigs mthun/ /sa phyogs gar yod mi shes kun gyis thugs zon gyis shig /ces pas/ rong 'brog phyogs su ban min sngags min gyi cha lugs spras pa'i chos pa rdzun ma khag cig gis rang nyid gter ston pa dang / chos pa/ sprul sku bcas su brdzus nas dad ldan mang tshogs kyi rgyu nor ham len byed pa dang / bu mo g.yo spyod byed pa/ sha la dga' zhing khrag la rngam pa bcas kyi spyod ngan ther 'don dgag 145

rgyag byed pa'i sgo nas mi ngan de rigs la dogs zon bya dgos pa'i dran skul byas yod/ yang 〈〈phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med bzhur〉phros/rig pa'i ne'u gsing gzhi la mthong chung gnag khyu'i rmig pas rdzi skabs su/ /slob gso me tog ra bar rnying zhen than pas dpung 'jug byed skabs su/ /rtsom rig kham bu'i 'gram par bslad skyon 'bu srin stong gis sbag skabs su/ /kye ma bdag gi 'dren byed zung las phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med bzhur/ /zhes pas/ rong 'brog phyogs su‘‘nged cag mi rabs nas mi rabs su phyugs la brten nas 'tsho ba las yi ger brten nas 'tsho ba min’’zer nas byis pa phyugs rdzir mngag pa las slob grwar mi skyel pa dang / rnying zhen dang rjes lus/ gu dog bcas kyi bsam blo spyad de gzhon par slob gso gtong ba/ bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byed pa dang bstun nas bod kyi sems khams dang rig lam/ goms srol/skad yig sogs dang 'phrod mi 'phrod dam 'byor mi 'byor la mi blta par/ gzhan gyi rig gnas dang rtsom rig yod do cog legs po'am sngon thon du brtsis nas slob sbyong dang bod la btsan gyis sbyor pa bcas kyi snang tshul sun 'byin byed par ma zad/ skyo gdung 146

gi mchi ma shor ba'i gnas su brjod nas nan du 'gog pa red/yang / 〈〈mtshang brtol drang srong ngag gi phur bu〉phros/dpon sa thob tshe rang rigs gtan brjed du 'gro zhing / /bla sar bkod tshe rgyu rngams ldab 'gyur gyis 'phel 'ongs/ /rtswa sa rtsod tshe pha bu'i 'brel thag kyang mi 'dug /rang sa shor tshe wa 'gros byed tshul 'di sdug pa/ /zhes pas/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi dpon po la la dpon du ma bskos sngon du mi rigs la sha tsha khul dang mi rigs kyi las don la do khur byed khul byas nas dpon por bskos rjes/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las don gtan nas mi bsgrub par rang nyid kyi go gnas 'phar ba'i las 'ba' zhig gnyer pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sprul par brjod pa'i bla sprul kha shas kyang sprul skur ngos bzung nas khri sar bkod rjes 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum kyi yon tan mi sbyang pa dang gzhan phan gyi las la mi brtson par 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi las la brel ba/ rong 'brog phyogs su rtswa sa'i don du mi rigs dang gnyen nye'i 'brel pa yang mi bsam par nang dme byed pa sogs bod mi rigs spyi la khyab pa'i snang tshul ngan pa'am zhan cha ther 'don dgag rgyag byed pa bcas lta bu red/de yang khong tsho'i zhen brtse'i sems kyis stobs bstsal zhing spobs pa chen po'i dpal 'bar ba/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rtsal rgyas pa bcas las thon pas dus rabs kyi don snying ldan zhing / bod kyi 147

rtsom rig lo rgyus steng bstod pa'i snyan ngag las ther 'don gyi snyan ngag cher mi rtsom pa'i srol lugs bsgyur nas/ rtsom rig gis dngos yod spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu bar sne khrid byas la/ dus skabs gsar pa'i mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i shes rtogs je mtho dang brtson sems cher bskyed/ yar skul gyi 'dun pa je che/ dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba dar rgyas bcas su 'gro bar slob gso'i nus pa nges can zhig thon pa yang smras ma 'tshal/yin na'ang / na gzhon rtsom pa po mang po zhig gis rtsom rig gis dngos yod 'tsho bar zhabs 'degs zhu par rlom pa dang /mtshang brtol dang sun 'byin la mtha' gcig tu zhen pa'i rkyen gyis/ rig rig thug thug la khab gtsags 'big gtsags byed pa dang yang na thad ka thad tshod khyi sdigs spang sdigs byas te bod spyi tshogs kyi mun pa'i mtshang brtol bar sgom pa dang / rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi bri yul gtso bo rang mtshang can gyi mi sna'i snang brnyan gsar gtod byed par do snang mi byed pa'i snang tshul yang mang po mthong bar gzab gzab bya dgos par snyam mo/ /gsum/ rang mos snyan ngag gi skor/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes/ g.yon thal che ba'i nor 'khrul bsam blo yo bsrang byed cing bsam blo bcings 'grol byed pa/bcos sgyur sgo 'byed dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun byed pa gtso 148

gnad du 'dzin pa'i byed phyogs srid jus lag bstar byas nas/rgyal yongs kyi las rigs so sor dpyid kyi dpal yon lta bu'i dge mtshan gsar pa shar zhing / mig gis 'dzam gling la blta ba dang sngon thon la blta ba/ rgyang ring la blta ba bcas kyi 'du shes mngon par 'phel pa dang chabs cig nga tsho bod kyi blo dang ldan pa khag cig kyang go rtogs sad shing bsam pa'i 'du shes sngar bas bcings 'grol thob ste/ nga tsho bod 'di'ang rnying zhen dang bag 'khum/ rmongs dad/ le lo/ rjes lus/ kla klo bcas kyi 'ching rgya las rnam par grol te/ shes rig dar zhing 'byor phyug ldan la/ mthun sgril dam pa'i mi rigs sngon thon can zhig tu 'gyur pa'i re smon dang spobs pa drag tu brdol pa ma zad/ lo rgyus kyi las 'gan de mngon 'gyur byed pa'ang deng rabs na gzhon rnams kyi shes rig dang dpa' ngar/ rtsol ba bcas la brten dgos par snyam/ dus rabs kyi sgul shugs la brten nas mi rabs shig gi sems khong nas drag tu brdol ba'i re smon dang dpa' ngar de mtshon par byed pa la de dang 'tsham pa'i rtsom lus gsar pa zhig dgos mkho byung /des na dus rabs shig gi bod mi'i sems kyi kun rtog ri mo mtshon pa'i dgos mkho skong ched/ gna' rabs bod kyi mgur glu dang gnas bstod la rmang gzhi byas shing 'dzam gling gi phul du byung ba'i rang mos snyan ngag la dpe blta pa/ deng rabs snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs tshad gzhir 'dzin pa/ 〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉gi dngos bstan 149

gyi rgyan dang deng rabs snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs zung du sbrel nas rang mos snyan ngag ces pa'i snyan ngag gsar pa 'di byung ba yin/ de yang brtsams chos dang po ni bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang rig gzhung zhib 'jug thad lam bu gsar btod byed mkhan don grub rgyal lags kyi〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉(pen la/ de ni rtsom pa pos deng rabs snyan ngag gzhung lugs kyi blo skyed 'og sngon gyi mgur glu ste/nged rang gnyis po khyad par che/ /nga ni dge 'dun tshal pa yin/ /dga' bde dpal/blo bde dpal/skyid pa'i dpal/da lta tshangs pa'i dga' bde dpal/⑪zhes pa dang / gnas bstod/ gnam gyi ni dbus/ sa'i ni dkyil/ gling gi ni snying po/ gangs ky-i ni ra ba/ chu bo kun gyi ni mgo bo/ ri mtho/ sa gtsang / yul bzang / mi mdzangs shing dpa' ru skye/chos bzang du byed/ rta mgyogs su 'phel ba'i gnas/⑪zhes pa sogs gzhi byas shing / rgyal khab phyi nang du gsar du dar pa'i snyan ngag dang ming du grags pa'i snyan rtsom tshad ldan la dpe byas pa/phreng ba'i rgyan(hokhrikhrikhu)dang bsdus brjod kyi rgyan/ rab rtog gi rgyan/gzugs rgyan sogs kyis legs par brgyan zhing bgro gleng gi tshul 150

gyis rtsom pa po khong dang khong 'dra ba'i rnam dpyod kyi blo gros yangs pa'i bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyis mi rigs kyi las skal dang mdun lam la do khur byed pa'i bsam pa rnam dag dang / khong tsho'i‘‘mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyis da lta'i tshab byed mi rung’ripa'i yang dag lta ba/ rnying zhen dang bag 'khum/ rmongs dad/ le lo/ gzhan rten/ re sgug kla klo sogs kyi dbang du ma song bar dus rabs dang mthun pa'i rig gnas la brten nas mdun skyod kyi lam bu gsar pa zhig btod pa'i snying stobs dang spobs pa/stobs shugs/ 'bod skul sogs mtshon par byed cing / de dag la yid spro zhing spobs pa rgyas nas bstod pa'i glu dbyangs dang bsngags pa'i me tog gtor ba'i sgo nas bod kyi spyi tshogs yongs la 'bod skul gyi dung brda bsgrags pa red/ snyan rtsom de ni bsam blo'i nang don dang sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa gang gi cha nas kyang bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng byung ma myong ba'i gsar byung bya dngos shig yin la/skabs de'i bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyi bsam phyogs dang 'phrod cing rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi dgos mkho dang mthun pas/ na gzhon rtsom pa po rnams kyis de ma thag dang len byas par ma zad/ de'i tshig 'gros dang tshig rkang gi rnam par lad mo byas nas snyan ngag rtsom pa dang / de'i blo bskyed 'og rgyal khab phyi nang gi tshad dang ldan pa'i rang mos snyan ngag dang de'i skor gyi gzhung lugs zung du sbrel nas rang gi khyad chos can gyi rang mos snyan ngag rtsom pa/ yang 151

na〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〉pa zhib 'jug byed pa dang rang mos snyan ngag skor gyi rtsom rig shes bya slob sbyong byas nas rang mos snyan ngag rtsom pa/ da dung rang mos snyan ngag gsar du thon pa'i nyams myong dang blo bskyed la brten nas/ sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi rjes 'brangs te rab rib snyan ngag 'bri mkhan yang mi nyung pa zhig byung bas dus skabs shig la bod kyi rtsom rig las rigs su rang mos snyan ngag dang rab rib snyan ngag sogs snyan rtsom gsar pa rtsom zhing slob pa'i tsha rlabs shig langs nas snyan ngag gi 'phel phyogs gtso bo zhig tu gyur/yin na'ang rtsom pa po rnams kyi rig gnas yon tan dang rtsom rig chu tshad mi 'dra ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi myong ba dang 'jig rten gyi lta bar khyad par yod pa/ gshis rgyud dang dga' phyogs 'bad phyogs kyang mi gcig pa'i dbang gis so so'i brtsams chos kyi rgyus spus la khyad par yod pa ste/ gzhan rtsom la lad mo byas pa tsam las rang gi bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos mi mngon pa'i snyan ngag mi nyung pa dang / tshigs bcad kyi rkang bar ring thung btod pa dang /yang na skas dbyibs sam zur dbyibs su bsgrigs cing / don gyi tshan pa re re'i mgor‘‘ka ye’’dang‘‘kye’’‘‘kye ma’’‘‘kye kye’’‘‘a’’‘‘e ma’’sogs 'bod pa'i sgra dang / ‘‘ltos dngari’‘‘nyon dang’’la sogs skul tshig gi sgra sbyor bar brten nas 'bod tshig sgrog pa lta bu'i snyan ngag nges can zhig yod la/ spyi tshogs la bsam 152

gzhigs byed pa'i thun mong gi rmang gzhi'i thog spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes dang mi rigs kyi dar rgyas/ 'tsho ba'i myong goms sogs phyogs mi 'dra ba dang zur ngos mi 'dra pa las rang gi sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos mngon par gsal la/ 'das pa dang da ltar bsam gzhigs dang yid ches ldab 'gyur gyis ma 'ongs brtson len bya rgyu'i dgos pa dang snying stobs mtshon pa'i snyan ngag kyang mang po yod/ de min brjod don rab rib byas nas ci yang go rgyu med pa'ang byung / rgyu mtshan de'i rkyen gyis‘‘deng rabs rtsom rig lha yi rdzing ring du/ /rang dbang snyan tshig sprin gyis bsgribs mthongs nas/ /legs bshad 'od stong bzhad pa'i daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung / /gsal bar mthong dka'i tshul 'di shes pa 'phyo/ /snyan tshig rang dbang ldan pas ci zhig bya/ /kun la rang dbang ha cang thal che na/ /'chol mas sa steng gang na mi 'jigs sam/ /rang dbang tshig la 'dod dgur dbang ba ste/ /tshig gi lhu lag bcad pa rang dbang min/ /don gyi gnad dang tshig gi thob thang ltar/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'phyur ba'i tshig sbyor mdzes/ /lnga rig paṇa chen ngag gi dbang bos kyang / /gsal bar ma gzigs rang mos snyan ngag 'di/ /'brog pa'i bu mos rgya chas spras pa bzhin/ /kun gyi mig gi tsher ma ma lags sam/ /de skad lhag bsam dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /kun phan tshig gi gru char 'jo ba 'di/ /rnam dag rtsom rig lha yi dga' tshal nas/ /snyan tshig me tog bzhad pa'i rgyur gyur cig /’’⑫ces pa'i rtsom 'di byung la/ de mtshungs su bod 153

kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag ni brda rnying dang mngon brjod/ yig skad sogs kyis bcings pas spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i 'gros dang mi mthun pa dang / bsam blo'i rang bzhin cher med pas/ nga tshor dgos pa ni mang tshogs kyi kha skad dngos kyis brtsams shing bsam blo'i rang bzhin shugs drag che ba'i deng rabs snyan ngag yin zhes pa'i gleng lugs shig kyang grags la/ rang mos snyan ngag gi dge skyon brjod pa'i dpyad rtsom yang lhag pa chos 'phel gyi〈〈bod kyi snyan rtsom gsar pa'i khyad chos skor che long tsam brjod pa〉〉⑫dang / ljang bu'i〈〈snyan ngag‘‘gsar ba'i’’skor gyi gnad don 'ga' shas la dmigs pa〉〉⑪/ dpal lha mo'i〈〈deng rabs snyan ngag gi rtsom tshul la rags tsam dpyad pa〉〉yi/ skal bzang ye shes kyi〈〈rang mos snyan ngag gi dge skyon skor tshod gleng〉〉⑪/ 'ju skal bzang gi〈〈deng rabs snyan ngag ngo sprod rags bsdus log rtogs mun pa sel ba'i skya rengs〉〉⑫/bu bzhi bsam pa'i don grub kyi〈〈bod kyi rang mos snyan ngag gi 'das pa'i dus dang ma 'ongs pa〉〉nyusogs gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung nas dge skyon gsal 'byed byas te yon tan dmigs su brjod cing zhan cha mdzub ston byed pa dang / deng rabs snyan ngag ngo sprod pa dang sbrel nas rgyu spus je legs su gtong bar bsam pa drang por brjod pa bcas byas/mi rabs shig gi thun mong gi blo gros dang rtsol pas sngon med gsar rtsom dang sngar yod rgyun 'khyongs/ zhan cha bcos sgyur/ chad pa 154

kha gsab/legs pa nang 'dren sogs byas pa brgyud nas/rang mos snyan ngag de brjod bya dang sgyu rtsal/ bsam blo phyogs yongs nas 'phel 'gyur byung zhing / phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos kyang don grub rgyal gyi〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〉dang ljang bu'i〈〈'bod pa〉〉 'ju skal bzang gi〈〈dge 'dun chos 'phel〉〉 dpal rtse'i〈〈gna' bo'i cong rnying〉〉 'phrin khyung gi〈〈lha sa/ rgyang thag ring ba'i grong khyer kher rkyang zhig〉〉gangs bu dga' skyed kyi〈〈pa sangs lags〉〉dur bu rnam grags kyi〈〈'bod pa'i g.yab mo〉〉 gcan me stag gi〈〈lho bzhud kyi chu 'dzin〉〉 rgod phrug dpal 'byor gyi〈〈ri grong〉〉 o rgyan rdo rje'i〈〈rmi lam〉〉 'chi med kyi〈〈nga dang nga'i las dbang〉〉 ldong chu shel gyi〈〈sgrol dkar mtsho〉〉 dbyangs go sgrol ma'i〈〈bud med tsho〉〉gzungs phyug skyid kyi〈〈rma chen gangs ri〉〉 tshe brtan rgyal gyi〈〈dge rgan/mtho sgang gi dar lcog〉〉 gangs zhun gyi〈〈'khor ba'i snying bo〉〉lha rgyal tshe ring gi〈〈'dzin ma'i gdung dbyangs〉〉 ye shes bzang bo'i〈〈rma rgyal sbom ra〉〉 rgya ye bkra shis phun tshogs kyi〈〈srin bu'i mig chu〉〉 lcam rang sad kyi〈〈rje tsong kha pa〉〉 bya mdo rab rgyas kyi〈〈'grul bzhud〉〉 rams tshe bho'i 〈〈zhing grong gi snyan ngag〉〉 rgya grol gyi〈〈byams 'dus kyi rmi lam〉〉 'bar rde'u yi〈〈chags 'jig〉〉bde skyid sgrol ma'i〈〈gces phrug〉〉sogs mang du byung la snyan ngag gi 'phel phyogs gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag de dag dang de dag gi shan shugs la brten nas/ bod kyi rang mos 155

snyan ngag de da lta sgyu rtsal rang bzhin tshad mtho zhing / bsam blo'i rang bzhin gting zab pa/ nang don rgya che zhing brtse dung shugs drag pa/ dbyangs snyan mngon par gsal ba/ tshig lus rang dbang che ba/rtsom pa po'i snying khong gi 'bod sgra dang mi rigs kyi brtson shugs/dus rabs kyi khyad chos/ gsar btod kyi snying stobs/ bcos sgyur gyi spobs pa/ mdun skyod kyi phugs bsam/ spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba bcas mtshon pa'i phyogs la 'phel gyin yod/bzhi/ byung brjod snyan ngag gi skor/dus rabs gsar pa'i nang du bod kyi rig gnas mtha' dag‘‘lha 'dre gdon bgegs’’kyi nyes 'gebs 'og nas dkar 'don byas shing / gna' bzang deng spyod byed pa'i rang dbang thob pas bod kyi snyan ngag thad sngar yod rgyun 'dzin dang nyams pa slar gso/ sngar med gsar gtod bcas byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉pas/ sngon byung gtam las gyur pa dang / /cig shos legs pa la brten pa/ /zhes pa'i gzhung lugs kyi sgo dang bstun zhing / 〈〈skyes rabs so bzhi pa〉〉dang〈〈skyes rabs brgya pa〉〉〈〈dpag bsam 'khri shing〉〉sogs kyi lad mo byas nas/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i skyes rabs dang gling ge sar rgyal po'i rtogs brjod/ da lta'i spyi tshogs dngos kyi byung ba gsar pa bcas la sbyar pa'i byung brjod snyan ngag kyang mang po byung / de yang1982lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb gsum par bkod pa'i snyan rtsom〈〈ri bong can gyi byung ba 156

brjod pa g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgra dbyangs 〉〉dang /1984lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb dang por bkod pa'i〈〈ri dwags ru ru'i gtam rgyud〉〉kyi brjod bya'i nang don ni ston pa shākya thub pa'i skyes rabs yin te/ dang po ni〈〈gser 'od dam pa'i mdo〉〉dang bka' 'gyur 'dul pa'i kha dum par bzhugs pa'i〈〈ri bong gi skyes rabs〉rolas brtsams pa dang / phyi ma ni〈〈skyes rabs so bzhi pa〉〉na bzhugs pa'i〈〈ri dwags ru ru'i skyes rabs〉〉pas brtsams la bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〈〈gser gyi gdu bu〉rdzang du 'khod pa'i〈〈dgra lha'i rgyal po'i rtogs brjod lha gling gab rtse dgu skor〉〉ni gling seng chen rgyal po'i rtogs brjod〈〈lha gling gab rtse dgu skor〉tharjod bya byas nas brtsams pa red/ byung brjod snyan ngag de dag gi brjod bya'i nang don da lta'i spyi tshogs dngos kyi byung ba min yang / thub pa'i skyes rabs gtam rgyud dang gling seng chen rgyal po'i rtogs brjod de dag ni nang don cha tshang ba dang rjod byed kyi tshig la gson nyams ldan pa/ byung rim gyis yid sems 'gug pa/ snang brnyan gsal ba/ 'tsho ba'i nyams 'gyur zab pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan thog 〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉gi lugs ltar brtsams pas/ sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang dang ro myong gi rin thang ha cang che zhing/ sgos su bod kyi rtsom rig nyams pa slar gso byed pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i mgo tsam la snyan ngag gsar slob pa rnams kyi slob sbyong gi ma dper yang gyur pa red/ byung brjod snyan ngag de dang des blo skyed la brten 157

nas da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos las brtsams pa'i〈〈gzhon nu'i yid kyi mdzes rgyan〉〉nyudang / 〈〈lam phran du lhag pa'i gtam〉〉⑪〈〈gser gyi gdu bu〉〉⑪ 〈〈bde skyid kyi gnyen don〉〉⑫sogs kyang gcig 'phro gcig la byung bas/ bod kyi snyan ngag gi rnam pa phun sum tshogs por 'gyur zhing dus rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i byung brjod snyan ngag gsar pa 'byung bar sne khrid byas la/1981lo'i〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb gsum par 'khod pa'i〈〈rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar pa'i 'bel gtam〉〉⑫ni rje mi la ras pa mon yul gnyi shang gi ri la bzhugs skabs/ kho khom rgyal pos rje btsun mi la ras pa'i snyan pa thos nas ya mtshan zhing dad par gyur thog rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan pa ltar/ gdan 'dren mkhan btang par rje btsun gyis rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar nas mgur gsungs pa de'i blo skyed la brten nas brtsams pa red/ rtsom de byung brjod snyan ngag tshad ldan zhig min na'ang rgyal srid sna bdun dang gzhon nu le lo can bar phan tshun gleng mol byed pa'i rtsom stangs dang / rje mi la ras pa'i mgur dang〈〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung〉〉gi skad cha zung du sbrel pa'i sgo nas gzhon nu le lo can rnams kyi bya spyod ther 'don byed cing / brtson pa cher skyed byed par rting skul byas pas/ rtsom stangs ngo mtshar zhing sgyu rtsal gyi yid 'gug nus pa che la/ rjod byed kyi tshig go sla zhing nyams che pa/ brjod don gnad la 'khel zhing slob gso'i phan nus che pa bcas rkyen 158

gyis/ 'grem spel byas ma thag snyan pa'i grags pa rgyas shing kun gyis nyams su myong bya dang gsar rtsom gyi dpe mtshan du gyur ro/ /lnga/ snyan ngag 'gyur ma'i skor/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun la bod kyi skad dang yi ge'i sgo nas brtsams pa'i snyan ngag la phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba'i dus mnyam du/ bod rigs rtsom pa pos rgya yig gi sgo nas brtsams pa'i snyan ngag kyang mang po byung bar ma zad/ skad grags che ba'i bod rigs snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring dang rta mgrin mgon po/skal bzang rdo rje/ rab rgyas pa sangs/ ye shes tshe ring sogs kyi snyan ngag bod yig tu bsgyur nas bod yig dus deb steng 'khod pa'am phyogs sgrig byas nas dpe skrun 'grem spel byas/ rtsom pa po de dag ni snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs shing lag len gyi nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad mtho la/ bod kyi 'tsho bar 'dris che zhing dmangs khrod rtsom rig la byang cha che bas/ khong tshos brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i nang don spyi tshogs kyi dngos yod 'tsho ba yin par ma zad/ tshig sbyor kha gsal zhing go sla ba/ gson nyams ldan pa/ mtshams tshig ldan zhing yid bkod gsal la gyer bde ba sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pa yin/der brten khong tsho'i snyan ngag dang snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs bod yig tu bsgyur pa ni/ bod kyi snyan ngag gi rnam pa dang grangs 'bor 159

phun sum tshogs por 'gro ba'i rgyur 'gyur zhing / snyan ngag gi lus 'grub tshul dang yid bkod gtod tshul/ brtse dung mtshon stangs/dbyangs snyan 'don stangs/ snang brnyan bzhengs lugs bcas kyi thad snyan ngag gsar slob pa rnams kyi zur lta'i dpyad gzhir gyur la/ sgos su bod kyi rang mos snyan ngag 'thus tshang can dang sgyu rtsal can/ tshad ldan can bcas su 'phel par dpe ston gyi nus pa mi dman pa bskyed pa red/mjug sdud pa'i gtam/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs bcu gsum pa'i rjes su/ rgyal nang du rnyog zing yo bsrang byed pa dang phyi phyogs su rig gnas sgo 'byed byed pa'i skal ba bzang bo dang bstun nas/ bod rigs rtsom pa po dang dpyad brjod pa rnams kyis brtson pa cher spyad kyis sngar yod rgyun 'dzin byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan gyi legs cha nang 'dren byas nas sngar med gsar gtod byas pas/ bod kyi snyan ngag de rnam pa dang brjod bya/ sgyu rtsal/ grangs 'bor/ gzhung lugs bcas phyogs mang po nas lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'phel 'gyur byung / /gsal bshad/dhitshe tan zhabs drung gis brtsams shing1983lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb3par 'khod yod/②bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan gyis brtsams shing1983lo'i〈〈sbrang 160

char〉〉deb3par 'khod yod/(byechab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis brtsams shing1980lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb2par 'khod yod/(nyerdo rje tshe brtan gyis brtsams shing1982lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/()dor zhi gdong drug snyems blos brtsams shing1983lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/(nyechab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis brtsams shing1989lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb2par 'khod yod/(1thub bstan dbang bos brtsams shing1987lo'i〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb2par 'khod yod/(nyebasod nams kyis brtsams shing1987lo'i〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb2par 'khod yod/(kyebase tshang blo bzang dpal ldan gyis brtsams shing1991lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/(rlurdo dgon gsang bdag rdo rje sogs kyis brtsams shing1991lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dob dang por 'khod yod/(mibakra shis bag gros brtsams shing1991lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb6par 'khod yod/(yidapal brtsegs kyis brtsams shing1991lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb6par 'khod yod/(〈dpal 'byor gyis brtsams shing1980lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/(1ye shes bstan 'dzin gyis brtsams shing1980lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom 161

rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/(snyegacod pa don grub kyis brtsams shing1981lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb2par 'khod yod/(yirdo rje tshe brtan gyis brtsams shing1982lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb2par 'khod yod/(1dbang chen don grub kyis brtsams shing1983lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb2par 'khod yod/(khya'aju skal bzang gis brtsams shing 1983lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb3par 'khod yod/(gyedor zhi gdong drug snyems blos brtsams shing1983lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb4par 'khod yod/tunyedon grub rgyal gyis brtsams shing1984lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/rkyus 1990lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/〈mi 1986lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb gnyis par 'khod yod/rkyus 1987lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb gnyis par 'khod yod/tunye 1994lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb bzhi par 'khod yod/tshun 1996lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb gsum par 'khod yod/〈yi 1983lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(1〈〈bod kyi deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉〉pas gsal/tunyetun hong yig rnying khrod kyi〈〈btsan po rim byung gi lo rgyus〉〉pas gas95/(nyergan zhabs sgrub nas brtsams/(yi 1990lo'i〈〈krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉〉deb gnyis par 'khod 162

yod/(kye 1990lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/(yi 1990lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb bzhi par 'khod yod/(mi 1990lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb drug par 'khod yod/(1 1991lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/(yi 1999lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/〈snye 1985lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb lnga par 'khod yod/(1bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〈〈gser gdub〉〉dang du 'khod yod/(7 1991lo'i〈〈sbrang char〉〉deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(gro 1988lo'i〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉deb dang por 'khod yod/(rludon grub rgyal gyis brtsams/

gsum pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi sgrung gtam bshad pa/dus skabs gsar pa'i dpyid kyi dpal la brten nas bod kyi rtsom rig skyed tshal du'ang mdzes pa'i me tog bzhad cing dga' ba'i 'bras bu smin pa dang / khyad par du snga na med pa'i deng rabs sgrung thung dang sgrung 'bring / sgrung ring / sgrung thung yig brgya ma/ mu 'brel sgrung thung / skye dngos sgrung gtam/ srog chags sgrung gtam/ lo rgyus sgrung gtam sogs sgrung gtam sna tshogs stong phrag 'ga' dpe skrun 'grem spel byas nas/ bod kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba phun tshogs su 'gro ba dang shes rig dar rgyas su gtong ba/ spyi tshogs bcos sgyur dang yar bskyed byed pa sogs la nus pa chen po thon dang thon bzhin yod pa red/ lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring la 'di 'dra'i rmad du byung ba'i grub 'bras thon pa ni bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng mthong dkon pa zhig red/ yin yang / rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi ngos nas dus skabs 'di'i sgrung gtam 'phel rgyas kyi snang tshul dang nyams myong /chos nyid bcas la zhib 'jug phyogs sdom mdzad pa med pas/ bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam la rgyus lon dang rol myong / zhib 'jugaslob khrid bcas byed par phan pa'i ched du/ bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi byung 'phel dang de'i rgyu rkyen/ brjod bya'i nang don dang 164

des mtshon pa'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun/ gsar rtsom gyi nyams myong dang khyad chos sogs la cung zad dpyad par bya'o/ /gcig dus rabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam gyi byung ba bshad pa/krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes pa nas spyi lo1978lo'i bar du bod la skabs de'i chab srid dril sgrog byed cing / dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul dang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i snyan ngag gsar pa khag cig yod rung / deng rabs sgrung gtam ni rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis 'byung ma thub/ des na dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du deng rabs sgrung gtam byung bar ma zad/ rnam pa je mang dang sgyu rtsal je legs/ nang don je rgyas/ bstan don je zab bcas su 'phel 'gyur byed thub pa ni/ phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen dang rang ngos kyi rgyu rkyen cung zad bzang po zhig 'dzoms pa ste/ phyi rol du tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su yo bsrang drang bcos byas nas/ ‘‘me tog mnyam bzhad dang / mkhas brgya 'gran gleng’’gi byed phyogs yang dag pa'i sgo nas lag bstar dngos 'beb byas shing tang gi mi rigs srid jus slar gso byas pa dang / rgya mi rigs la deng rabs sgrung gtam sngar nas grub zin pas dpe lta sa'i brtsams chos mang ba/ rtsom rig gi dus deb khag cig gsar du spel bas brtsams chos 'god sa yod par gyur/ rang ngos su deng rabs rtsom rig gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa zab cing 165

bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig gi rmang mthug pa'i dar gzhon rtsom pa po khag cig 'tshar longs byung ba dang / kho tsho rtsom rig la dga' zhing rtsom pa'i nyams myong nges can zhig bsags pa dang / nyin re bzhin 'pho 'gyur byed pa'i bod kyi spyi tshogs khrod du 'tsho bas/ blo ngor mi sna'i snang brnyan dang gtam rgyud gsar pa sna tshogs kyis khengs yod/ des na sgrung gtam ni mi sna de dag zhib 'bri byed pa dang gtam rgyud de dag brjod par ches 'phrod pa'i rtsom lus yin pas/deng rabs kyi don snying ldan pa'i sgrung gtam gsar gtod byas par ma zad/ sgrung gtam de'i rigs bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi rtsom lus gtso bo zhig tu gyur pa yin/ de lta bu'i rtsom lus kyi srol gtod mkhan nam rmang 'ding mkhan gtso bo ni dpal don grub rgyal lags yin/ khong ni1953lor mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gcan tsha rdzong gi dgu 'gyur pad mo rong zhes pa'i ri sder sku 'khrungs pa dang / dgung lo brgyad kyi steng nas rim bzhin slob chung dang rma lho khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwar grims nas/ bod rgya yi ge'i rmang bting pa dang / 1969lor rma lho khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwa mthar phyin rjes/ mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs su las bgos byas te rtsom sgrig pa dang lo tsā pa'i phyag las mdzad/ 1971lo nas1974lo'i bar du krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i mi rigs skad yig 'dzin grwar slob gnyer mdzad/ slob mthar phyin rjes phyir mtsho sngon du log nas 166

kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs su rtsom sgrig pa dang lo tsā pa'i phyag las mdzad/ 1978lor krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i zhib 'jug slob mar rgyugs 'phrod cing / 1981lor hra'o hri'i go ming thob nas slob mthar phyin rjes rim bzhin slob grwa de dang mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lho khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwar dge rgan gyi phyag las mdzad/ 1985lo'i zla11par mtsho sngon zhing chen chab cha grong brdal du sku grongs/ khong ni skye thob kyi shes rab rno zhing sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan ldan pa dang / rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi las la thugs phyogs shing 'jug mkhas la/ bod dang bod kyi rtsom rig dar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong ba'i dgongs pa rnam par dag cing / sngar gyi srol bzang rgyun 'khyongs dang gzhan gyi legs cha sdud len byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng rang gis gsar gtod mdzad pa'i nus rtsal khyad du 'phags pa zhig ldan pa red/ de yang bod kyi srol rgyun sgrung gtam gyis byung rim brjod pa dang skad cha zhib 'bri byed pa gtsor 'dzin pa'i rtsom srol dang / deng rabs sgrung gtam gyis mi sna'i gshis ka dang bsam blo'i 'phel 'gyur zhib 'bri byed pa dang dngos yod 'tsho ba brjod pa gtsor 'dzin pa'i rtsom thabs zung dang sbrel ba'i sgo nas〈pad mtsho〉 dang('brug mtsho〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam brtsams shing / lo rabs bdun cu pa'i mjug tu 'phro rim 'phror(mtsho sngon gsar 'gyur〉steng du spel nas bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi srol btod pa dang / gna' bo'i mgur glu dang 167

deng gi rang mos snyan ngag gi rtsom thabs zung du sbrel nas rang mos snyan ngag〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉thartsams pa ①dang / rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar pa'i mgur ②gyi thugs bskyed la brten nas〈rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i 'phel gtam〉②brtsams shing / rje btsun mi la'i〈rmi lam brda sprod kyi mgur〉⑨dang gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung sogs las rmi lam la brtag pa'i byung rim 'god stangs la dpe bltas nas('khrul min rmi lam ngo mtshar dga' skyed〉②ces pa'i don brjod snyan ngag brtsams pa sogs las mtshon thub/ khong gis gsar gtod yod pa'i sgo nas gzhan bzang rang spyod dang / gna' bzang deng spyod byas pa des skabs de'i spyi tshogs la shugs rkyen zab mo bzos par ma zad/ rtsom pa po rnams la rang gi srol rgyun bzang po rgyun 'khyongs dang gzhan gyi legs cha sdud len byed par ma dpe bzang po bskrun pa red/dpal don grub rgyal lags ni bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi srol gtod mkhan gtso bo zhig yin par ma zad/ rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i rang bzhin thad nas tshul min gyi bya ngan spyod ngan dang 'os min gyi spyi tshogs snang tshul la ther 'don dgag rgyag byed pa'i snying stobs can dang / spyi tshogs yar thon 'byung bar thugs smon mdzad mkhan zhig kyang yin/ khos dus yun thung thung lo 'ga'i ring la rtsom srol gsar pa btod pa'i dus mnyam du sprul sku rdzun ma dang tshul dang mi mthun pa'i dpon po/ mna' ma ngan pa sogs kyi bsam 168

sbyor ngan pa mtshang 'byin dang der dgag rgyag mdzad pa'i〈sprul sku〉⑧dang / (rmi rtag sgyu ma'i rmi lam〉② 〈rgyu 'bras med pa'i mna' ma〉⑧ (sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung〉⑨ 〈rkang lam phra mo〉⑪ 〈rgan po blo gyong〉⑪sogs sgrung gtam dang lhug rtsom gyis gtsos rtsom rig brtsams chos sum cu tsam brtsams nas/ rtsom rig gis dngos yod spyi tshogs la nus pa bskyed par yang sne khrid mdzad pa red/ des na dpal don grub rgyal lags ni bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi srol gtod mkhan dang rmang 'ding mkhan nam sne khrid mkhan gtso bo zhig yin la/ khong gis brtsams pa'i〈pad mtsho〉dang〈'brug mtsho〉sogs ni khong gi sgrung gtam dang po yin par ma zad/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng gi deng rabs sgrung gtam dang po'ang red/khong gi gsar gtod rang bzhin ldan pa'i brtsams chos de dag snga gzhug tu 'grem spel byas pa de bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng gi gsar gtod cig yin par ma zad/ skabs der rtsom rig la blo phyogs pa'i gzhon dar khag cig la blo bskyed dam skul lcag chen po thebs/ khong gis deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi srol btod pa dang chabs cig rtsom pa'i rtsal rdzongs shing gzhung lugs kyi rmang 'thug pa/ 'tsho ba'i myong tshor zab pa/ rtsom pa'i kun slong dag pa bcas phul tu byung ba'i sgrung gtam rtsom pa po glang bdun dpal 'byor dang reb gong rdo rje mkhar/ bkris dpal ldan/ chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring / byams pa chos 'dzoms/ rnam sras/ lhag pa don grub/ tshe ring 169

don grub/ brag gdong bkras gling dbang rdor/ a smyon bkra shis don grub/ bkra bha/ stag 'bum rgyal sogs bcu phrag du ma char shul gyi sha mo brdol pa bzhin thon zhing/ rang rang gi rig pa'i rtsal la brten nas gsar gtod rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgrung gtam mang du brtsams nas bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi rnam pa 'thus tshang dang rgyu spus je legs su btang pa ste/ bod rgya dbyin gsum gyi yi ger sbyangs pa zab cing rang gzhan kun gyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs la nang byan chud pa/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom la 'jug pa yangs pa'i glang bdun dpal 'byor gyis sngar gyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud dang rab rtog sgrung gtam/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung bcas kyi rab btags sam 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom thabs dang / deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi mi'i gshis ka dang bsam blo'i 'phel 'gyur 'god stangs zung du sbrel ba'i thabs la brten nas/ 〈me tog ldum ra'i nang gi klan ka〉 zhes pa'i skye dngos sgrung gtam brtsams par ma zad/1980lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉deb gsum pa'i steng bkod rjes klog pa po rnams kyi do snang chen po byas shing / zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs rim pa'i gsar rtsom bya dga' dang rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs kyi phul byung rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi bya dga' thob/ rnam grol lags kyis sngar gyi〈gtam pad+ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar〉⑪dang〈bya sprel gtam rgyud〉⑪ 〈g.yag lug ra phag gi gtam rgyud〉⑫170

sogs kyi rtsom srol gyi rgyun bskyangs shing deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi rtsom srol la zur blta byas nas/ (char shul gyi nags tshal〉zhes pa'i srog chags sgrung gtam brtsams nas/ 1982lo'i(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉deb gsum pa'i steng 'khod pa dang / cang ma 'gor par skal bzang ye shes kyis1983lo'i(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉deb dang po'i steng dpyad rtsom spel nas gdeng 'jog legs po byas pa sogs la brten nas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis dang dod chen po byed cing shugs rkyen zab mo thebs/ phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos de dag gi shugs rkyen la brten nas deng rabs dang srol rgyun zung gi khyad chos ldan pa'i skye dngos sgrung gtam dang srog chags sgrung gtam〈yang cun me tog〉⑫dang〈phrag dog can gyi co ka〉⑪ 〈lcang gru bzhi'i zlos gar〉⑪ 〈spo bo blo 'khrul dang khyi/ zhum bu bcas kyi gtam rgyud〉⑪ ('khon 'gras〉⑪sogs mang du thon/ snga na med pa'i sgrung gtam de dag dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pa des skabs der rtsom pa po'i brjod 'dod kyi bsam blo mtshar ba'i nyams dang gab pa'i tshul gyis klog pa po rnams la bstan par ma zad/ srol rgyun gyi rtsol srol legs po rgyun 'khyongs dang 'phel rgyas su gtong bar yang byas rjes chen po bzhagaspyi tshogs steng gnas pa'i tshul min gyi spyod ngan sna tshogs la zur za dang mtshang 'byin byas nas bcos bsgyur byed pa dang rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi re smon mtshon pa'i dgos mkho skong ched/ tshig

nyung don 'dus dang skya 'bri'i thabs shes la brten nas gson nyams ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan btod cing / gzhan gyi nga rgyal gyi mgo bo gcog pa dang tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bsam spyod ngan pa sogs la zur za dang mtshang 'byin byed par dmigs bsal gyi nus pa ldan pa'i sgrung gtam yig brgya ma mang po gsar rtsom byas par ma zad/ lo rabs dgu bcu bar phul du byung ba'i sgrung gtam rtsom pa po bkra bhas da lta 'dzam gling spyir khyab pa'i rtsom rig gzhung lugs slob sbyong byed pa dang / mi rigs gzhan gyi brtsams chos la dpe bltas nas mu 'brel sgrung gtam yig brgya ma dang po〈sgrol ma nyer gcig〉yices pa brtsams nas/ bod la mu 'brel sgrung gtam yig brgya ma med pa'i stong cha bskangs pas/ bod kyi rtsom rig las rigs kyi gdeng 'jog mthon po dang bsngags brjod chen po thob/bod rigs rtsom pa po rnams kyis sgrung 'bring dang sgrung thung mang po brtsams nas grub 'bras ha cang chen po blangs shing spyi tshogs thog snyan pa'i grags pa rab tu rgyas par ma zad/ sgrung 'bring dang sgrung thung mang po brtsams par brten nas gsar rtsom gyi nyams myong mang po bsags pa dang / tshig sbyor je legs dang rtsom rtsal je mtho/ rtsom mos je cher phyin/ khong tshos sngar las lhag pa'i grub 'bras chen po len pa'i ched du sgrung 'bring dang sgrung thung rtsom pa'i dus mnyam du rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsom rig grags chen mang po bklags nas sgrung ring gi gzhi rtsa'i sgrig gzhi sogs shes bya rgyus 172

lon byed cing / phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu cha dang gson nyams ldan pa'i gtam rgyud mang po 'tshol sdud byas thog deng rabs rang bzhin gyi sgrung ring mang po brtsams pa red/ de yang thog mar snyan du grags pa'i bod rigs rtsom pa po dang shes yon can 'jam dpal rgya mtsho lags kyis(skal bzang me tog〉⑪ces pa rgya bod yig gnyis ka'i steng nas dpe skrun 'grem spel byas rjes/ skabs dang po'i rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sgrung ring la gzengs bstod byed pa'i dpyad bsdur khrod du bya dga' thob/ spyi tshogs kyis gtsigs chen dang gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po byas pas/ rtsom pa po gzhan la'ang blo bskyed dang skul ma chen po thebs/ kho tshos gcig na lo rgyus steng gtan chags su gyur pa'i don rkyen gal chen dang gson nyams ldan pa'i gtam rgyud rab dang rim pa zhib 'bri byas nas/ skabs de'i bod spyi tshogs kyi lkog tu gyur pa'i yol ba phyes te/rnam pa ngo ma shes su 'jug pa dang / gnyis su rtsom pa'i them rim gsar pa zhig la gom pa spo ba/ gsum na rang nyid kyi rtsom rtsal ngom pa sogs kyi don du/ sgrung ring sna tshogs phan tshun 'gran pa ji bzhin brtsams nas dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pas/ bod spyi tshogs steng shugs rkyen zab mo thebs par ma zad/ brtsams chos mang che bar gdeng 'jog kyang mi dman pa thob/ dper na/ glang bdun dpal 'byor gyis( gtsug g.yu〉yizhes pa brtsams shing /1993lor rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs kyi phul byung rtsom rig 173

brtsams chos kyi bya dga' thob/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis〈rkyal pa'i 'jig rten du nyul pa'i gtam rgyud〉spyidang(rnam shes dgod sgra〉⑫zhes pa brtsams shing / 〈rnam shes dgod sgra〉la mtsho sngon zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi bya dga' thob/bkra shis dpal ldan gyis〈phal ba'i khyim tshang zhig gi skyid sdug〉yices pa brtsams shing / 1994lor rtsom pa por‘‘krong krung 'un rtsom rig bya dga'’’ste rgyal khab rim pa'i bya dga' thob/ lhag pa don grub kyis〈'pho 'gyur〉spyidang〈drel pa'i mi tshe〉spyidang〈mi mngon pa'i 'ching thag〉yizhes pa brtsams shing / 〈'pho 'gyur〉la1997lor〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉rtsom sgrig khang gi‘‘rlung rta bum pa'i’’bya dga' thob/ brag gdong bkras gling dbang rdor gyis(bkras zur tshang gi gsang pa'i gtam rgyud〉⑫brtsams shing /1997lor〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉khang gi‘‘rlung rta bum pa'i’’bya dga' thob/ bkra bhas(srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉⑫zhes pa brtsams shing / (sbrang char〉bya dga' thob/ stag 'bum rgyal gyis(lhing 'jags kyi rtswa thang〉spyibartsams shing / mtsho sngon zhing chen dang mtsho sngon rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lhan tshogs sogs kyi bya dga' thob/bstan pa yar rgyas kyis(thag ring gi sbra nag〉ཿbrtsams pa dang /nag po skal bzang gis(klu 'bum mi rgod〉⑪brtsams pa tshe ring don grub kyis〈mes po〉⑩dang(smug pa〉yibartsams te 'phro rim 'phror rgya che'i klog pa po'i mig gi dga' ston du gyur/174

bod rigs rtsom pa po rnams kyis ma skul dang blangs kyis snga na med pa'i brtsams chos gsar rtsom byed pa'i dus mnyam du mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang〈sbrang char〉rtsom sgrig khang gtso byas pa'i 'brel yod rtsa 'dzugs dang las khungs kyis kyang bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gong nas gong du spel bar ha cang gtsigs chen mdzad/ khong tshos skabs der bod la deng rabs rang bzhin gyi lo rgyus sgrung gtam ring mo med par dmigs shing / bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi rnam pa 'thus tshang can du gtong ba dang / lo rgyus steng gi mi sna grags can khag cig gi ngo mtshar rtogs brjod dang don rkyen gal chen khag cig sgyu rtsal gyi sgo nas brjod pa la brten nas/ dus skabs de dag gi spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul dang lo rgyus kyi byung ba/ mi sna'i snang brnyan sogs rgya che'i klog pa po'i mig lam du 'grem phyir/ ched du mi sna rtsa 'dzugs dang brjod bya gtan 'beb yod pa'i sgo nas las bgos byas pas/ tshe rgyal gyis〈thon mi sam bho ṭa〉yizhes pa dang / tshe brtan rdo rjes〈tsong kha rgyal po〉⑪zhes pa brtsams te dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pa nas deng rabs rang bzhin gyi lo rgyus sgrung gtam ring mo yang yod par gyur/ don de la dmigs nas mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lhan tshogs kyis phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos kyi bya dga' gnang /dus skabs 'di'i nang du bod la snga na med pa'i sgrung gtam sna 175

tshogs 'di 'dra mang po zhig thon par ma zad/ rgyu spus kyang rgyun chad med par mthor 'degs su 'gro ba ni/ tang gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi byed phyogs bzang zhing dus deb so so'i rtsom sgrig khang gis lhag bsam gyis rgyab skyor byas pa dang / rtsom pa po rnams kyis hur brtson byas pa las gzhan/ bod la gna' rabs rtsom rig gi rmang gzhi 'thug po dang gzhan gyi rtsom rig legs cha nang 'dren byed pa'i srol rgyun legs po dang nyams myong phun sum tshogs po yod pa'i rkyen red/ der brten/ deng rabs rtsom rig mu 'thud du 'phel rgyas su 'gro dgos na gna' rabs rtsom rig la de ltar gces 'dzin bya dgos/gnyis/ dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam gyi snang tshul gtso bo bshad pa/gong du gleng ba ltar dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du bod la sgrung gtam sna tshogs stong phrag du ma spel ba ni spyi tshogs kyi rgyab ljongs dang dus rabs nges can zhig dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa dang /lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi bod spyi tshogs kyi ngos dang zur mang po mtshon pa ste/ brjod bya'i nang don rgya che zhing brjod bya'i bstan don gting zab pas/ re re bzhin brjod thabs bral na/ gsham nas nang don gyi ngos nas rigs chen po'am gtso bo 'gar phye ste cung zad 'chad par bya'o/ /(gcig)bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs 'og gi 176

bod ljongs phyi tshogs dang mi dmangs kyi phugs re mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam/lo rabs bdun cu pa'i mjug tu bod rigs mi dmangs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'ching ba las rnam par grol nas rgyal khab kyi bdag por gyur te lo 'khor nyis shu lhag 'gor rung / bcings 'grol sngon la bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs 'og tu bod 'bangs phal che bas dbul phongs dang nyom chung / rjes lus bcas kyi 'tsho ba rol pas/ de la lta stangs ha cang dman pa dang / bod ljongs zhi bas bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshun gyi dus yun ring po zhig la de'i nyes skyon ther 'don dang dgag rgyag byas pas rtsom pa po rnams la shugs rkyen ha cang zab mo chags pa/ bod ljongs kyi chab srid skabs bab la dgos mkho che ba bcas kyi dbang gis/ ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’nag nyes ther 'don dgag rgyag byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/spyi tshogs rnying ba'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyi gdug rtsub che ba'i rang gshis mtshang 'byin dang zhing bran rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi 'tsho ba phyir dran byed pa dang / sdug bsngal de las skyob mkhan gung khran tang la bsngags brjod byed pa'ang dus rabs gsar ba'i sgrung gtam dang khyad par du sgrung ring rnams kyi brjod bya'i nang don gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ dper na/ glang bdun dpal 'byor gyis brtsams pa'i〈gtsug g.yu〉 zhes pa'i sgrung ring las lho kha'i zhing 177

bran phun tshogs tshang la gtsug g.yu rtsa chen zhig yod pa sa de ga'i rdzong dpon gyis shes rjes/ zhi drag zung gi thabs la brten nas len thabs byas kyang phun tshogs bza' zla gnyis kyis ma byin pas/ kho rang btson du brdzangs shing dpal ldan gyi a ne g.yu sgron gyi rogs ram 'og btson las bros te sde dge phyogs su phyin/ phun tshogs kyi chung ma 'dzoms pa nad kyis 'chi khar gtsug g.yu de phun tshogs la byin zhing / jo bo'i sku mdun la phul nas bu dpal ldan la bde skyid yong bar smon lam 'debs dgos pa'i kha chems bzhag phun tshogs kyis chung ma'i kha chems ltar gtsug g.yu de jo bo chen po'i mdun du phul nas smon lam btab/ yin na'ang gtsug g.yu de cung ma 'gor bar lha sa'i mi dpon gyi sger nor du gyur/ de nas mi dpon gyis sa dbang chen po'i chung ma'i ming bo mda' dpon brgyud nas gtsug g.yu de sa dbang chen por phul/ gtsug g.yu de dpon khag de dag gcig nas gcig brgyud de mda' dpon gyi 'grog bzang gsal sgron gyi lag tu tshud rjes/ mda' dpon de gtsug g.yu'i bdag po ngo ma dpal ldan gyis dgra sha len par dogs pas/ lkog g.yo bshams nas dpal ldan btson du bcug cing bgrong rtsis byas/ yin na'ang /dpal ldan gyi grogs po bde skyid kyis mi dpang nor dpang tshang ba'i sgo nas gsang ba brtol nas dpal ldan btson grol thob/mthar mda' dpon gyis dpal ldan gsod rtsis byed tshe bde skyid kyis yang bskyar bskyabs rjes/ kho gnyis mnyam du lha sa nas mu 178

mtha' med pa'i gangs ri spangs ljongs kyi phyogs su phyin pa ste/gtsug g.yu las byung ba'i gtam rgyud rab dang rim pa brjod pa la brten nas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs 'og tu dpon 'bangs mtho dman bar gsum gyi 'brel ba gsal bor brjod pa dang / mi sna 'dra min sna tshogs kyi snang brnyan btod par brten nas sa dbang dang rdzong dpon/ mda' dpon sogs dbang sgyur mkhan gyi kha 'jam khog gnag dang / zol sbyor khrel med kyi rang gshis dang spyod ngan sun 'byin ther 'dod byed cing / zhing bran rnams kyis chab srid thad rang dbang thob pa dang 'tsho ba'i thad bde skyid yong bar re ba'i 'dun pa mtshon la/ re 'dun de mngon 'gyur byed par skyabs bzang gzhan du 'tshol dgos pa shugs las bstan yod/chos 'dzoms kyis brtsams pa'i(dwa phrug gi las dbang〉⑪la mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi zlos gar bstan bcos dang deng rabs sgrung gtam rtsom stangs zung du sbrel pa'i sgo nas/ bde grong gzhis ka'i nang du kha ngo skyes 'bras mtshar ba'i g.yog mo zhig yod par sku drag tshos btsan g.yem byas nas byis pa skyes rjes khrag mang po bzhur rung sman bcos byed pa'i cha rkyen med pas tshe las 'das pa dang / dwa phrug tu lus pa'i bu chung bstan 'dzin gyis lo lnga'i steng nas snga gzhug tu bde lung gzhis ka dang lha sa'i gzim shag tu bran g.yog byed skabs mnar gcod sna tshogs myangs nas shes pa rnal 179

la mi gnas par gyur mthar/ lha sa'i gzim shag gi phyir bskrad de 'khyags ltogs dang gcong nad gnyis kas mnar nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du phyin pa'i zhing bran mi rabs gnyis kyi skyo sdug gi gtam rgyud bkod pa la brten nas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs 'og gi zhing bran spyi'i bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'tsho ba dang las skal mtshon pa lta bu red/ de min skal bzang rnam grol gyis brtsams pa'i〈bu mo spun gsum gyi rnam thar〉⑫dang / bstan pas brtsams pa'i〈'jur ta spen tshe〉3dbang chen stobs rgyas kyis brtsams pa'i〈rta 'dul mkhan gyi gtam rgyud〉spyisogs sgrung thung mang po'i brjod bya'i nang don yang 'di bzhin no/ /brtsams sgrung de dag ni bod ljongs rnying par bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs 'og byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi don rkyen sna tshogs dang spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos las brtsams pa yin pas/ de dag dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pa des rtsom pa po rnams kyi brjod 'dod bsam blo mdzes dpyod kyi sgo nas gsal ler mtshon pa dang / skabs de'i chab srid dril sgrog gi bab dang yongs su mthun par ma zad/ rjes rabs pa dang bod rig par zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la mtshon na/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i bod kyi chab srid lam lugs dang dpon rigs mtho dma' bar gsum gyi dbang sgyur byed stangs/ de dag bar gyi 'brel ba/ zhing bran rnams kyi dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba dang chab srid kyi go gnas/ bsam blo'i 'khyer so 180

sogs la rgyus lon byed pa'i dpyad gzhi rtsa chen zhig kyang red/(gnyis)sems rma brjod pa'i sgrung gtam/‘‘sems rma brjod pa'i rtsom rig’’ni‘‘rig gnas gsar brje’’mjug gril rjes ches thog mar thon pa'i rgyal yongs rang bzhin gyi rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun nam snang tshul zhig yin zhing / des zhib 'bri byas pa ni spyi tshogs kyi rma kha dang‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po’’lo bcu'i nang du krung go'i spyi tshogs la bzos pa'i skyo sdug red/ ‘‘rig gnas gsar brjes’rirgyal khab dang spyi tshogs/ mi dmangs dung phyur du ma'i sems khong du rma kha bzos pas/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlag ma thag‘‘sems rma brjod pa'i rtsom rigari’de rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i rlabs phreng dang po'i tshul gyis thon pa red/ nga tsho bod la mtshon na'ang de bzhin te/ ‘‘lo bcu'i nang zing’’du bod kyi dgon sde mtha' dag‘‘lha 'dre gdon bgegs kyi tshang’ridu brjod nas gtor zhig tu gtong pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas thams cad chos lugs rmongs dad du brjod de bkag 'gog byed pa/ dpe cha sna tshogs rig gnas rnying pa'i rigs su bshad nas mer sreg cing / bla sprul dang grwa pa rnams la mi dmangs la bshu gzhog byed pa'i spyang ki zer pa dang / 'go khrid che chung tshang mar ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro ba'i dbang 'dzin pa zer nas dgag rgyag dang mnar gcod tshad med byas/ tha na brtson pa chen pos zhor las dang lag shes bzo las gnyer mkhan rnams 181

la'ang ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro mkhan zer nas 'thab rtsod dang gcer rdung byas/ las rigs so so'i bod mi rnams kyi sems la brjed thabs med pa'i rma kha bzos pas/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlags rjes/ 〈char shul gyi nags tshal〉 (rnam grol)dang(dpe tshab sprod pa〉nya(rig 'dzin) (bkra shis don grub gnyer sgrig byed pa'i snga rjes su〉⑫(rin chen tshe dga') 〈sdug 'bras〉sti(dpal mchog) 〈thug 'phrad〉chu(sga tshes gsum nyi ma)sogs sems rma brjod pa'i sgrung gtam gcig rjes gnyis 'thud kyis thon pa red/‘‘sems rma'i rtsom rig’’ni rma kha'i myong tshor dang mchi ma'i rtsom rig tsam min par‘‘mi bzhi shog khagari’gi nag nyes mtshang 'byin byed pa dang zang zing gis bzos pa'i nyes skyon ther 'don byed pa red/ dper na/ (sdug 'bras〉la mtshon na/ mgon zhol kung hre'i thon skyed las 'dzin snyan grags zer ba des‘‘sngon thon pa’riskul slong byas nas thon skyed kho na smra ba'i‘‘dbang 'dzin par’’dgag pa brgyab cing / ‘‘gsar du byung ba'i phyug po'i’’rgyu nor gzhung bzhes byed pa/ ‘‘rjes lus pa'i’’mgor‘‘zhwa mo’’bskon pa bcas byas nas/ 'byor ldan gral rim dang 'byor med gral rim gyi dpung khag gi dbye ba gsal bor nges su bcug pa dang / gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi bsam blo ldan pa'i phyugs rdzi sngon thon can skyed sring byas pas/ gong rim 'go khrid kyi bstod bsngags thob cing krung hre'i kru'u rin la 'phar pa'i snang tshul sun 'byin byas pa dang /182

rang gi dpon gnas 'phar pa dang mtshan snyan rgyas pa'i don du/ sa khul rang la mthun min dang phan 'bras 'byung min/ mang tshogs kyi dka' khag bcas la bsam blo mi gtong par phyogs re ba'i sgo nas sa khul mi gcig pa dang rang byung cha rkyen mi 'dra ba'i sa gnas kyi nyams myong btsan shed kyis zhwa dpe lham 'geb byas par dgag pa nan mo brgyab yod/(dpe tshab sprod pa〉zhes pa las‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’skabs su g.yon gyi chab srid lam phyogs kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa'i dma' 'bring dang po'i slob ma bkra shis kyis rang gi dge rgan grags pa'i dpe cha(snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs〉dang / (gser tog sum rtags〉 (dag yig dge bshes chos grags〉sogs‘‘rig gnas rnying ba'am’’‘‘chos lugs rmongs dad’’kyi rigs su bshad nas mer bsregs shing / dge rgan bkra shis la'ang‘‘lha 'dre gdon bgegs’’zhes gshe gshe btang pa dang / ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlags rjes rang gis sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod sems skyes shing dpe tshab nyos te dge rgan la 'gyod bshags byas pa bstan yod/yang / 〈bkra shis don grub gnyen sgrig byed pa'i snga rjes su〉zhes pa ni/ sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna gtso bo a khu rdo rjes 'das don phyir dran gyi tshul gyis brtsams pa ste/ ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’skabs su brag dmar sde ba'i ru gtso la gcod lo zhes pa ngal 183

rtsol la mi dga' ba dang / rku dang nag tshong rgyag pa/ bud med rnams la brnyas bcos byed pa sogs bya ngan spyod ngan kho na byed mkhan zhig yod pa de bskos rjes/ kho rang gtso byas pa'i dmar srung dmag rnams kyis ru gtso sngon ma blo bzang ni lam phyogs thog nor 'khrul tshabs chen yod pa'i‘‘ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa’’red ces yar bslangs pa dang sbrags/ lham 'debs a khu rdo rje tshang gi mna' ma 'phrog pa'i ched du a khu rdo rje la'ang‘‘gsar du thon pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim’’dang / ‘‘bshu gzhog la rten mkhan zhing pa phyug po’’zhes pa'i nyes ming btags nas/ zla ba kha shas la dgag rgyag dang 'thab rtsod/ gcer rdung /'jigs skul sogs khrims med lugs med kyi bya ba sna tshogs byas shing / de lta bu'i zang zing gi chab srid las 'gul yun ring du spel nas mi rnams blo bde'i ngang thon skyed byed pa'i go skabs ma byung stabs/ mi sems so sor gyes pa dang thon tshad mar chag pa sogs kyi mtha' 'bras ngan pa byung ste/ khyim tshang mang che ba zas gos med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar pas/ gzhan nor rku pa dang tsha thab steng gi gdan yang mi btsong thabs med kyi gnas tshul sna tshogs byung ba zhib 'bri byas nas/ ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen pos’’bzos pa'i nag nyes ther 'don byed cing der dgag pa rgyag pa lta bu'o/ /‘‘sems rma'i rtsom rig’’de dus skabs shig gi rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun zhig gi cha nas 'das zin yang / ‘‘rig 184

gnas gsar brje chen pos’’bod kyi goms srol la mthong chung byas pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas la dma' 'beb byas pa/ bod kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams la gcer rdung dang mnar gcod byas pa/ khyad par du bod kyi dgon sde khag gi rten dang brten pa dang / dpe rgyun dkon po sogs rig gnas dngos rdzas rtsa chen rnams meg med du btang pa'i na sems dang 'khon sems ni bod mi dmangs kyi sems su nam yin yang brjed thabs med pa zhig yin pas/ phyis kyi‘‘bcos sgyur sgrung gtam’’mang por yang thag zhor 'breng drud kyi sgo nas zur za dang sun 'byin/ dgag rgyag bcas byas pa las rtogs thub/(gsum)bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi grub 'bras mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam/de yang‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’skabs su gral rim 'thab rtsod gtsor bzung nas/ ‘‘ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro ba'i dbang 'dzin pa’’dang / ‘‘lha 'dre gdon bgegs’’ ‘‘thon skyed kho na smra ba’’ ‘‘gsar du byung ba'i 'byor ldan gral rim pa’risogs la 'thab rtsod dang dgag pa rgyag pa'i las la bral zhing / mi rnams kyi bsam blo zang zing du gyur nas thon skyed dam 'dzin byed ma thub pas/ rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor bstud mar mar bab cing dmangs kyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba ha cang sdug por gyur pa dang / khyad par du rong 'brog phyogs su thon skyed 'gan 'khri lam lugs lag bstar byas nas/ rgya che'i rong 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba 185

snga na med pa'i 'gyur ldog nyams spro ba byung bas/ rgyal yongs las rigs so so kun nas tang gi bcos sgyur sgo 'byed kyi srid jus gsar par mgrin gcig tu bsngags brjod dang gong bkur byas/gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og tu bod kyi rtsom rig las rigs su'ang dus skabs gsar pa'i 'tsho ba gsar pa mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam khag cig ngang ngam shugs kyis thon pa yin/ dper na/ thub bstan gyis brtsams pa'i〈a chung gis rta nyos pa〉3lta bur mtshon na/‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i’’skabs su 'phyi ba gsod pa dang slong mo byas nas 'tsho ba rol zhing kung hre yongs la med po skad grags che ba'i a chung gis thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar byas pa'i lo gsum par sri thar gyi lag nas‘‘pe cin ci phu’rizhes pa'i rta snyan grags can de nyos par ma zad/ da dung bu mo mdzes ma zhig kyang chung mar blangs pa'i gtam rgyud brjod pa la brten nas/thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar byas rjes kyi 'tsho ba gsar pa'i rnam pa ston pa'i shugs las lam lugs de'i yang dag rang bzhin la bstod bsngags kyang byed pa ltar red/(phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug〉las/ gtsang khul gyi zhing ba'i bu mo tshe brtan lha mo'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul brjod byar bzung nas de'i nye 'khor gyi so nam pa'i dud grong dang mi sna khag cig gi lo ngo sum cu lhag gi skyid sdug dang / bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas pa nas lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i lo 'go'i bar bod 186

kyi zhing khul gyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ mi'i bsam blo'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs sogs kyi 'gyur ldog mtshon pa dang /lhag par du tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes zhing khul du thog ma'i 'pho 'gyur chen po byung tshul mtshon 'dugayang / (lhing 'jags kyi rtswa thang〉zhes par mtshon na'ang sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna gtso bo dbang ldan rdo rje zer par‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i’’skabs su g.yon thal che ba'i lam phyogs kyi gnod 'tshe thebs pas/ rang yul bskyur nas gzhan yul 'grims nas dka' ba cher spyad kyis tshong las chung chung gnyer te ma dngul bsags pa dang / tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su phyir rang yul du log ste/ rang gi ma dngul btang nas tshong khang dang slob grwa 'dzugs pa dang / sde ba'i 'go khrid pa rgyal khab gzhan pa'i phyugs las sa khul du blta skor ram nyams myong len du 'gro bar bcug pa sogs gzhan phan gyi las bsgrubs pa dang / slob chung gi dge rgan sgrol ma dkar mor brtse dung zab mo chags shing / srol rgyun gyi stobs shugs dang dbang chen khag cig gis mgo mnon pa dang bkag rgya bzos kyang brtse dung gi chu rgyun ma chad pa sogs zhib 'bri byed pa la brten nas/ tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su 'brog phyogs rtswa thang du byung ba'i gsar pa dang / rang mos gnyen sgrig 187

byed pa'i snying stobs la bsngags pa brjod pa ltar red/‘‘bcos sgyur rtsom rig’’dang yang na bcos sgyur sgo 'byed kyi grub 'bras mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam de dag rtsom rig gsar rtsom don dngos dang nye bar byed pa dang / spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang gom pa mnyam dgos pa'i blang bya dang mthun par ma zad/ ‘‘sems rma brjod pa'i rtsom rig’ridang do snyom pa yang byed thub pas/ gsar rtsom la mdzub ston byed pa'i sde khag rnams kyis mthong chen dang khyab spel byas pa yin/(bzhi)sun 'byin sgrung gtam/dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du bod kyi yar skyed kyi 'dun pa mngon 'gyur byed pa dang bsam blo'i shes rtogs je mthor gtong ba/ dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas su gtong ba bcas kyi bgegs bar chad du gyur pa'i bsam blo rjes lus dang / goms srol rnying pa/ bya ngan spyod ngan bcas mtshang 'byin ther 'don byed rgyu ni dus skabs gsar pa'i bod rigs rtsom pa po rnams kyi g.yol thabs med pa'i 'os 'gan yin pas/ skabs de'i sgrung gtam mi nyung ba zhig gi brjod bya'i bstan don rigs 'dir gtogs pa ste/chos lugs pa rdzun ma'i ngo tsha khrel med kyi bya spyod ngan par dgag pa rgyag pa dang / 'du shes rnying pa dang goms srol ngan pa mkhregs bzung byas nas/ pho mo'i gnyen don la bgegs bar chad bzo pa dang rtswa sa'i don du phu nu nang dme byed par ther 'don dgag rgyag 188

byed pa/ las rgyu 'bras med pa'i bu phrug la las pha mar bkur gzo mi byed pa'i spyod pa skyug bro ba mtshang 'byin byed pa/ gzhan la mi rigs la rgya bshad cing rang gis rang 'khri'i las ka'ang bzang por mi bsgrub par zur za byed pa sogs shin tu mang zhing / de dag las kyang brtsams chos mang zhing gnad la khel ba ni/ chos lugs pa rdzun ma'i skyon mtshang la ther 'don dgag rgyag byas pa'i sgrung gtam red/ de yang rgyu mtshan yod de/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlags rjes tang gi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus yang dag pa'i sgo nas lag bstar dngos 'beb byas nas/ chos lugs phyogs yongs nas slar gso byed pa'i rnam pa gsar pa kun nas rgyas pas/ rgya che'i chos dad mang tshogs kyi yid kyi 'dzum rgya lhug par grol pa dang / dus yun ring bor khong du sbas ba'i dad pa'i stobs brdol zhing ser sna'i khu tshur yongs su lhod nas dge ba'i las bsgrub par 'bad pa'i bkra shis rnam pas khyab song / go skabs der brten nas 'dod ham che zhing khrel bag med pa/ g.yo sgyur mkhas shing le lo che pa 'ga' zhig chos lugs par brdzus nas/dam pa'i lha chos dang 'jig rten mi chos kun la'ang mi rung ba'i ngo tsha khrel med kyi bya ngan sna dgu byas/ rtsom rig ni mdzes dpyod kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig yin pas snang tshul de'i rigs snang med du 'jog ga la srid/ de yang gnad don de'i rigs brjod byar byas pa'i sgrung gtam dang po ni〈sprul sku〉yin zhing / de'i nang du bya 189

ngan sna dgu byed pa'i sprul sku rdzun ma dang rmongs pa'i dra bar tshud pa'i a khu nyi ma sogs kyi snang brnyan btod pa la brten nas/ rgyu nor la rngam zhing 'dod sred che pa/ rdzun gtam la mkhas shing g.yo sgyu che ba'i sprul sku rdzun ma'i bya spyod skyug bro ba ther 'don byed pa dang / lus la ser bo gyon zhing kha nas‘‘dkon mchog mkhyen’rizer mkhan zhig yin na/ bshad bshad thams cad lung bstan du nges shing mkho mkho tshang ma 'bul bar ster pa'i rmongs dad pa a khu nyi ma dang bu mo 'brug mo lta bu la dran skul gyi cong brda gtong gin yod la/ sprul sku ngo ma zhig yod med la'ang dogs slong mdzad par snyam/skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs steng sprul sku dang dge bshes/ grub thob pa/ lha ba/ mo ba sogs su brdzus nas/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi rgyu nor ham 'phrog dang bud med g.yo spyod/ nad par rkang rdzi sogs byed pa'i don rkyen cung mang rung / chos lugs dang 'brel ba'i don dag gleng na gcig tu tang gi srid jus dang / gnyis su chos lugs pa/ gsum du spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags bcas la bsam blo gtong dgos pas/ (sprul sku'i〉sngon du gnad don 'di'i skor brjod byar byas pa'i sgrung gtam ha lam med pa 'dra/ dpal don grub rgyal gyis snang tshul de'i rigs thugs kyis ma bzod par thugs spobs chen pos(sprul sku〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam de brtsams nas〈sbrang char〉dus deb tu spel rjes/ gnad don de'i rigs brjod byar byas pa'i 190

sgrung gtam ste pir thogs kyi(grub thob pa〉0dang / tsher ma'i(grub thob rta nag can〉yi rdo rje rin chen gyi〈mjal pa〉⑫ ka 'jam dbyangs kyi〈'gyod sems〉ñtsasogs 'phro rim 'phror thon par ma zad/ sngar las rno ngar che ba'i sgo nas gnad don de'i rigs la mtshang 'byin dgag rgyag byas pas/ skabs de'i rtsom rig gi snang tshul lam 'phel phyogs gtso bo zhig tu gyur/phul tu byung ba'i sgrung gtam 'di dag skabs der chos lugs kyi phyi gos gon pa dang ming g.yar nas/ dad ldan mang tshogs la mgo g.yog mgo skor gtong ba'i mi ngan kha shas kyi mgo bo 'joms byed kyi mtshon cha dang cal 'drog dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i mang tshogs khag cig rmongs pa'i gnyid las sad pa'i cong brdar gyur bar ma zad/ da lta dang ma 'ongs par yang dngos yod kyi don snying chen po yod par snyam/dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam gyi rtsom pa po mang che ba ni na gzhon dar ma yin zhing / pho mo'i brtse dung dang gnyen sgrig gi phyogs la do snang dang rtog dpyod byas pa ha cang zhib pa dang /bsam blo'i steng rang mos gnyen sgrig legs par snyam pas/ rigs rus mchog dman dang srung ma mthun min/ rus gtsang min sogs 'du shes dang goms srol rnying pa mkhregs bzung byas nas/ bu bu mo'i rang mos kyi gnyen don la the gtogs dang bar chad bzo ba dang / yang na btsan shed kyis gnyen sgrig pa'i snang tshul la dgag 191

pa rgyag pa'i sgrung gtam yang mi nyung ba zhig yod pa las dus deb steng spel pa snga zhing sne khrid dang blo bskyed kyi nus pa thon pa ni/dpal don grub rgyal gyi(sad kyi bcom pa'i me tog〉yin par snyam/des gtso bor bu bu mo mngal na yod pa'i dus nas gnyen rtags brgyab pa'i goms srol dgod bro ba des 'tsho bar dga' zhen dang ma 'ongs par re bas khengs pa'i gzhon nu tshe ring dang lha skyid gnyis kyi dri med brtse dung la bar bgegs byas pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa ston pa dang / ye shes chos 'phel gyi(rdza ri ga tshod mtho yang nyi zla bkag par mi nus〉⑪zhes pa las/ gzhon nu bstan 'dzin 'jigs med dang bu mo blo bzang sgrol ma gnyis chung dus nas slob grwa gcig 'grims nas mnyam du 'tsho ba rol ba las phan tshun la brtse dung zab mo chags nas/ tshe gang gtan grogs bya rgyu'i dam tshig rdo rje mdud pa bcings rung / bu mo blo bzang sgrol ma'i spo bo mgar ba yin pa'i rkyen gyis/ kho gnyis kyi lugs mthun gyi brtse dung la bkag 'gog dang / khrel dgod/ 'phya dmod sogs byas pa dang /gzhon nu pho mo gnyis kyis zhum pa med par ngo rgol byas tshul brjod pa ste/ sgrung gtam gnyis kyis ngos mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'du shes rnying pa dang lugs srol ngan pa'i nyes skyon la sun 'byin dgag rgyag byed pa dang / dri ma med pa'i rang mos brtse dung dang rang dbang gnyen sgrig brtson pa'i snying stobs la bstod glu len zhing /phyis rabs pa'i rang mos brtse dung la 'bras bu yid bzhin du smin 192

par re 'bod byed kyin yod/da dung chos 'dzoms kyis brtsams pa'i(rigs rus〉nyadang tshe ring rnam mgon gyi(klu mo mtsho〉nya bkra shis zla ba'i〈gtsang po'i pha rol〉9sogs kyang brjod bya'i bstan don 'di'i rigs mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam yin/ sgrung gtam de dag las mang che ba brtse dung dang gnyen sgrig gi ched du gnyen sgrig brjod pa ma yin par/ bod spyi tshogs su khyab gdal du gnas pa'i 'du shes rnying ba dang lugs srol ngan pa bcos sgyur byas nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol ba dang sngon thon gyi mi rigs shig tu 'gyur rgyu de yin pas/ klog pa po mang pos dga' bsu thob par ma zad/ spyi tshogs kyi don snying yang nges can zhig ldan pa red/spyir pha ma dang gnyen bshes la gus zhabs byed pa ni mi chos kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi gtso bo zhig yin la/ bod kyis gna' snga mo nas sri zhu mchog tu brtsi zhing / rgyal po srong btsan gyi ring nas‘‘pha dang ma la drin gzo bkur bsti bya’’zhes mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims su 'khod kyang / las rgyu 'bras mi brtsi pa dang khrel bag med pa'i bu bu mo la las pha mas bsags pa'i rgyu nor dgos shing pha ma mi dgos la/ yang na pha ma rgan mtshang du byed par ma zad/ pha ma mnar gcod byed pa dang nam 'chi la re sgug byed pa'i snang tshul yang mi nyung pas/ gnad don de'i rigs sun 'byin dgag rgyag byed pa'i sgrung gtam yang dpal don grub rgyal gyi〈rgyu 'bras med 193
