pa'i mna' ma〉dang / don yod kyi〈pha rgan 'das rjes〉gyi rdo rje rin chen gyi〈a ma'i sems〉nyasogs mang du thon la/ de dag las brjod pa nyung zhing zur za bya yul mang la sgyu rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba ni(pha rgan 'das rjes〉zhes pa de yin/ sgrung gtam des ka cu mkhar la sram dang g.yu byur nyo ru song pa'i a khu bstan pa ma shi bar sde ba'i nang gi mi rnams kyis a khu bstan pa phyir rang yul la log pa'i lam du rlangs 'khor la chag skyon byung nas shi zhing 'drer skyes par lab pa dang / a lags tshang gis kyang de dang mthun par gsung zhing / a khu bstan pa'i bu bu mo dang mag pa mna' ma rnams kyis a pha'i rgyu nor ji ltar bgo pa dang a ma sus gso pa'i don la kha 'thab byed skabs/ a khu bstan pa bde 'jags ngang phyir slebs nas kho tsho'i kha rtsod kyi tshig dang rnam 'gyur tshang ma shes rjes/ khong khro zhe sdang dang blo pham yi chad kyis sa la 'gyel zhing tshe las 'das pa'i gtam rgyud brjod pa'i sgo nas/ da lta sde tsho la lar mi shi shi tshang ma 'drer skyes par lab pa dang / bu bu mo kha shas kyi pha ma'i rgyu la dga' zhing pha ma gso bar mi 'dod pa'i bsam spyod/ a lags la shas kyi‘‘mkhyen pa’’bcas la zur za tsha thag chod pa zhig mdzad yod/yang / spyang tsher gyi(la rgya〉spyil mtshon na'ang / sa2kugasum rgyun du mkhar grong chung ba'i bzhi mdo'i za khang du 'dzoms nas chang 'thungs rjes rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi gnas tshul dang mi rigs kyi la rgya 194

bshad cing / mjug mthar chang gis bzi nas za khang du zhag tu lus pa'i ngang tshul 'khod pa la brten nas/ rgyun par rang gi 'gan 'khri'i bya ba'ang legs por mi bsgrub par chang 'thung pa dang / chang gis bzi rjes rang gi lus la'ang bdag mi thub pa'i gzhon dar kha shas kyis chang 'thungs rjes mi rigs kyi la rgya bshad par zur za dang 'phya dmod byed kyin yod/ snang tshul 'di ni42dzugasum tsam la yod pa ma yin par rang re gzhon dar rnams kyi khrod du tshad mi 'dra par gnas pa zhig yin pas/ sgrung gtam 'di'i rigs 'grem spel byas pas de dag gi bsam spyod bcos sgyur byas nas ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas mi rigs kyi la rgya brtson len byed par slob gso'i nus pa thon pa smras ma 'tshal/de min da dung dpon po la las rang gi dbang shugs la brten nas gzhan gyi rgyu nor len pa dang / mi kha shas kyis ltag sgor brten nas rang don 'grub thabs byed pa/ sde tsho la las rtsa sa'i don du phu nu nang dme byed pa/ 'du shes rnying pa'i shan zhugs kyis bod rigs bud med kyi 'tsho ba dang re smon/ brtse dung sogs la ya nga ba'i gnod 'tshe thebs pa sogs tshul min gyi bya spyod dang 'os min gyi snang tshul sna tshogs brjod byar byas pa'i sgrung gtam yig brgya ma dang mu 'brel sgrung gtam yig brgya ma'ang rnam grags kyis brtsams pa'i(bar chad〉nyadang / tshe ring don grub kyis brtsams pa'i(zla 'od 'og gi zlos gar〉⑫ 〈bud med las byed cig gi nyin gang〉myi195

tshe brtan rdo rjes brtsams pa'i〈gla rtsi〉spyi sangs rgyas kyis brtsams pa'i(bsam yul las 'das pa〉nya sum bha'i don pos brtsams pa'i〈ngag don zung 'brel〉spyi don grub kyis brtsams pa'i〈spu nad〉myi bkra bhas brtsams pa'i(sgrol ma nyer gcig〉sogs ha cang mang pa red/dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam las sun 'byin sgrung gtam gyis grangs ka mang du zin zhing / skabs 'di'i sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya'i bstan don gtso bo zhig tu gyur pa ni dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom pa po rnams gzhan mtshang 'bru bar dga' ba ma yin la/ rtsom pa po rang rang gi chags sdang dang phyogs zhen gyi dbang du song pa de bas kyang ma yin/ kho tsho tshang ma bod mi rigs kyi bde sdug dang 'phel rgyas/ mdun lam bcas la sems khur dang rtog dpyod/ do snang bcas byed mkhan yin pas/ dus skabs gsar pa'i dus bab bzang bor brten nas mi rigs gzhan rnams shes rig dang dpal 'byor phyogs so so nas bya 'phur ba bzhin 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba yin na rang mi rigs da dung 'du shes rnying pa dang rmongs pa'i mun pa/ lugs srol ngan pa/ rjes lus kyi lta ba sogs kyi rkang rdor thogs nas lus pa'i snang tshul gangs dkar sems kyis ma bzod par/gsar rtsom gyi gri dang ral grir brten nas bar bgegs nad kyi skrangs pa rtsa nas 'don par gzhol pa red/ der brten/ kho tshos sun 'byin sgrung gtam de dag rtsom pa'i dgos pa yang brtsams 196

chos nang bton pa'i skyon mtshang de dag la khab gtsags 'bigs gtsags tsam byed 'dod ma yin/ skyon mtshang de dag gi rtsa ba 'byung rkyen dang bcas pa bton nas/ phyin chad de rigs phyir mi 'byung ba'i don du yin pas/ bod kyi spyi tshogs bcos skyong dang phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar don snying gal chen ldan pa red/(lnga)dus rabs kyi khyad chos dang snying stobs mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam/dngos yod spyi tshogs khrod kyi byung ba brjod pa dang mi dang mi bar byung ba'i 'brel ba dang phog thug 'gal ba bcas zhib 'bri byas nas/ dus rabs kyi khyad chos dang snying stobs mtshon par byed pa ni/ deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos gtso bo yin la/ deng rabs rtsom pa po rnams kyi 'bad bya gtso bo'ang yin pas/ dus skabs gsar pa'i sngon nas dpal don grub rgyal gyis brjod bya'i bstan don de'i rigs mtshon pa'i〈pad mtsho〉 dang〈'brug mtsho〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam brtsams nas〈mtsho sngon gsar 'gyur〉 du 'khod la/ de'i rjes su rtsom pa po mang pos sgrung gtam de'i rigs mang du brtsams nas 'grem spel byas dang byed bzhin pa las phul du byung ba 'ga' drangs na/ dpal don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i〈'brong stag thang〉nyadang / tshe ring don grub kyi〈gzhon nu'i rang sgra dbyar gyi rnga gsang〉yi rnam sras kyi(mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwa〉spyi a lo rin chen rgyal po'i〈spyang brag lung ba〉nyasogs lta bu 197

red/ sgrung gtam de dag gi brjod bya'i bstan don ha lam phyogs gcig tu gtogs kyang rtsom pa po rang rang gi dga' phyogs dang bsam phyogs/ rgyus lon byas pa'i rgyu cha sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ la las drang phyogs mi sna'i yar thon gyi byung ba brjod cing /de'i rang gshis dang phugs bsam/ bya spyod sogs zhib 'bri byed pa'i sgo nas thad kar bstod bsngags brjod pa dang / la las drang ldog phyogs gnyis kyi mtha' 'bras gshib sdur byed pa'i sgo nas mtshon par byed pa/ la las drang ldog phyogs mi sna'i bar gyi phog thug dang 'gal rtsod 'bri ba'i sgo nas mtshon pa bcas gsum du 'dus pa red/ dper na/ (pad mtsho〉lta bur mtshon na/ sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna gtso bo pad mtshos lug 'tsho zhor du rang sbyong byas te mi rigs dge thon slob grwar rgyugs 'phrod pa'i gnas tshul bkod nas/ bod kyi na gzhon dang khyad par du gzhon nu ma rnams kyis tshan rig shes bya dang / rig gnas slob sbyong byed pa'i snying rus chen por bstod pa dang / ('brug mtsho〉las 'brug mtsho lta bu'i bod rigs slob chen pas rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas dang rtswa thang gi mi rabs rjes ma gso skyong byed ched/ rang nyid kyi thob thang dang bde sdug mi bsam par 'brog phyogs kyi slob chung dge rgan byed du song ba'i spyod tshul bzang po dang snying stobs la bstod bsngags chen po mdzad/ 〈'brong stag thang〉las mes po'i dus nas byung ba'i tsho khag bar gyi 'gal ba'am rtsod gzhi rnams 198

deng rabs gzhon nu dag gis rnam par bsal ba'i go rtogs dang bya spyod thad gar bris nas bsngags brjod byed pa lta bu red/yang / 〈gzhon nu'i rang sgra dbyar gyi rnga gsang〉las/ gzhon nu tshe ring gis nad ljid mo phog pa'i a pha bla ma'i lung bstan ltar mtha' gcig tu lha sar 'gro ba yang yang du bkag pa'i byung rim rab dang rim pa 'god cing / rang bzhin gyis gshis rgyud yag cing rig pa rno la rmongs dad la mi dga' pa/ deng rabs kyi tshan rig shes bya sogs la sbyong 'dod ha cang che ba'i gzhon nu tshe ring sogs kyi snang brnyan skrun pa'i sgo nas dus skabs gsar pa'i bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyi bsam blo dang / spobs pa/ dus rabs kyi snying stobs bcas mtshon pa dang / 〈spyang brag lung ba〉zhes pa las a ma dpal sgron gyis g.yang lung sde ba'i chag 'jigs tshang ma gzhi bdag a myes spyang brag dang 'brel par snyam nas/ tshe gang bor a myes spyang brag la phog thug byed par 'dzem yang mtha' gzhug rang gi tshe srog kyang rnam rtog de'i dbang du gyur pa dang / kho mo'i bu spyang thar tshe ring gis 'du shes rnying pa'i 'jigs skul la ma 'dzem par spobs pa chen pos a myes spyang brag gi bla rir 'khod pa'i spyang tshogs rtsa med du btang zhing de'i nye 'dabs su sa rko rdo slog byas nas sman rdzas bzo grwa btsugs rung / a myes spyang brag gis gnod pa ma thebs par ma zad kha las rlung rta dar pa ste/ a ma dpal sgron ma bu gnyis kyi las skal gshib sdur byed pa'i sgo nas bod kyi mi 199

rabs gsar ba'i snying stobs dang bya spyod la bstod bsngags brjod cing / de'i shugs las rtsom pa po'i bsam blo rnying pa dang goms srol ngan pa'i 'ching rgya gtor te dpal yon gsar pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i smon 'dun yang mtshon yod pa ltar ro/ /gong du brjod pa'i sgrung gtam rigs lnga ni spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang chab srid kyi 'gyur ldog rgyal yongs rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gyi shugs rkyen 'og byung ba'i bod kyi sgrung gtam gyi snang tshul gtso bo lnga red/gsum/ dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos bshad pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du phyi rol yul dang rang ngos gnyis ka'i mthun rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ bod kyi sgrung gtam phyi'i rnam pa dang brjod bya'i khyab rgya/ mtshon don bsam blo/ sgyu rtsal rtsom stangs/ brtsams chos kyi grangs ka sogs gang thad nas snga na med pa'i 'phel 'gyur gsar pa byung ba ni bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun las byung ba'i dus rabs kyi rlabs phreng zhig yin zhing /ngo ma yid spro zhing nyams dga' la ngar rgyas pa zhig yin pa su zhig gis bsnyon par nus/ des na de lta bu'i sgrung gtam la khyad chos gang 'dra yod ce na/ brtsams chos shin tu mang pas tshang ma klog ma thub pa dang / sgrung gtam gsar rtsom gyi lag len ha cang nyung zhing gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad zhan pa'i dbang gis/ 'di lta bu dang de 200

'dra ba yod ces cha tshang zhing gnad la khel ba zhig brjod mi nus rung / rang blos dpag tshod kyis sgrung gtam spyi la khyab pa'i khyad chos rags tsam gleng ba 'di ltar/(gcig)rnam pa'i 'phel phyogs kyi khyad chos/dus skabs 'di'i rtsom pa po rnams rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad chab srid kyi bkag rgya med par rang dbang thob pa dang / brjod bya'i nang don rgya che zhing sna tshogs yin pa'i dbang gis/ gsar rtsom thad sgrung gtam sna tshogs kyi dgos mkho byung bas/ sgrung thung gtso byas thog sgrung thung yig brgya ma dang / mu 'brel sgrung thung / sgrung 'bring / sgrung ring / srog chags sgrung gtam/ skye dngos sgrung gtam/lo rgyus sgrung gtam sogs kyang 'phro rim 'phror thon nas mnyam du 'phel ba red/(gnyis)brjod bya'i nang don gyi khyad chos/skabs 'di'i rtsom pa po phal che ba na gzhon dar ma yin zhing /kho tshor bod spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i gnad don dngos brjod pa la brten nas/ bod kyi las don so so 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i kun slong rnam dag dang spobs pa chen po ldan pa'i rkyen gyis/ kho tsho'i brtsams chos kyi brjod bya'i nang don mang che ba yang spyi tshogs rnying pa nas da lta'i bar gyi bod spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang sgos su dus skabs 'di'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos yin pa red/ 'di ni sngon ma'i dus skabs gang la'ang yod ma myong pa'i yar thon gyi khyad 201

chos gtso bo zhig red/(gsum)mi rigs kyi khyad chos/bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam ni rgya dang nub phyogs rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa dang / sngon thon mi rigs de dag gi sgrung gtam la zur lta byas nas brtsams pa yin rung / rtsom pa po mang che ba bod rigs yin pa dang srol rgyun rtsom rig gi shes bya'i rmang 'thug pa/ brjod bya'i nang don bod kyi 'tsho ba dngos yin pa/ rtsom byed skad yig kyang bod kyi skad dang yi ge yin par ma zad/rtsom pa po mi nyung ba zhig gis sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna'i lab gleng gi tshig rnams bsam bzhin sngon ma'i mgur glu dang ge sar sgrung glu/gna' rabs sgrung gtam gyi skad cha 'bri srol bcas ltar bris pa dang / bod rang gi goms srol ltar dmangs khrod kyi glu dang la gzhas/ gtam dpe/ bshad pa/ gsol mchod sogs gang la gang 'tsham du spyad pas/ brtsams chos kyi phyogs so so na mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal lo/ /(bzhi)dus rabs kyi khrad chos/ rgan dor zhi snyems blo mchog gis‘‘deng skabs kyi dus rabs kyi khyad chos ni 'das pa'i dus rabs kyi rjes lus kyi gnas stangs yang rtsa ba nas 'gyur med cing / da lta'i dus rabs dang spyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin dang mthun pa'i khyad chos gsar pa phyogs kun nas dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i nyams mngon sum myong snang du grub pa de 202

yin/’’⑫gsungs/ des na skabs 'di'i sgrung gtam mang che ba'i brjod bya'i nang don dus skabs rang gi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos yin pas/ bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byas pa'i rjes kyi bod spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa gsar pa mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam/ tshul min gyi bsam spyod dang 'os min gyi snang tshul sna tshogs la sun 'byin dgag rgyag byed pa'i sgrung gtam gang yin rung de'i brjod bya rang ngos na 'das pa'i dus kyi rjes lus kyi cha dang deng rabs dus kyi sngon thon gyi cha gnyis ka gnas thog rtsom pa po rnams kyis rang rang gi brjod 'dod bsam blo'i dgos mkho ltar sgyu rtsal gyi las snon byed cing / dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa dang drang ldog phyogs gnyis ka'i snang brnyan bkod de/ bden bzang mdzes gsum la bsngags pa brjod cing rdzun ngan btsog gsum la mtshang 'byin dgag rgyag byas pa las/ dus rabs kyi khyad chos rang shugs kyis thon yod/bzhi/ dus skabs gsar pa'i sgrung gtam 'gyur ma bshad pa/rgyal nang gi sngon thon mi rigs dang phyi gling gi phul du byung ba'i sgrung gtam ni rang rang rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gi nying bcud yin la/ 'dzam gling mi rigs spyi'i bsam pa'i longs spyod cig yin par ma zad/ nga tsho bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas su gtong bar med mi rung ba'i zur 203

lta'i brtsams chos kyang yin/ der rten dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du deng rabs rang bzhin gyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom byed pa'i dus mnyam du 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan gyi phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos de dag ngo sprod byed pa dang / bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams kyi shes rgya je che dang rtsom rtsal je mthor gtong ba bcas kyi don du/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mang po zhig gis 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan gyi phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos dang bod rigs rtsom pa pos rgya yig gi steng nas brtsams pa'i sgrung gtam bod yig tu bsgyur nas/ 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉dang(sbrang char〉sogs rtsom rig dus deb steng du 'grem spel byas par ma zad/ 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉rtsom sgrig khang gis da dung phul byung brtsams chos lo tsā byed par skul ma thebs pa'i ched du1992lor 'gyur rtsom gyi ched bsgrigs dus deb spel nas rgyal khab phyi nang gi phul byung brtsams chos rnams rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar phul/ dus mtshungs su rgyal yongs kyi bod yig dpe skrun khang so sos kyang rgyal khab phyi nang gi phul byung brtsams chos lo tsā dpe skrun byed par mthong chen mdzad/ dper na/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis1980lor zhing chen dang ljongs lnga'i dpe skrun khang gis 'gan du blangs nas bsgyur pa'i(chu ngogs gtam rgyud rgyas pa〉 deb4dpe skrun byas pa dang /1984lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis〈thog khang dmar po'i rmi lam〉'gyur ma(ngag dbang chos dar gyis 204

bsgyur)dpe skrun byas/ 1985lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉dang〈sbrang char〉sogs dus deb steng 'khod pa'i 'gyur rtsom spus legs rnams gcig tu bsdus pa'i( phyi gling pa'i sgrung thung phyogs bsgrigs〉 dpe skrun byas/1987lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis〈thang san bla ma'i rnam thar〉'gyur ma(don yod rnam rgyal gyis bsgyur)dpe skrun byas/rgyal khab phyi nang gi sgrung gtam grags chen sna tshogs dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pa des bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dang bsam blo'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs por 'gyur pa dang / bod rigs rtsom pa po rnams kyi shes rgya je che dang rtsom rtsal je mthor 'gro ba/'dzam gling gi sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi dus skabs so so'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel 'gyur dang spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba/ yul srol goms gshis/ kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi/ mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so sogs rgyus lon byed par phan nus chen po thon la/ bod rigs rtsom pa pos rgya yig gi thog nas bod kyi 'tsho ba spyad nas brtsams pa'i sgrung gtam ste/ skal bzang tshe brtan gyi〈brjed mi rung ba'i 'das don〉⑪dang / (dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu〉⑪ 〈mdzes shing sdug pa'i tshon ris〉⑪ 〈slar yang ngo phrad pa〉⑪ 〈gla rtsi〉bcas dang / ye shes tshe ring gi(bsam yul las 'das pa'i don〉⑫ don grub dbang 'bum gyi〈gsal la mi gsal ba'i zla 'od〉⑫ bkra shis 205

zla ba'i(gtsang bo'i pha rol〉 ye shes tshe ring gi〈rgyang ring du 'then pa'i rkang lam phra mo〉⑪ rdo rje tshe brtan gyi(rngam brjid ldan pa'i lab tse ri bo〉⑪sogs sgrung gtam khag cig ni rgyal khab spyi'i dus skabs so so'i rtsom rig bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun ltar bod kyi 'tsho ba brjod bya byas nas brtsams pa yin pas/ sgrung gtam de dag la sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs dang bsam gzhigs byed stangs thad rang rang gi khyad chos yod par ma zad/ rtsom rig gi brjod bya'i bstan don thad bod yig gis gsar rtsom byed mkhan rnams la sne khrid dam zur ston gyi nus pa'ang nges can zhig bskyed par nges/ de min phul du byung ba'i 'gyur rtsom de dag ni rgya bod yig gnyis la byang cha cung zad che ba dang / lo tsā'i lag len gyi rmang gzhi dang rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad nges can zhig yod pa'i lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur thog dus deb rtsom sgrig pa dang dpe skrun rtsom sgrig pa rnams kyis zhu dag yang yang byas pa'i 'gyur rtsom yin pas/ rtsom rig lo tsā ba dang lo tsā'i zhib 'jug pa rnams la mtshon na/ mi rigs mi 'dra pa dang brjod bya mi mtshungs pa'i brtsams chos ji ltar lo tsā byed pa'i dpyad gzhi rtsa chen du'ang 'gyur nges red/mjug sdud pa'i gtam/dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du bod la deng rabs sgrung gtaru/ med pa nas yod pa dang / yod pa nas cha yongs nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba ni bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng mthong dkon pa'i 206

snang tshul zhig yin rung / bod kyi phul du byung ba'i gna' rabs sgrung gtam dang sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi phul du byung ba'i deng rabs sgrung gtam dang bsdur na da dung zhan cha cung zad mang pas/mu 'thud du gna' bzang deng spyod dang phyi bzang nang 'dren byed cing spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang du zab zhugs byas nas 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi sra zhing brtan par gtong pa dang chabs cig rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi blo sbyong mtho ru btegs te/ legs par bstod pa dang dman par 'phya ba gang zhig yin rung de'i spyi tshogs dang lo rgyus kyi 'byung rkyen dang bcas pa gting zab cing gnad la 'khel pa zhig brjod ci thub bya dgos/ de ltar byas na dus rabs dang mthun zhing spyi tshogs la phan pa'i brtsams chos sngar las legs po thon par gdon mi za'o/ /gsal bshad/()phran gyi〈dus skabs gsar ba'i bod kyi snyan ngag bshad pa〉 las zhib mor brjod yod/6)sgo'i1981lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i〈mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉 gyi shog ngos446las gsal/()()1981lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i('bol rtsom zhogs pa'i skya rengs〉 las gsal/rjo1981lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/⑦1986lo'i(sbrang char〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/(bye1983lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/207

()1984lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(yi1984lo'i〈 sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/(nye1997lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈dpal don grub rgyal gyi gsung 'bum〉 pod gnyis pa'i shog ngos52las gsal/(spredapal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bos brtsams/(41978lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis yang bskyar par du bskrun/tshul1984lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/(khyabyams pa chos 'dzoms kyis brtsams shing1982lo'i( sbrang char〉deb dang po'i steng du 'khod yod/dzun+t+ra.u rgyan rdo rjes brtsams shing1985lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈bod kyi brtsams sgrung 'dems sgrig〉 tu 'khod yod/(1chos 'phel tshe ring gis brtsams shing1985lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈bod kyi brtsams sgrung 'dems sgrig〉 tu 'khod yod/(khyamagon po dngos grub kyis brtsams shing1985lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i(bod kyi brtsams sgrung 'dems sgrig〉 tu 'khod yod/(gyeyon tan gyis brtsams shing1985lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i(bod kyi brtsams sgrung 'dems sgrig〉 tu 'khod yod/(kye1994lor kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/6)rgya yig deb1980lor mi dmangs rtsom rig dpe skrun khang gis par 208

kun gyis mkhyen gsal red/ spyi lo1958lor bstan pa rgya mtsho mchog gis srol rgyun gyi rtsom srol dang deng rabs lhug rtsom gyi rtsom stangs zung du sbrel nas〈mi dmangs shes rab rtsal gyis dge mtshan gsar du bskrun〉①zhes pa'i don brjod lhug rtsom brtsams myong rung / skabs de'i bod spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang rtsom pa po'i dpung shugs/ brtsams chos spel sa'i dus deb sogs kyi cha rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i rkyen gyis/ lhug rtsom gyi rigs bye brag pa zhig byas nas khyab spel dang dar rgyas su 'gro ma thub ste/ dus skabs de dang de'i rjes kyi dus yun nges can zhig gi bod kyi shes yon can rnam pas yul gzhan la blta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos sam myong tshor brjod pa dang / yang na de dag snyan zhur 'bul pa'i yi ge'ang tshigs bcad snyan ngag gi lam nas brtsams yod pa las rtogs thub/ des na lhug rtsom de brjod bya'i nang don rgya che zhing rnam pa sna tshogs yin pa dang / yid 'gyur ston pa dang don brjod par tshod 'dzin med pa/ sgrig gzhir rang dbang che ba/ skad cha snyan pa bcas kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa'i rtsom lus yan ga ba zhig gi tshul du thon zhing 'phel ba yang gtso bo tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su/ dar gzhon rtsom pa po khag cig 'tshar longs byung ba'i grub 'bras red/ kho tsho dngos gzhi'i slob ma'i skabs dang yang na zhib 'jug slob ma'i skabs su bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa dang brda sprod rig pa sogs la sbyangs brtson byas nas rtsom 212

rtsal rgyas shing / 〈rtsom rig rnam bshad〉dang(rtsom 'jug〉sogs sbyangs nas rtsom rig gzhung lugs nges can zhig rgyud la 'byor ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng rgya dang nub phyogs mi rigs gzhan gyi phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos la zur lta byas nas brtsams pa red/ de yang dar gzhon rtsom pa po de dag la tshig nyams 'don pa gtsor byed pa'i〈snyan ngag me long〉 gi shugs rkyen zab thog yid sprul phun sum tshogs shing tshor 'du drag la/ rang gi pha yul dang mi rigs/ rig gnas bcas la brtse dung zab mo ldan pa'i rkyen gyis/ skabs de'i lhug rtsom mang che ba snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba la brten nas yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom yin la/ lhug rtsom de'i rigs dus thog tu gsar du spel pa'i(sbrang char〉 dang〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 (mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉 sogs dus deb dang(mtsho sngon nyin re gsar 'gyur〉 dang〈bod ljongs tshags par〉 gyi rtsom rig par ngos su bkod pa des rgya che klog pa po rnams la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs shing rtsom pa po rnams rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i mos pa je drag dang brtson sems je cher gyur pas/ lhug rtsom gyi grangs ka dang rnam pa mgyogs myur ngang je mang du gyur/ dus mtshungs su tshags par khang dang rgyang sgrog khang sogs gsar 'gyur las khungs kyis bya ba'i phan nus je cher btang nas/ dus rabs 'phel rgyas kyi blang bya dang mthun par byed ched/ ched las bcos bsgyur byas te le tshan je mang dang bod yig gis thad kar bris pa'i 213

rtsom yig mang tsam bkol ba'i phyogs su 'khor pa dang / mtsho sngon bod yig〈tshan rtsal tshags par〉 dang mtsho sngon bod yig(khrims lugs tshags par〉 (gangs rgyan na chung tshags par〉sogs gsar du spel pas/ don brjod lhug rtsom gtso byas pa'i lhug rtsom sna tshogs shin tu mkho bar gyur/ don de la dmigs nas〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 khang dang mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs sogs kyis bstud mar lo 'gar las zhor gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyi zab sbyong 'dzin grwa bsgrubs nas de'i phyogs kyi rtsom pa po skyed sring byas pa dang chabs cig mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur khang dang mtsho sngon bod yig〈khrims lugs tshags par〉rtsom sgrig khang / yul shul khul chu bo rma 'bri rtsa gsum 'byung yul gyi skye khams khor yug srung skyong tshogs pa bcas kyis spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul dang dril bsgrags kyi dgos mkhor dmigs nas/skye khams khor yug srung skyob byed pa mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom sna tshogs bsdus shing de dag las phul byung brtsams chos la bya dga' gnang pa'i byed sgo bsdus nas/ rtsom pa po rnams kyi grub 'bras la gzengs bstod dang lhug rtsom la blo 'jug par skul ma thebs pas/ snyan zhu'i rtsom rig dang dpyad brjod lhug rtsom yang mang du thon pa yin/ de ltar dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du bod kyi slob gso dang gsar 'gyur/ dpe skrun sogs las rigs phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / 'brel yod sde khag gis lhag bsam gyis rgyab skyor 214

dang ram 'degs byas 'og rgya che'i rtsom pa po rnams kyis brtson pa cher spyad byas pa la brten nas/ rang re bod la'ang yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom dang don brjod lhug rtsom/ snyan zhu rtsom rig sogs deng rabs lhug rtsom sna tshogs yod par ma zad/ grangs 'bor yang je mang nas je mang du 'phel bzhin yod/ dper na/1985lor bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes nas lo nyi shu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu pa'i ched du phyogs sgrig byas pa'i dpe deb〈bod kyi lhug rtsom 'dems sgrig〉②las lhug rtsom35yod pa dang /1981lo nas1992lo'i bar bod khams yongs kyi bod yig gi dus deb dang tshags par steng du spel ba'i lhug rtsom las legs shos bdams pa'i ched sgrig dpe deb〈kha ba'i rnam shes〉dulas phul byung lhug rtsom lnga bcu lhag yod cing / 1991lor(sbrang char〉spel nas lo ngo nyi shu 'khor bar dga' ston rten 'brel zhu ched dus deb de'i steng du lo ngo nyi shu'i ring spel ba'i lhug rtsom ches legs shos bdams pa'i(lhug rtsom pad ma'i ze'u 'bru〉tshulas lhug rtsom69yod la/ 2003lo nas2004lo'i bar(mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 dang mtsho sngon bod yig(khrims lugs tshags par〉 steng du skye khams khor yug srung skyob byed pa mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom rkyang rkyang40lhag bkod pa sogs las mtshon/ 'phel phyogs kyi ngos nas bltas na'ang snyan ngag gi lam nas rang byung gi yul ljongs dang grong khyer sogs kyi bkod par bsngags brjod byed pa 215

nas dngos yod spyi tshogs khrod kyi mi dang don brjod pa'am zhib 'bri gtsor byed pa'i phyogs su 'khor yod/ mdor na/ bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom de med pa nas yod pa dang / yod pa nas grangs 'bor je mang dang / rnam pa 'thus tshang can/ spus ka tshad ldan can/brjod don spyi tshogs can bcas kyi phyogs su 'phel gyin yod/ /gnyis/ gnas rnying dang yul srol ngo sprod pa'i lhug rtsom/bod ni lo rgyus ring zhing rig gnag phun sum tshogs pa'i mi rigs shig yin la/ lo rgyus rig gnas dang 'brel ba'i gnas rnying dang dngos rdzas/ yul srol goms 'dris kyang bod khams kun tu khyab mod/ bod yul sa rgya che zhing 'grim 'grul ha cang stabs mi bde ba'i dbang gis/ bod rigs yin yang bod sa gnas khag gi gnas rnying dang rig rdzas/ yul srol bcas tshang mar cha rgyus yod pa ha cang nyung la/ rang gi mi rigs dang yul khams/ rig gnas/ lo rgyus bcas la dga' ba zhig yin phyin/ gnas rnying de dag la mjal skor ram ltad mor 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag po yod par ma zad/ de dag ngo sprod byed pa ni rang gi gzi brjid dam rang gshis tsam du gyur 'dug der rten/ gnas skor ram gnas mjal du phyin pa'i mthong thos dran reg gtsor ston pa'i lhug rtsom ha cang mang ba ste/ 〈kha ba'i rnam shes〉 'ba' zhig las khrin chin dbyin dang don grub rgyal gnyis kyis brtsams pa'i〈gna' rabs kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi bang mdzod— — tun hong〉②dang / 'phrin las chos grags kyis 216

brtsams pa'i〈mnga' ris su gna' shul grags can 'tshol zhib tu skyod pa'i zin bris〉⑥dang〈gtsang khul gyi gnas chen khag la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos〉skyo 〈rgya bod mthun lam gyi lo rgyus dpang rtags— — dpal zhwa lu gser khang la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos〉rjo wer 'chang gis brtsams pa'i〈pe cin gyi mchod rten rtse lnga〉⑨ chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gis brtsams pa'i〈chab cha rtswa thang gi bkra shis glu sgra〉⑪ tshe dbang dang blo tshul gyis brtsams pa'i〈dpa' bo'i me tog〉⑪ dkon los brtsams pa'i〈gzi rtsa sde dgu'i mdzes ljongs〉⑪dang〈bkra shis dgra lha'i rgyal po'i lab rtse stod dus kyi ngo mtshar mthong thos〉⑪sogs yod/ des na lhug rtsom 'di dag ni skabs de'i phul du byung ba'i lhug rtsom yang yin pas/'di dag gzhir bzung nas cung zad spros na/1 lhug rtsom 'di'i rigs phal che ba gnas skor du phyin pa'i gom pa'i 'degs 'jog gi go rim ltar tshig lhug gtso bo dang bcad pa'ang cung zad 'dres pa'i tshig gi rnam pa spyad de brtsams pas/ rtsom hril bo'i go rim gsal zhing mgo rnga tshang la bro nyams che pa red/ dper na/ (gna' rabs kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi bang mdzod— — tun hong〉la mtshon na dang thog tun hong rdzong mkhar nas lam la chas te mo ko khu'u la bskyod pa'i lam bar du mthong pa'i yul ljongs ngo mtshar pa rnams zhib 'bri gson nyams ldan pa zhig byas nas rtsom gyi 'go brtsams rjes/ rim bzhin mo ko khu'u dang 217

de nas tun hong rdzong rig gnas /bang du phyin pa'i mthong thos dang lta tshul sogs ngo sprod zhib mo byed cing / mthar sangs rgyas stong gi brag phug gzhan pa mtshams sbyor mdor tsam byas nas rtsom gyi mjug bsdus pa dang / (gtsang khul gyi gnas chen khag la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos〉 kyang thog mar rtsom pa pos kho rang lta skor du 'gro sa'i yul te gtsang phyogs kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod mdor tsam byas rjes/ lha sa nas lam la chas te yar 'brog g.yu mtsho la phyin pa dang de nas rim bzhin dpal 'khor chos sde dang / rgyal rtse rdzong ri/gzhis ka bsam grub rtse/ bkra shis lhun dgon bcas su lta skor byas pa'i go rim ltar zhib 'bri dang brjod pa zung du sbrel nas brtsams yod la/ 〈bkra shis dgra lha'i rgyal po'i lab rtse stod dus kyi ngo mtshar mthong thos〉 kyang rtsom pa pos kho tsho lta skor pa rnams gdan drangs pa ltar rlangs 'khor la bsdad nas lta skor du phyin pa ste/thog mar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la phyin pa dang / de nas rim bzhin bsang khog dang bkra shis lung dkar khar phyin nas bkra shis dgra lha rgyal po'i lab rtse stod par ltad mo bltas rjes phyir log pa'i go rim ltar brtsams yod pa ltar red/ lhug rtsom 'di'i rigs kyi sgrig gzhi ni don gyi byung rim ltar bkod yod pas go rim gsal la go ba lon bde pa red/2 yul bkod zhib 'bri byas pa gson nyams ldan zhing brtse dung gi shugs drag pas/ yid 'gug gi nus pa ldan zhing rol myong 218

gi rin thang che pa red/ skad char snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i bro nyams ldan dgos pa ni lhug rtsom spyi'i blang bya yin la klog pa po rnams kyi yi da kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i lcags kyu'ang yin pas/ lhug rtsom phal che ba'i skad cha de sgrung gtam dang bsdur na snyan nyams che zhing brtse dung gi shugs drag pa dang / khyad par du yul gyi bkod pa ni snyan ngag gi rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pas gson nyams ldan zhing yid du 'ongs pa zhig red/ dper na/ 〈mnga' ris su gna' shul grags can 'tshol zhib tu bskyod pa'i zin bris〉 las/ rtsom pa po'i mthong snang du gyur pa'i gangs ti se'i bkod pa ni 'di ltar bris yod/‘‘rdul gyis ma gos pa'i chu shel gyi lhun po ltar ri bo ti se'i rtse mo nam mkha'i dbyings su zug 'dra ba mthong ba tsam gyis yid dbang 'gugs pa'i ngo mtshar ldan pa/ mthon mthing nor bu'i 'od chags kun gsal dbyings nas chu 'dzin gzhon nus mgo lcogs ldem zhing lang long g.yo ba'i gar sgyur gyi snyim pa zum ste shis pa brjod cing de la 'dud pa/ rab dkar shel gyi zur phud rtse ru mtshams sprin dmar po'i mdzes pa ngoms shing sa 'dzin dga' ba'i mgul gyi bum bzang las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i sgra snyan par grags pas yid 'phrog rna ba'i cod pan g.yo ba med/ sked skabs dbang bo'i gzhu yis rab bcings tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba 'phra tshom rab brgyan cha ma ltar du mdzes/ smad 'dabs sngo ljang lo 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i ne'u gsing gi gzhir me tog sna 219

tshogs rnam par bkra shing / lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu phran du ma dri med dbang sngon bzhus pa 'khyil 'dra'i ma pham g.yu mtshor 'dus/ de ltar ngo mtshar thams cad bsdus pa'i gzugs brnyan de rnams 'jig rten byed pos sprul pa'i ji bzhin mig ldan kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog par gyur’’zhes snyan ngag gi rgyan sna tshogs la brten nas gangs ti se'i rtse mo nas mtha' skor gyi spang ljongs bar gyi rang byung gi bkod pa sna tshogs mig lam du dngos su shar ba lta bu zhig bkod yod/ phul du byung ba'i rtsom pa po 'phrin las chos grags kyi lhug rtsom la da dung khyad chos shig yod pa ni rang gis mthong pa'i yul bkod zhib 'bri byed pa dang mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung sgros dang / mgur ma/ dmangs khrod kyi glu gzhas/ lha sgrung sogs phan tshun ram 'degs kyi tshul gyis gang la gang 'tsham du bsdebs nas mtshon par byed pa de red/ dper na/ (rgya bod mthun lam gyi lo rgyus dpang rtags〉 las/ ‘‘an da rnyil gyi mdog ltar sngo ba'i mtsho mo'i steng du nya 'dzin g.yor gru tshar du dngar ba chal chil rlabs kyi phreng bas mdun du skul zhing / mtsho dkyil gling phran sgang du chu bya'i tshogs rnams 'dus te bag phebs rtsed 'jor rol bzhin pa dang mtsho 'gram gyi thang du rtswa 'jam gsar bas khengs shing phyugs rigs dkar nag khyu dang khyus dri zhim bcud dang ldan pa'i rtswa chu longs su spyod bzhin 'dug gzigs dang / rgyang du yid 'ong lhun sdug rab dkar mdangs su bkra ba'i sa 'dzin 220

mngon par mtho bas/ mdun du nam mkha'i bu mo sngo bsangs ma sa gzhi'i phun tshogs myong slad du chu bo'i gzugs kyis thang la babs pa ji bzhin ngo mtshar che/ de lta bu'i nyams dga'i bkod pas rab tu mdzes pa'i ljongs de mthong dus/ nga'i blo ngor de sngon mkhas dbang tshos g.yu mtsho de'i ljongs la bstod pa'i snyan ngag cig lhang nger dran byung ba ste/ dbang sngon me long phyis 'dra'i g.yu mtsho'i mtha'/ /me tog rab mdzes 'khri shing tshal gyis bskor/ /lo phyugs rab 'phel 'dod yon phun sum tshogs/ /e ma sum rtsen gnas mchog 'dir 'phos sam/ /zhes gsungs pa de mngon sum don dang ldan pa zhig rang 'dug’’lta bur mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos rang gi mthong snang du gyur pa'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i yul ljongs gson nyams ldan pa zhig zhib 'bri byas rjes dran pa'i tshul gyis sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsungs drangs nas rtsom gyi bro nyams je drag dang bden lugs je cher btang yod pa ltar ro/ /yin na'ang / gzhan gyi lung gang 'tsham dang sgyu rtsal gyis 'dren pa las 'byor mi 'byor tshang ma btsan gyis drangs pa mang na rang rtsom nyog rdzob tu 'gro nges red/3 brjod bya rgya che zhing mthong thos dngos yin pas/ bden tshad mtho zhing shes bya'i rang bzhin drag la dpyad gzhi'i rin thang che ba red/ bod mi rigs 'di khyab rgya che zhing rang byung gi bkod pa ngo mtshar can mtha' yas pa dang / sgos su snyan du grags pa'i 221

gna' bo'i rig gnas rjes shul mang po yod pa ni bod kyi lo rgyus dus skabs so so'i thon dngos gal chen yin la/ lo rgyus kyi dus skabs dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel 'gyur nges can zhig la 'brel ba dam po yod pas/ de dag tshang ma ma lus par ngo sprod byed pa ni dka' khag dang zhib tshegs ha cang che ba'i las ka zhig red/ yin na'ang / bod kyi rig gnas la dga' zhen che zhing thugs khur mdzad mkhan rnams kyis lam thag ring ba dang 'grim 'grul mi bde ba/'gro sgo che ba/ dka' khag mang pa bcas la ma 'dzem par sa le bar stong phrag gi lam la phyin nas/ rtog dpyod zhib mo mdzad par ma zad/ rang gi mthong thos dang lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi/ dmangs khrod kyi bshad rgyun sogs zung du sbrel pa'i thabs la brten nas/ gna' bo'i rig gnas rjes shul de dag dang de dag na bzhugs pa'i rig gnas dngos rdzas rtsa chen rnams ngo sprod cha tshang zhing khungs dag pa zhig byas yod pa red/ dper na/ (pe cin gyi mchod rten rtse lnga〉las rtsom pa po bden pa lhag par rtogs pa'i lha khang du mjal skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos dang lha khang der bzhugs pa'i mchod rten rtse lnga nyams gso thengs gnyis pa byas pa'i gnas tshul bkod pa'i rdo ring yi ge( bod yig) thabs mkhas kyis zung 'brel byas nas/mchod rten rtse lnga dang bden pa lhag pa rtogs pa'i lha khang gnyis dus nam zhig la skyes bu gang gis dgos pa ci don du bzhengs pa dang / phyis su nyams gso ji ltar mdzad tshul/ da lta'i gnas stangs 222

gang 'dra yin tshul sogs ngo sprod cha tshang byas pa dang / (gtsang khul gyi gnas chen khag la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos〉 las/gzhis ka bsam grub rtse ngo sprod byed tshe sngon ma pho brang de dar zhing rgyas dus dbang phyug rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa drangs nas/ pho brang de zhig ral du ma song gong gi bkod pa ngo sprod byed pa/ (gna' rabs kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi bang mdzod—— tun hong〉 du tun hong na yod pa'i thang rgyal rabs kyi rdo ring yi ge dang / (thang yig gsar rnying〉 sogs rgya'i lo rgyus deb ther/brag phug ang365pa'i nang du 'khod pa'i yig byang sogs dang rang gi mthong thos rnams thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas gang 'tsham du bsdebs nas/ tung hong sa cha'i mo ko khu'u brag phug de dus nam zhig la rkyen gang la brten nas gsar bzhengs byas pa dang / gnas de na rig rdzas ji 'dra yod tshul dang khyad par du tun hong sa cha bod dmag gis dus nam nas nam bar du bzung tshul/ bod dang 'brel ba'i ldebs ris dang dpe rnying / yig byang gang 'dra yod tshul dang de dag gi nang don ci yin pa sogs ngo sprod gsal po zhig byas pa ltar red/ lhug rtsom 'di dag ni rtsom pa po dngos su gnas rnying de dag la phyin pa'i mthong thos dang dka' spyad kyis rtog dpyod byas pa'i 'bras bu sgyu rtsal gyi thabs la brten nas mtshams sbyor byas pa yin pas/ sgyu rtsal gyi longs spyod cig yin par ma zad/gnas rnying de dag gi yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang lo rgyus/ rig 223

rdzas sogs la rgyus lon byed pa dang / bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas/ rgya bod rig gnas kyi 'brel ba bcas la zhib 'jug byed pa'i dpyad gzhi rtsa chen zhig kyang red/ /gsum/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom/lo rabs brgyad cu nas dgu bcu ba'i mgo'i bar gyi yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom la brjod bya'i nang don gyi ngos nas bltas na/ mang che ba bsngags brjod dang yar skul gyi lhug rtsom ste/yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang / dus skabs gsar pa'i spyi tshogs kyi dge mtshan/ tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus sogs la bsngags pa brjod pa dang / mi rigs rang gi zhan cha'am skyon mtshang phyung nas yar skyed la rting skul byed pa'i lhug rtsom yin la/ rtsom srol gyi ngos nas bltas na bod kyi srol rgyun gyi snyan ngag rtsom stangs ltar brtsams pa dang / deng rabs lhug rtsom gyi rtsom srol gtsor bzung nas brtsams pa'i rigs gnyis yod/ de yang rtsom stangs gang 'dra zhig spyod pa ni rtsom pa po'i dga' phyogs goms phyogs dang rtsom rig gi gso sbyong / brjod bya'i nang don sogs la thad kar 'brel ba dam po yod pas/ yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang grong khyer gyi rnam pa sogs la bstod na de dang 'phrod pa'i rtsom stangs te/ 〈snyan ngag me long〉 gi dngos bstan gyi dpe rgyan dang gzugs rgyan/ rab rtog gi rgyan/ phul byung gi rgyan/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan la sogs pas mdzes par spro pa'i srol rgyun snyan ngag 224

gi rtsom srol ltar rtsom pa dang / mngon du mthong rgyu med pa lkog gyur gyi bsam blo dang gshis ka spobs pa/ brtson pa/ re smon/ 'dod mos/byed nus sogs la bstod tshe‘‘dngos bo gzhan la brten nas bsam blo ston pa dang / yul bkod 'bri bar brten nas brtse dung mtshon pa’’zhes pa ltar/ de dag thad kar mi brjod par mtshon byed kyi dngos po gzhan zhig gi steng la bcol zhing der brtse dung zab mo bcangs nas/ ches cher bstod pa'i sgo nas rang gi dga' spro mtshon par byed pa'i deng rabs lhug rtsom gyi rtsom srol spyod pa shas che par snyam/ des na srol rgyun snyan ngag gi rtsom srol ltar brtsams pa'i lhug rtsom gtso bo la chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi〈lan gru'i dpyid dpal〉⑪dang / reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyi〈lan gru grong khyer gyi gzi dpal cher brjod sgra dbyangs〉⑪ lhag pa don grub kyi〈bkra shis pa'i dus chen gyi nyin mo〉⑪ kun bzang rgyal mtshan gyi〈dwangs ba bzang bo'i 'gyur ba〉⑪ bla gnas bsod nams rdo rje'i(bya spyod mu tig do shal〉⑪sogs mang du yod pa las〈lan gru'i dpyid dpal〉 lta bur mtshon na‘‘rtsom pa pos bod kyi gna' bo'i rtsom yig 'bri tshul gyi byed thabs bcad lhug spel ma bkol spyod byas nas rang rgyal nub byang gi grong khyer chen po lan gru zhes pa'i yul ljongs kyi mdzes ris dang khor yug gi mdzes nyams ma lus snyan 'jebs dri za'i dbyangs kyis brgyan nas gsal bor bris pa ste/ thog mar bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom yig 'bri tshul ltar tshigs bcad kyi phreng ba'i 225

me tog gcig gis sngon bsus nas rjes su go rim yod pa'i ngang grong khyer de ni rang rgyal gyi sa phyogs gang du gnas pa dang / sa de'i ri mtho tshul dang sa gtsang tshul/ chu klung mang tshul/ ljon pa mdzes tshul/ sa yi dge bcu tshang tshul bcas re rer bsngags brjod mdzad de rang byung khams kyi dpyid dpal sgeg mos nor 'dzin khor yug steng gi ljon pa dang me tog 'dab brgya'i tshogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs su bcug pa de dpe byas nas mi rnams kyis tang gi srid jus gsar ba'i nyin byed 'og rang rang las bgos kyi gnas su hur thag rbad chod kyis bya ba sgrub bzhin yod pa'i tshul legs par mtshon yod pa dang / rtsom gyi sgrig rim cha tshang zhing brjod bya'i don gsal ba/bklags pa tsam gyis mi rnams kyi yid dbang cig car du 'phrog nus pa'o/ /ririder ma zad rtsom pa pos lan gru grong khyer du lo mang por slob gnyer byas nas grong khyer de dang khyad par du nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor dga' zhen che zhing brtse dungs zab la cha rgyus che ba yin/ lhug rtsom 'di yang dga' ba dang dungs ba de lta bu zung du bsdebs pa 'phel ba'i stobs las thon pa yin pas/brtsams chos kyi mgo mjug bar gsum du dga' ba'i nyams kyi khengs 'dug don de la dmigs nas lo rabs brgyad cu par zhing chen dang ljongs lnga'i mi rigs slob chen drug gis mnyam du bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi skad yig slob deb nang du bdams pa dang /lo rabs dgu bcu par mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par 226

du bskrun pa'i zhing chen dang ljongs lnga'i mtho 'bring gi bod kyi skad yig slob deb su bdams shing / 1983lo nas1985lo'i bar gyi mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi rtsom rig la bya dga' gnang ba'i dpyad sdur khrod bya dga' ang gnyis pa thob/ de bas na lhug rtsom 'di dang /ting 'dzin gyis brtsams pa'i〈rlangs 'khor rtsal las thon pa'i dge mtshan gsar ba〉⑫ 〈bkra shis pa'i dus chen gyi nyin mo〉spyisogs ni skabs de'i yul bkod la bsngags pa'i lhug rtsom gyi 'thus tshab brtsams chos su 'dems kyang 'gal ba med snyam/2 deng rabs lhug rtsom gyi rtsom stangs ltar brtsams pa'i lhug rtsom la'ang reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyi〈cang shes rta pho〉yidang sangs grol gyi〈dgu chu'i glu dbyangs〉spyi gcod pa don grub kyi〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra〉spyi 'bum skyabs kyi〈phran ni rtswa chung 'di la dga'〉yirmongs grol gyi(bya glag〉⑨rnam rgyal gyi〈gangs rgyan pad+ma〉spyi don kun grub pa'i〈gangs seng dkar mo〉⑪ rin chen don grub kyi(gangs ri〉⑪rin chen bkra shis kyi〈shel gyi lhun po〉⑫lha rgyal tshe ring gi〈gces par 'os pa'i rta mchog〉⑩ sgom pa bkra shis kyi〈rdza ri'i khrod kyi chu phran〉⑪ rin chen don grub kyi〈me tog gser chen〉nyalha rgyal tshe ring gi〈klu chab sngon mo〉②nyi ma tshe ring gi〈'dab brgya lhug par grol ba'i me tog〉stiskal bzang skyabs kyi〈gangs khrod kyi rbab chu〉nyumagon po bkra shis kyi〈gro ma'i me tog〉nyurdo rje gcod pa'i〈rtsa thang / me tog gi 'jig rten〉⑪gnya' 227

blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi(nor〉⑪sogs shin tu mang pa las phal che bas bod mi rigs la phyogs yongs nas bsngags pa brjod pa dang yang na mi rigs rang gi zhan cha bton nas mdun skyod kyi lam la skul ba red/ snang tshul 'di la bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig thad kyi rlabs rgyun chung chung zhig yin zhes na'ang mi chog pa med snyam/ des na bye brag tu sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon thabs gang la brten nas bod kyi dge mtshan dang khyad chos la bsngags brjod byas yod ce na/brtsams chos de dag gi brjod bya'i nang don dang sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon thabs kyang ha lam gcig mtshungs yin te/ bod mi rigs kyi zhen snying rje che ba'i gshis ka dang zhi 'jam kun mthun gyi spyod pa/dka' spyad las brtson gyi goms gshis/ dpa' ngar zhum med kyi snying stobs/ gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i blo gros/ sngon med gsar gtod kyi spobs pa/ ngo mtshar rmad byung gi byas rjes sogs la bstod par 'dod pa de yid la bzhag nas de dag mtshon byed kyi dngos po gzhan te/ gangs ri dang chu klung / me tog rtsi shing / seng ge rta mchog bya glag nor sogs la brtse dung zab mo bcangs shing sems ldan mi yi tshul du de dag gi rang bzhin dang byed nus/ phan yon/khyad chos sogs phyogs mang po nas bris shing dbyangs nyams dang gzugs brnyan ldan pa'i sgo nas ches cher bstod nas/ rang gi sems khong gi dga' spro dang re 'dun mtshon par byas yod/ dper na/ 〈dgu chu'i glu dbyangs〉 lta bur mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos rang gi 228

brjod 'dod kyi bsam blo de thad kar mi brjod par dgu chu'i steng nas mtshon par byed pa ste/ thog mar‘‘dwangs gtsang gi bzhin/ gya gyu'i 'gros/ lhung lhung gi sgra ’’zhes dgu chu'i phyi'i snang tshul la bsngags pa dang / de nas‘‘'o ma'i rgyun/ bdud rtsi'i bcud/ sbrang char gyi thigs pas legs par grub’’ces dgu chu'i ro bcud dam rang bzhin la bsngags brjod yang yang byas rjes/ de'i ming thogs tshul dang lo rgyus kyi dus skabs so sor gnod pa sna tshogs thebs tshul bris pa brgyud nas sngon chad kyi dgu chu ni‘‘skyo gdung gi dbugs ring / 'jigs skrag gi smre sngags/ bkres ltogs kyi 'khun sgra/mya ngan gyi 'o dod/ 'gyod sems kyi ngu skad/ sdug bsngal gyi cho nge sogs kyis grub pa'i skyo gzhas dang sdug glu/ smre gzhas kho na red/’’ces pa dang / da lta‘‘ma 'ongs pas khyod la lag brda bstan nas 'bod kyin yod cing / khyod kyi 'dun pa dang / re ba/ bde skyid rnams ma 'ongs pa'i lag tu bsnams yod pas/ rnying pa'i gram pa dang / rjes lus kyi lung ba/ rmongs dad kyi 'phrang 'gag ma lus phangs med du bskyur nas ma 'ongs pa'i phyogs su kha gtad nas rgyugs shig’’ces dgu chu la skul ba'i tshul gyis rang re'i mi rigs spyi la ma 'ongs re 'dun dang bde skyid 'tsho ba mngon 'gyur byed pa'i las la skul pa dang / de las rtsom pa pos rang mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse dung dang dga' zhen/ re smon bcas mngon par mtshon yod/ de min brtsams chos kyi mgo mjug bar gsum du sdeb 229

sbyor mnyam pa'i tshig gi phreng ba gcig sne gcig la bstar nas lhugs por brjod pas snyan ngag gi 'gros nyams thon zhing rtsom pa po rtsom pa'i las la mkhas pa'i khyad chos kyang mtshon yod/ yangadzñomanyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra〉 dang(gro ma'i me tog〉 lta bur mtshon na/rtsom pa pos mnyen 'jam rtswa dang gro ma'i me tog gnyis la thad kar bstod par ma zad/ skye dngos gzhan dang bsdur pa'i sgo nas kyang de dag gi khyad chos la bstod pa byas pas/ sgyu rtsal gyi nus pa 'bur du thon yod/ dper na/ 1989lor mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi phul du byung ba'i rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi bya dga' thob pa'i〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra〉las/ ‘‘rang yul spang ljongs yangs po ru dbyar gyi dpal mo'i mdzes sdug mngon pa na ne'u gsing g.yu yi gzhong bar me tog nor bus 'phra btab pa lta bu'i rtswa thang ni lta na sdug cing yid du 'ong ba dang / de ltar skye stobs kyis dpal 'bar zhing ngo mtshar yongs su rdzogs pa'i rmang gzhir gyur pa'i rgyu gtso bo ni bcud kyi 'byung khungs dang stobs kyi skyed byed de rtswa'i rigs yin pa smos ci/’’zhes mnyen 'jam rtswa ni‘‘bcud kyi 'byung khungs’’dang‘‘stobs kyi skyed byed’ridu bsngags pa dang / ‘‘thud zhim pa mar gyi drin dang sha zhim pa rtswa yi drin’riyin pa'i gnas lugs sngon du gleng nas/ de la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan brjod skabs 'di ltar 'khod yod/ ‘‘rtswa rang nyid la gsom dkar ljon shing lta bu'i nga rgyal gyi mgo 'phang dgung la zug pa med par gzugs stobs chung ba 230

dang / skye bo phal ba'i bgrod byed kyi zhabs na khengs skyung gi rnam 'gyur lham lham ston bzhin mchis shing / rta nor lug gsum gyi 'gro ba'i 'tsho rten kho nar yang gyur yod pa dang / skye bo sus longs su spyod 'dod na kho rang grags 'gul ci yang med par rang lus phangs med du sbyin pa'i snying stobs phul tu byung ba dang ldan/ rtswa rang nyid la yid 'ong me tog lta bu'i mdzes sdug dang yid 'gugs kyi nus pa med kyang / 'gyur med gser bzang lta bu'i sems shugs dang / rdo rje brag ri 'dra ba'i srog snying / dmar bo me 'od 'dra 'dra'i spro sems bcas ldan pa red/’’ces pa dang / ‘‘dgun 'khyag grang ngar lhags pas re zhig rtswa'i rigs kyi mdog bzang ljang khu'i gos de snying rje med par phrogs na'ang / kho nyid ljon pa'i lo 'dab dang me tog gi 'dab ma ji bzhin dri bzhon bu mo'i rjes su bsnyegs nas gang sar 'phur mi 'gro ba dang / grang ngar dgu brtsegs kyi lhags pa'i gdong bsus te stobs kyis 'greng zhing gyen ldog gi ngar sgra'ang bar med du sgrogs shing / dpyid kyi dpal yon 'char bar re smon 'cha' 'o/ /’’zhes 'jam mnyen rtswa de me tog dang ljon shing la bsdur nas bstod pas/ de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin dang byed nus/ phan yon sogs 'bur du thon zhing / de dang chabs cig mnyen 'jam rtswa'i bcud la brten pa'i sha dang 'o ma/bal 'jam sogs phyugs thon dngos rdzas la 'dod ham che zhing /nyam chung rtswa'i rigs la sdang pa'i mi la la'i kun spyod ngan par 231

mtshang brtol dgag rgyag kyang byas yod/ de yang gnad don gsal bor bton rjes de'i rgyu mtshan kha gsal pa'i sgo nas rgyas spros ma byas par/ ‘‘rtswa yi bcud kyi lus phung gso 'dod kyang / /rtswa dngos mthong na zhe sdang khong khro dang / /rtswa zhes dma' 'bebs sdig mo bgyid pa 'di/ /rtswa la dungs min bcud la chags pas so/ /zhes pa dang / yang na srid pa'i kha dper g.yag la dungs pa min zhing khrag la gces pa yin zer pa dang gnyis su ma mchis so/ /’’zhes tshigs su bcad pa gcig dang gtam dpe gcig drangs pa des ha cang thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas dgag bya'i yul gyi skyon mtshang drungs nas phyung zhing klog pa po rnams la bsam gzhigs zab mo gtong rgyu zhig kyang bton pa red/ rtsom pa pos mnyen 'jam rtswa la phyogs mang po nas bsngags pa dang / khyad par du rtswa la sdang mkhan la khong khro chen pos mtshang 'byin dgag rgyag gnad du khel ba byas pa las rtsom pa po rtswa yi rigs la dga' zhing dungs pa bla lhag gis mtshon zhing /lhug rtsom 'di legs por 'khyongs pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig kyang yin par snyam/ don de la dmigs nas dpal don grub rgyal gyis kyang‘‘〈〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra〉〉ni brjod bya'i don zab pa'i rtsom legs po zhig yin la/ glu sgra de ni rtsom pa po'i sems kyi gting dang glo rgyu'i mtshams nas byung ba'i bod rigs kyi gshis ka ldan zhing /brtse dungs kyi 'dun ma che ba'i 'tsho ba gsar pa'i bstod glu dang spyi tshogs gsar pa'i 'brog phyogs dang 'brog phyogs rtswa thang gi bka' 232

drin dran pa'i gsal 'debs kyi glu sgra zhig red ces bshad chog’’ces pa dang / ‘‘rang gi bsam blo dang rang gi brtse dungs/rang gi 'du shes/ rang gi lta ba/ rang gi khyad chos bcas mtshon yod pas lhug rtsom gyi nags khrod du skyes pa'i tsan dan gsar pa zhig red’’⑫ces gdengs 'jog mdzad yod/ dpe de bzhin du〈gro ma'i me tog〉 las kyang gro ma'i me tog gi mtshar sdug dang dri bsung /rang bzhin/ phan nus bcas la thad kar bsngags brjod chen po byas thog ‘‘grang ngar gyi rta la chibs shing / kha ba yi lcags tshan thogs pa/ grang rlung gi dpung dang bsdebs pa'i dgun dus mi yul khams su 'ong pa'i tshe/ me tog a gar dang / me tog pad ma/ me tog ser chen/ me tog khrog khrog me tog lha ris/ me tog rgyal sras bcas kyis gson nyams btang zhing / nus mthu bri/ phan stobs zad nas lus hreng hreng dang / yal ga rengs rengs/ rkang 'thung sdug sdug tu gyur nas gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i nus pa dper bzhag na nyin mo'i skar ma/ chu las du ba/ nam mkha'i me tog rus sbal gyi spu/ mo gsham gyi bu ltar rab tu dkon mod/ 'on kyang gro mas rang nyid kyi lang tsho'i me tog dus kyi srin po'i kha ru tshud na'ang / gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa nyams su 'jug par ma 'dod nas sa gzhi chen po'i lto rum na kha khu sim par gnas shing / go skabs bzang po slebs tshe/kun la phan pa'i sman/ kha la zhim pa'i zas/ pho la sman pa'i bcud sogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'bras rdog byu ru dang mtshungs pa mi 233

rnams la 'jungs pa med par phul ba'i las la rtse gcig yid kyis gzhol ba red/ri’zhes gro ma'i me tog dang me tog gzhan pa rnams kyi ngang tshul gshib sdur byed pa'i sgo nas gro ma'i me tog gi thun min khyad chos 'bur du btod cing de la che cher bsngags pa dang / de la brten nas rtsom pa po'i dga' zhing spro ba'i yid 'gyur ngang gis mtshon yod/ de min bod kyi 'das pa phyir dran gyis phyogs sdom mdzad pa dang da lta'i spyi tshogs steng gi snang tshul la la skyon mtshang du brjod nas dgag pa mdzad thog ma 'ongs mdun lam gsar gtod byed par skul ba'am re 'bod 'don pa'i lhug rtsom legs po yang yod pa red/ dper na/ dpal don grub rgyal lags kyis brtsams pa'i(rkang lam phra mo〉tshul mtshon na rtsom pa pos‘‘nga'i bsam pa'i brtse dung gi rtsig rdebs ngos su lham mer bkra ba'i dran 'dzin gyi ri mo ste— — lo zla'i rlung 'tshub kyis bsub mi thub cing dus kyi char chu yis 'jig mi nus pa ni nga tsho'i sde 'dabs kyi rkang lam phra mo de red’’ces klog mkhan rnams kyi mig lam du‘‘rkang lam phra momi’zhes pa'i rtsom gyi kha byang ngam gleng gzhi gtso bo gsal bor bton rjes/ sos dus kyi nyi ma 'phud thabs byed pa'i rus ldong can gyi rgan po dang / gling tshang gi sgrung pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs su sems pa'i rgan mo/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi rjes 'brangs pa/ri dwags la mos pa'i rngon pa sogs kyis rkang lam phra mo de sus gshags pa'i thad rtsod pa byas tshul bris pa dang / don de la rtsom pa 234

po rang gis lta ba brjod pa ste/ ‘‘rkang lam phra mo 'di gshags mkhan ni lha mi dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba gang zhig yin na yang ngo ma rlabs che ba red/ g.yang gzar ba'i brag ri 'di lta bu'i ngos nas lam btod rgyu'i blo skyes pa de ni blo gros kyi dwangs ma yin la/ blo de lag len du btab pa ni gsar skrun gyi nying bcud red/ gya gyu'i rkang lam 'di khyon dog cing la gzar la khug pa mang na yang /thengs dang por lam phran 'di'i thog tu rkang rjes bkod pa'i gna' mi de'i spobs pa ji 'dra mtho zhing snying stobs ji 'dra che ba dang / thengs dang por lam phran 'di ded nas ri rtse la slebs pa'i dpa' bo de'i blo rgya ji 'dra che zhing mig rgyang ji 'dra'i ring ba zhig red ang / ’rizhes dpyad brjod dam gdengs 'jog mdzad pa dang /de nas rkang lam phra mo de zhig ral du gyur rung gnyan dang btsan gyi lam du bsams nas zhig gso byed mi phod cing / bcings 'grol rjes su rlangs 'khor bgrod sa'i gzhung lam zhig gsar du btod kyang sle bo 'khur ba'i mi phal cher gyi‘‘lam che yang la gzar bas 'khor lo'i rigs la nyen kha shin tu che ba dang / sa bskor thag ring la sa gzhi shin tu mkhregs pas rkang ba na ba'i rgyu red snyam’’nas/da dung rkang lam phra mo brgyud nas 'gro ba dang / pho gsar mo gsar rnams kyis gzhung lam gyi phan yon rtogs nas de'i steng du 'gro la/mthar rang nyid kyang gzhung lam la zhugs pa bris pa ste/ bsdus gab dang dngos 'bri/ dpyad brjod dang / gshib sdur bcas zung du sbrel 235

ba'i rtsom thabs spyad de/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams kyis nga tshor gzi brjid 'od stong 'bar ba'i lo rgyus dang rig gnas gsar gtod byas par ma zad/ gsar gtod kyi snying stobs dang nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa bzhag par dga' gus yi rangs mdzad pa dang / dam pa gong ma rnams dang srol rgyun rig gnas la‘‘gna' mi glen pa de tsho’’zhes dmod pa bor mkhan la mtshang 'bru dgag rgyag mdzad pa/ phul tu byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas la ngag gi bstod pa tsam gyis bag la bsnyal pa dang yang na grub mtha' gang rung zhig gi mdzad rjes yin par rtsod pa de skyon mtshang ngam zhan char brjod nas/ ‘‘gna' bzang deng spyod’’byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng dus dang 'tsham pa'i rig gnas gsar pa ste gzhung lam gsar gtod byas nas de'i steng du mdun spyod byed par rting skul dang re 'bod byed kyin yod/ 'di ni rtsom pa pos bod kyi 'das pa dang srol rgyun rig gnas la bcangs pa'i lta ba dang / ma 'ongs par bgrod lam gang du 'gro ba'i langs phyogs te rtsom pa po gtso byas pa'i mi rabs shig gi bsam blo gtso bo red/ lhug rtsom 'dir yid 'gyur sna gcig 'bur du thon med pa 'dra yang / zhib tu bklags na rtsom pa po'i yid kyi spro ba dang / dga' gus/ khro ba/ skyo ba sogs yid 'gyur sna tshogs chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin phan tshun bsdebes nas mngon par mtshon pa dang / khyad par du brjod bya'i nang don bdams pa ha cang gnad la khel zhing dngos yod gyi 236

don snying shin tu che bas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams dang sgos su deng rabs kyi gzhon nu gsar slob pa rnams la mi rigs dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i ched du gsar gtod rang bzhin ldan pa'i bya ba bsgrub par yar skul gyi nus pa mi dman pa thon par nges/bzhi/ skye khams srung skyob mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom/lo rabs dgu bcu ba'i tshun la'ang lhug rtsom mang du thon zhing de dag gi brjod bya'i nang don la gnas skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos brjod pa dang / spyi tshogs khrod kyi tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bya ngan spyod ngan la 'tshang 'byin dgag pa rgyag pa/ spyi tshogs yar skyed la skul ba/ skye khams khor yug srung skyob byed pa/ pho mo'i brtse dungs brjod pa sogs sna tshogs yod pa las ltos bcas kyis mang ba'am rtsom rig gi snang tshul zhig tu grub pa ni/ skye khams srung skyob mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom red/ de yang mi'i rigs je mang du 'phel nas rang gi 'tsho ba'i longs spyod kyi ched du/ gang 'dod kyis rang byung gi skye dngos dang srog chags/ khor yug sogs la gnod 'tshe dang gtor brlag tshabs chen byas pas/ ri skye srog chags mang po zhig gi rgyud nyams la rtsi shing dang me tog rtsa chen mang po zhig gi mtshar sdug kyang mthong rgyu med par gyur/ de bzhin du rang byung gi mkha' rlung dang gnam gshis dro grang sogs la nyin re las nyin rer 'gyur ldog chen po ste/ dbyar dus chu log brgyugs shing than pa byung ba dang dgun dus sa 'gul yong zhing nad yams sna tshogs byung / rang 237

byung gi skye khams khor yug cha mi snyoms pa'i rkyen gyis mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba dang lus khams la gnod 'tshe chen po thebs pa dang bstun nas/ skye khams khor yug bsrungs na rang nyid srung skyob thebs pa dang / rang nyid la gces par bsams na thog mar skye khams khor yug la gces dgos pa'i gnas lugs rtogs te/ thabs dang khrims sna tshogs la brten nas skye khams khor yug srung skyob byed pa'i bya 'gul spel ba dang chabs cig tshags par khang dang gsar 'gyur las khungs so sos kyang de'i skor gyi lhug rtsom 'tshol sdud byas pa dang / phul byung brtsams chos la bya dga' gnang nas gzengs bstod dang rting skul mdzad/ spyi tshogs kyi dar srol de lta bu'i shugs rkyen 'og skye khams khor yug srung skyong byed rgyu de rang shugs kyis rtsom pa po khag cig gis yid 'jog bya yul du gyur pas/de skor gyi lhug rtsom bcu phrag mang po par skrun 'grem spel byas shing / de dag las yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom dang / snyan zhu rtsom rig kyang mi nyung ba zhig yod par ma zad/ khyung thar rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i(sa nag dang 'brel ba'i ljang bsgyur skor gleng ba〉⑤la mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur khang dang / mtsho sngon bod yig〈khrims lugs tshags par〉 rtsom sgrig khang / yul shul khul chu bo rma 'bri rdza gsum 'byung yul gyi skye khams khor yug srung skyob tshogs pa bcas kyis gnang pa'i‘‘so srung pa'i 'gyur khugs’’bya dga' ang dang po thob pa dang / byams pa bkra shis kyis brtsams pa'i(rtswa thang 238

gi ngu 'bod〉tshudang / skal rgyam gyis brtsams pa'i(sha yu mo zhig gi skyo glu〉tshu rta mgrin rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i〈rin thang gi 'tshol snyeg〉stisogs la ang gnyis pa thob/ dge 'dun lhun grub kyis brtsams pa'i(gnam ka med 'og gi yid bzhin nor bu〉chudang srin mos brtsams pa'i〈mnar gcod〉tshu klu mo rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i(rdza 'dabs kyi bsam gzhigs〉0 dpal ldan rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i〈ljang mdog gi rmi lam〉tshu rdo rje lhun grub kyis brtsams pa'i(bdag gi snying khong gi su ru'i zhing khams〉⑫sogs la ang gsum pa thob/ phul du byung ba'i lhug rtsom de dag nang du rtsom pa po'i brjod 'dod kyi bsam blo thad kar mngon sum du mi brjod par mi gshis ldan pa'i ri dwags dang rtswa thang / rtswa/ me togachu sogs la brten nas/ mi rnams kyis rang gi 'tsho ba'i longs spyod kyi don du snying rje med par ri skye srog chags rngon pa dang / gang 'dod kyis nags tshal gcod pa dang sa rgod slog pa/ 'dzem dogs med par chu dang gtsang bo/ mtsho dang mtshe'u btsog par gtong pa/'char gzhi med par sman rtsa sko ba la sogs pa'i bya spyod dang de'i nyes dmigs brjod nas/ skye khams khor yug srung skyob byed pa'i las la 'bad par rting skul byed pa'am re 'bod 'don pa dang /de'i shugs las rtsom pa po rnams rang gi pha yul la dga' ba dang /skye khams khor yug la gnod skyel mkhan la sdang ba/ ri skye srog chags la snying rje ba/ blun rmongs kyi bya spyod la yid mug pa sogs 239

yid 'gyur sna tshogs mngon par mtshon yod/ phul du byung ba'i lhug rtsom de dag la dmigs sa'i rang bzhin drag po zhig yod pas/ skye khams khor yug srung skyong byed par dngos yod kyi don snying yang chen po ldan pa red/ 'di ni lhug rtsom de rigs kyi thun mong gi khyad chos su mngon pa yin/ skye khams khor yug srung skyob byed pa mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom de dag las gzhan da dung 'ju skal bzang gis brtsams pa'i〈rang khyim〉nyadang / phag mo don grub kyis brtsams pa'i〈a ma lags/ byams ldan gyi skyes ma〉spyi rdo sbis chos skyong gis brtsams pa'i〈smyu gu'i gtam rgyud〉nya khyung bzang gis brtsams pa'i〈'brog khyi zhig gi gtam rgyud〉ñtsa bkra shis sgrol mas brtsams pa'i〈dpyid kyi rmi lam〉ñtsa 'jigs med theg mchog gis brtsams pa'i〈nges don gyi nyi ma〉nyasogs sgyu rtsal gyi yid 'gug nus pa che zhing mtshon don bsam blo gting zab pa'i phul byung lhug rtsom yang mi nyung ba zhig thon yod/ /gsal bshad/bu1981lo'i zla4par kan su'u mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈snyan ngag gi spyi don tshig rgyan rig pa'i lde mig〉gi gzhug tu drangs yod/②1985lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/()1993lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/()2001lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/240

(nye1981lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/() 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 du 'khod yod/(nye1983lo'i(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/() (bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 du 'khod yod/()1984lo'i(sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/ (yi1982lo'i(sbrang char〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(kye(dkar mdzes tshags par〉 du 'khod yod/(yi1985lo'i〈zla zer〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/(smra1989lo'i〈zla zer〉 deb bzhi par 'khod yod/(spre1982lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/(yi1983lo'i〈zla zer〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/(sprerkyunye1981lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(11983lo'i〈bod ljongs mang tshogs rig rtsal〉 deb dang por 'khod/(khya1982lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(sgri1983lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb drug par 'khod yod/rkyu11984lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/〈yi1985lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/6)1984lo'i〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/rkyu71983lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/tunye1983lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/rkyunye1986lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/rkyu11986lo'i(sbrang char〉 deb bzhi bar 'khod yod/241

〈mi1986lo'i(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb bzhi bar 'khod yod/yon1986lo'i(sbrang char〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/ 〈yi1986lo'i(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/()1986lo'i(zla zer〉 deb bzhi bar 'khod yod/(yi〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 steng du 'khod yod/ (mi1989lo'i(zla zer〉 deb bzhi par 'khod yod/(1(bod kyi rtsom rig〉 tu 'khod yod/(51989lo'i(zla zer〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/(yi1989lo'i(zla zer〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/(11989lo'i(zla zer〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(snye〈'brog yul gyi 'char ka'i rol mo〉 bya bar 'khod yod/(nye1997lo'i mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i(dpal don grub rgyal gyi gsung 'bum〉 pod gsum pa'i shog ngos16na gsal/(yi1984lo'i(sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/()2003lo'i zla10pa'i tshes14nyin gyi〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 du 'khod yod/(mi〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 du 'khod yod/(nye2003lo'i zla11pa'itshes25nyin gyi mtsho sngon bod yig〈khrims lugs tshags par〉 du 'khod yod/(nye2003lo'i zla10pa'i tshes15nyin gyi mtsho sngon bod yig〈khrims lugs tshags par〉 du 'khod yod/(khya2003lo'i zla6pa'i tshes15nyin gyi mtsho sngon bod yig〈khrims lugs tshags par〉 du 'khod yod/ (spre2003lo'i zla11pa'i tshes5nyin gyi mtsho sngon bod yig(khrims lugs 242

tshags par〉 du 'khod yod/(12003lo'i zla8pa'i tshes15nyin gyi mtsho sngon bod yig〈khrims lugs tshags par〉 du 'khod yod/(spre2003lo'i zla10pa'i tshes26nyin gyi(mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 du 'khod yod/(gro2003lo'i zla7pa'i tshes12nyin gyi〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 du 'khod yod/(rlu2000lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/(mi2000lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/〈yi1999lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb bzhi par 'khod yod/〈〈1996lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/(spre1991lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/tsan+t+ra1991lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/lnga pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig dpyad rtsom bshad pa/rtsom rig gi skyon yon la dpyad pa ni rtsom rig gzhung lugs dang mdzes dpyod kyi gzhi rtsa'i lta ba spyad nas rtsom rig gi snang tshul dang rtsom rig gi gnad don yod tshad la dbye zhib dang gdeng 'jog byed pa'i rtsom rig gi bya 'gul zhig yin zhing / de dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom bar du phan tshun 'bral thabs med pa'i 'brel ba dam po ldan pa ste/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya bzhag 'phel rgyas su phyin pa des rtag tu rtsom rig dpyad brjod byed pa dar rgyas gong 243

'phel du gtong ba dang / rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyis kyang phyir rtsom rig gsar rtsom la mdzub ston dang yar skul byed par ma zad/ klog pa po'i rtsom rig rol myong gi nus pa skyed sring dang mthor 'degs su gtong nges red/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod ni rtsom pa po dang klog pa po/ gsar rtsom dang rol myong bcas bar du med du mi rung ba'i zam pa zhig red/ der brten/ dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du bod kyi rtsom rig de brjod don dang rnam pa/ sgyu rtsal dang rnam grangs sogs phyogs so so nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung nas lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar pa zhig tu slebs pa dang chabs cig rtsom rig gi skyon yon brjod pa'i dpyad rtsom sna tshogs kyang brgya lhag cig thon pa red/ de dag brjod bya'i nang don gyi ngos nas dbye na phyogs gsum du 'dus pa'o/ /gcig deng rabs rtsom rig skor gyi dpyad rtsom/dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du bod la snyan ngag dang sgrung gtam/ lhug rtsom sogs brtsams chos gsar pa ha cang mang po thon par ma zad/ de dag gi dge skyon brjod pa'i dpyad rtsom yang chab brag yon tan rgya mtsho'i〈bod kyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom skor gyi gnad don 'ga'/ 1981— —1984lo'i bar gyi sgrung gtam thung ngu bklags rjes kyi 'char snang /〉①dang / rgan dor zhi'i〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs mtshon pa'i tshig phreng ngag gi rol dbyangs las brtsams te snyan tshig 'bri stangs cung zad gleng ba〉② sbrang char gyi〈244

bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa gong du spel ba'i skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'〉② stobs rgyal gyi〈dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dang de'i 'phel phyogs kyi gnad don la dpyad pa〉②mkhab chos 'phel gyi〈sgrung gtam gsar rtsom gyi skor rags tsam bshad pa〉⑤ go po lin gyi〈dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya'i bstan don skor rags tsam gleng ba〉⑥ bkra shis dpal ldan gyi〈don grub rgyal gyi rtsom dang des bod rigs kyi rtsom rig gsar par thebs pa'i shugs rkyen skor〉② lhag pa chos 'phel gyi〈bod kyi snyan rtsom gsar pa'i khyad chos skor che long tsam brjod pa〉tshu 'ju skal bzang gi(deng rabs snyan ngag ngo sprod rags bsdus log rtog mun pa sel ba'i skya rengs〉⑨ mgon po'i〈gsar bzhad 'dab phreng dgod pa'i bkrag mdangs/ — — gsar byung lhug rtsom du ma'i khyad chos rags tsam brjod pa〉⑪ tshe rdor gyi〈dus rabs gsar pa'i bod yig gi rtsom rig bya bzhag la blta ba〉⑪ kun dga'i〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor gleng ba〉⑪sogs bcu phrag mang po thon zhing / zur dang ngos sna tshogs nas skabs 'di'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi snang tshul dang 'phel phyogs/bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun/ brjod bya'i bstan don/ rtsom stangs/ khyad chos/ rtsom gshis sogs la dpyad zhib zab mo byas nas/ legs cha khas len dang zhan cha gsal 'don/ nor 'khrul ther 'don/ nyams myong phyogs sdom/ bsam 'char drang brjod/ 'bad phyogs gsal 245

ston bcas byas yod/ dper na/ 〈bod kyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom skor gyi gnad don 'ga'〉 zhes pa las rtsom pa pos1981lo nas1984lo'i bar du(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 steng bkod pa'i sgrung gtam thung ngu rnams bklags rjes 'char snang dang bsam 'char 'di ltar bton yod/ don tshan dang por1979lo nas bzung gsar du 'tshar longs byung ba'i rtsom pa po rnams kyis bod yig gi steng nas sgrung gtam mang po brtsams nas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa'i dus rabs kyi dbye mtshams ldan pa'i lam gsar zhig btod rjes/ rtsom pa po 'bor chen zhig la skul ma thebs pa dang / bod yig gi dus deb mang po gsar du spel nas rtsom yig 'grem spel byed sa yod par gyur pas/ sgrung gtam sngar las mang po zhig brtsams shing spel te bod kyi spyi tshogs dang dus rabs so so'i dpe ris sna tshogs klog pa po'i spyan sngar phul zhing / bod kyi rtsom rig dang khyad par du deng rabs rtsom rig dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar nus pa chen po bton pa khas blangs pa dang chabs cigaskabs de'i sgrung gtam la dpyad pa btang nas sgrung gtam la la lhug rtsom la gtogs pa dang / la la go bde sgrung gtam la gtogs pa/ la la gtam rgyud la gtogs par bstan yod/don tshan gnyis par gtso bo sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad pa btang ste/ skabs de'i sgrung gtam du mi sna dang khor yug bris yod kyang dper 'os kyi chu tshad shin tu zhan par ma 246

zad/ brtsams chos mang por mi sna dang khor yug bris pa ha cang rig 'drar gyur yod pa dang / sgrung gtam gsar rtsom byas par rnam pa'i thad gsar gtod rang bzhin zhan pa dang nang don thad rgya chung la gting mi zab pa/ 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bya dngos bye brag ngos zin med pa dang bsreg bcad brdar gsum gyi sgo nas 'bur du ma thon zhing / las snon gang yang byed thub med pas spyi tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i ngo bo mtshon dka'/ pho mo'i brtse dung mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam mang po thon pa las pho mo'i brtse dung gi bgegs bar chad de phyi ngos tsam nas mi 'ga' re'i gnyen don gyi gegs su gyur pa las/bgegs bar chad de brgyud de spyi tshogs dang dus rabs kyi 'byung rtsa ther 'don byed thub med pa dang klog pa por shes rtogs dang bag chags zam mo ster mi thub pas/ sgrung gtam de dag la skye 'phel gyi nus shugs ha cang chung ba/ rong 'brog gi 'tsho ba'i 'gyur ldog mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam mang po yod kyang phan tshun la 'dra ba mang drags pas/ de 'dra'i gson nyams ldan la yid dbang 'gug pa zhig min zhing / bya dngos kyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid dang khyad chos gang yang gting zab mo zhig ston thub med pa/ ‘‘sems rma'i sgrung gtam’’yang mi nyung pa zhig thon yod kyang phan tshun lad mo byas drags pa'i rkyen gyis phal che ba spyi 'gros can dang srid jus 'grel bshad tsam du gyur pa/ brtsam byar gyur pa'i sa cha dang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i goms srol spyir btang ba'ang mi shes par rang snang 247

gang shar gyis rtog bzo mang po byas pas klog pa po bzhad gad kyi gzhir gyur pa bcas zhan cha bdun tsam bton rjes/ zhan cha de dag 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni/ gcig na rtsom pa por rtsom rig gi blo sbyong med pa dang / gnyis su 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi mi brtan pa/ gsum na sgyu rtsal gyi thabs lam la blo gros kyi rtsal thon med pa/ bzhi na rjod byed tshig gis dben pa bcas yin par bstan pa dang / zhan cha de dag legs por bsgyur nas sgrung gtam gyi spus ka je legs su gtong dgos na/ rtsom pa po gsar pa skyed sring byed par mthong chung mi byed par nges par du cha rkyen bskrun nas rtsom pa por phyogs so so'i shes bya sbyangs brtson byed du bcug ste rig gnas chu tshad mthor 'degs dang 'tsho ba'i nang zab zhugs byed du bcug nas 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi je brtan du gtong dgos par bstan no/ /don tshan gsum par gtam rgyud kyi byung rim dang de'i byed nus kyi ngos nas skabs de'i sgrung gtam la dbye zhib byas nas mi 'dang sa bstan pa ste/ ‘‘nga tsho'i rtsom pa po'i rtsom yig kha shas kyi nang yig tshogs ji 'dra mang po zhig yod kyang byung rim rags rim yin pa dang bkod sgrig byas pa mi legs pas mi sna'i gshis kas byung rim thag gcod yang dag pa zhig byed thub med pa dang / byung rim gyis kyang mi sna'i gshis ka'i 'phel rgyas la 'don pa'i shugs de 'dra'i nus ldan zhig ma red’’zer/don tshan bzhi bar sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes pa dang de'i byed nus kyi 248

ngos nas deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi sgyu rtsal nus shugs dang gson nyams zhan pa ni rtsom pa pos 'tsho ba dngos khrod kyi mi dang bya ba'i phyogs so so'i ma lag de da dung las snon dang snying sdud byas nas dper 'os pa'i gzugs brnyan zhig tu bsgyur ma thub pa dang / sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon thabs dang rjod byed kyi skad char byang cha med pa/'tsho bar cha rgyus med par rang nyid kyi mthong thos tsam dang yang na gzhan gyi ngag sgros tsam shog bu'i steng du phab pa'am rang snang gang shar gyis gtam rgyud rtog bzo byas pa'i rkyen yin pa dang / sgrung gtam nang du rgya skad kyi shan zhugs pa'i skad cha dang / sum rtags dag gsum dang 'gal ba'i gnad don/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sbyor tshul mi 'grig pa/ phrad med pa'i tshig bdag sgra dang tshig grogs pa ba gnyis khyad med du bkol pa/ gzugs 'gyur las tshig la 'gyur ldog med pa/ dus gsum dang skul tshig la dbye ba med pa/ bya byed tha dad dang tha mi dad pa'i las tshig la khyad par med pa bcas ha cang mang pa ni rgya skad kyi shan shugs zab cing bod kyi brda sprod rig par byang cha med pa'am gzab nan ma byas pa'i rkyen yin pas/ don 'di'i rigs la mthong chung mi bya bar gzab gzab bya dgos pa dang / bod yig gi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhir slob sbyong nan tan bya dgos par bstan pa lta bu'o/ /yang / 〈dus skabs gsar ba'i bod kyi sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya'i bstan don skor rags tsam gleng ba〉 zhes par mtshon na/ rtsom 249

pa pos dus skabs gsar ba'i bod kyi sgrung gtam gong du 'phel ba'i go rim nang dge skyon dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'phel phyogs nges pa'i don la dmigs nas1981— —1987lo'i bar gyi〈sbrang char〉dus deb steng du 'khod pa'i sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya'i bstan don la rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun nam snang tshul gyi ngos nas zhib 'jug dang dpyad pa btang nas phyogs sdom byas pa ste/ ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen pos’’rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyi sems su bzos pa'i skyo sdug dang de'i lo rgyus kyi 'byung rkyen dang bcas par 'tshang 'byin dgag rgyag byed pa'i‘‘sems rma mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam’’dang / mi gshis ngan pa'i mi rnams la kun spyod kyi khrims ra'i steng nas kun spyod kyi nyes chad bsgrags te kho tshor bod la sngar nas yod pa'i srol bzang rnams rgyun 'dzin bya dgos pa'i bslab bya bton pa'i mi chos kun spyod kyi sgrung gtam/ bod spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i tshul min gyi bya spyod dang 'os min gyi snang tshul la zur za dang mtshang 'byin byed pa'i zur za'i sgrung gtam/ chos lugs pa rdzun ma'i skyug bro ba'i bya spyod la zur za dang dgag pa rgyag pa dang / cal 'drog dad pa'i rjes su 'brang pa'i mang tshogs khag cig rmongs pa'i gnyid las sad pa'i cong brda sgrog pa'i sgrung gtam/ dus skabs 'di'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs kun spyod dang bsam pa'i 'du shes bcas su gnas pa'i bsgyur bcos dang rnying zhen/ sngon thon dang rjes lus/250

bcings grol dang bkag sdom sogs kyi 'gal ba mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam/ dus tshod ha cang thung ba'i nang du mi sna'i sems kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bang rim dang skad cig gi 'gyur ldog rnams gsal bor ston pa'i rtog pa rang yan gyi sgrung gtam gsar pa mgo 'bus pa bcas rtsom rig gi snang tshul drug bstan par ma zad/ snang tshul de dag 'byung ba'i spyi tshogs kyi rgyab ljongs sam 'byung rkyen/ byed nus/ dge skyon sogs kyang gsal bor bstan yod/yang / 〈bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa gong du spel ba'i skor gyi bsam gzhig 'ga'〉 zhes par rtsom pa pos1980lo nas1988lo'i bar du bod kyi rtsom rig dus deb sna tshogs su spel ba'i brtsams chos sna tshogs kyi grub 'bras dang bzang phyogs khas blangs thogartsom rig gsar rtsom gyi spus tshad mthor 'degs byed dgos na nges par du gnad don bzhi thag gcod bya dgos par bstan/1 mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rgyun 'dzin byed pa dang de gsar bcos byed pa gnyis ji ltar zung 'brel legs po byed pa dang /deng rabs 'du shes kyi dpyad 'jog la brten nas rgyun mi chad par 'gyur ldog dang gong du 'phel bzhin pa'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos la ngos ji ltar 'dzin pa dang go ba ji ltar len pa/ de ji ltar khong du chud pa'am gsal bor mtshon par bya dgos/2 gsar rtsom bya ba'i khrod kyi‘‘bye bragari’dang‘‘spyi khyab’’ ‘‘zab 251

pa’’dang‘‘yangs pa’’bye brag la zab par 'jug pa dang / spyi khyab la rgyus lon byed pa zung 'brel byed rgyu'i gnad don 'di dag cis kyang thag gcod dgos/3 rtsom pa po rnams kyis hur brtson gyis rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang / mtshan nyid rig par slob sbyong byed dgos shing /gzhung gzigs mang du mdzad de/ rang nyid zab cing zhib pa'i bsam blo dang / zab yangs dpag dka'i shes yon/ bla na 'phags pa'i phugs bsam bcas dang ldan pa'i mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i bzo bkod pa zhig tu 'gyur bar brtson pa bskyed dgos/4 rtsom pa po dag gis rang gi mig zung la brten nas lta zhib dang / rang gi rtog shes la brten nas tshor sdud/ rang gi klad par brten nas bsam gzhig byed pa de gtsigs su bzung nas rang gi mi rigs la ngos 'dzin dang rang gi sgyu rtsal rang gshis dang gsar rtsom gyi khyad chos spel bar byas thog rang gi btod pa'i lam ded nas gom pa rim bgrod kyis dus rabs kyi rtsom rig yang rtser 'dzeg dgos/ zhes bstan yod/yang / 〈bod kyi snyan rtsom gsar pa'i khyad chos skor che long tsam brjod pa〉 zhes par rtsom pa pos gsar du dar ba'i rang mos snyan ngag thad kyi grub 'bras dang / nyams myong phyogs sdom gyis de'i dge mtshan mthong bar byas te gong nas gong du spel zhing 'thus sgo je tshang du 'gro ba'i ched du1983lo'i tshun gyi bod kyi rang mos snyan 252

ngag la zhib 'jug dang dpyad pa btang nas/ de la nang don rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / brtse dung gis yongs su phyug pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi thabs 'phrul ngo mtshar ba/ sgra gdangs kyi nyams 'gyur mngon par gsal ba/ mngon gsal dod pos srol rgyun gyi snyan rtsom 'bri stangs rgyun 'dzin byas yod pa/ rjod byed tshig gi sbyor bar rang mos che ba'i khar dmigs bsal tshan pa gong 'og gnyis mthun dgos pa'i lugs shig kyang yod pa bcas kyi dge mtshan nam khyad chos drug yod pa dpe'i sgo nas phyogs sdom byas yod/yang / 〈gsar byung lhug rtsom du ma'i khyad chos rags tsam brjod pa〉 las thog mar lhug rtsom gyi rang bzhin dang khyad chos zhib tu bkral pa dang / de'i nang gses su brtse dung gtsor ston pa'i lhug rtsom dang / don brjod lhug rtsom/ dpyad brjod lhug rtsom gsum yod pa gsal bor brjod rjes/ lhug rtsom gyi khyad chos gsum ste/ rtsom yig hril bo'i sgrig rim cha tshang zhing nang don phun sum tshogs pa/ bris pa'i tshig 'bru nyung na'ang brjod bya'i bsam don cung zab cing go rim gsal ba dang / mtshon bya dang mtshon byed gnyis 'dzoms kyi khyad chos ldan zhing / 'phral du dngos gnas kyi 'tsho ba mtshon thub pa/ rjod byed kyi tshig snyan zhing 'jebs la go bde ba bcas kyi sgo nas skabs der 'grem spel byas pa'i lhug rtsom khag cig gi sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs dang bsam blo'i rang bzhin la dbye zhib byas nas/ legs cha khas len nam bsngags brjod byed pa 253

dang chabs cig ‘‘lhug rtsom la la ni chu sna gar khrid kyi dpe ltar de dag la gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin ches cher mi ldan pa dang /bsam pa'i 'dang rgyag sa yang shin tu khyab chung ba/ 'dzam gling du dar khyab che ba'i mdzes rig gi phyogs nas bltas na'ang skyon gang mang yod’’par bstan yod pa lta bu'o/ /rtsom rig brtsams chos sna tshogs gsar rtsom 'grem spel byas pa dang mnyam du de dag la zur dang ngos du ma nas zhib 'jug dbye zhib byas nas/ bzang bor bstod pa dang nyams myong dang khyad chos phyogs sdom byas pa des rtsom pa po rnams rtsom pa la 'jug par spobs pa cher bskyed dang spro ba je rgyas/ gdeng tshod je che bcas su 'gyur pa dang / zhan cha'am gnad don rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa drang por brjod cing / de dag bcos bsgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'bad phyogs gsal bor bstan pa des rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad kyi zhan cha bcos bsgyur byed cing srol rgyun rtsom rig gi rmang gzhi'i steng blang dor yod pa'i sgo nas phyi rgyal dang mi rigs gzhan pa'i gsar rtsom thabs shes sdud len byed pa/ gsar rtsom gyi nang don je legs dang sgyu rtsal je mtho/ bstan don je zab tu btang nas brtsams chos kyi spus tshad je mtho dang tshad ldan can du 'gyur bar mdzub khrid kyi nus pa chen po bskyed pa dang / klog pa po'i blta klog dang zhib 'jug gi chu tshad je mthor 'gro bar gso byed sman gyi nus pa thon pa deng rabs rtsom rig dus yun thung ngu'i 254

nang phyogs yongs nas yar ngo'i zla bzhin dar rgyas gong 'phel byas te phun sum tshogs por gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa las nges thub/gnyis/ gna' rabs rtsom rig skor gyi dpyad rtsom/bod rigs shes yon pa rnams kyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad je mthor song ba dang / rtsom rig brtsams chos la rol myong dang zhib 'jug byed pa'i nus pa mthor 'degs byung ba/ gna' rabs rtsom rig gi yon tan rtogs shing de la dbye zhib byed pa'i dgos mkho je cher gyur pa bcas dang bstun nas/ gna' rabs rtsom rig gi byung 'phel dang brjod bya'i nang don/ rtsom lus kyi rnam pa/ mtshon don bsam blo/ sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal/ rtsa ba'i khyad chos/bzang gi nyams myong / khrid ston gzhung lugs bcas phyogs yongs nas rgyus lon dang phyogs sdom byas nas gna' bzang deng spyod byed pa'i ched du/ deng gi zhib 'jug rigs lam ltar〈snyan ngag me long〉gi dngos bstan gyi lugs dang deng gi rtsom rig gzhung lugs spyad nas/ gna' rabs rtsom rig la phyogs yongs nas zhib 'jug gting zab mo byas/ de mtshon byed kyi dpyad rtsom la yang dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo'i(dbyangs can ma dang snyan tshig rig pa〉⑪dpal don grub rgyal gyi(bod kyi mgur glu byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus dang khyad chos bsdus par ston pa rig pa'i khye'u rnam par rtsen pa'i skyel tshal〉⑪ tshe ring thar gyi(bod kyi gna' rabs sgrung gtam la 255
