saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyi rtsom rig gi shan zhugs pa'i skor gyi dpyad pa〉⑪'ju skal bzang gi〈bod kyi snyan ngag gi rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas skor rags tsam gleng pa〉⑪ bkra shis phun tshogs kyi〈bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi rigs dang lus kyi rnam grangs la che long tsam dpyad pa〉⑪ chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi〈bod kyi gab tshig gi byung 'phel dang khyad chos mdo tsam brjod pa〉⑪ rdo rje rin chen gyi〈lha sgrung dang rtsom rig bar gyi 'brel ba bshad pa〉⑪ rnam sras kyi〈rgya gar gyi rig byed gtam rgyud dang bod kyi snyan ngag gi 'brel ba〉spyi phran gyi〈bod kyi sgyu rtsal rtsom rig la thub pa'i skyes rabs kyi shan zhugs tshul gleng pa mkhas pa'i legs bshad 'dren pa'i dar dkar ring mo〉spyi bon po'i(sa skya legs bshad kyi mtha' dpyod skal bzang yid kyi dga' ston〉spyi ldong spel chos grags kyi(bod kyirtsom rig gi tshad gzhi brjod pa drang srong tshangs thig〉yi lha mchog rgyal gyi(snyan ngag me long gis bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la thon pa'i nus pa mdo tsam brjod pa〉nyisogs bcu phrag mang po gsar rtsom 'grem spel byas/ dpyad rtsom de dag gis zur dang ngos mang po nas bod gna' rabs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos dang gzhung lugs bstan bcos la zhib 'jug gting zab mo byas te/rtsom lus so so'i byung 'phel dang de'i chos nyid/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos/ gsar rtsom gyi nyams myong / rtsom rig gi snang tshul bcas tshan rig dang mthun pa'i sgo nas phyogs sdom byas pa dang / brtsams chos 256

snga phyis kyi 'brel ba dang rgya bod rtsom rig bar gyi 'brel ba/ rtsom lus so so'i dbye ba bcas gsal bor byas pa/ rtsom rig gi tshad gzhi gtan la phab pa des gna' rabs rtsom rig la slob sbyong dang rol myong / rgyus lon/ zhib 'jug bcas byed par gzhung lugs kyi khrid ston nus pa bskyed pa dang / gna' bzang deng spyod byas nas bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig phyogs yongs nas yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro par dge mtshan ldan pa'i phan nus bskyed pa red/gsum/ rtsom rig shes bya'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom/dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du brtsams chos sna tshogs gsar rtsom byed pa dang de dag gi dge skyon brjod pa'i dpyad rtsom spel ba'i dus mnyam du skabs de'i brtsams chos kyi zhan char dmigs nas rtsom rig shes bya dang gsar rtsom byed stangs ston pa'i dpyad rtsom yang mi nyung ba zhig spel nas deng rabs rtsom rig sngar las yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar skul 'ded byed pa red/ dper na/(sgrung gtam gsar rtsom gyi skor rags tsam bshad pa〉ni rtsom pa pos1989lo'i sngon du spel ba'i sgrung gtam mang po zhig la sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos med pa dang / yid 'gug gi nus pa zhan pa ni sgrung gtam rtsom rtsal la byang cha med pa dang / sgos su sgyu rtsal gyi byung rim gdam gses dang bcud sdud byed stangs skor gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi shes bya zhan pa'i lan par nges nas brtsams pa ste/gtso bor gtam rgyud kyi byung rim dang brjod don gtso bo/ sgrig gzhi 257

sogs ji 'dra yin pa re re bzhin ngo sprod gsal po byas rjes/ byung rim gdam gses dang bcud sdud byed pa brgyud nas brtsams chos nang du mtshon pa'i 'tsho ba ni dngos yod 'tsho ba las shugs che zhing dper 'os pa/ slob gso'i don snying ldan pa zhig yong ci thub bya dgos shing / byung rim gdam gses dang bcud sdud byed pa'i bya rim du bsam tshod dang rtog bzos dngos yod nyams myong dang myong tshor mi ldang ba kha gsab byed thub par ma zad/ rtsom pa pos gsar du btod pa'i sgyu rtsal gzugs brnyan de bas phun sum tshogs pa dang tshad mtho'i gcig sdud kyi rang bzhin ldan par gtong nus shing / byung rim nying sdud dang blo khog chen pos bsam tshod dang rtog bzo byed pa'ang 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang myong tshor gyi rmang gzhir brten pa dang / mi sna'i rang gshis mtshon pa'i dgos mkho dang bstun dgos pa'i gnas lugs brjod pa/ brjod don gtso bo ni sgyu rtsal bsam gzhig gi lte gnad yin zhing de 'tsho ba dang byung rim/ mi sna'i gzugs brnyan bcas las rang shugs su mtshon dgos tshul brjod pa/ sgrig gzhi'i gzhi 'dzin sa ni sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya dngos te 'tsho ba dngos yin pa dang / byung rim brjod pa des mi sna zhib 'bri byed par zhabs 'degs zhu dgos tshul/ sgrung gtam gyi mgo ji ltar rtsom pa dang mjug ji ltar sdud pa sogs dpe'i sgo nas gsal bor bstan pa red/yang / (deng rabs snyan ngag ngo sprod rags bsdus log rtog 258

mun pa sel ba'i skya rengs〉 ni/ rtsom pa pos dus skabs gsar par thon pa'i‘‘deng rabs snyan ngag’’khag cig deng rabs snyan ngag ces pa'i tshig ris kyi tshon mdangs la zhen mos byed pa tsam las don du de'i rang bzhin dang / khyad chos/ ngo bo/ zab gnad sogs kyi skor la sha zin spu zin tsam las ma byung ba'am tha na nye phyogs tsam du'ang ma song ba dang / 'ga' zhig deng rabs snyan ngag ces pa tshigs bcad kyi rkang par ring thung btod pa tsam la 'dod cing /'ga' zhig deng rabs snyan ngag ces pa gtso bo bsam blo'i rang bzhin shugs drag pa'i snyan ngag tsam la ngos bzung pa de dang de 'dra'i log rtog sel ba dang / gzhan yang 'di phyogs la mos pa yod pa rnams la phan par dgongs nas/ deng rabs ring lugs pa'i snyan ngag gi bsam blo'i khyad chos/ deng rabs ring lugs pa'i snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal rtsa don/ deng rabs ring lugs pa'i snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal thabs lam gyi khyad chos bcas ngo sprod gsal po byas yod/yang / 〈snyan ngag gi byung 'phel dang 'brel te skabs so so'i snyan ngag gi go don la cung zad dpyad pa〉yil mtshon na/ rtsom pa po bdud lha rgyal gyis deng rabs dang sngon rabs kyi bod kyi mkhas pa tshos snyan ngag la mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bzhag pa'i dbang gis/ snyan ngag zer ba tshig rgyan la go ba dang / rang rkya thub pa'i rtsom lus bye brag cig la go ba sogs byung bar dmigs shing /dus skabs so so'i snyan ngag gi byung 'phel dang khyad chos gzhir 259

bzung nas 'degs 'jog gsal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa thog ma'i snyan ngag tshig gi rgyan gyis spras pa'i rtsom rig bar ma'i snyan ngagakhyad chos bzhi ldan gyi rtsom rig bye brag pa mtha' ma'i snyan ngag bcas dus skabs so so'i snyan ngag gi go don de rigs chen po gsum du dbye pa lta bu'o/ /dpyad rtsom 'di dang 'di lta bu mang du spel nas rtsom rig shes bya dang gsar rtsom gyi thabs rtsal sna tshogs ngo sprod byas pa dang / gzhung lugs kyi sgo nas zhan cha'i 'byung rkyen dang bcas pa sngog 'don dang yo bsrang byed pa'i bsam 'char bton pa de sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod dang bsdur na grangs ka nyung zhing gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad de 'dra mthon po min rung / skabs de'i bod rigs rtsom pa po rnams kyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad dang rtsom rtsal je mthor 'gro ba dang / rtsom rig gsar gtod kyi snying stobs je cher 'gro ba/ rtsom rig gzhung lugs dang gsar rtsom lag len zung du sbrel nas brtsams chos tshad ldan nam phul du byung ba gang mang spel pa bcas la dge mtshan ldan pa'i phan nus thon pa chos nyid du gyur pas smras ma 'tshal/mdor na/ gna' dang deng gi rtsom rig brtsams chos la zhib dpyod byas nas dge pa'i nyams myong dang skyon gyi bslab bya phyogs sdom byas thog ma 'ongs pa'i 'bad phyogs gsal bor bstan pa dang / deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos spyi'i zhan char 260

dmigs nas rtsom rig shes bya dang gzhung lugs dpe dang sbrel nas ngo sprod byas pa des rtsom pa po rnams kyi rtsom rtsal je legs dang rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad je mthor 'gro pa dang /brtsams chos tshad ldan can dang brjod bya spyi tshogs can/ rtsom lus sna 'dzoms can/ sgyu rtsal tshad mtho can/ mtshon don gting zab can bcas kyi phyogs su 'phel bar mdzub ston dang skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po thon pa yin no/ /gsal bshad/()1986lo'i(sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/②1988lo'i〈zla zer〉 deb dang po dang gnyis par 'khod yod/()1988lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/()1988lo'i(krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/()1989lo'i〈lho kha'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb gsum pa dang1991lo'i deb gnyis pa dang gsum pa bcas su 'khod yod/(bye1989lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/(11989lo'i〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉 deb dang por 'ikhod yod/()1990lo'i〈 krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/()1991lo'i(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/(rlu1992lo'i〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/()1999lo'i(bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(yi1997lo'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 deb dang por 'khod yod/261

(smra1990lo'i〈sbrang char〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/〈nye1997lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈dpal don grub rgyal gyi gsung 'bum〉 pod gsum par 'khod yod/(yi(yirkyunye1991lor krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i(bod kyi shes rig dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉 deb gnyis par 'khod yod/(snye1990lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/(1(grorkyunye1992lor krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈bod kyi shes rig dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉 deb gsum par 'khod yod/tun+t+ratunyerkyunye1996lor krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈bod kyi shes rig dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉 deb bzhi bar 'khod yod/rkyunye1993lo'i〈sprang char〉 deb bzhi par 'khod yod/7 262

drug pa/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig bshad pa/dus skabs gsar ba'i nang du bod skad kyi rgyang sgrog dang brnyan 'phrin/ glog brnyan/ sgra gzugs par bskrun bcas kyi las rigs 'phel rgyas su song ba dang / dmangs khrod du yi ge shes mkhan je mang du song zhing rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig phyogs yongs nas dar rgyas chen po byung ba dang bstun nas/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig nyams su myong ba'i spro ba ngang gis nyams pas/ dmangs rtsom gsar pa rtsom pa yang ltos bcas kyis nyung par gyur/ bod rigs las byed pa dang shes yon can khag cig gis skabs bab kyi dril sgrog dgos mkho dang brjod 'dod bsam blo ltar tang dang rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag mes rgyal dang mi rigs mthun sgril/ 'thab phyogs so so'i dar rgyas kyi rnam pa/ spyi tshogs gsar pa'i 'tsho ba/ lo rgyus kyi don dag gal chen bcas la bstod bsngags brjod pa dang / spyi tshogs steng gi tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bya ngan spyod ngan la 'tshang 'byin dgag rgyag byed pa'i dmangs glu gsar pa dang / gtam rgyud gsar pa/ khed dam gab tshig gsar pa sogs brtsams yod kyang / grangs ka mi mang pa dang 263

skabs 'di'i rtsom rig gi 'phel phyogs sam snang tshul gtso bo zhig tu 'gyur thub med/ yin na'ang / dmangs khrod rtsom rig sngog 'don dang dag sgrig khyab spel/ dpe skrun/ zhib 'jug lo tsā sogs bya bzhag la lo rgyus steng byung ma myong ba'i grub 'bras chen po blangs pas/ gsham du'ang gtso bor phyogs 'di dag nas cung zad bshad par bya'o/ /gcig dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi 'chad nyan spel ba/tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su slob grwa chen mor rgyugs sprod pa'i lam lugs slar gso byas pa dang chabs cig krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ lho nub mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ bod ljongs mi rigs slob grwa chen mo sogs kyis bod kyi skad dang rtsom rig ched las bcos bsgyur byed skabs(bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig spyi bshad〉 dang〈bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig lta klog〉sogs slob tshan kha gsab byas pa dang / bod kyi dmangs khrod brtsams chos dang 'dzam gling spyi spyod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig gzhung lugs zung du sbrel ba'i slob deb rtsom sgrig byas nas 'chad nyan spel bar ma zad/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo sogs kyis ched du gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dang dmangs khrod rtsom rig thad kyi zhib 'jug slob ma'ang skyed sring 264

byed bzhin yod/ bod la lo rgyus steng 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan gyis 'gran dka' ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung rung de gzhung lugs dang sbrel nas 'chad nyan byed pa'i srol ni sngon chad byung ma myong ba 'dra/ des na rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs kyi slob grwa chen mo so sos bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor gyi slob tshan bkod sgrig byas pa dang zhib 'jug slob ma'i ched las btsugs nas 'chad nyan spel pa des bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i mtho rim ched las mi sna mang po skyed sring byas par ma zad/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'chad nyan dang de'i slob deb rtsom sgrig byed pa de nyid bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi ngo bo dang byed nus/ khyad chos/ gsar rtsom gyi nyams myong / 'phel 'gyur gyi chos nyid/ zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras sogs phyogs sdom byas nas/ gzhung lugs kyi sgo nas khyad spel dang rol myong byed pa'i bya rim gal chen zhig tu song yod/gnyis/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig khyab spel byed pa/bod mi rigs kyis gna' bo'i dus nas dmangs khrod rtsom rig phun sum tshogs pa zhig brtsams yod kyang / de yi ger 'god pa'i cha rkyen zhan la deng rabs nang bzhin sngon thon gyi dril sgrog yo byad kyang med pas/ de khyab spel byed pa'i thabs lam gtso shos ni ngag thog yin pa gna' bo'i dus su sgrung la‘‘rna sgrung’’①zer pa las gsal/ des na ngag thog nas 'chad thengs re re'i nyan mkhan la 265

tshad yod pa dang / nyan mkhan gyi yid 'dzin la'ang bzang ngan yod pas/ bshad bshad thams cad kun gyis shes pa dang nyan nyan yod tshad yid na 'dug pa'i nges pa med/ der rten dmangs khrod kyi brtsams chos yod do cog dus yun thung thung zhig gi nang du sa khyon chen por khyab mi thub pa dang / mi mang pos rol myong byed thub kyin med/ der ma zad brtsams chos kha shas yun ring ma song par nyams zad du gyur cing / brtsams chos la la lo rgyus kyi dus rim mang po brgyud pas skad cha'i thad dus rabs kyi khyad chos med par gyur/don de la 'brel yod las khungs kyis yid 'jog chen po byas nas bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa dang /bod rigs mang tshogs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs por gtong ched/ mtsho sngon zhing chen rig gnas thin gyis〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉 zhes pa'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi dus deb gsar du spel ba dang / bod ljongs mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang gis(bod ljongs mang tshogs rig rtsal〉lam〈spang rgyan me tog〉 ces pa'i dus deb gsar spel byas nas/ bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi glu khed dam glu mdud/ kha mtshar/ glu shags/ skor gzhas/ nang ma/ chang gzhas/ la gzhas/ las gzhas sogs glu gzhas sna tshogs dang / lha sgrung dang gtam rgyud/ byis sgrung / gling sgrung sogs sgrung rigs sna tshogs/ sa bshad dang ston bshad/ chang bshad/ skra bshad/ ja bshad/ rogs bshad/ rta bshad/ nas bshad sogs bshad pa sna tshogs/ khed dam 266

gab tshig gtam dpe sogs dang / de min dmangs khrod rtsom rig la zhib 'jug byas pa'i ched rtsom bcas 'khod nas 'grem spel byas par ma zad/ (bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉dang〈sbrang char〉 〈zla zer〉 (spang rgyan me tog〉 (lho kha'i rtsom rig〉 (gangs ljongs rig gnas〉sogs rtsom rig dus deb dang / 〈bod ljongs tshags par〉 (bod yig) mtsho sngon(bod yig gsar 'gyur〉 (gangs can na chung tshags par〉 mtsho sngon bod yig(khrims lugs tshags par〉 mtsho sngon bod yig〈tshan rtsal tshags par〉sogs su'ang dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi le tshan btod nas brtsams chos sna tshogs spel ba dang / de mtshungs su bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang brnyan 'phrin khang / mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang brnyan 'phrin khang sogs kyis kyang bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor gyi le tshan sna tshogs btod nas/ gling ge sar gyi sgrung dang dmangs khrod gtam rgyud/ khed dam gab tshig glu gzhas sogs gtong gin yod/bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig sna tshogs yig thog nas 'tshol sdud legs sgrig byas te 'grem spel byas pa dang / rgyang sgrog dang brnyan 'phrin sogs deng rabs can gyi dril sgrog thabs lam brgyud nas khyab sgrog byas pa des bod rigs mang tshogs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs por btang par ma zad/ bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig rgyun 'dzin dang khyab spel/ rol myong sogs byed par 267

yang byas rjes bla na med pa bskrun no/ /gsum/ sdud sgrig dpe sgrun byed pa/bod gangs can pa ni mtsho bod mtho sgang gi gdod ma'i mi rigs yin zhing lo rgyus kyi dus rim so sor dmangs khrod rtsom rig sna tshogs brtsams nas rol myong gi dgos mkho tshim par byed pa dang thon skyed ngal rtsol la zhabs 'degs zhus par ma zad/ lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi sngon la chab srid la zhabs 'degs zhu pa'i yo byad gal chen du'ang gyur pa‘‘bod kyi chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs’rizhes pas shes thub/ yin yang skabs der bod la da lta'i sgra sbyor gyi yi ge 'di med pas/ 'tshol sdud dag sgrig byed thabs bral la/ srong btsan gyi ring nas da lta'i sgra sbyor gyi yi ge 'di gsar skrun byas kyang shes yon can rnams kyi smyug kha gtso bor nang bstan bod la bsgyur pa dang yig thog brtsams chos rtsom pa'i thad la phyogs pa las dmangs khrod rtsom rig la de 'dra'i mthong chen ma mdzad pas/ brtsams chos gang mang zhig 'tshol sdud dag sgrig byed ma thub/ dus skabs gsar pa'i tshun la rgyal khab gzhung gis bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'tshol sdud dag sgrig dang dpe skrun bya bar mthong chen mdzad nas/ srid jus dang gron dngul/ mi sna bcas kyi thad rgyab rogs chen po byas pa dang chabs cig rim pa so so'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs dang mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang /mi sger bcas kyis dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis dmangs khrod rtsom 268

rig 'tshol sdud dag sgrig byas par ma zad/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang dang mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / mi rigs dpe skrun khang / kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang / si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang sogs kyis dpe skrun 'grem spel byas/ dpe mtshon tsam drangs na/ glu gzhas la〈bod kyi la gzhas gzhon nu 'gug pa'i lcags kyu〉②dang / 〈bod kyi dmangs glu snyan dbang gso ba'i bdud rtsi〉rjo 〈g.yang dkar lug glu〉⑨ 〈bod kyi chang gzhas phyogs bsgrigs〉⑤ (gtsang khul gyi yul glu legs btus〉⑥ 〈dpa' ris dmangs khrod kyi glu snyan ngag gi rol mtsho〉② 〈lho kha'i dmangs gzhas phyogs bsdus〉⑧ 〈a rig glu shags snyan dbang gso ba'i bdud rtsi〉⑨ ('jig rten chos brgyad dga' ba'i bdud rtsi〉⑪ 〈khu byug sngon mo'i mgrin glu〉⑪ 〈dmangs gzhas phyogs bsgrigs〉⑪ 〈bod kyi dmangs khrod glu dbyangs bdams bsgrigs〉⑪ 〈la gzhas mthun pa drug skor〉⑪ 〈glu shags srid pa'i dar lce〉⑪ 〈la shags khrom chen dgu rdzogs〉⑪ 〈rogs 'then rdo rje'i tshe mdud〉⑪ (srid pa'i khugs pa bco brgyad〉⑪ (bod ljongs ngal rtsol glu gzhas〉⑪ (bod kyi dmangs gzhas phyogs bsgrigs〉spyisogs dang / gtam dpe la〈bod kyi gtam dpe mthong ba 'dzum shor〉⑪ 〈bod kyi gtam dpe phyogs bsgrigs〉spyi (bod rigs kyi gtam dpe〉⑪ 〈khams pa'i gtam dpe gces bsdus〉⑫〈gtam dpe〉⑧ (gtsang khul gyi gtam dpe legs btus〉spyi (269

bod kyi gtam dpe phyogs bsgrigs〉spyi 〈gtam brjod mes po'i zhal rgyun〉yisogs shin tu mang / gtam rgyud la〈a khu ston pa'i gtam rgyud〉⑫ 〈gtam rgyud〉⑫ 〈bod ljongs dbus gtsang khul gyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud〉yi 〈gtam rgyud gsar bsgrigs〉nya 〈ro sgrung〉a (ngag rgyun〉⑩ (gna' gtam mthong ba dga' skyed〉yi(mi ro rtse sgrung〉gyi (byis sgrung dga' ba'i rtsed 'jo〉spyisogs yod/bshad pa la'ang(gro tshang gnyen ston ngo mtshar dga' skyed〉⑪ (ston bshad skyid g.yang dga' 'khyil〉⑫ (gnyen bshad thos pa kun dga'〉⑦ 〈gna' rgya'i tshe lo〉0 〈a mdo'i rogs 'then 'dem bsgrigs〉tshu 〈bshad pa〉tshusogs mang po yod/gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la mtshon na de bas kyang mang pa ste/rags rtsis byas na mig sngar 'tshol sdud byas pa'i bod yig gi〈gling sgrung〉lag bris ma dang shing par deb120lhag yod pa dang /dmangs khrod sgrung pas bshad pa zin thor 'khod pa ha lam sgrung khag300lhag yod/ de dag las〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉dang('jang gling g.yul 'gyed〉 (mon gling g.yul 'gyed〉 (bdud 'dul〉sogs sgrung khag80lhag cig dngos su dpe skrun 'grem spel byas par ma zad/ krung go spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi zhib 'jug rnam grangs su gtogs pa'i gling sgrung gces btus deb40dang /bod ljongs kyi sgrung pa grags can bsam 'grub kyis bshad pa'i sgrung khag30lhag da lta dngos su dag sgrig dpe skrun byed kyin yod la/270

sgos su babs sgrung pa grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus dang grags pa/ bsam 'grub sogs kyis(thog gling g.yul 'gyed〉stidang〈gnam the'u gter rdzong〉tshu 〈a stag sha rdzong〉⑤ 〈'ba' kag lo rgyal po'i sgrung〉⑰ 〈bkra shis smon lam lnga〉⑦sogs sgrung gsar pa bcu phrag mang po bshad pa sgrar phab nas dag sgrig dpe skrun byas pa des gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung sngar las 'thus tshang dang tshad ldan du gtong pa dang de'i zhib 'jug las don dar rgyas su 'gro bar skul 'ded chen po byed nges red/dmangs khrod rtsom rig sna tshogs yi ger bkod nas dag sgrig dpe skrun byed pa dang chabs cig sgra gzugs dpe skrun las rigs dar pa'i 'gros dang bstun nas/ dmangs khrod kyi brtsams chos sna tshogs sgra gzugs su phab cing / sgra thag dang 'od sder bskrun nas 'grem tshong byas pa des sa gnas so so'i dmangs khrod brtsams chos brje res dang rol myong / khyab gdal bcas su gtong bar sman gyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyed la/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'tshol sdud dang legs sgrig dpe skrun bcas byed pa'i bya rim du legs sgrig mkhan dang rtsom sgrig pa rnams kyis sngar yod kyi rnam pa srung 'dzin byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng nang don skyar zlos dang gong 'og 'gal ba/ tshig skyon che ba la sogs pa'i skyon cha spangs dor byed cing / brtsams chos hril bo dang brjod bya'i bstan don la dmigs nas nang don 'thus tshang dang gong 'og 'brel chags pa/271

tshig sbyor je legs bcas su btang pas/ bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig nang don cha tshang can dang rnam pa tshad ldan can/ tshig sbyor kun mthun can/ bstan don yar bskyed can sogs kyi phyogs la 'phel zhing 'phel gyin yod pa red/bzhi/ zhib 'jug dar spel byed pa/bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig mang po sdud sgrig dpe skrun dang / 'grem spel byas pa dang bstun nas der zhib 'jug byed rgyu de rgyal khab dang zhing chen rim pa'i zhib 'jug rnam grangs kyi gras su 'god pa dang / yang na de'i skor gyi rig gzhung tshogs 'du rab dang rim pa bsdus nas rig gzhung skor gyi lta ba spel ba'am brje res byas la/ khyad par du gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la zhib 'jug byed pa de thengs mang por rgyal khab dang zhing chen rim pa'i zhib 'jug rnam grangs kyi gras su bzhag pa dang / de'i skor gyi rgyal spyi'i gros mol tshogs 'du thengs drug bsdus pas/ rgyal la/ ba phyi nang gi 'brel yod las khungs dang mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang der yid 'jog byas nas zhib 'jug gi dpyad rtsom dang dpe deb mang po dpe skrun 'grem spel byas pa red/ dper na/ (gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dang bod kyi rig gnas〉⑫ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la dpyad pa kun gsal 'phrul gyi me long〉myi (dmangs srol rig pa dang ge sar dmangs srol rig gnas spyi bshad〉li 〈gling sgrung gi par gyi zhib 'jug〉nya 〈ya mtshan che ba'i gling ge sar sgrung pa'i 272

gsang ba〉ñtsa 〈ge sar sgrung dang 'brel ba'i gtam seng chen nyi ma 'dren pa'i skya rengs dang po〉ñtsa 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dang bod kyi tsho ba〉yisogs dpe deb20lhag dpe skrun byas pa dang / (krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉 dang〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉 (bod ljongs sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug〉sogs kyi steng du dpyad rtsom brgya phrag 'ga' 'grem spel byas shing / de dag gis mi'i rigs rig pa dang chos lugs rig pa/ skad brda rig pa/ lo rgyus rig pa/ skye khams ljongs rgyu rig pa/ rol mo zlos gar rig pa/ dmangs srol rig pa/rtsom rig la sogs pa'i thabs la brten nas/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi lo rgyus kyi sa bon dang / byung 'phel/ khyab khongs/ tsho ba'i mched khungs/ skad cha'i khyad chos/ sgrung glu'i dbyangs rta/ chos lugs dad mos/ rus bla/ sgrung pa/ lo tsā byed stangs/ gling sgrung rig gnas kyi thon khungs gsar gtod dang bed spyod byed pa/ skye khams srung skyob byed pa/ gling sgrung rig pa ji ltar dar spel byed pa sogs kyi thad la ngos dang rig tshan mang po nas zhib 'jug zab mo byas nas tshan rig dang mthun pa'i lta ba gsar pa mang po bton pas/gling sgrung gi brjod bya'i sa bon dang sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos/ mtshon don bsam blo/ sgrung ba'i yon tan sogs gzhi rtsa'i shes bya dang khyad chos rgyus lon byed cing / gling sgrung gi byung ba dang 'phel rgyas/ bod mi rigs kyi rus bla dang chos lugs dad mos/ yul srol goms gshis sogs la zhib 'jug zab mo byed pa'i dpyad gzhi ha cang rtsa 273

chen du gyur la/ gling sgrung rig pa dang bod kyi gna' rabs spyi tshogs la zhib 'jug zab mo byed par rig gzhung gi rin thang chen po dang gzhung lugs kyi don snying gal chen ldan zhing / gling sgrung dang de'i rig gzhung tshan khag dar zhing rgyas par skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po bskyed dang skyed bzhin yod/dmangs khrod kyi rtsom lus gzhan pa'i thad kyi dpyad rtsom yangadzñobod gna' rabs kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor brjod pa〉gyidang / 〈bod rigs dmangs khrod gtam rgyud kyi byung 'phel dang de'i chos lugs kyi lta ba'i skor la cung dpyad pa〉spyi 〈lha sgrung dang rtsom rig bar gyi 'brel ba bshad pa〉nya 〈bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom lus lde'u bshad pa〉⑫ 〈bod rigs kyi gtam dpe'i mtshan nyid la thog ma'i dpyad pa mdo tsam〉spyi (bod rigs byis pa'i rtsom rig skor rags tsam brjod pa〉rgya 〈bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig las dmangs glu'i skor gleng ba〉nyasogs shin tu mang zhing /dpyad rtsom de dag gis rig gnas dang mi'i rigs rig pa/dmangs srol rig pa/ mi rigs rig pa/ rtsom rig gzhung lugs/ lo rgyus rig pa/ sems khams rig pa sogs kyi thabs la brten nas/bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi rtsom lus so so ste lha sgrung dang gtam rgyud/ ngag rgyun/ glu gzhas/ bshad pa/ gtam dpe/ khed dam lde'u/'bras dkar/ byis sgrung sogs kyi go don dang byung 'phel/ khyad chos/phan yon/ shan shugs/ sdud sgrig nyar tshags byed tshul sogs la ngos 274

dang zur mang po nas zhib 'jug gting zab cing zhib tshags po zhig byas nas/ rtsom lus so so'i go don gtan la 'beb cing byung 'phel gyi chos nyid dang khyad chos phyogs sdom byed pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba dang spyi tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba gsal bor byed pa/ mi rigs gzhan gyi dmangs rtsom bod la khyab pa dang de'i shan zhugs tshul zhib tu ston pa/ ma 'ongs par 'bad brtson dang zhib 'jug bya yul gang la byed pa gsal bor bton pas/ bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig la phyogs yongs nas rgyus lon yang dag byed pa'i dpyad gzhi rtsa chen zhig yin zhing / bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa dang zhib 'jug mtha' 'khyol ba zhig 'khyongs par rig gzhung gi rin thang dang khrid ston gyi don snying ha cang chen po zhig ldan pa red/mi rigs gang zhig yin rung de'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dus dang 'tsham pa'i 'phel rgyas chen po zhig bya dgos na/ rang gi sngar yod kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mi rigs gzhan gyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal nang 'dren byed pa dang de'i legs cha sdud len bya dgos pa ni ha lam chos nyid lta bur gyur pas/ rim pa so so'i 'brel yod las khungs dang bod kyi shes yon can rnams kyis kyang bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig rol myong dang 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho bskong pa'i don du/ rang gi dmangs khrod brtsams chos sna tshogs 'tshol sdud legs sgrig dang /dpe skrun 'grem spel/ zhib 'jug sogs kyi bya bar brtson pa chen po 275

spyad nas grub 'bras bla na med pa blangs par ma zad/ 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan gyi dmangs rtsom sdud sgrig yig sgyur byed pa dang /khyad par du gtam rgyud sna tshogs bod la mang po 'gyur zhing par du btab pa red/ de yang dpe mtshon tsam drangs na/ bkra shis sgrol mas bsgyur pa'i〈'dzam gling dmangs khrod sgrung〉yidang / tshe ring don grub kyis bsgyur ba'i〈mtshan zhag stong gi gtam rgyud〉8dpal 'dzoms dang lhag pa tshe ring gis bsgyur pa'i rgyal spyi'i phul byung byis pa'i gtam rgyud(phyi rgyal gyi phul byung byis pa'i gtam rgyud〉slustod cha dang smad cha/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bsgyur zhing par du bskrun pa'i(dbyis so'i gtam rgyud〉spyi lo byi h+phu sogs kyis sdud sgrig byas shing las dang len sogs kyis bsgyur pa'i(a mas gsungs pa'i sgrung〉spyi(byis pa'i blo sgo 'byed pa'i dpe tshogs) spen pa tshe ring gis bsgyur pa'i〈nor we'i dmangs khrod sgrung gtam〉⑪ lin han tas rtsom sgrig byas shing 'chi med rdo rjes bsgyur pa'i〈kran go dus rabs kyi gtam rgyud〉⑫ lin han tas rtsom sgrig byas shing lhag pa tshe ring gis bsgyur pa'i〈khrun chig dus rabs kyi gtam rgyud〉⑪ khren len khra'o dang tshe ring chos 'phel gyis bsgyur pa'i〈han rgyal rabs kyi gtam rgyud〉⑨ shes rab 'od zer gyis bsgyur pa'i(a h+phan thi'i gtam rgyud〉yi yon tan rgya mtsho dang gu ru mtshos sgrig sgyur byas pa'i〈phyi rgyal gyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud bdams sgrig〉⑪sogs lta bu red/276

gtam rgyud 'di dag ni lo rgyus kyi dus skabs so sor 'dzam gling gi mi rigs khag gi thun mong gi blo gros rtsal las thon pa'i brtsams chos grags can rkyang rkyang yin zhing / de dag gi brjod bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs pas shes bya'i rang bzhin drag la/ sgyu rtsal gyi bro nyams rmad du byung bas yid 'gug gi nus pa che ba/ brjod bya'i dmigs don rnam par dag pas slob gso'i phan nus che ba bcas kyis khyad chos mngon par gsal ba red/ der brten/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi gtam rgyud grags can sna tshogs bod du 'gyur pa 'dis bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig rnam grangs dang rig gnas 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs por 'gyur par ma zad/ 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus kyi 'phel 'gyur dang yul srol goms gshis/bsam blo'i 'du shes/ chos lugs dad mos/ thon skyed byed stangs/spyi tshogs 'tsho ba/ mi chos kun spyod/ mi tshe'i lta ba/ mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba sogs la rgyus lon byed pa'i dpyad gzhi rtsa chen zhig yin la/bod rigs byis pa rnams kyi blo rig rgyas par byed pa dang dmangs rtsom gsar pa rtsom par blo skyed kyi nus pa chen po thebs pa red/mjug sdud pa'i gtam/lo ngo sum cu tsam gyi dus yun la rim pa so so'i 'brel yod las khungs dang mi sger gyis rgyal khab gzhung gi shugs chen po'i rgyab skyor 'og dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'tshol sdud dag sgrig dang /dpe skrun/ 'grem spel/ zhib 'jug lo tsā bcas kyi bya ba rgya chen po 277
